en.s: The Battle of Tetorigawa (手取川の戦い, Tetorigawa no Tatakai) took place near the Tetori River in Japan's Kaga Province in 1577, between the forces of Oda Nobunaga against Uesugi Kenshin. This was destined to be Kenshin's last great battle. Kenshin tricked Nobunaga into launching a frontal attack across the Tedorigawa and defeated him. Having suffered the loss of 1,000 men, the Oda withdrew south.

zh.s: 手取川之战（日语：手取川の戦い，Tetorigawa no Tatakai）于1577年在日本加贺国手取川附近爆发，交战双方是织田信长和上杉谦信的军队。这是谦信最后一场重要战役。谦信诱使信长发动正面进攻，渡过手取川后将其击败。织田军损失1,000人后向南撤退。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Storming of Shelford House was a confrontation of the English Civil War that took place from 1 to 3 November 1645. The Parliamentarian force of Colonel-General Sydnam Poyntz attacked the Royalist outpost of Shelford House, which was one of a group of strongholds defending the strategically important town of Newark-on-Trent.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 舍尔福德庄园突袭是英国内战中的一次交战，发生于1645年11月1日至3日。赛德纳姆·波因茨上将率领议会军进攻王党军驻守的舍尔福德庄园。该庄园是保卫战略要地纽瓦克镇的一系列据点之一。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The siege of Ganja (Persian: پروستن گنجه) during the last phase of the Ottoman–Persian War (1730–1735) resulted in the surrender of the city by its Ottoman garrison after a brave defense was rendered futile by the destruction of the main Turkish army marching to its relief in the battle of Baghavard.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 占贾围城战发生于奥斯曼—波斯战争（1730—1735年）后期。巴格瓦尔德战役中，前来解围的土耳其主力被击溃，奥斯曼守军的坚守因此失去希望，最终交出城市。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的事件开始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: In the Battle of Torgau on 3 November 1760, King Frederick the Great's Prussian army fought an Austrian army under the command of Field Marshal Leopold Josef Graf Daun. The Prussians won a costly victory in one of the bloodiest battles of the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War).

zh.s: 1760年11月3日，腓特烈大帝率领的普鲁士军队与利奥波德·约瑟夫·冯·道恩元帅指挥的奥地利军队在托尔高交战。普鲁士军队付出惨重代价后获胜。这是第三次西里西亚战争（七年战争的一部分）中伤亡最惨重的战役之一。

en.s: The Palaris Revolt of 1762–1765 was led by Juan de la Cruz Palaris, also known as "Pantaleón Pérez", of Binalatongan (now San Carlos City), Pangasinan.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1762年至1765年的帕拉里斯起义由胡安·德拉克鲁斯·帕拉里斯领导，他也被称为“潘塔莱翁·佩雷斯”，来自宾纳洛通安（今圣卡洛斯市，邦阿西楠省）。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的事件开始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The siege of Fort St. Jean (September 17 – November 3, 1775 French: Siège du Fort Saint-Jean) was conducted by American Brigadier General Richard Montgomery on the town and fort of Saint-Jean, also called St. John, St. Johns, or St. John's, in the British province of Quebec during the American Revolutionary War. The siege lasted from September 17 to November 3, 1775.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 圣让堡围城战（法语：Siège du Fort Saint-Jean）发生于美国独立战争期间。美国准将理查德·蒙哥马利率军围攻英属魁北克省圣让镇及其堡垒；该地也称圣约翰、圣约翰斯等。围城战从1775年9月17日持续到11月3日。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: (Main article: Virée de Galerne) The battle of Fougères was a battle on 3 November 1793 at Fougères, during the Virée de Galerne. It was a Vendéen victory. The Vendéens (on their way from taking Mayenne) decided to march on Saint-Malo to make contact with the British and, recently joined by the Chouans, marched on Fougères on the way. Realising the danger, the Republicans prepared to defend the city and castle, with adjudant général Brière gathering 6,000 National Guards and soldiers from line regiments and inspecting the castle's defences. Many administrators chose to leave the city and flee towards Rennes, with some exceptions staying put, such as mayor Lesueur.

zh.s: 富热尔战役于1793年11月3日在富热尔爆发，是旺代叛乱期间的一场战斗。旺代军获胜。他们刚攻下马耶讷，随后决定向圣马洛进军，与英国人接触；一些舒昂党人加入后，部队途经富热尔。共和军意识到危险，准备保卫城镇和城堡。布里埃副将集结了6,000名国民自卫军和线列团士兵，并检查城堡防御。许多行政人员离开城镇，逃往雷恩，但也有少数人留下，例如市长勒叙尔。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1795 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1795, in order to elect the Governor of New Jersey. Incumbent Federalist Governor Richard Howell was unanimously re-elected by the New Jersey General Assembly as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1795年新泽西州州长选举于11月3日举行。联邦党籍时任州长理查德·豪厄尔没有对手，由新泽西州议会一致推选连任。

en.s: The 1802 Georgia gubernatorial special election was held on November 3, 1802, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia following the resignation of Governor Josiah Tattnall due to declining health. Democratic-Republican candidate and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Georgia's at-large congressional district John Milledge defeated Federalist candidate and candidate for Governor in 1801 Thomas P. Carnes in a Georgia General Assembly vote.

zh.t: 1802年美国佐治亚州州长特别选举
zh.s: 1802年美国佐治亚州州长特别选举于11月3日举行，旨在选出新州长，接替因健康状况恶化而辞职的约西亚·塔特纳尔。民主共和党候选人、曾任佐治亚州单一国会选区联邦众议员的约翰·米利奇，在佐治亚州议会投票中击败联邦党候选人托马斯·P·卡恩斯；卡恩斯曾于1801年竞选州长。

en.s: The Greater Poland uprising of 1806 was a Polish military insurrection which occurred in the region of Wielkopolska, also known as Greater Poland, against the occupying Prussian forces after the Partitions of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth (1772–1795). The uprising was organized by General Jan Henryk Dąbrowski to help advancing French forces under Napoleon in liberating Poland from Prussian occupation.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1806年大波兰起义是波兰军队在大波兰地区发动的军事起义，反抗瓜分波兰立陶宛联邦（1772—1795年）后占领该地的普鲁士军队。扬·亨利克·东布罗夫斯基将军组织起义，以协助拿破仑率领的法军向前推进，解放被普鲁士占领的波兰。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的事件开始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1810 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1810, in order to elect the governor of New Jersey. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Joseph Bloomfield was unanimously re-elected by the New Jersey General Assembly as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1810年新泽西州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主共和党籍时任州长约瑟夫·布卢姆菲尔德没有对手，由新泽西州议会一致推选连任。

en.s: The Battle of Vyazma (3 November 1812; 22 October by OS), occurred at the beginning of Napoleon's retreat from Moscow. In this encounter, a Russian force commanded by General of the Infantry Miloradovich pressed and inflicted heavy losses on the rear guard of the Grande Armée. The Grande Armée was retreating back along the already devastated road, experiencing a shortage of food, a consequence of the Battle of Maloyaroslavets.

zh.s: 维亚济马战役发生于1812年11月3日（儒略历10月22日），当时拿破仑的军队刚开始从莫斯科撤退。米洛拉多维奇步兵上将指挥的俄军进攻法军大军团后卫部队，并使其遭受重大损失。大军团沿着已经被破坏的道路撤退，粮食短缺；这一局面是在马洛亚罗斯拉韦茨战役后形成的。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: The Battle of Tallushatchee was a battle fought during the War of 1812 and Creek War on November 3, 1813, in Alabama between Red Stick Creeks Native Americans and United States dragoons. A cavalry force commanded by Brigadier General John Coffee was able to defeat the Creek warriors.

zh.s: 塔卢沙奇战役于1813年11月3日爆发，是1812年战争和克里克战争期间的一场战役。战斗发生在阿拉巴马州，交战双方是红棍克里克人和美国龙骑兵。约翰·科菲准将率领的骑兵部队击败了克里克战士。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Persian Gulf campaign of 1819 was a British punitive expedition, principally against the Arab maritime force of the Qawasim in the Persian Gulf, which embarked from Bombay, India in November 1819 to attack Ras Al Khaimah. The campaign was militarily successful for the British and led to the signing of the General Maritime Treaty of 1820 between the British and the Sheikhs of what was then known as the "Pirate Coast" and would become known as the Trucial Coast or Trucial States after this treaty.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1819年波斯湾远征是英国发动的一次惩罚性远征，主要针对波斯湾的阿拉伯海上势力卡瓦西姆人。1819年11月，远征军从印度孟买启程，进攻拉斯海马。英国在军事上取得成功，并于1820年与当时被称为“海盗海岸”的地区酋长签署《一般海上条约》；该地区后来因此得名“休战海岸”或“休战诸国”。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的事件开始日期。

en.t: 1828 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 3, 1828, as part of the 1828 United States presidential election. The Democratic ticket of the former U.S. senator from Tennessee Andrew Jackson and the incumbent vice president John C. Calhoun defeated National Republican ticket of the incumbent president John Quincy Adams and the U.S. secretary of the treasury Richard Rush.

zh.s: 印第安纳州于1828年11月3日举行总统选举，是1828年美国总统选举的一部分。民主党候选人、来自田纳西州的前联邦参议员安德鲁·杰克逊及其竞选搭档、时任副总统约翰·C·卡尔霍恩，击败了国家共和党候选人、时任总统约翰·昆西·亚当斯及其竞选搭档、美国财政部长理查德·拉什。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained introduction and main occurrence-date infobox

en.t: 1828 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1828 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 3, 1828, as part of the 1828 United States presidential election. Georgia voters chose 9 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. There were two Andrew Jackson tickets in Georgia representing the two different local parties. The Troup party won with 9,712 votes, beating the Clark (or Clarke) party which got 7,991 votes.

zh.s: 1828年美国佐治亚州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。佐治亚州选民选出9名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。当地有两张安德鲁·杰克逊的候选人名单，分别代表两个地方派系。特鲁普派以9712票获胜，击败获得7991票的克拉克派。

en.s: The 1836 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1836, in order to elect the governor of New Jersey. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the U.S. House of Representatives from New Jersey's at-large district Philemon Dickerson was elected by the New Jersey General Assembly against Whig nominee and former member of the New Jersey General Assembly William Pennington.

zh.s: 1836年新泽西州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党候选人菲利蒙·迪克森是时任新泽西州联邦众议员，代表该州全州选区。他由新泽西州议会选为州长，击败辉格党候选人、前新泽西州议会议员威廉·彭宁顿。

en.t: The Times of India, the world's largest circulated English language daily broadsheet newspaper is founded as The Bombay Times and Journal of Commerce
en.s: The Times of India (TOI) is an Indian English-language daily news and digital news media outlet. It is the third-largest newspaper in India by circulation and the ninth-largest selling English-language daily in the world. It is the oldest English-language newspaper in India and the second-oldest Indian newspaper still in circulation, with its first edition published in 1838. It is nicknamed "The Old Lady of Bori Bunder".

zh.t: 《印度时报》创刊，初名《孟买时报与商业杂志》，是全球发行量最大的英文日报
zh.s: 《印度时报》（TOI）是印度的英文日报及数字新闻媒体。按发行量计算，它是印度第三大报纸，也是全球销量第九的英文日报。它是印度历史最悠久的英文报纸，也是仍在发行的第二古老印度报纸，首期于1838年出版。它还有“博里班德老妇人”的绰号。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The First Battle of Chuenpi was fought between British and Chinese ships at the entrance of the Humen strait (Bogue), Guangdong province, China, on 3 November 1839 during the First Opium War. The British Hyacinth and Volage opened fire on Chinese ships they perceived as being hostile.

zh.s: 第一次穿鼻之战于1839年11月3日爆发，是第一次鸦片战争期间的一场海战。交战双方是英国和中国舰船，战斗地点在中国广东虎门海峡（Bogue）入口处。英国军舰“风信子”号和“伏拉日”号向它们认为有敌意的中国船只开火。

en.t: 1840 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1840 United States presidential election in Tennessee was held on November 3, 1840 as part of the 1840 United States presidential election. Voters chose 15 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Tennessee voted for the Whig candidate, William Henry Harrison, over Democratic candidate Martin Van Buren. Harrison won the state by a margin of 11.32%.

zh.s: 1840年田纳西州总统选举于11月3日举行，是1840年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出15名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。田纳西州支持辉格党候选人威廉·亨利·哈里森，击败民主党候选人马丁·范布伦。哈里森以11.32个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1840 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Louisiana on November 3, 1840 as part of the 1840 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Louisiana voted for the Whig candidate, William Henry Harrison, over Democratic candidate Martin Van Buren. Harrison won Louisiana by a margin of 19.46%.

zh.s: 路易斯安那州于1840年11月3日举行总统选举，是1840年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。路易斯安那州支持辉格党候选人威廉·亨利·哈里森，击败民主党候选人马丁·范布伦。哈里森以19.46个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1840 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1840. Whig Governor Cornelius Comegys was unable to seek re-election to a second term. Former State Representative William B. Cooper ran as the Whig nominee to succeed Comegys and faced Democratic nominee Warren B. Jefferson in the general election. Cooper won the largest victory in a gubernatorial election since 1819, and was ushered into office with a sizable Whig majority in the legislature.

zh.s: 1840年特拉华州州长选举于11月3日举行。辉格党籍州长科尼利厄斯·科梅吉斯无法竞选第二个任期。前州众议员威廉·B·库珀作为辉格党候选人参选，接替科梅吉斯，并在大选中对阵民主党候选人沃伦·B·杰斐逊。库珀赢得了自1819年以来州长选举中最大的胜利，并在辉格党在州议会占据明显多数的情况下就任。

en.s: The Siamese–Vietnamese War of 1840–1845 (Thai: อานามสยามยุทธ (พ.ศ. 2383 – พ.ศ. 2388), Vietnamese: Chiến tranh Việt–Xiêm (1840–1845), Khmer: សង្គ្រាមសៀម-យួន (១៨៤០-១៨៤៥)) was a military conflict between the Đại Nam, ruled by Emperor Minh Mạng and then Emperor Thiệu Trị, and the Kingdom of Siam, under the rule of Chakri King Nangklao.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1840至1845年的暹罗—越南战争（泰语：อานามสยามยุทธ（佛历2383—2388年）；越南语：Chiến tranh Việt–Xiêm（1840—1845）；高棉语：សង្គ្រាមសៀម-យួន（១៨៤០-១៨៤៥））是大南与暹罗王国之间的军事冲突。大南由明命帝及其后继者绍治帝统治，暹罗则由却克里王朝的南告国王统治。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Bombardment of Acre or Storming and Capture of Acre (also known as the "Fourth Battle of Acre") occurred on 3 November 1840. The Oriental Crisis of 1840 was an episode in the Egyptian–Ottoman War in the eastern Mediterranean, triggered by the rebellious Wali of Egypt and Sudan Muhammad Ali Pasha's aims to establish a personal empire in the Egypt Eyalet.
en.n: The Bombardment of Acre or Storming and Capture of Acre (also known as the "Fourth Battle of Acre") occurred on 3 November 1840.

zh.s: 阿克里炮击战或阿克里攻占战（又称“第四次阿克里战役”）发生于1840年11月3日。1840年东方危机是埃及—奥斯曼战争在东地中海地区的一段冲突，起因是埃及和苏丹总督穆罕默德·阿里帕夏发动叛乱，试图在埃及行省建立个人帝国。
zh.n: 1840年11月3日发生了阿克里炮击战或攻占战（又称“第四次阿克里战役”）。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1845 Mississippi gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1845, to elect the governor of Mississippi. Albert G. Brown, a Democrat won against Whig Thomas Coopwood and candidate Issac N. Davis.

zh.s: 1845年密西西比州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党人阿尔伯特·G·布朗击败辉格党人托马斯·库普伍德和艾萨克·N·戴维斯，当选州长。

en.s: The 1846 Delaware gubernatorial special election was held on November 3, 1846. A year into the term of Whig Governor Thomas Stockton, elected in 1844, he died, elevating State Senate Speaker Joseph Maull to the governorship. Maull, in turn, also died, making State House Speaker William Temple Governor. Former State Representative Peter F. Causey ran as the Whig nominee to succeed Temple, and faced former State Senator William Tharp, the Democratic nominee from 1844.

zh.s: 1846年特拉华州州长特别选举于11月3日举行。1844年当选的辉格党州长托马斯·斯托克顿在任期开始一年后去世，州参议院议长约瑟夫·莫尔接任州长。随后莫尔也去世，州众议院议长威廉·坦普尔继任州长。前州众议员彼得·F·考西作为辉格党候选人参选，接替坦普尔，并对阵民主党候选人、前州参议员威廉·索普；索普曾在1844年参选。

en.s: The 1846 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1846. Incumbent Governor Silas Wright ran for a second term in office but was defeated by John Young. Young won with the support of the Anti-Rent movement, an armed insurgency of tenant farmers who rebelled against the existing feudal system of landholding.

zh.s: 1846年纽约州州长选举于1846年11月3日举行。现任州长赛拉斯·赖特竞选连任，但败给约翰·杨。杨获得反地租运动支持；这场武装起义由佃农发起，反对当时的封建土地所有制。

en.s: The 1846 New York state election was held on November 3, 1846, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor and two Canal Commissioners, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and eight members of the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1846年纽约州选举于11月3日举行，选出州长、副州长、两名运河委员、纽约州众议院全体议员和8名州参议员。

en.t: The draft constitution was somewhat reluctantly approved by the States General in slightly amended form, and was proclaimed on 3 November 1848
en.s: Johan Rudolph Thorbecke (14 January 1798 – 4 June 1872) was a Dutch liberal statesman. As the leading figure in the Constitutional Reform of 1848, he is considered the founder of parliamentary democracy in the Netherlands, and the most important Dutch statesman of the 19th century. Born in Zwolle in 1798 to a financially struggling Lutheran merchant family of German origin, Thorbecke attended a Latin school and studied law and humanities in Amsterdam and Leiden.

zh.t: 宪法草案经略作修订后由三级会议勉强通过，并于1848年11月3日公布
zh.s: 约翰·鲁道夫·托尔贝克（1798年1月14日—1872年6月4日）是荷兰自由派政治家。作为1848年宪政改革的主要人物，他被视为荷兰议会民主制的奠基者，也是19世纪最重要的荷兰政治家。他1798年出生于兹沃勒，家境拮据，父母是德国裔路德宗商人；他曾就读拉丁学校，后在阿姆斯特丹和莱顿学习法律与人文学科。

en.s: The 1857 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1857. After incumbent Governor Coles Bashford declined to seek re-election, Republican Party candidate Alexander Randall narrowly defeated Democratic candidate James B. Cross by a margin of just 118 votes. Richland County would not vote for a Democrat again until 1924, nor would Polk County until 1918 and Juneau County until 1892.

zh.s: 1857年威斯康星州州长选举于11月3日举行。时任州长科尔斯·巴什福德放弃竞选连任后，共和党候选人亚历山大·兰德尔以118票的微弱优势击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·B·克罗斯。里奇兰县直到1924年才再次投票支持民主党，波尔克县要到1918年，朱诺县则要到1892年。

en.s: The 1857 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 3. Incumbent Know-Nothing governor Henry J. Gardner ran for a fourth term in office, but lost the support of the Republican Party, which nominated Speaker of the United States House of Representatives Nathaniel P. Banks. Banks prevailed over Gardner to become the first Republican governor of Massachusetts.

zh.s: 1857年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月3日举行。无知党籍时任州长亨利·J·加德纳竞选第四个任期，但失去了共和党的支持。共和党提名了美国众议院议长纳撒尼尔·P·班克斯，班克斯击败加德纳，成为马萨诸塞州首位共和党籍州长。

en.s: The 1863 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1863, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Acting Secretary of State David Blakeley defeated Democratic nominee and former Speaker of the Minnesota House of Representatives Amos Coggswell.

zh.s: 1863年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月3日举行。共和党候选人、时任代理州务卿戴维·布莱克利击败民主党候选人、明尼苏达州众议院前议长阿莫斯·科格斯韦尔。

en.s: The 1863 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1863, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and former Speaker of the Minnesota House of Representatives Charles D. Sherwood defeated Democratic nominee and former Territorial Speaker of the Minnesota House of Representatives James S. Norris.

zh.s: 1863年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党候选人、明尼苏达州众议院前议长查尔斯·D·舍伍德击败民主党候选人、明尼苏达领地众议院前议长詹姆斯·S·诺里斯。

en.s: The 1863 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1863, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Attorney General Gordon E. Cole defeated Democratic nominee William H. Grant.

zh.t: 1863年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1863年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月3日举行。共和党候选人、时任总检察长戈登·E·科尔击败民主党候选人威廉·H·格兰特。

en.s: The 1863 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 3, 1863, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Charles McIlrath defeated Democratic nominee John H. McKinney.

zh.s: 1863年明尼苏达州审计长选举于11月3日举行。共和党候选人、时任州审计长查尔斯·麦克伊拉斯击败民主党候选人约翰·H·麦金尼。

en.s: The Second Battle of Collierville (November 3, 1863), also known as the Action at Collierville, was fought during the American Civil War between the United States (Union) and Confederate States. The fighting occurred during a demonstration on Collierville, Tennessee, by Brigadier-General James R. Chalmers, Confederate States Army. Four minor battles occurred in 1863 in Shelby County during a three-month period.

zh.t: 科利尔维尔第二次战役
zh.s: 科利尔维尔第二次战役于1863年11月3日爆发，也称科利尔维尔行动，是美国南北战争期间北方联邦与南方邦联之间的一场战斗。邦联军詹姆斯·R·查默斯准将率军在田纳西州科利尔维尔进行佯动时，双方发生战斗。1863年，三个月内孟菲斯谢尔比县共发生四场小规模战斗。

en.s: The 1863 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1863. Union candidate James T. Lewis won the election with nearly 60% of the vote, defeating Democratic candidate Henry L. Palmer. The incumbent Governor, Edward Salomon, had ascended to office after the accidental drowning of his predecessor, Louis P. Harvey, in April 1862. He was a former Democrat who had been elected Lieutenant Governor on the Union ticket in 1861.

zh.s: 1863年威斯康星州州长选举于11月3日举行。联邦党候选人詹姆斯·T·刘易斯以接近60%的得票率获胜，击败民主党候选人亨利·L·帕尔默。时任州长爱德华·萨洛蒙于1862年4月在前任州长路易斯·P·哈维意外溺水身亡后继任。他曾是一名民主党人，并于1861年以联邦党候选人身份当选副州长。

en.s: The 1863 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 3. Governor John Albion Andrew was re-elected to a fourth term in office over Democrat Henry W. Paine.

zh.s: 1863年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月3日举行。州长约翰·阿尔比恩·安德鲁击败民主党人亨利·W·佩恩，连任第四个任期。

en.s: The Battle of Bayou Bourbeux also known as the Battle of Grand Coteau, Battle of Boggy Creek or the Battle of Carrion Crow Bayou (Carencro is the Cajun French word for buzzard), which is present day Carencro Bayou, was fought in southwestern Louisiana west of the town of Grand Coteau, during the American Civil War. The engagement was between the forces of Confederate Brigadier General Thomas Green and Union Brigadier General Stephen G.

zh.s: 布尔布河之战又称大科托之战、博吉溪之战或秃鹫湾河口之战（Carencro是卡津法语“秃鹫”的意思；现称卡朗克罗河口），是美国内战期间路易斯安那州西南部的一场战斗，地点在大科托镇以西。交战双方是托马斯·格林准将率领的南方邦联军和斯蒂芬·G。

en.s: The 1864 Victorian colonial election was held from 5 October to 3 November 1864 to elect the 4th Parliament of Victoria. All 78 seats in 49 electorates in the Legislative Assembly were up for election, though sixteen seats were uncontested. There were 24 single-member, 21 two-member and 4 three-member electorates. Support for liberal protectionist candidates dominated this election, to such an extent that the colonial newspapers made no attempt to classify individual elected members as Ministerialists or Oppositionists.

zh.s: 1864年维多利亚殖民地选举于1864年10月5日至11月3日举行，选出维多利亚第四届议会。立法议会49个选区的78个席位全部改选，其中16席没有竞争。选区中有24个单议员选区、21个双议员选区和4个三议员选区。自由贸易保护派候选人在选举中占主导，殖民地报纸甚至没有把当选议员逐一归为政府派或反对派。

en.s: The Battle of Mentana was fought on November 3, 1867 near the village of Mentana between French-Papal troops and the Italian volunteers led by Giuseppe Garibaldi, who were attempting to capture Rome, then the main centre of the peninsula still outside of the newly unified Kingdom of Italy. The battle ended in a victory by the French-Papal troops.

zh.s: 1867年11月3日，法军和教皇国军队在曼塔纳村附近与意大利志愿军交战。意大利志愿军由朱塞佩·加里波第率领，试图攻占罗马；当时罗马是意大利半岛上尚未并入新统一的意大利王国的主要地区。这场战役以法军和教皇国军队获胜告终。

en.s: The Second Battle of Tuyutí was fought on 3 November 1867 between the Paraguayan Army and a smaller allied Brazilian-Argentine force. The Paraguayans lost twice as many soldiers as the allies and were defeated.

zh.s: 图尤蒂第二次战役于1867年11月3日爆发，交战双方是巴拉圭军队和规模较小的巴西—阿根廷联军。巴拉圭军队的伤亡人数是盟军的两倍，最终战败。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1868 was the 21st quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 3, 1868. It was the first presidential election to take place after the American Civil War, during the period referred to as Reconstruction. As three of the former Confederate states (Texas, Mississippi, and Virginia) were not yet restored to the Union, their electors could not vote in the election. The incumbent President, Andrew Johnson, who succeeded to the presidency in 1865 following the assassination of President Abraham Lincoln, was unpopular and failed to receive the Democratic presidential nomination.

zh.s: 1868年美国总统选举是第21次四年一度的总统选举，于1868年11月3日星期二举行。这是美国内战结束后、重建时期的首次总统选举。由于得克萨斯州、密西西比州和弗吉尼亚州这三个前邦联州尚未重新加入联邦，它们的选举人不能参加投票。安德鲁·约翰逊总统于1865年亚伯拉罕·林肯遇刺后接任总统，但他不得人心，也未能获得民主党总统候选人提名。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1868
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1868 were elections for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 3, 1868. California's delegation remained at two Democrats and one Republican.

en.t: United States presidential election in Wisconsin, 1868
en.s: The 1868 United States presidential election in Wisconsin was held on November 3, 1868. Wisconsin voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Republican Party candidate Ulysses S. Grant won the state with 56% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's eight electoral votes.

zh.s: 1868年11月3日举行美国总统选举，威斯康星州选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人尤利西斯·格兰特以56%的普选票赢得该州，并获得威斯康星州的8张选举人票。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1868
en.s: The 1868 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 3, 1868, as part of the 1868 United States presidential election. Voters chose 26 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania voted for the Republican nominee, Ulysses S. Grant, over the Democratic nominee, Horatio Seymour. Grant won Pennsylvania by a margin of 4.4%.

zh.s: 1868年11月3日，宾夕法尼亚州举行美国总统选举。选民选出26名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。宾夕法尼亚州支持共和党候选人尤利西斯·格兰特，击败民主党候选人霍雷肖·西摩。格兰特在该州领先4.4个百分点。

en.t: 1868 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1868 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 3, 1868, as part of the 1868 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. This would be the first time in the state's history where the popular vote was used in the state during the presidential election, with previous elections having used the state legislature.

zh.s: 1868年南卡罗来纳州总统选举于11月3日举行，是1868年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。这是南卡罗来纳州历史上首次在总统选举中采用普选投票；此前选举人由州议会选出。

Grant, over the Democratic nominee, Horatio Seymour. Grant won the state by a narrow margin of 2.98%.

zh.s: 1868年康涅狄格州总统选举于11月3日举行，是1868年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。康涅狄格州支持共和党候选人尤利西斯·S·格兰特，击败民主党候选人霍雷肖·西摩。格兰特以2.98个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1868 United States presidential election in New Jersey

New Jersey voted for the Democratic nominee, former Governor of New York Horatio Seymour, over the Republican nominee, General Ulysses S. Grant.

en.s: The 1868 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 3, 1868, as part of the 1868 United States presidential election. en.t: 1868 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1868 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 3, 1868, as part of the 1868 United States presidential election. Grant, over the Democratic nominee, Horatio Seymour. Grant won his home state by a margin of 11.38%.

zh.s: 1868年伊利诺伊州总统选举于11月3日举行，是1868年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出16名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。伊利诺伊州支持共和党候选人尤利西斯·S·格兰特，击败民主党候选人霍雷肖·西摩。格兰特在家乡州以11.38个百分点的优势获胜。

en.s: The 1868 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1868, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Missouri. Republican nominee Edwin O. Stanard defeated Democratic nominee and former member of the Missouri House of Representatives Norman Jay Colman. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1868年密苏里州副州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党候选人埃德温·O·斯坦纳德击败民主党候选人诺曼·杰伊·科尔曼。科尔曼曾任密苏里州众议院议员。这次选举的准确结果不详。

en.s: The 1868 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 3, 1868, as part of the 1868 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. North Carolina was won by Ulysses S.

zh.t: 1868年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1868年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。北卡罗来纳州选民选出9名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。该州支持共和党总统候选人尤利西斯·S·格兰特。

en.s: The 1868 United States presidential election in Vermont took place on November 3, 1868, as part of the 1868 United States presidential election. zh.s: 1868年佛蒙特州总统选举于11月3日举行，是1868年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。佛蒙特州支持共和党候选人尤利西斯·S·格兰特，击败民主党候选人霍雷肖·西摩。格兰特以57.14个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1868 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1868. Republican nominee Henry P. Baldwin defeated Democratic nominee John Moore with 56.65% of the vote.

en.t: 1868 United States presidential election in Arkansas

Grant became the first of his party to ever carry Arkansas, taking 53.68% of the state's vote to Democrat Horatio Seymour's 46.32%.

zh.s: 1868年阿肯色州总统选举于11月3日举行，是1868年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人尤利西斯·S·格兰特以53.68%的得票率击败民主党候选人霍雷肖·西摩，成为首位赢得阿肯色州的共和党总统候选人；西摩获得46.32%的选票。

en.s: The 1868 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 3, 1868, as part of the 1868 United States presidential election. Grant, over the Democratic nominee, Horatio Seymour. Grant won the state by a margin of 37.65%.

zh.s: 1868年堪萨斯州总统选举于11月3日举行，是1868年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。堪萨斯州支持共和党候选人尤利西斯·S·格兰特，击败民主党候选人霍雷肖·西摩。格兰特以37.65个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1868 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1868 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 3, 1868, as part of the 1868 United States presidential election. Grant, over the Democratic nominee, Horatio Seymour. Grant won the state by a margin of 24.82%.

en.s: The 1868 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 3, 1868, as part of the 1868 United States presidential election. en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 3, 1868, as part of the 1868 United States presidential election. Grant and the speaker of the United States House of Representatives Schuyler Colfax defeated the Democratic ticket of the former governor of New York Horatio Seymour and the former U.S. representative from Missouri's 1st congressional district Francis P.

en.s: The 1868 Missouri gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1868, and resulted in a victory for the Republican nominee, Congressman Joseph W. McClurg, over Democratic nominee former Congressman John S. Phelps. This was the first election a governor was elected to a 2-year term, instead of 4 years. Missouri would return to electing its governors to 4-year terms in 1880.

zh.s: 1868年密苏里州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党提名人、联邦众议员约瑟夫·W·麦克卢格击败民主党提名人、前联邦众议员约翰·S·菲尔普斯，当选州长。这是密苏里州首次选举州长担任两年任期，而非四年任期。1880年起，该州恢复四年一届的州长选举。

en.s: The 1868 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1868. Incumbent Governor Reuben Fenton did not run for re-election to a third term. Mayor of New York City John T. Hoffman won the election over Republican John Augustus Griswold. As of 2026, this is the most recent time any mayor of New York City was elected Governor of New York or any higher office.

zh.s: 1868年纽约州州长选举于11月3日举行。时任州长鲁本·芬顿没有竞选第三个任期。纽约市市长约翰·T·霍夫曼击败共和党人约翰·奥古斯塔斯·格里斯沃尔德，当选州长。截至2026年，这是纽约市市长最近一次当选纽约州州长或更高职位。

en.t: 1868 United States presidential election in Georgia

en.s: The 1868 Illinois gubernatorial election was the fourteenth election for this office. Republican nominee, John M. Palmer defeated the Democratic nominee John R. Eden. en.t: William Claflin wins the Massachusetts gubernatorial election

en.s: The Siege of Belfort (3 November 1870 – 18 February 1871) was a 103-day military assault and blockade of the city of Belfort, France by Prussian forces during the Franco-Prussian War. The French garrison held out until the January 1871 armistice between France and the German Empire obligated French forces to abandon the stronghold in February 1871. Belfort is located in a gap between the mountainous southern Vosges and the Jura Massif, strategically positioned as the gateway between Alsace and central France. At the beginning of the war, the French Army of the Rhine was routed in northern Alsace.

zh.s: 贝尔福围城战从1870年11月3日持续至1871年2月18日，是普鲁士军队在普法战争期间对法国贝尔福市发动的103天进攻和封锁。法国守军坚守到1871年1月，直到法国与德意志帝国停战后，才在2月放弃要塞。贝尔福位于南孚日山脉与汝拉山脉之间的山口，地处阿尔萨斯通往法国中部的战略要道。战争初期，法国莱茵军团在阿尔萨斯北部被击溃。

Washburn, was defeated by Democrat William Gaston, a former mayor of Boston. Gaston was the first Democrat elected governor since George S. Boutwell in 1852, and received the largest share of the vote for any Democrat in the state since the party's founding in 1828.

zh.s: 1874年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党代理州长托马斯·塔尔博特在威廉·B·沃什伯恩辞职后接任，但这次被民主党人威廉·加斯顿击败。加斯顿曾任波士顿市长；他是自1852年乔治·S·巴特韦尔当选以来，首位当选州长的民主党人，也是自1828年民主党成立以来，该州得票占比最高的民主党候选人。

en.s: The 1874 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1874, to elect the governor of Alabama. Incumbent Republican David P. Lewis unsuccessfully ran for reelection, losing to Democratic former U.S. Representative George S. Houston. This election would end an era of serious competition between the local Democratic and Republican parties, and start a 112-year win streak for Democrats in the gubernatorial level.

zh.s: 1874年阿拉巴马州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任州长戴维·P·刘易斯竞选连任失败，败给民主党人、前联邦众议员乔治·S·休斯顿。这次选举结束了当地民主、共和两党激烈竞争的时期，也开启了民主党连续112年赢得州长选举的纪录。

en.s: The last major rebellion of the indigenous Mapuches of Araucanía took place in 1881, during the last phase of the Occupation of Araucanía (1861–1883) by the Chilean state. It was planned by Mapuche chiefs in March 1881 to be launched in November the same year. Mapuche support for the uprising was not unanimous: Some Mapuche factions sided with the Chileans and others declared themselves neutral.
en.n: The Mapuche uprising of 1881 begins in Chile.

zh.s: 1881年，智利国家占领阿劳卡尼亚地区的最后阶段发生了当地马普切人的最后一次大规模起义。马普切首领于1881年3月策划在当年11月发动起义。马普切人对起义的支持并不一致：一些派别支持智利人，另一些则保持中立。尽管如此，起义组织者仍成功争取到此前未曾与智利交战的马普切派别参与。多数袭击在几天内被击退，之后智利继续巩固其征服成果。
zh.n: 1881年马普切人起义在智利爆发。

The same situation occurred with Alexander Lyon Jr. of St.

en.s: The Battle of Wana Camp was a battle on 3 November 1894 between rebel Mahsud tribesmen and a British colonial frontier force stationed in Wana, on the northwestern frontier of the British Raj. The battle began a campaign of offensive actions by British forces in Waziristan to reduce the strength of Mahsud tribes within the area.

zh.s: 1894年11月3日，叛乱的马赫苏德部族武装与驻扎在英属印度西北边境瓦纳的英国殖民地边防部队交战。这场战斗开启了英国军队在瓦济里斯坦采取的一系列进攻行动，目的是削弱该地区的马赫苏德部族。

en.s: The 1896 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1896. Republican Party of Minnesota incumbent David Marston Clough narrowly defeated Democratic Party of Minnesota challenger John Lind. Lind later won the 1898 gubernatorial election and became the first Democrat elected to the office of Governor of Minnesota since Henry Hastings Sibley left office in 1860. 1896 was the first of three successive elections in which Lind ran for governor at the head of a coalition consisting of the Democratic Party and the majority faction of the People's Party.

zh.s: 1896年明尼苏达州州长选举于1896年11月3日举行。共和党籍现任州长戴维·马斯顿·克拉夫以微弱优势击败民主党挑战者约翰·林德。林德后来赢得1898年州长选举，成为自1860年亨利·哈斯廷斯·西布利卸任以来首位当选明尼苏达州州长的民主党人。1896年是林德三次竞选州长中的第一次；他当时代表由民主党和人民党多数派系组成的联盟。

en.t: United States presidential election in Montana, 1896
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Montana took place on November 3, 1896 throughout 45 states. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Montana overwhelmingly voted for the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative from Nebraska William Jennings Bryan over the Republican nominee, former governor of Ohio William McKinley. Bryan won Montana by a landslide margin of 60.22%. Bryan's support for many Populist goals resulted in him being nominated by both the Democratic Party and the People's Party (Populists), though with different running mates.

zh.t: 1896年美国总统选举蒙大拿州结果

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1896 was the 28th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 3, 1896. It was the climax of an intensely heated contest in which Republican candidate William McKinley (a former Governor of Ohio) defeated Democrat William Jennings Bryan (a former Representative from Nebraska) in one of the most dramatic and complex races in American history. The 1896 campaign is often considered to be a realigning election that ended the old Third Party System and began the Fourth Party System. McKinley forged a conservative coalition in which businessmen, professionals, skilled factory workers, and prosperous farmers were heavily represented.

zh.s: 1896年美国总统选举是第28次四年一度的总统选举，于1896年11月3日星期二举行。这场竞选异常激烈且复杂，俄亥俄州前州长、共和党候选人威廉·麦金莱击败了内布拉斯加州前联邦众议员、民主党候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。麦金莱当选被视为一次重组性选举，标志着旧第三党制结束、第四党制开始。麦金莱组成了一个保守派联盟，其成员以商人、专业人士、熟练工厂工人和富裕农民为主。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1896
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. New York voters chose 36 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by the Republican nominees, former Governor William McKinley of Ohio and his running mate corporate lawyer Garret Hobart of New Jersey. McKinley and Hobart defeated the Democratic nominees, former Congressman William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate industrialist Arthur Sewall of Maine.

en.s: The 1896 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896, to elect a Governor of South Dakota to a two-year term. People's Party nominee Andrew E. Lee was elected, defeating Republican nominee Amund O. Ringsrud and Prohibition Party nominee J. F. Hanson. Lee's victory was by the smallest margin in South Dakota gubernatorial election history; he defeated Ringsrud by 319 votes, or 0.39% of votes. Lee was also the only Populist in South Dakota history to serve as governor.

Republican Party candidate William McKinley won the state with 60% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's twelve electoral votes.

zh.t: 1896年威斯康星州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1896年11月3日举行美国总统选举，威斯康星州选民选出12名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人威廉·麦金莱以60%的普选票赢得该州，并获得威斯康星州的12张选举人票。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Florida, 1896
en.s: Elections to the United States House of Representatives in Florida were held November 3, 1896 for two seats in the 55th Congress. These elections were held at the same time as the 1896 Presidential election and the election for Governor. There were a total of five different parties running, including a short-lived breakaway faction of the Democratic Party known as the National Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1896年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1896年11月3日，佛罗里达州举行联邦众议院选举，选出第55届国会的两名代表。选举与当年的总统选举和州长选举同时举行，共有五个政党参选，其中包括民主党短暂分裂后成立的全国民主党。

en.s: The 1896 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896 to select the governor of the state of South Carolina. William Haselden Ellerbe won the Democratic primary and easily won the general election to become the 86th governor of South Carolina.

zh.s: 1896年11月3日，南卡罗来纳州举行州长选举。威廉·哈塞尔登·埃勒比赢得民主党初选，并在大选中轻松获胜，成为该州第86任州长。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1896
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 3, 1896 throughout 45 states. Voters chose 32 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, former governor of Ohio William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative from Nebraska William Jennings Bryan. McKinley won Pennsylvania by a landslide margin of 24.71%.

zh.t: 1896年宾夕法尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1896年11月3日，宾夕法尼亚州举行美国总统选举。选民选出32名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。宾夕法尼亚州以明显优势支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱，击败民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩。麦金莱在该州领先24.71个百分点。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1896
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 3, 1896, as part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose twelve representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Democratic and Populist candidate, former U.S. Representative William J. Bryan over the Republican candidate, Ohio Governor William McKinley.

zh.t: 1896年弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1896年11月3日，弗吉尼亚州举行美国总统选举。选民选出12名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。弗吉尼亚州支持民主党和民粹党共同提名的前联邦众议员威廉·J·布赖恩，击败共和党候选人、俄亥俄州州长威廉·麦金莱。
