en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 3, 1896, as part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Carolina overwhelmingly voted for the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative from Nebraska William Jennings Bryan, over the Republican nominee, former governor of Ohio William McKinley.

zh.s: 1896年南卡罗来纳州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。南卡罗来纳州以压倒性优势支持民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩，击败共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Kansas voters chose ten electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Kansas was won by the Democratic nominees, former U.S. Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate Arthur Sewall of Maine.

zh.s: 1896年堪萨斯州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。堪萨斯州选民选出10名选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及其竞选搭档、来自缅因州的阿瑟·西沃尔赢得堪萨斯州。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 3, 1896, as part of the 1896 United States presidential election. The Republican ticket of the former governor of Ohio William McKinley and the former president of the New Jersey Senate Garret Hobart defeated the Democratic and Populist ticket of the former U.S. representative from Nebraska's 1st congressional district William Jennings Bryan and the president of the Maine Central Railroad Arthur Sewall.

zh.s: 印第安纳州于1896年11月3日举行总统选举，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档、前新泽西州参议院议长加勒特·霍巴特，击败民主党和人民党联合候选人、来自内布拉斯加州第一国会选区的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩，以及缅因中央铁路总裁阿瑟·西沃尔。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Iowa voted for the Republican nominees, former Ohio Governor William McKinley and his running mate Garret Hobart of New Jersey, over the Populist nominees, former Representative William Jennings Bryan, and former Representative Thomas E.

zh.s: 1896年美国爱荷华州总统选举于11月3日举行。当时美国45个州都参加了总统选举。爱荷华州选民选出13名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。爱荷华州支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档、新泽西州的加勒特·霍巴特，击败了民粹党候选人、前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.s: The 1896 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. Republican nominee George A. Ramsdell defeated Democratic nominee Henry O. Kent with 61.41% of the vote.

zh.s: 1896年新罕布什尔州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党候选人乔治·A·拉姆斯德尔以61.41%的得票率击败民主党候选人亨利·O·肯特。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Minnesota was won by the Republican nominees, former Ohio Governor William McKinley and his running mate Garret Hobart of New Jersey.

zh.s: 1896年明尼苏达州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。明尼苏达州选民选出9名选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档、来自新泽西州的加勒特·霍巴特赢得明尼苏达州。

en.s: The 1896 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. People's Party nominee John W. Leedy defeated incumbent Republican Edmund Needham Morrill with 50.55% of the vote.

zh.s: 1896年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月3日举行。人民党候选人约翰·W·利迪以50.55%的得票率击败共和党籍时任州长埃德蒙·尼德姆·莫里尔。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 3, 1896, as part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island voted for the Republican nominee, former governor of Ohio William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative from Nebraska William Jennings Bryan.

zh.s: 1896年罗得岛州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。罗得岛州支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱，击败民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. State voters chose 24 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Illinois was won by the Republican candidate former Governor of Ohio William McKinley and his running mate Garret Hobart of New Jersey.

zh.s: 1896年伊利诺伊州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。该州选民选出24名选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档、来自新泽西州的加勒特·霍巴特赢得伊利诺伊州。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. State voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Washington was won by the People's Party nominees, former U.S. Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate Thomas E.

zh.s: 1896年美国华盛顿州总统选举于11月3日举行。当时美国45个州都参加了总统选举。华盛顿州选民选出4名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。该州支持人民党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.s: The 1896 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. Incumbent Republican Governor William H. Upham retired. Republican nominee Edward Scofield defeated Democratic nominee Willis C. Silverthorn with 59.67% of the vote. Scofield's popular vote share was the highest in the state's history for a gubernatorial candidate to that point, reflecting the state's transition from a Republican-leaning but competitive state to one dominated by the Republicans.

zh.s: 1896年威斯康星州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任州长威廉·H·厄珀姆退休。共和党候选人爱德华·斯科菲尔德以59.67%的得票率击败民主党候选人威利斯·C·西尔弗索恩。斯科菲尔德的普选票占比创下该州州长候选人当时的最高纪录，反映出威斯康星州从倾向共和党但竞争激烈的州，逐渐转变为由共和党主导的州。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose 14 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president.

zh.s: 1896年密歇根州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。选民选出14名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Utah was held on November 3, 1896, as part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. This was the first time Utah participated in a presidential election, having been admitted as the 45th state on January 4 of that year.

zh.s: 1896年犹他州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。犹他州于当年1月4日成为美国第45个州，这是该州首次参加总统选举。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 3, 1896, as part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose 15 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Massachusetts overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, former governor of Ohio William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative from Nebraska William Jennings Bryan.

zh.s: 1896年马萨诸塞州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出15名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。马萨诸塞州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱，击败民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. South Dakota was won by the Populist nominees, former U.S. Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate Arthur Sewall of Maine.

zh.s: 1896年南达科他州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。选民选出4名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。人民党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及其竞选搭档、来自缅因州的阿瑟·西沃尔赢得南达科他州。

en.s: The 1896 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. Democratic nominee Alva Adams defeated People's Party nominee Morton Shelley Bailey with 46.22% of the vote.

zh.s: 1896年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党候选人阿尔瓦·亚当斯以46.22%的得票率击败人民党候选人莫顿·谢利·贝利。

en.s: The 1896 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1896, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee Edward Coke Crow defeated Republican nominee John Kennish, People's nominee Frank E. Richey, Prohibition nominee George E. Bowling and National Democratic nominee Nicholas D. Thurmond.

zh.s: 1896年密苏里州总检察长选举于11月3日举行。民主党候选人爱德华·科克·克劳击败共和党候选人约翰·肯尼什、人民党候选人弗兰克·E·里奇、禁酒党候选人乔治·E·鲍林，以及国家民主党候选人尼古拉斯·D·瑟蒙德。

en.s: The 1896 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. Republican nominee Hazen S. Pingree defeated Fusion candidate of the Democratic, People's, and Union Silver parties, Charles R. Sligh with 55.57% of the vote.

zh.s: 1896年密歇根州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党候选人黑曾·S·平格里以55.57%的得票率击败查尔斯·R·斯莱，后者是民主党、人民党和银元联盟联合推出的候选人。

en.s: The 1896 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896, and featured Populist and Democratic fusion nominee James E. Harris defeating his major rival, Republican nominee Orlando Tefft. Other candidates who received two percent of the vote or less included Gold Democratic nominee Owen F. Biglin, Prohibition nominee Lucius O. Jones, Socialist Labor nominee Fred Herman, and National Silver nominee Oscar Kent.

zh.t: 1896年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1896年内布拉斯加州副州长选举于11月3日举行。民粹党和民主党联合候选人詹姆斯·E·哈里斯击败主要对手、共和党候选人奥兰多·特夫特。其他候选人获得的选票均不超过2%，包括金民主党候选人欧文·F·比格林、禁酒党候选人卢修斯·O·琼斯、社会主义工党候选人弗雷德·赫尔曼，以及国家银币党候选人奥斯卡·肯特。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Although the state had been carried by a Democratic-Populist fusion ticket in 1892, unlike the other Mountain and Plains states, North Dakota was largely Catholic and Lutheran and opposed Populist and Democratic nominee William Jennings Bryan’s Evangelical Protestantism.

zh.s: 1896年北达科他州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。选民选出3名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。1892年，民主党和人民党联合候选人在北达科他州获胜；但与其他山区和平原州不同，北达科他州以天主教徒和路德宗信徒为主，反对民主党和人民党候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩所持的福音派新教立场。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters in Missouri chose 17 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Missouri was won by the Democratic nominees, former U.S. Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate Arthur Sewall of Maine.

zh.s: 1896年11月3日举行美国总统选举，密苏里州选民选出17名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩与来自缅因州的竞选搭档阿瑟·休厄尔赢得该州。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Idaho, upon its organization as a territory was overwhelmingly Democratic, but had been increasingly dominated by the Republican Party in the years leading up to statehood, as ex-Southern and Mormon mining settlers were increasingly outweighed by those from the Midwest.

zh.s: 1896年美国爱达荷州总统选举于11月3日举行。当时美国45个州都参加了总统选举。爱达荷州选民选出3名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。爱达荷领地成立后长期由民主党主导；建州前几年，共和党影响力不断上升。随着来自中西部的矿业移民增多，南方移民和摩门教矿工定居者的影响相对减弱。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1896, in 32 states, concurrent with the House, Senate elections and presidential election, on November 3, 1896 (except in Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Maine, Rhode Island and Vermont, which held early elections). Following the death of Delaware Governor Joshua H. Marvil, the General Assembly scheduled the next gubernatorial election for 1896, two years into the term.

zh.s: 1896年11月3日，美国32个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院、联邦参议院和总统选举同时进行。阿拉巴马州、阿肯色州、佛罗里达州、佐治亚州、路易斯安那州、缅因州、罗得岛州和佛蒙特州提前举行了选举。特拉华州州长约书亚·H·马维尔去世后，州议会决定把下一次州长选举安排在1896年，也就是其任期开始两年后。

en.s: The 1896 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. Incumbent Democratic Governor John Peter Altgeld was defeated by Republican nominee John Riley Tanner who won 54.10% of the vote.

zh.s: 1896年11月3日举行伊利诺伊州州长选举。在任民主党州长约翰·彼得·奥特盖尔德败给共和党提名人约翰·莱利·坦纳，坦纳获得54.10%的选票。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 3, 1896. Voters chose 10 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Jersey voted for the Republican nominee, former governor of Ohio William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative from Nebraska William Jennings Bryan.

zh.s: 1896年11月3日，新泽西州举行美国总统选举。选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。新泽西州支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱，击败民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩。

en.t: 1896 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming
en.s: The Wyoming United States House election for 1896 was held on November 3, 1896. Democratic John Eugene Osborne defeated Republican incumbent Frank Wheeler Mondell with 49.14% of the vote making Mondell the third incumbent Representative from Wyoming to lose reelection and was the third time in a row that the incumbent had lost. It was the first time that the House election was won with only a plurality of the votes.

zh.t: 1896年怀俄明州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1896年11月3日举行怀俄明州联邦众议院选举。民主党人约翰·尤金·奥斯本以49.14%的得票率击败共和党在任议员弗兰克·惠勒·蒙德尔。蒙德尔是第三位在怀俄明州竞选连任失败的现任议员；这也是连续第三次出现这种情况。此次是首次由得票不过半的候选人赢得该州联邦众议院选举。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Alabama voters chose eleven electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Alabama was won by the Democratic nominees, former U.S. Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate Arthur Sewall of Maine.

zh.t: 1896年阿拉巴马州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1896年11月3日，阿拉巴马州举行美国总统选举。选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩与来自缅因州的竞选搭档阿瑟·休厄尔赢得该州。

en.s: The 1896 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1896, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Albert Berg defeated Democratic nominee Julius J. Heinrich and Prohibition nominee James A. McConkey.

zh.s: 1896年11月3日举行明尼苏达州州务卿选举。在任共和党州务卿阿尔伯特·伯格击败民主党提名人朱利叶斯·J·海因里希和禁酒党提名人詹姆斯·A·麦康基。

en.s: The 1896 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1896, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Henry W. Childs defeated Democratic nominee John Arnold Keyes.

zh.t: 1896年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1896年11月3日举行明尼苏达州总检察长选举。在任共和党总检察长亨利·W·柴尔兹击败民主党提名人约翰·阿诺德·凯斯。

en.s: The 1896 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. Republican nominee James A. Mount defeated Democratic nominee Benjamin F. Shively with 50.93% of the vote.

zh.s: 1896年11月3日举行印第安纳州州长选举。共和党提名人詹姆斯·A·芒特以50.93%的得票率击败民主党提名人本杰明·F·希夫利。

en.s: The 1896 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. Shortly after his victory in the 1894 gubernatorial election, Republican Governor Joshua H. Marvil died. State Senate Speaker William T. Watson, a Democrat, became Governor and a new election for a full four-year term was scheduled in 1896. Though Watson was considered a potential candidate for re-election, the Democratic convention instead nominated Ebe W.

zh.s: 1896年特拉华州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党州长约书亚·H·马维尔在1894年州长选举中获胜后不久便去世。民主党人、州参议院议长威廉·T·沃森继任州长，并安排在1896年举行新选举，选出完整四年任期的州长。尽管沃森被认为可能竞选连任，民主党代表大会最终提名了埃布·W。

en.s: The 1896 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1896, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent secretary of state Alexander A. Lesueur defeated Republican nominee William B. Freeman, People's nominee Thomas H. Day, Prohibition nominee Edwin E. McClellan, National Democratic nominee and former Missouri Attorney General Daniel H. McIntyre and Socialist Labor nominee Albert E.

zh.t: 1896年美国密苏里州州务卿选举
zh.s: 1896年美国密苏里州州务卿选举于11月3日举行。民主党候选人、时任州务卿亚历山大·A·勒叙尔击败了共和党候选人威廉·B·弗里曼、人民党候选人托马斯·H·戴、禁酒党候选人埃德温·E·麦克莱伦、国家民主党候选人及密苏里州前司法部长丹尼尔·H·麦金太尔。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 3, 1896. All 45 contemporary states participated in the 1896 United States presidential election. State voters chose four electors for the Electoral College, which was responsible for selecting the president and vice president. Oregon was won by the Republican nominees, former Ohio Governor William McKinley and his running mate Garret Hobart of New Jersey, defeating the Democratic nominee William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his Populist running mate Thomas E.

zh.s: 1896年美国俄勒冈州总统选举于11月3日举行。当时美国45个州都参加了总统选举。俄勒冈州选民选出4名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档、新泽西州的加勒特·霍巴特击败了民主党总统候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Delaware was won by the Republican nominees, former Ohio Governor William McKinley and his running mate Garret Hobart of New Jersey.

zh.s: 1896年11月3日，特拉华州举行美国总统选举。全美当时的45个州都参加了这次选举。特拉华州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱与竞选搭档加勒特·霍巴特赢得该州。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose six electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. West Virginia was won by the Republican nominees, former Ohio Governor William McKinley and his running mate Garret Hobart of New Jersey.

zh.t: 1896年西弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1896年11月3日，西弗吉尼亚州举行美国总统选举。全美当时的45个州都参加了这次选举。选民选出6名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱与竞选搭档加勒特·霍巴特赢得该州。

en.t: 1896 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1896 United States House of Representatives elections were held for the most part on November 3, 1896, with Oregon, Maine, and Vermont holding theirs early in either June or September. They coincided with the election of President William McKinley. Elections were held for 357 seats of the United States House of Representatives, representing 45 states, to serve in the 55th United States Congress.

zh.s: 1896年美国联邦众议院选举大多于11月3日举行，俄勒冈州、缅因州和佛蒙特州的选举则提前在6月或9月举行。选举与威廉·麦金莱当选总统同时发生。45个州共选出357名联邦众议员，进入第55届美国国会。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 3, 1896, as part of the 1896 United States presidential election. State voters chose 23 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Since the Civil War, Ohio politics had been controlled by a conflict between the anti-Civil War Appalachian southeast and German-American counties of the northwest, opposed both to the heavily Yankee and New Englander northeast and to the Ohio Company counties of the southeast.

zh.s: 1896年11月3日，俄亥俄州举行美国总统选举。该州选民选出23名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。南北战争后，俄亥俄州政治受到地区分歧影响：反对南北战争的阿巴拉契亚东南部和德裔美国人聚居的西北部，与以扬基人和新英格兰人为主的东北部及俄亥俄公司的县份存在对立。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 3, 1896, as part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine voted for the Republican nominee, former governor of Ohio William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative from Nebraska William Jennings Bryan.

zh.s: 1896年11月3日，缅因州举行美国总统选举。选民选出6名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。缅因州支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱，击败民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Florida took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Florida voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Florida was won by the Democratic nominees, former U.S. Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate Arthur Sewall of Maine.

zh.s: 1896年佛罗里达州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。佛罗里达州选民选出4名选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及其竞选搭档、来自缅因州的阿瑟·西沃尔赢得佛罗里达州。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Nebraska was won by the Democratic nominees, former U.S. Representative and Nebraska native William Jennings Bryan and his Democratic running mate Arthur Sewall of Maine.

zh.s: 1896年内布拉斯加州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。选民选出8名选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、内布拉斯加州人、前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及其民主党竞选搭档、来自缅因州的阿瑟·西沃尔赢得内布拉斯加州。

en.s: The 1896 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 3, 1896, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee Frank L. Pitts defeated Republican nominee Jacob F. Gmelich, People's nominee Oscar Wood, Prohibition nominee Irving T. Hull, National Democratic nominee William McIlwrath and Socialist Labor nominee Henry J. Poelling.

zh.s: 1896年密苏里州财政部长选举于11月3日举行。民主党候选人弗兰克·L·皮茨击败共和党候选人雅各布·F·格梅利希、人民党候选人奥斯卡·伍德、禁酒党候选人欧文·T·赫尔、国家民主党候选人威廉·麦克伊尔拉特和社会主义工党候选人亨利·J·波林。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. States voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Maryland was won by the Republican nominees, former Ohio Governor William McKinley and his running mate Garret Hobart of New Jersey.

zh.s: 1896年马里兰州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。该州选民选出8名选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档、来自新泽西州的加勒特·霍巴特赢得马里兰州。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 3, 1896, as part of the 1896 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.s: 1896年怀俄明州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。怀俄明州选民选出3名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Kentucky was won by the Republican nominees, former Ohio Governor William McKinley and his running mate Garret Hobart of New Jersey.

zh.s: 1896年肯塔基州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。选民选出13名选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档、来自新泽西州的加勒特·霍巴特赢得肯塔基州。

en.s: The 1896 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. Republican nominee Daniel Lindsay Russell defeated Democratic nominee Cyrus B. Watson with 46.52% of the vote. This was the only election in North Carolina between 1872 and 1972 in which the Republican nominee won the governor's office.

zh.s: 1896年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党候选人丹尼尔·林赛·拉塞尔以46.52%的得票率击败民主党候选人赛勒斯·B·沃森。这是1872年至1972年间，北卡罗来纳州唯一一次共和党候选人赢得州长职位的选举。

en.s: The 1896 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896, and featured incumbent Governor Silas A. Holcomb, a Populist, defeating his major rival, Republican nominee John H. MacColl, to win a second two-year term in office.

zh.s: 1896年内布拉斯加州州长选举于11月3日举行。民粹党籍时任州长塞拉斯·A·霍尔科姆击败主要对手、共和党候选人约翰·H·麦科尔，赢得第二个两年任期。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. In its early days as a state, Colorado had like the Plains States to its east been solidly Republican.

zh.s: 1896年科罗拉多州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。选民选出4名选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。作为一个新州，科罗拉多州早期和它东边的大平原州一样，一直坚定支持共和党。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Nevada was won by the Silver and Democratic nominees, former U.S. Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate Arthur Sewall of Maine.

zh.s: 1896年内华达州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。该州选民选出3名选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。银元党和民主党联合候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及其竞选搭档、来自缅因州的阿瑟·西沃尔赢得内华达州。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Following the overthrow of Reconstruction Republican government, Louisiana, like most of the former Confederacy, established a Democratic-dominated but highly fraudulent political system that would from 1890 be challenged by the rise of the Populist Party due to declining conditions for farmers.

zh.s: 1896年路易斯安那州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。该州选民选出8名选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。重建时期由共和党执政的政府被推翻后，路易斯安那州和前邦联大多数地区一样，建立了民主党主导但充斥舞弊的政治体系。从1890年起，由于农民处境恶化，人民党的兴起开始挑战这一体系。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. This election marks the establishment of one-party hegemony in every county in Arkansas except Unionist Ozark Newton and Searcy where Republicans would control local government permanently.

zh.s: 1896年阿肯色州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。选民选出8名选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。这次选举标志着阿肯色州除支持联邦主义的奥扎克地区牛顿县和塞尔西县外，所有县都确立了一党长期主导的局面；共和党随后永久控制了这两个县的地方政府。

en.s: The 1896 Montana gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. Democratic and Populist nominee Robert Burns Smith defeated Republican and Silver Republican nominee Alexander C. Botkin with 70.99% of the vote.

zh.s: 1896年蒙大拿州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党和人民党联合候选人罗伯特·伯恩斯·史密斯以70.99%的得票率击败共和党和银共和党联合候选人亚历山大·C·博特金。

en.s: The 1896 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. Republican nominee Frank A. Briggs defeated People's Party nominee Robert B. Richardson with 55.61% of the vote.

zh.s: 1896年北达科他州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党候选人弗兰克·A·布里格斯以55.61%的得票率击败人民党候选人罗伯特·B·理查森。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in California took place on November 3, 1896, as part of the 1896 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California narrowly voted for the Republican nominee, Ohio Governor William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former Nebraska representative William Jennings Bryan.

zh.s: 1896年加利福尼亚州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出9名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。加利福尼亚州以微弱优势支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州州长威廉·麦金莱，击败民主党候选人、内布拉斯加州前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.s: The 1896 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. Republican nominee Lorrin A. Cooke defeated Democratic nominee Joseph B. Sargent with 62.53% of the vote.

zh.s: 1896年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党候选人洛林·A·库克以62.53%的得票率击败民主党候选人约瑟夫·B·萨金特。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Mississippi was won by the Democratic nominees, former U.S. Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate Arthur Sewall of Maine.

zh.s: 1896年密西西比州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。选民选出9名选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及其竞选搭档、来自缅因州的阿瑟·西沃尔赢得密西西比州。

en.s: The 1896 Illinois lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896, in order to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Illinois. Republican nominee William Northcott defeated Democratic nominee Monroe Carroll Crawford, as well as several other candidates.

zh.s: 1896年伊利诺伊州副州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党候选人威廉·诺思科特击败民主党候选人门罗·卡罗尔·克劳福德及其他数名候选人。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 3, 1896, as part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Hampshire overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, former governor of Ohio William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative from Nebraska William Jennings Bryan.

zh.s: 1896年新罕布什尔州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。新罕布什尔州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱，击败民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Vermont
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Vermont took place on November 3, 1896, as part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Vermont overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominees, former governor of Ohio William McKinley and his running mate Garret Hobart of New Jersey.

zh.s: 1896年佛蒙特州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。佛蒙特州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档、来自新泽西州的加勒特·霍巴特。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 3, 1896, as part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut voted for the Republican nominee, former Governor of Ohio William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative from Nebraska William Jennings Bryan.

zh.s: 1896年康涅狄格州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。康涅狄格州支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前州长威廉·麦金莱，击败民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose 12 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. For over a century after the Civil War, Tennessee’s white citizenry was divided according to partisan loyalties established in that war.

zh.s: 1896年田纳西州总统选举于11月3日举行，当时美国所有45个州都参加了全国总统选举。田纳西州选民选出12名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。南北战争结束后的一个多世纪里，田纳西州白人居民一直按战争时期形成的党派忠诚度分化。

en.s: The 1896 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. Democratic nominee Frank Steunenberg defeated Republican nominee David H. Budlong with 76.79% of the vote.

zh.s: 1896年爱达荷州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党候选人弗兰克·斯托伊嫩伯格以76.79%的得票率击败共和党候选人大卫·H·巴德隆。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Texas took place on November 3, 1896. State voters chose 15 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Texas was won by the Democratic nominees, former U.S. Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate Arthur Sewall of Maine.

zh.s: 1896年得克萨斯州总统选举于11月3日举行。该州选民选出15名选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及其竞选搭档、来自缅因州的阿瑟·西沃尔赢得得克萨斯州。

en.s: The 1896 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 3, 1896, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor James M. Seibert defeated Republican nominee John G. Bishop, People's nominee Sheridan Webster, Prohibition nominee John O. Rolfe, National Democratic nominee Edward D. Porter and Socialist Labor nominee James A. Randall.

zh.s: 1896年密苏里州审计长选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任州审计长詹姆斯·M·塞伯特击败共和党候选人约翰·G·毕晓普、人民党候选人谢里登·韦伯斯特、禁酒党候选人约翰·O·罗尔夫、国家民主党候选人爱德华·D·波特和社会主义工党候选人詹姆斯·A·兰德尔。

en.s: The 1896 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896, to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota House of Representatives John L. Gibbs defeated Democratic-People's nominee James Madison Bowler and Prohibition nominee Clarence Wedge.

zh.s: 1896年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党候选人、时任明尼苏达州众议员约翰·L·吉布斯击败民主党—人民党联合候选人詹姆斯·麦迪逊·鲍勒和禁酒党候选人克拉伦斯·韦奇。

en.s: The 1896 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Missouri. Democratic nominee August Bolte defeated Republican nominee Abraham C. Pettijohn, People's nominee J. H. Hillis, Prohibition nominee James M. Richey, National Democratic nominee Alfred F. Osterman and Socialist Labor nominee Christopher Rocker.

zh.s: 1896年密苏里州副州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党候选人奥古斯特·博尔特击败共和党候选人亚伯拉罕·C·佩蒂约翰、人民党候选人J·H·希利斯、禁酒党候选人詹姆斯·M·里奇、国家民主党候选人阿尔弗雷德·F·奥斯特曼和社会主义工党候选人克里斯托弗·罗克。

en.s: The 1896 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. Acting Governor Roger Wolcott, a Republican, was elected to a full term in office, defeating Democratic U.S. Representative George Fred Williams.

zh.s: 1896年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍代理州长罗杰·沃尔科特当选，赢得完整任期，击败民主党候选人、美国联邦众议员乔治·弗雷德·威廉斯。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 3, 1896. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1896 United States presidential election. Voters chose 11 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. North Carolina was won by the Democratic nominees, former U.S.

zh.t: 1896年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1896年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举于11月3日举行。当时美国45个州都参加了总统选举。北卡罗来纳州选民选出11名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。该州支持民主党总统候选人。

en.t: 1896 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1896 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 3, 1896, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Following Reconstruction, Georgia would be the first former Confederate state to substantially disenfranchise its newly enfranchised freedmen and many poor whites, doing so in the early 1870s.

zh.s: 1896年美国佐治亚州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出13名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。重建时期结束后，佐治亚州在19世纪70年代初大幅剥夺了新近获得公民权的获释奴隶及许多贫困白人的选举权，成为第一个这样做的前邦联州。

en.s: The 1896 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. Former Democratic governor Robert Love Taylor narrowly defeated Republican nominee G. N. Tillman with 48.75% of the vote. The Democratic Party was concerned about Republicans' chances of winning the governor's office and believed that the incumbent, Peter Turney, had won the office by using questionable tactics two years earlier.

zh.s: 1896年11月3日举行田纳西州州长选举。前民主党州长罗伯特·洛夫·泰勒以48.75%的得票率险胜共和党提名人G·N·蒂尔曼。民主党担心共和党可能赢得州长职位，并认为在任州长彼得·特尼两年前通过可疑手段当选。

en.s: The 1896 Missouri gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896, and resulted in a victory for the Democratic nominee, State Treasurer of Missouri Lawrence Vest Stephens, over the Republican candidate Robert E. Lewis, Prohibition candidate Herman Preston Faris, National Democratic candidate J. McDowell Trimble and Socialist Labor candidate Louis C. Fry.

zh.s: 1896年11月3日举行密苏里州州长选举。民主党提名人、密苏里州州财长劳伦斯·韦斯特·斯蒂芬斯胜出，击败共和党候选人罗伯特·E·刘易斯、禁酒党候选人赫尔曼·普雷斯顿·法里斯、全国民主党候选人J·麦克道尔·特林布尔和社会主义工党候选人路易斯·C·弗莱。

en.s: The 1896 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1896. Populist nominee John Rankin Rogers defeated Republican nominee Charley Sullivan, with 55.55% of the vote. In this statewide election, including for all other state officers such as Lieutenant Governor, the Democrats fused with the Populists, except for the presidential election where the Democratic Party ran an independent slate of electors.

zh.s: 1896年11月3日举行华盛顿州州长选举。民粹党提名人约翰·兰金·罗杰斯以55.55%的得票率击败共和党提名人查利·沙利文。在这次全州选举中，除总统选举外，民主党人与民粹党人在副州长等所有州级职位上联合提名候选人；总统选举中，民主党另行提名了一组总统选举人。

en.s: The 1896 West Virginia gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1896, to elect the governor of West Virginia.

zh.s: 1896年11月3日举行西弗吉尼亚州州长选举。

en.s: The 1896 New York state election was held on November 3, 1896, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor and a judge of the New York Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly. Besides, a constitutional amendment on forestry was proposed, and rejected with 321,486 votes for and 710,505 against it.

zh.s: 1896年11月3日，纽约州举行选举，选出州长、副州长、纽约州上诉法院一名法官和州众议院全体议员。选民还对一项林业宪法修正案进行表决，结果以321,486票赞成、710,505票反对遭到否决。

en.s: The 1896 Texas gubernatorial election was held to elect the Governor of Texas. Governor Charles Culberson was re-elected to a second term over Jerome C. Kearby, a Populist running with Republican support. The total vote recorded in the general election was nearly 540,000 and the most for any Texas election until the 1918 Democratic Party primary.

zh.s: 1896年得克萨斯州州长选举选出该州州长。州长查尔斯·卡尔伯森击败民粹党候选人杰罗姆·C·卡尔比，成功连任第二个任期。大选记录的总票数接近54万，直到1918年民主党初选前，这一票数都是得克萨斯州所有选举中的最高纪录。

en.s: The 1898 Texas gubernatorial election was held to elect the governor of Texas. Joseph D. Sayers was elected over Barnett Gibbs, a Populist running with Republican support.

zh.s: 1898年得克萨斯州州长选举选出了该州州长。约瑟夫·D·塞耶斯击败获得共和党支持的民粹党候选人巴内特·吉布斯，当选州长。

en.s: The Fashoda Incident, also known as the Fashoda Crisis (French: Crise de Fachoda), was the climax of imperialist territorial disputes between Britain and France in East Africa, occurring between 10 July and 3 November 1898. A French expedition to Fashoda on the White Nile sought to gain control of the Upper Nile river basin and thereby exclude Britain from Sudan.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 法绍达事件，又称法绍达危机（法语：Crise de Fachoda），是英国和法国在东非争夺殖民地的冲突高潮，发生于1898年7月10日至11月3日。法国远征队前往白尼罗河畔的法绍达，试图控制上尼罗河流域，从而把英国势力排除在苏丹之外。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Negros Revolution (Filipino: Himagsikang Negrense; Cebuano: Rebolusyong Negrense; Spanish: Revolución negrense), commemorated and popularly known as the Fifth of November (Spanish: Cinco de noviembre) or Negros Day (Hiligaynon: Adlaw sang Negros; Cebuano: Adlaw sa Negros; Spanish: Día de Negros) was a political movement in the Philippines that established a government on Negros Island in 1898, during the Spanish-American War, ending Spanish control of the island and paving the way for a republican government run by the Negrense natives.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 内格罗斯革命（菲律宾语：Himagsikang Negrense；宿务语：Rebolusyong Negrense；西班牙语：Revolución negrense）通常称为“十一月五日”（西班牙语：Cinco de noviembre）或“内格罗斯日”（希利盖农语：Adlaw sang Negros；宿务语：Adlaw sa Negros；西班牙语：Día de Negros）。这场菲律宾政治运动于1898年西美战争期间在内格罗斯岛建立政权，结束了西班牙对该岛的控制，并为当地内格罗斯人建立共和政府铺平道路。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 1903 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1903. Incumbent Democrat Lucius F. C. Garvin defeated Republican nominee Samuel Pomeroy Colt with 49.29% of the vote.

zh.s: 1903年11月3日举行罗得岛州州长选举。在任民主党州长卢修斯·F·C·加文以49.29%的得票率击败共和党提名人塞缪尔·波默罗伊·科尔特。

en.s: The 1903 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1903. Incumbent Republican Albert B. Cummins defeated Democratic nominee J. B. Sullivan with 57.14% of the vote.

zh.s: 1903年11月3日举行艾奥瓦州州长选举。在任共和党州长阿尔伯特·B·卡明斯以57.14%的得票率击败民主党提名人J·B·沙利文。

en.s: The 1903 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 3, 1903, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee Gordon T. Atkinson defeated Republican nominee L. E. P. Dennis, Prohibition nominee Daniel W. Miles and Socialist nominee George L. Wild.

zh.s: 1903年11月3日举行马里兰州审计长选举。民主党提名人戈登·T·阿特金森击败共和党提名人L·E·P·丹尼斯、禁酒党提名人丹尼尔·W·迈尔斯和社会党提名人乔治·L·怀尔德。

en.s: The 1903 Iowa State Senate elections were the last state legislative general elections held on an odd-numbered year. Iowa voters elected state senators in 29 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators traditionally serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. However, under the Biennial Elections law enacted in 1904 by the Iowa General Assembly, the senators elected in 1903 served an additional fifth year (until the 1908 elections) to accommodate the transition to holding elections on even-numbered years. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1903 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here. The 1903 elections occurred before primary elections were established in Iowa by the Primary Election Law in 1907. The general election took place on November 3, 1903.

zh.s: 1903年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是该州最后一次在奇数年举行州议会大选。选民在州参议院50个选区中的29个选区选出参议员。州参议员通常任期四年，但根据艾奥瓦州议会1904年通过的两年一度选举法，1903年当选的参议员额外任职一年，直到1908年选举，以便把选举改到偶数年举行。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1903年选举中50个州参议院选区的全州地图。艾奥瓦州1907年通过初选法、设立初选之前，该州尚未举行初选。大选于1903年11月3日举行。

en.s: The 1903 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 3, 1903, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee William Shepard Bryan Jr. defeated Republican nominee George Whitelock, Socialist nominee Charles B. Backman and Prohibition nominee Frank Higgins.

zh.s: 1903年11月3日举行马里兰州总检察长选举。民主党提名人小威廉·谢泼德·布莱恩击败共和党提名人乔治·怀特洛克、社会党提名人查尔斯·B·巴克曼和禁酒党提名人弗兰克·希金斯。

en.s: The 1903 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1903. Incumbent Republican Governor John L. Bates was re-elected to a second term, defeating Democratic nominee William A. Gaston and Socialist John C. Chase in a rematch of the 1902 election.

zh.s: 1903年11月3日举行马萨诸塞州州长选举。在任共和党州长约翰·L·贝茨击败民主党提名人威廉·A·加斯顿和社会党人约翰·C·蔡斯，成功连任第二届。这是两人继1902年选举后再次交手。

en.s: The 1903 Maryland gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1903. Incumbent Governor John Walter Smith did not seek re-election. Democratic candidate Edwin Warfield defeated Republican candidate Stevenson A. Williams.

zh.s: 1903年11月3日举行马里兰州州长选举。在任州长约翰·沃尔特·史密斯没有竞选连任。民主党候选人埃德温·沃菲尔德击败共和党候选人史蒂文森·A·威廉姆斯。

en.s: The 1903 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1903. The incumbent Democratic governor, J. C. W. Beckham, defeated Republican nominee Morris B. Belknap to a win a term in his own right.

zh.s: 1903年11月3日举行肯塔基州州长选举。在任民主党州长J·C·W·贝克汉姆击败共和党提名人莫里斯·B·贝尔纳普，赢得一个完整任期。

en.s: The 1903 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 3, 1903. Incumbent Eugene E. Schmitz was reelected with 43% of the vote.

zh.s: 1903年11月3日举行旧金山市长选举。在任市长尤金·E·施密茨以43%的得票率成功连任。

en.t: Panama secedes from Colombia and establishes an independent republic
en.s: On November 3, 1903, Panama's secession from Colombia was formalized and the Republic of Panama was established. The separation took place on the Isthmus of Panama, which until then had been part of Colombia.
en.n: This records Panama's separation from Colombia in 1903, not its earlier independence from Spain in 1821.

zh.t: 巴拿马脱离哥伦比亚独立
zh.s: 1903年11月3日，巴拿马正式脱离哥伦比亚，成立巴拿马共和国。这场分离发生在此前属于哥伦比亚的巴拿马地峡。
zh.n: 此条记录1903年巴拿马脱离哥伦比亚；1821年脱离西班牙是另一件事。

en.s: Panama, officially the Republic of Panama, is a country located at the southern end of Central America in North America, bordering South America. It is bordered by Costa Rica to the west, Colombia to the southeast, the Caribbean Sea to the north, and the Pacific Ocean to the south. Its capital and largest city is Panama City, whose metropolitan area is home to nearly half of the country's over 4 million inhabitants.

zh.t: 巴拿马脱离哥伦比亚成为共和国
zh.s: 巴拿马正式名称为巴拿马共和国，位于北美洲中美洲南端，与南美洲接壤。该国西邻哥斯达黎加，东南接哥伦比亚，北濒加勒比海，南临太平洋。首都和最大城市为巴拿马城，其都会区居住着全国超过400万居民中的近半数。

en.s: The 1904 West Monmouthshire by-election was a parliamentary by-election held on 3 November 1904. The constituency returned one Member of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system. The seat was vacant following the death of the seat's incumbent MP Sir William Vernon Harcourt. Thomas Richards was elected in his place.

zh.s: 1904年11月3日举行英国议会西蒙茅斯郡西区补选。该选区选出一名下议院议员，采用简单多数制。前任议员威廉·弗农·哈考特爵士去世后，席位空缺。托马斯·理查兹当选接替他。

en.s: The 1904 Canadian federal election was held on November 3, 1904, to elect members of the House of Commons of Canada of the 10th Parliament of Canada. Prime Minister Sir Wilfrid Laurier led the Liberal Party of Canada to a third term in government, with an increased majority, and over half of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1904年11月3日举行加拿大联邦大选，选出加拿大第10届议会的下议院议员。首相威尔弗里德·劳里埃爵士领导加拿大自由党再次执政，进入第三个任期。自由党扩大多数席位，并获得过半数普选票。

en.s: The 1906 South Australian state election was held on 3 November 1906 to elect all 42 seats in the South Australian House of Assembly. The seat of Northern Territory went to an election on 10 November. The incumbent United Labor Party (ULP) government led by Premier of South Australia Thomas Price with coalition partner the Liberal and Democratic Union (LDU) led by Archibald Peake, defeated the conservative opposition led by Leader of the Opposition Richard Butler.

zh.s: 1906年11月3日，南澳大利亚州举行州选举，选出州众议院全部42个席位。北领地选区的选举于11月10日举行。在任联合劳工党政府由州长托马斯·普莱斯领导，联合执政伙伴自由民主联盟由阿奇博尔德·皮克领导；两党击败了由反对党领袖理查德·巴特勒领导的保守派反对党。

en.s: The 1906 Galway Borough by-election was held on 3 November 1906. The by-election was held due to the resignation of the incumbent Irish Parliamentary MP, Charles Ramsay Devlin, in order to return to Canada. It was won by the Irish Parliamentary candidate Stephen Gwynn.

zh.s: 1906年11月3日举行戈尔韦区补选。爱尔兰议会党议员查尔斯·拉姆齐·德夫林辞职后留下空缺，他辞职是为了返回加拿大。爱尔兰议会党候选人斯蒂芬·格温赢得补选。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1908 was the 31st quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 3, 1908. Popular incumbent President Theodore Roosevelt, honoring a promise not to seek a third term, persuaded the Republican Party to nominate William Howard Taft, his close friend and Secretary of War, to become his successor. Having lost the 1904 election badly with a conservative candidate, the Democratic Party turned to two-time nominee William Jennings Bryan, who had been defeated in 1896 and 1900 by Republican William McKinley. Despite his two previous defeats, Bryan remained extremely popular among the more liberal and populist elements of the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 1908年美国总统选举是第31次四年一度的总统选举，于1908年11月3日星期二举行。受欢迎的现任总统西奥多·罗斯福信守不竞选第三个任期的承诺，并促使共和党提名他的密友、战争部长威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱接任。民主党在1904年由一位保守派候选人参选并惨败后，再次提名威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。布莱恩曾在1896年和1900年两次败给共和党人威廉·麦金莱，但仍深受民主党内较为自由派和民粹主义派系的欢迎。

en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Florida was held on November 3, 1908, as part of the 1908 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice-president. With the disfranchisement of African-Americans by a poll tax in 1889, Florida became a one-party Democratic state, which it was to remain until the 1950s—apart from the anti-Catholic vote against Al Smith in 1928.

zh.t: 1908年佛罗里达州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行美国总统选举，佛罗里达州选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。由于1889年的人头税剥夺了非裔美国人的选举权，佛罗里达州成为民主党一党独大的州，这种局面一直持续到20世纪50年代；1928年反对阿尔·史密斯的反天主教选票是例外。

en.s: The 1908 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1908, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee George T. Simpson defeated Democratic nominee Marvin E. Mathews, Public Ownership nominee Alfred W. Uhl and Independence League nominee John T. P. Power.

zh.t: 1908年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行明尼苏达州总检察长选举。共和党提名人乔治·T·辛普森击败民主党提名人马文·E·马修斯、公共所有权党提名人阿尔弗雷德·W·厄尔和独立联盟提名人约翰·T·P·鲍尔。

en.s: An election to the Aberdeen Corporation was held on 3 November 1908, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. 11 of the corporation's 34 seats were up for election, although only 3 were contested. The primary question in this election was the 'Water Question,' a debate of whether the city should continue to obtain drinking water from the River Dee, or if a new supply should be pulled from River Avon.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日，阿伯丁举行市政选举，与苏格兰各地市政选举同时进行。市议会34个席位中有11个参与改选，但只有3个席位存在竞争。此次选举的主要议题是“供水问题”：市政府是否应继续从迪河取用饮用水，还是改从埃文河引水。

en.s: The 1908 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908. Republican nominee James H. Brady defeated Democratic nominee Moses Alexander with 49.61% of the vote.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行爱达荷州州长选举。共和党提名人詹姆斯·H·布雷迪以49.61%的得票率击败民主党提名人摩西·亚历山大。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 3, 1908, as part of the 1908 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa voted for the Republican nominees, Secretary of War William Howard Taft of Ohio and his running mate James S. Sherman of New York.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日，艾奥瓦州举行美国总统选举，作为当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出13名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。艾奥瓦州支持共和党候选人、来自俄亥俄州的战争部长威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱，以及他的竞选搭档、来自纽约州的詹姆斯·S·谢尔曼。

en.s: The 1908 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908. Republican nominee Beryl F. Carroll defeated Democratic nominee Frederick Edward White with 54.60% of the vote.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行艾奥瓦州州长选举。共和党候选人贝里尔·F·卡罗尔以54.60%的得票率击败民主党候选人弗雷德里克·爱德华·怀特。

en.s: The 1908 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908. Primary elections were held on September 1, 1908. Incumbent Republican Governor James O. Davidson won re-election, defeating Democratic nominee John A. Aylward and Social Democratic nominee Harvey Dee Brown, with 54.03% of the vote.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行威斯康星州州长选举，初选于同年9月1日举行。现任共和党州长詹姆斯·O·戴维森成功连任，以54.03%的得票率击败民主党候选人约翰·A·艾尔沃德和社会民主党候选人哈维·迪·布朗。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 3, 1908. Voters chose 10 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Mississippi overwhelmingly voted for the Democratic nominees, former U.S. Representative of Nebraska William Jennings Bryan and his running mate John W. Kern of Indiana. They defeated the Republican nominees, Secretary of War William Howard Taft of Ohio and his running mate James S.

zh.t: 1908年美国密西西比州总统选举
zh.s: 1908年美国密西西比州总统选举于11月3日举行。选民选出10名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。密西西比州以压倒性优势支持民主党候选人：来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及其竞选搭档、来自印第安纳州的约翰·W·克恩。他们击败了共和党候选人、俄亥俄州陆军部长威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱及其竞选搭档詹姆斯·S·谢尔曼。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 3, 1908, as part of the 1908 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia was won by the 42nd Secretary of War William Howard Taft (R–Ohio), running with representative James S.

zh.t: 1908年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1908年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。西弗吉尼亚州支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州陆军部长威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱及其竞选搭档、联邦众议员詹姆斯·S·谢尔曼。

en.s: The 1908 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908. Incumbent Democrat John Burke defeated Republican nominee C. A. Johnson with 51.06% of the vote.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行北达科他州州长选举。现任民主党州长约翰·伯克以51.06%的得票率击败共和党候选人C·A·约翰逊。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 3, 1908. All contemporary 46 states were part of the 1908 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Nebraska was won by the Democratic nominees, former Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate John W. Kern of Indiana.

zh.t: 1908年内布拉斯加州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1908年11月3日，内布拉斯加州举行美国总统选举，作为当年总统选举的一部分。当时的46个州都参加了此次选举。选民选出8名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。内布拉斯加州支持民主党候选人、前众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩，以及他的竞选搭档、来自印第安纳州的约翰·W·克恩。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 3, 1908. All contemporary 46 states were part of the 1908 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Delaware was won by the Republican nominees, former Secretary of War William Howard Taft of Ohio and his running mate James S.

zh.s: 1908年美国特拉华州总统选举于11月3日举行。当时美国46个州都参加了总统选举。特拉华州选民选出3名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。该州支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前陆军部长威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱及其竞选搭档詹姆斯·S·谢尔曼。

en.s: The 1908 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Melville R. Hopewell, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee Erasmus O. Garrett as well as Prohibition Party nominee Frank E. Linch and Socialist Party nominee Thomas Jorgenson.

zh.t: 1908年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州副州长选举。现任共和党副州长梅尔维尔·R·霍普韦尔击败民主党候选人伊拉斯默斯·O·加勒特、禁酒党候选人弗兰克·E·林奇和社会党候选人托马斯·约根森。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1908, in 33 states, concurrent with the House, Senate elections and presidential election, on November 3, 1908 (except in Arkansas, Georgia, Maine and Vermont, which held early elections). In Ohio, the gubernatorial election was held in an even-numbered year for the first time, having previously been held in odd-numbered years. The previous election in this state took place in 1905.

zh.s: 1908年，美国33个州举行州长选举，与众议院、参议院和总统选举同期进行，投票日为11月3日；阿肯色州、佐治亚州、缅因州和佛蒙特州则提前举行了选举。俄亥俄州首次在偶数年举行州长选举，此前该州的选举在奇数年举行。俄亥俄州上一次州长选举是在1905年。

en.s: The 1908 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908. Republican nominee Aram J. Pothier defeated Democratic nominee Olney Arnold with 52.61% of the vote.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行罗得岛州州长选举。共和党候选人阿拉姆·J·波蒂埃以52.61%的得票率击败民主党候选人奥尔尼·阿诺德。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 3, 1908. All 46 states were part of the 1908 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. This was the first presidential election Oklahoma participated in, as it had become the 46th state on November 16, 1907.

zh.t: 1908年俄克拉何马州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1908年11月3日，俄克拉何马州举行美国总统选举。当年美国全部46个州都参加了总统选举。选民选出7名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。这是俄克拉何马州首次参加总统选举；该州于1907年11月16日成为美国第46个州。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 3, 1908. All contemporary 46 states were part of the 1908 United States presidential election. Voters chose five electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Washington had been established earlier in the 1900s as a one-party Republican bastion, which it would remain at a Presidential level apart from the 1910s GOP split until Franklin D.

zh.s: 1908年美国华盛顿州总统选举于11月3日举行。当时美国46个州都参加了总统选举。选民选出5名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。华盛顿州在20世纪初已成为共和党一党占优势的州；除1910年代共和党分裂期间外，该州在总统选举中一直支持共和党，直到富兰克林·D·罗斯福时期。

en.s: The 1908 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1908, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Julius A. Schmahl defeated Democratic nominee Richard F. Lamb, Prohibition nominee James F. Damon, Socialist nominee John LeFevre and Independence League nominee J.S. Waterston.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行明尼苏达州州务卿选举，以选出该州的州务卿。共和党候选人、现任州务卿朱利叶斯·A·施马尔击败了民主党候选人理查德·F·兰姆、禁酒党候选人詹姆斯·F·戴蒙、社会党候选人约翰·勒费弗尔和独立联盟候选人J·S·沃特斯顿。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 3, 1908. All contemporary 46 states were part of the 1908 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Kentucky was won by the Democratic nominees, former Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate John W. Kern of Indiana.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日，肯塔基州举行美国总统选举，作为当年总统选举的一部分。当时的46个州都参加了此次选举。选民选出13名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。肯塔基州支持民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩，以及他的竞选搭档、来自印第安纳州的约翰·W·克恩。

en.s: The 1908 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908. Incumbent Republican Fred M. Warner defeated Democratic candidate Lawton T. Hemans with 48.39% of the vote.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行密歇根州州长选举。现任共和党州长弗雷德·M·华纳以48.39%的得票率击败民主党候选人劳顿·T·赫曼斯。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 3, 1908. All contemporary 46 states were part of the 1908 United States presidential election. State voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Polls always said that Oregon, which had voted Democratic only once over twelve presidential elections since statehood, would ultimately be easily retained by Taft.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日，俄勒冈州举行美国总统选举，作为当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民调一直显示，俄勒冈州会轻松支持塔夫脱。自建州以来的12次总统选举中，俄勒冈州只有一次支持民主党；除20世纪10年代共和党分裂时期外，此后在总统选举中一直支持共和党。

en.s: The 1908 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908. Democratic nominee John F. Shafroth defeated Republican nominee Jesse Fuller McDonald with 49.41% of the vote.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行科罗拉多州州长选举。民主党候选人约翰·F·沙弗罗斯以49.41%的得票率击败共和党候选人杰西·富勒·麦克唐纳。

en.s: The 1908 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908. Republican nominee William Spry defeated Democratic nominee Jesse William Knight with 47.45% of the vote.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行犹他州州长选举。共和党候选人威廉·斯普赖以47.45%的得票率击败民主党候选人杰西·威廉·奈特。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 3, 1908, as part of the 1908 United States presidential election. Voters chose 16 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Massachusetts overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominees, Secretary of War William Howard Taft of Ohio and his running mate James S. Sherman of New York.

zh.t: 1908年马萨诸塞州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1908年11月3日，马萨诸塞州举行美国总统选举，作为当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出16名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。马萨诸塞州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、来自俄亥俄州的战争部长威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱，以及他的竞选搭档、来自纽约州的詹姆斯·S·谢尔曼。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 3, 1908. All contemporary 46 states were part of the 1908 United States presidential election. State voters chose 27 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Illinois was won by the Republican nominees, former Secretary of War William Howard Taft of Ohio and his running mate James S.

zh.t: 1908年美国伊利诺伊州总统选举
zh.s: 1908年美国伊利诺伊州总统选举于11月3日举行。当时美国46个州都参加了总统选举。伊利诺伊州选民选出27名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。该州支持共和党候选人、俄亥俄州前陆军部长威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱及其竞选搭档詹姆斯·S·谢尔曼。

en.s: The 1908 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 3, 1908, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee James Cowgill defeated Republican nominee Wilbur F. Maring.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行密苏里州财政部长选举。民主党候选人詹姆斯·考吉尔击败共和党候选人威尔伯·F·马林。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 3, 1908, as part of the 1908 United States presidential election. State voters chose 23 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Since the Civil War, Ohio politics had been controlled by a conflict between the anti-Civil War Appalachian southeast and German-American counties of the northwest, opposed both to the heavily Yankee and New Englander northeast and to the Ohio Company counties of the southeast.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日，俄亥俄州举行美国总统选举，作为当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出23名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。自南北战争以来，俄亥俄州政坛一直受到几股势力之间的矛盾影响：反对内战的阿巴拉契亚东南部和西北部的德裔美国人，与东北部以扬基和新英格兰移民后裔为主的地区，以及东南部俄亥俄公司所在县相对立。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Texas took place on November 3, 1908. Voters chose 18 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Texas overwhelmingly voted for the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative William Jennings Bryan, over the Republican nominee, Secretary of War William Howard Taft. Bryan won Texas by a landslide margin of 51.62%.

zh.t: 1908年得克萨斯州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1908年11月3日，得克萨斯州举行美国总统选举。选民选出18名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。得克萨斯州以压倒性优势支持民主党候选人、前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩，大幅领先共和党候选人、战争部长威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱，得票差距为51.62个百分点。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 3, 1908. All contemporary 46 states were part of the 1908 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. After having voted for Republican William McKinley in 1896 and 1900, Maryland would become exceedingly close in 1904 with Alton B.

zh.s: 1908年美国马里兰州总统选举于11月3日举行。当时美国46个州都参加了总统选举。马里兰州选民选出8名总统选举人，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。马里兰州在1896年和1900年都支持共和党候选人威廉·麦金莱；到1904年，选情已变得十分胶着，艾尔顿·B。

en.s: The 1908 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908. Incumbent Republican Governor Charles S. Deneen defeated Democratic nominee and former Vice President of the United States Adlai E. Stevenson I with 47.64% of the vote.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行伊利诺伊州州长选举。现任共和党州长查尔斯·S·德宁以47.64%的得票率击败民主党候选人、美国前副总统阿德莱·E·史蒂文森一世。

en.s: The 1908 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1908. Incumbent Lieutenant Governor Adolph Olson Eberhart of the Republican Party of Minnesota defeated Minnesota Democratic Party challenger Julius J. Reiter and Prohibition Party candidate T. J. Anderson.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行明尼苏达州副州长选举。现任共和党副州长阿道夫·奥尔森·埃伯哈特击败明尼苏达州民主党候选人朱利叶斯·J·赖特和禁酒党候选人T·J·安德森。

en.s: The 1908 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908. It saw the election of Republican nominee John G. Oglesby.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行伊利诺伊州副州长选举，共和党候选人约翰·G·奥格尔斯比当选。

en.s: The 1908 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1908, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee Cornelius Roach defeated Republican nominee and incumbent secretary of state John Ephraim Swanger.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行密苏里州州务卿选举。民主党候选人科尼利厄斯·罗奇击败共和党候选人、时任州务卿约翰·伊弗雷姆·斯旺格。

en.s: The 1908 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908. Republican nominee Henry B. Quinby defeated Democratic nominee Clarence E. Carr with 50.40% of the vote.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。共和党候选人亨利·B·昆比以50.40%的得票率击败民主党候选人克拉伦斯·E·卡尔。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 3, 1908. All contemporary 46 states were part of the 1908 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, who selected the president and vice president. Idaho was won by the Republican nominees, former Secretary of War William Howard Taft of Ohio and his running mate James S.

en.s: The 1908 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908. Republican nominee George L. Lilley defeated Democratic nominee A. Heaton Robertson with 51.92% of the vote.

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 3, 1908, as part of the 1908 United States presidential election. Connecticut voted for the Republican nominees, Secretary of War William Howard Taft of Ohio and his running mate James S. Sherman of New York.

zh.t: 1908年康涅狄格州美国总统选举

en.s: The 1908 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908. Democratic nominee Judson Harmon defeated incumbent Republican Andrew L. Harris with 49.20% of the vote.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行俄亥俄州州长选举。民主党候选人贾德森·哈蒙以49.20%的得票率击败现任共和党州长安德鲁·L·哈里斯。

en.s: The 1908 Alabama Railroad Commission election was held on November 3, 1908 to elect the president of the Alabama Railroad Commission (ARC). The primary election was held on May 18, 1908.

zh.t: 1908年阿拉巴马州铁路委员会选举
zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行阿拉巴马州铁路委员会选举，以选出委员会主席。初选于1908年5月18日举行。

en.s: The 1908 Missouri gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908, and resulted in a victory for the Republican nominee, Missouri Attorney General Herbert S. Hadley, over the Democratic candidate, former Congressman William S. Cowherd, and several other candidates representing minor parties. This election broke a string of eleven consecutive Democratic governors, as it was the first election since 1870 which did not result in a victory by the Democratic nominee (no Democrat had run in 1870).

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行密苏里州州长选举。共和党候选人、密苏里州总检察长赫伯特·S·哈德利击败民主党候选人、前联邦众议员威廉·S·考赫德及其他小党候选人，当选州长。这次选举结束了民主党连续11次赢得州长选举的纪录；自1870年以来，民主党候选人首次落败（1870年没有民主党人参选）。

en.s: The 1908 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908. Incumbent Republican Governor George L. Sheldon was defeated by Democratic nominee Ashton C. Shallenberger.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州州长选举。现任共和党州长乔治·L·谢尔登败给民主党候选人阿什顿·C·沙伦伯格。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 3, 1908. All contemporary 46 states were part of the 1908 United States presidential election. Alabama voters chose eleven electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Alabama was won by the Democratic nominees, former Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate John W. Kern of Indiana.

zh.t: 1908年阿拉巴马州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1908年11月3日，阿拉巴马州举行美国总统选举，作为当年总统选举的一部分。当时的46个州都参加了此次选举。阿拉巴马州选出11名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。该州支持民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩，以及他的竞选搭档、来自印第安纳州的约翰·W·克恩。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 3, 1908, as part of the 1908 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island voted for the Republican nominees, Secretary of War William Howard Taft of Ohio and his running mate James S. Sherman of New York.

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Vermont
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Vermont took place on November 3, 1908, as part of the 1908 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Vermont overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominees, Secretary of War William Howard Taft of Ohio and his running mate James S. Sherman of New York.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日，佛蒙特州举行美国总统选举，作为当年总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。佛蒙特州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、来自俄亥俄州的战争部长威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱，以及他的竞选搭档、来自纽约州的詹姆斯·S·谢尔曼。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Utah was held on November 3, 1908, throughout all forty-six contemporary states as part of the 1908 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. This was the last election when Utah had the minimum three electoral votes as it would gain a second congressional district after the 1910 Census.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日，犹他州举行美国总统选举。当时的46个州都参加了此次选举。犹他州选出3名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。这是犹他州选举人票仍为最低的3票的最后一次选举；该州在1910年人口普查后增加了第二个国会选区。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 3, 1908. All contemporary 46 states were part of the 1908 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Following the passage of a new constitution in 1898, Louisiana became a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 1908年11月3日，路易斯安那州举行美国总统选举，作为当年总统选举的一部分。当时的46个州都参加了此次选举。路易斯安那州选出9名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。1898年新宪法通过后，路易斯安那州成为由民主党主导的一党制州。

en.t: 1908 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 3, 1908, as part of the 1908 United States presidential election. en.s: The 1908 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908. Though some Republicans had interest in nominating incumbent Governor Preston Lea to a second term, the state convention instead named former State Senator Simeon S. Pennewill as the Republican nominee. In the general election, Pennewill faced Democratic nominee Rowland G. Paynter, a physician. Pennewill ultimately defeated Paynter by a relatively slim margin, continuing the Republican streak in Delaware gubernatorial elections.

en.s: The 1908 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1908, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent State Treasurer of Missouri Jacob F. Gmelich defeated Democratic nominee William Rock Painter.

en.s: The 1908 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 3, 1908. All contemporary 46 states were part of the 1908 United States presidential election. zh.s: 1908年11月3日，加利福尼亚州举行美国总统选举，作为当年总统选举的一部分。该州选出10名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。加利福尼亚州支持共和党候选人、前战争部长威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱，以及他的竞选搭档、来自纽约州的詹姆斯·S·谢尔曼。

Voters chose nine electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. zh.s: 1908年11月3日，阿肯色州举行美国总统选举。当时的46个州都参加了此次选举。选民选出9名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。自1890年以来，阿肯色州一直是典型的吉姆·克劳法南方州，大多数黑人和贫困白人因人头税而被剥夺投票权。

en.s: The 1912 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was the 25th All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1912 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, an inter-county Gaelic football tournament for the top teams in Ireland. Louth were aiming to repeat their 1910 success, while Antrim sought their first All-Ireland SFC title, having lost the previous year's final to Cork.

en.s: The 1914 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1914 for the post of the Governor of Arizona. The Supreme Court of Arizona ruled that there would be no statewide elections in 1912, thus extending the terms to sync up with elections on even years. The Democratic nominee was incumbent governor George W. P. Hunt, his Republican opponent was the final Delegate to Congress from Arizona Territory, Ralph H. Cameron. Cameron was disadvantaged by the same reason the previous Republican nominee Wells was, he had opposed statehood with the present Constitution.

en.s: The California gubernatorial election, 1914 was held on November 3, 1914. Hiram Johnson was elected in 1910 as a member of the Republican Party. Dissatisfaction with the conservatism of the Taft administration led many Republicans to join former President Roosevelt's Progressive Party, with Johnson served as the Vice-Presidential candidate in the 1912 presidential election. Despite losing the general election, and winning California by less than 200 votes, Johnson was supremely popular in California. He was re-elected in 1914 as governor under the Progressive Party ticket, nearly tripling his vote from 1910 as a Republican, and was elected and reelected as Senator many times until his death in 1945.

zh.s: 1914年加利福尼亚州州长选举于1914年11月3日举行。希勒姆·约翰逊在1910年以共和党人身份当选州长。由于不满塔夫脱政府的保守主义，许多共和党人转而加入前总统罗斯福的进步党；约翰逊也曾在1912年总统选举中担任罗斯福的副总统候选人。罗斯福在大选中落败，但在加利福尼亚州仅以不到200票之差取胜，约翰逊仍在当地极受欢迎。1914年，约翰逊以进步党候选人身份再次当选州长，得票数接近他1910年以共和党人身份参选时的三倍。他后来多次当选和连任联邦参议员，直至1945年去世。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1914 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1914. Democratic Party of Minnesota candidate Winfield Scott Hammond defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger William E. Lee.

zh.s: 1914年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月3日举行。明尼苏达州民主党候选人温菲尔德·斯科特·哈蒙德击败了共和党对手威廉·E·李。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Ohio, 1914
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in Ohio was held on November 3, 1914. Republican nominee Warren G. Harding, future President of the United States, defeated Democratic nominee Timothy S. Hogan to succeed retiring incumbent Republican Senator Theodore E. Burton.

zh.t: 1914年俄亥俄州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行俄亥俄州联邦参议院选举。共和党提名人、后来的美国总统沃伦·G·哈定击败民主党提名人蒂莫西·S·霍根，接替退休的共和党参议员西奥多·E·伯顿。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1914 took place on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Republican Allen M. Fletcher, per the "Mountain Rule", did not run for re-election to a second term as Governor of Vermont. Republican candidate Charles W. Gates defeated Democratic candidate Harland B. Howe and Progressive candidate Walter J. Aldrich to succeed him.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行佛蒙特州州长选举。根据“山地规则”，在任共和党州长艾伦·M·弗莱彻没有竞选连任。共和党候选人查尔斯·W·盖茨击败民主党候选人哈兰·B·豪和进步党候选人沃尔特·J·奥尔德里奇，接任州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1914 New York state election was held on November 3, 1914, to elect the Governor, the Lieutenant Governor, the Secretary of State, the State Comptroller, the Attorney General, the State Treasurer, the State Engineer, a U.S. Senator and a judge of the New York Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate, and delegates-at-large to the New York State Constitutional Convention of 1915.

zh.s: 1914年纽约州选举于11月3日举行，选举州长、副州长、州务卿、州审计长、州总检察长、州财政部长、州工程师、一名联邦参议员和一名纽约州上诉法院法官，并选举纽约州众议院和参议院全体议员，以及出席1915年纽约州制宪会议的全州代表。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 1914
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Boies Penrose won re-election against Gifford Pinchot and Alexander Mitchell Palmer.

zh.t: 1914年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1914年宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任联邦参议员博伊斯·彭罗斯击败吉福德·平肖和亚历山大·米切尔·帕尔默，成功连任。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1914
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1914 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 3, 1914. Republicans lost two seats, one to the Progressive Party and one to the Prohibition Party.

zh.t: 1914年加利福尼亚州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1914年加利福尼亚州联邦众议员选举是选举该州联邦众议院代表团的选举，于11月3日的联邦众议院普选中举行。共和党失去两个席位，其中一个由进步党赢得，另一个由禁酒党赢得。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1914 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1914 to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. The election matched Republican James Withycombe against Democratic candidate C. J. Smith.

zh.s: 1914年俄勒冈州州长选举于11月3日举行，选出该州州长。共和党候选人詹姆斯·威瑟科姆与民主党候选人C·J·史密斯参选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Pennsylvania gubernatorial election of 1914 occurred on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Republican governor John K. Tener was not a candidate for re-election. Republican candidate Martin Grove Brumbaugh defeated Democratic candidate Vance C. McCormick to become Governor of Pennsylvania.

zh.s: 1914年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任州长约翰·K·特纳没有竞选连任。共和党候选人马丁·格罗夫·布兰博击败民主党候选人万斯·C·麦考密克，当选宾夕法尼亚州州长。
