en.t: United States Senate election in Vermont, 1914
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in Vermont took place on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Republican William P. Dillingham successfully ran for re-election to another term in the United States Senate, defeating Democratic candidate Charles A. Prouty. This was the first United States Senate direct election to take place in Vermont following the ratification of the Seventeenth Amendment to the United States Constitution.

zh.t: 1914年佛蒙特州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1914年佛蒙特州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任参议员威廉·P·迪林厄姆成功连任，击败民主党候选人查尔斯·A·普劳蒂。这是美国宪法第十七修正案获批准后，佛蒙特州举行的首次联邦参议员直选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1914 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Republican nominee Frank B. Willis defeated incumbent Democratic governor James M. Cox and Progressive nominee James Rudolph Garfield with 46.32% of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行俄亥俄州州长选举。共和党候选人弗兰克·B·威利斯以46.32%的得票率击败现任民主党州长詹姆斯·M·考克斯和进步党候选人詹姆斯·鲁道夫·加菲尔德。

en.t: 1914 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 3, 1914. It was the first direct U.S. Senate election in Colorado following the ratification of the Seventeenth Amendment. Incumbent U.S. Senator Charles S. Thomas, a Democrat, who was first elected by the state legislature to fill a vacancy in 1913, ran for re-election to a full term.

zh.t: 1914年美国科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1914年美国科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。这是美国宪法第十七修正案获批准后，科罗拉多州首次通过直接选举产生联邦参议员。民主党籍时任联邦参议员查尔斯·S·托马斯于1913年由州议会选出，填补空缺；此次他竞选完整任期。

en.s: The 1914 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Democratic Governor John H. Morehead defeated Republican nominee Robert B. Howell with 50.36% of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州州长选举。现任民主党州长约翰·H·莫尔黑德以50.36%的得票率击败共和党候选人罗伯特·B·豪厄尔。

en.s: The 1914 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Republican nominee George Alfred Carlson defeated Democratic nominee Thomas M. Patterson with 48.67% of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行科罗拉多州州长选举。共和党候选人乔治·阿尔弗雷德·卡尔森以48.67%的得票率击败民主党候选人托马斯·M·帕特森。

en.t: 1914 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in Connecticut was held on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Senator Frank B. Brandegee was re-elected to a second term in office over Democratic U.S. Representative Augustine Lonergan.

zh.t: 1914年康涅狄格州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行康涅狄格州联邦参议员选举。现任参议员弗兰克·B·布兰迪吉击败民主党候选人、联邦众议员奥古斯丁·洛纳根，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1914 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Democrat Woodbridge N. Ferris defeated Republican candidate Chase S. Osborn with 48.15% of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行密歇根州州长选举。现任民主党州长伍德布里奇·N·费里斯以48.15%的得票率击败共和党候选人蔡斯·S·奥斯本。

en.s: The 1914 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Democratic nominee Moses Alexander defeated incumbent Republican John M. Haines with 44.13% of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行爱达荷州州长选举。民主党候选人摩西·亚历山大以44.13%的得票率击败现任共和党州长约翰·M·海恩斯。

en.s: The 1914 Connecticut Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1914, in order to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Republican nominee George E. Hinman defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Connecticut State Senate John F. McDonough.

zh.t: 1914年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行康涅狄格州总检察长选举。共和党候选人乔治·E·欣曼击败民主党候选人、时任康涅狄格州参议员约翰·F·麦克多诺。

en.s: The 1914 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Democratic Governor Samuel D. Felker declined to seek re-election. Businessman Rolland H. Spaulding won the Republican primary and faced Executive Councilor Albert W. Noone, the Democratic nominee, in the general election. Spaulding defeated Noone in a landslide.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。现任民主党州长塞缪尔·D·费尔克没有竞选连任。商人罗兰·H·斯波尔丁赢得共和党初选，并在大选中对阵民主党候选人、行政委员会委员阿尔伯特·W·努恩。斯波尔丁以压倒性优势获胜。

en.s: The 1914 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Lieutenant Governor J. A. A. Burnquist of the Republican Party of Minnesota defeated Minnesota Democratic Party challenger Charles M. Andrist, Socialist Party of Minnesota candidate Andrew Hanson, and Prohibition Party candidate A. W. Piper.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行明尼苏达州副州长选举。现任共和党副州长J·A·A·伯恩奎斯特击败民主党候选人查尔斯·M·安德里斯、明尼苏达州社会党候选人安德鲁·汉森和禁酒党候选人A·W·派珀。

en.s: The 1914 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Democratic nominee Emmet D. Boyle defeated incumbent Republican Tasker Oddie with 44.65% of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行内华达州州长选举。民主党候选人埃米特·D·博伊尔以44.65%的得票率击败现任共和党州长塔斯克·奥迪。

en.s: The 1914 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Republican nominee Robert Livingston Beeckman defeated Democratic nominee Patrick H. Quinn with 53.80% of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行罗得岛州州长选举。共和党候选人罗伯特·利文斯顿·比克曼以53.80%的得票率击败民主党候选人帕特里克·H·奎因。

en.s: The 1914 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914, and featured Democratic nominee James Pearson defeating Republican nominee Walter V. Hoagland as well as Progressive Party nominee G. L. E. Klingbiel, Socialist Party nominee Glen H. Abel, and Prohibition Party nominee Henry F. J. Hockenberger. Incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Samuel R. McKelvie did not seek reelection.

zh.t: 1914年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州副州长选举。民主党候选人詹姆斯·皮尔逊击败共和党候选人沃尔特·V·霍格兰，以及进步党候选人G·L·E·克林比尔、社会党候选人格伦·H·阿贝尔和禁酒党候选人亨利·F·J·霍肯伯格。现任副州长塞缪尔·R·麦凯尔维没有竞选连任。

en.t: 1914 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in Missouri took place on November 3, 1914, in Missouri. Incumbent Democratic Senator William J. Stone was re-elected to a third term in office. He defeated Thomas Akins of the Republican Party.

zh.t: 1914年密苏里州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行密苏里州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党参议员威廉·J·斯通成功连任第三个任期，击败共和党候选人托马斯·阿金斯。

en.s: The 1914 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Primary elections were held on September 1, 1914. Incumbent Republican Governor Francis E. McGovern retired to run for U.S. Senate. Republican nominee Emanuel L. Philipp defeated Democratic nominee John C. Karel, Progressive nominee John J. Blaine and Social Democratic nominee Oscar Ameringer, with 43.26% of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行威斯康星州州长选举，初选于同年9月1日举行。现任共和党州长弗朗西斯·E·麦戈文退出竞选，转而竞选联邦参议员。共和党候选人伊曼纽尔·L·菲利普以43.26%的得票率击败民主党候选人约翰·C·卡雷尔、进步党候选人约翰·J·布莱恩和社会民主党候选人奥斯卡·阿默林格。

en.s: The 1914 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1914, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Julius A. Schmahl defeated Democratic nominee Nels N. Bergheim, Prohibition nominee Iver M. Kalnes and Progressive nominee John C. Lewis.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行明尼苏达州州务卿选举。共和党候选人、现任州务卿朱利叶斯·A·施马尔击败民主党候选人内尔斯·N·伯格海姆、禁酒党候选人艾弗·M·卡尔内斯和进步党候选人约翰·C·刘易斯。

en.s: The 1914 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 3, 1914, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee J. A. O. Preus defeated Democratic nominee Andrew J. Rush, Socialist nominee Timothy A. Thompson and Progressive nominee Will Curtis.

zh.t: 1914年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行明尼苏达州州审计长选举。共和党候选人J·A·O·普鲁斯击败民主党候选人安德鲁·J·拉什、社会党候选人蒂莫西·A·汤普森和进步党候选人威尔·柯蒂斯。

en.s: The 1914 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Democratic nominee Thomas Clarke Rye defeated incumbent Republican governor Ben W. Hooper with 53.55% of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行田纳西州州长选举。民主党候选人托马斯·克拉克·赖以53.55%的得票率击败现任共和党州长本·W·胡珀。

en.s: The 1914 Oklahoma elections were held on November 3, 1914, in the U.S. state of Oklahoma. Oklahoma voters elected statewide officials and members of the United States House of Representatives.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日，俄克拉何马州举行选举，选出全州公职人员和联邦众议院议员。

en.s: The 1914 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Despite a close election in 1912, incumbent Republican governor Frank M. Byrne defeated Democratic nominee James W. McCarter, an Edmunds County Judge, with 50.07% of the vote. Coincidently, Bryne's Democratic opponent in 1912, Edwin S. Johnson, was elected the same year to represent South Dakota in the United States Senate.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行南达科他州州长选举。尽管1912年的选举竞争激烈，在任共和党州长弗兰克·M·伯恩仍以50.07%的得票率击败民主党提名人、埃德蒙兹县法官詹姆斯·W·麦卡特。伯恩在1912年的民主党对手埃德温·S·约翰逊同年当选南达科他州联邦参议员。

en.t: 1914 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Senator Thomas Gore, a Democrat, sought re-election in his first popular election. He was challenged by Republican nominee John H. Burford, a former Justice on the Territorial Oklahoma Supreme Court; Socialist nominee Patrick S. Nagle, a former U.S. Marshal; and Progressive nominee William O. Cromwell, the former State Attorney General.

zh.t: 1914年俄克拉何马州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1914年11月3日，俄克拉何马州举行联邦参议院选举。在任民主党参议员托马斯·戈尔首次参加普选，竞选连任。对手包括共和党提名人、前俄克拉何马领地最高法院法官约翰·H·伯福德；社会党提名人、前联邦法警帕特里克·S·纳格尔；以及进步党提名人、前州总检察长威廉·O·克朗普顿。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1914, in 31 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 3, 1914 (except for Arkansas and Maine, where they were held on September 14, and Georgia, where they were held on October 7). In Arizona, the governor was elected to a two-year term for the first time, having been elected to an inaugural three-year term at the first election in 1911.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日，美国31个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举同时进行。阿肯色州和缅因州于9月14日提前举行选举，佐治亚州则于10月7日举行。亚利桑那州州长首次改为两年一届；此前，该州在1911年的首次选举中选出任期三年的州长。

en.s: The 1914 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1914, in order to elect the governor of Alabama. Democratic incumbent Emmet O'Neal was term-limited, and could not seek a second consecutive term.

zh.s: 1914年阿拉巴马州州长选举于11月3日举行，目的是选出州长。民主党籍时任州长埃米特·奥尼尔受任期限制，不能竞选连任。

loc: 美国俄克拉何马州俄克拉何马县

en.s: The 1914 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat Robert L. Williams narrowly defeated Republican John Fields and Socialist Fred W. Holt. Also on the ballot were Independents Amos L. Wilson and T. J. Wood as well as Progressive Party nominee John P. Hickam. The Prohibition Party also had ballot access but did not run a candidate in the general election.

zh.t: 1914年美国俄克拉何马州州长选举
zh.s: 1914年美国俄克拉何马州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党候选人罗伯特·L·威廉姆斯以微弱优势击败共和党候选人约翰·菲尔兹和社会党候选人弗雷德·W·霍尔特。独立候选人阿莫斯·L·威尔逊、T·J·伍德以及进步党候选人约翰·P·希卡姆也列于选票上。禁酒党有资格参选，但没有推出大选候选人。

en.s: The 1914 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Republican L. B. Hanna defeated Democratic nominee Frank O. Hellstrom with 49.58% of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行北达科他州州长选举。在任共和党州长L·B·汉纳以49.58%的得票率击败民主党提名人弗兰克·O·赫尔斯特伦。

en.t: 1914 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: 1914 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 64th United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 3, 1914, while Maine held theirs on September 14. They were held in the middle of President Woodrow Wilson's first term.

zh.s: 1914年举行美国联邦众议院选举，选出第64届国会议员。选举大多于11月3日举行，缅因州则在9月14日举行。选举时，伍德罗·威尔逊正处于总统首个任期中。

en.s: The 1914 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1914. The Democratic nominee and cattleman John B. Kendrick defeated the Republican Hilliard S. Ridgely with 51.61% of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行怀俄明州州长选举。民主党提名人、牧场主约翰·B·肯德里克以51.61%的得票率击败共和党人希利亚德·S·里奇利。

en.t: 1914 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in California was held on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Republican Senator George Clement Perkins did not run for re-election. In a three-way race, Democratic former mayor of San Francisco James Duval Phelan defeated Progressive attorney Francis J. Heney and Republican U.S. Representative Joseph R. Knowland.

zh.t: 1914年加利福尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行加利福尼亚州联邦参议院选举。在任共和党参议员乔治·克莱门特·珀金斯没有竞选连任。三人角逐该席位，旧金山前市长、民主党人詹姆斯·杜瓦尔·费兰击败进步党律师弗朗西斯·J·亨尼和共和党联邦众议员约瑟夫·R·诺兰。

en.t: 1914 United States Senate election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in North Dakota took place on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Senator Asle Gronna, a Republican, sought re-election in his first popular election. Against several strong challengers, he won the Republican primary, though only with a plurality. In the general election, he faced former U.S. Senator William E. Purcell, the Democratic nominee. Gronna ultimately had little difficulty defeating Purcell to win re-election.

zh.t: 1914年北达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行北达科他州联邦参议员选举。现任共和党参议员阿斯勒·格罗纳首次通过普选寻求连任。他面对多名实力强劲的挑战者，在共和党初选中胜出，但只获得相对多数票。大选中，他对阵民主党候选人、前联邦参议员威廉·E·珀塞尔。格罗纳最终轻松击败珀塞尔，成功连任。

en.s: The 1914 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Progressive State Assemblyman John Morton Eshleman defeated Democratic State Assemblyman Jo V. Snyder with 62.31% of the vote.

zh.t: 1914年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行加利福尼亚州副州长选举。进步党州众议员约翰·莫顿·埃什尔曼以62.31%的得票率击败民主党州众议员乔·V·斯奈德。

en.t: 1914 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Senator Coe I. Crawford, a Republican, sought re-election in his first popular election. He was defeated in the Republican primary by Congressman Charles H. Burke, the House Minority Whip. In the general election, he was narrowly defeated by Edwin S. Johnson, the 1912 Democratic nominee for Governor, who won a narrow plurality.

zh.t: 1914年南达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行南达科他州联邦参议员选举。现任共和党参议员科伊·I·克劳福德首次通过普选寻求连任。他在共和党初选中败给众议员、众议院少数党党鞭查尔斯·H·伯克。大选中，他又以微弱差距败给埃德温·S·约翰逊；约翰逊曾是1912年州长选举的民主党候选人，并以微弱优势获胜。

en.s: The 1914 Massachusetts gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1914. Democratic Governor David I. Walsh defeated the Republican, Samuel W. McCall, and the Progressive, Joseph Walker, and won reelection with 45.93% of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行马萨诸塞州州长选举。民主党州长戴维·I·沃尔什以45.93%的得票率击败共和党候选人塞缪尔·W·麦考尔和进步党候选人约瑟夫·沃克，成功连任。

en.s: The 1914 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Republican George W. Clarke defeated Democratic nominee John Taylor Hamilton with 49.31% of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行艾奥瓦州州长选举。现任共和党州长乔治·W·克拉克以49.31%的得票率击败民主党候选人约翰·泰勒·汉密尔顿。

en.s: The 1914 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1914, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Lyndon A. Smith defeated Democratic nominee Neil Cronin and Progressive nominee and former member of the Minnesota Senate August V. Rieke.

zh.t: 1914年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行明尼苏达州总检察长选举。共和党候选人、现任总检察长林登·A·史密斯击败民主党候选人尼尔·克罗宁，以及进步党候选人、前明尼苏达州参议员奥古斯特·V·里克。

en.s: The 1914 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Republican nominee Marcus H. Holcomb defeated Democratic nominee Lyman T. Tingier with 50.39% of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行康涅狄格州州长选举。共和党候选人马库斯·H·霍尔科姆以50.39%的得票率击败民主党候选人莱曼·T·廷吉尔。

en.s: The 1914 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914. Republican nominee Arthur Capper defeated Democratic incumbent George H. Hodges with 39.67% of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行堪萨斯州州长选举。共和党候选人阿瑟·卡珀以39.67%的得票率击败民主党籍现任州长乔治·H·霍奇斯。

en.t: 1914 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Republican senator Lawrence Yates Sherman, first elected to a partial term by the Illinois General Assembly in a special election the previous year, was reelected to a full term as U.S. senator by a popular vote.

zh.t: 1914年伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举。现任共和党参议员劳伦斯·耶茨·谢尔曼前一年在特别选举中由伊利诺伊州议会选出，任期仅到本届结束；这次他通过普选连任，获得完整任期。

en.s: The 1914 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1914, in order to elect the Governor of Texas. James E. Ferguson, nominated by the Democratic Party, easily defeated his two general election opponents, E.R. Meitzen of the Socialist Party and John W. Philip of the Republican Party.

zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行得克萨斯州州长选举。民主党提名的詹姆斯·E·弗格森轻松击败两名大选对手：社会党候选人E·R·迈岑和共和党候选人约翰·W·菲利普。

en.t: 1914 United States Senate election in Alabama
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in Alabama was held on November 3, 1914. Incumbent U.S. Senator Frank White, who had been elected in a May 11, 1914, special election to fill the remaining months of Senator Joseph F. Johnston's term, did not run for re-election. U.S. Representative Oscar Underwood, the House Majority Leader, won the Democratic primary over fellow Representative Richmond P. Hobson.

zh.t: 1914年美国阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1914年美国阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。时任联邦参议员弗兰克·怀特在1914年5月11日的特别选举中当选，接替约瑟夫·F·约翰斯顿任期剩余的几个月；他没有竞选连任。联邦众议员、众议院多数党领袖奥斯卡·安德伍德在民主党初选中击败了同为联邦众议员的里士满·P·霍布森。

en.t: 1914 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in Kansas was held on November 3, 1914, and was the first popular Senate election held in the state after the ratification of the Seventeenth Amendment. Incumbent Republican Senator Joseph L. Bristow ran for re-election to a second term, but he was narrowly defeated in the Republican primary by former Senator Charles Curtis. Two members of Congress—Democrat George A.

zh.t: 1914年美国堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1914年美国堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。这是美国宪法第十七修正案获批准后，该州首次举行联邦参议员普选。共和党籍时任参议员约瑟夫·L·布里斯托竞选连任第二个任期，但在共和党初选中以微弱差距败给前参议员查尔斯·柯蒂斯。两位联邦议员——民主党人乔治·A。

en.s: The 1914 United States Senate elections were held on November 3, 1914. These were the first regularly scheduled elections held following the ratification of the Seventeenth Amendment to the United States Constitution in 1913, which required that all seats up for election be popularly elected, rather than chosen by their state legislatures. Thus, it was the first time that elections were generally scheduled on Election Day to coincide with the U.S.

zh.s: 1914年美国联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。这是美国宪法第十七修正案于1913年获批准后，首次举行定期改选。修正案规定，所有改选席位都必须由选民直接投票产生，而不再由州议会选出。这也是联邦选举首次普遍安排在选举日举行，与美国……

en.t: 1914 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 3, 1914. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Wesley Livsey Jones was re-elected to a second term in office in a three-way race with William Wilson Black and Ole Hanson. This election was the first time since 1891 that an incumbent Republican Senator from Washington was re-elected or won re-election.

zh.t: 1914年华盛顿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1914年11月3日举行华盛顿州联邦参议院选举。在任共和党参议员韦斯利·利夫赛·琼斯在三人角逐中击败威廉·威尔逊·布莱克和奥勒·汉森，连任第二届。这是自1891年以来，华盛顿州共和党在任参议员首次成功连任或赢得连任选举。

en.s: The Battle of Kilimanjaro at Longido took place in German East Africa in November 1914 and was an early skirmish during the East African Campaign of the First World War.

zh.s: 乞力马扎罗之战发生于1914年11月的德属东非隆吉多，是第一次世界大战东非战役初期的一场小规模交战。

en.t: 1914 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 3. Incumbent Republican Senator Elihu Root chose not to seek re-election. James Wolcott Wadsworth Jr. was elected to succeed Root, defeating Democrat James Watson Gerard. Primary elections were held on September 28. These were the first direct primaries (in which party members chose each candidate individually rather than as part of a slate) in the history of New York state.

zh.t: 1914年美国联邦参议院纽约州选举
zh.s: 1914年美国联邦参议院纽约州选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任参议员伊莱休·鲁特决定不竞选连任。詹姆斯·沃尔科特·沃兹沃思二世当选接替鲁特，击败民主党人詹姆斯·沃森·杰拉德。初选于9月28日举行。这是纽约州历史上首次举行直接初选，党内成员逐个选择候选人，而不是整组选出候选人名单。

en.t: 1914 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in Arizona was held on Tuesday November 3, Incumbent United States Senator Marcus Aurelius Smith was reelected to a second term defeating state senator Don Lorenzo Hubbell, the Republican nominee, in the general election by a wide margin. Several third-party candidates also ran in the election including former Prohibition Party presidential candidate Eugene W.

zh.t: 1914年美国亚利桑那州参议员选举
zh.s: 1914年11月3日，亚利桑那州举行联邦参议员选举。民主党现任议员马库斯·史密斯以明显优势击败共和党候选人唐·洛伦佐·哈贝尔，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The 1914 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1914 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 22 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1914 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1914年爱荷华州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。爱荷华州选民在州参议院50个选区中的22个选区选出议员，州参议员任期四年。爱荷华州议会提供了1914年州参议院50个选区的全州地图。

en.s: The Battle of Moon Sound was a naval battle fought between the forces of the German Empire, and the Russian Republic (and three British submarines) in the Baltic Sea during Operation Albion from 16 October 1917 until 3 November 1917 during World War I. The German intention was to destroy the Russian forces and occupy the West Estonian Archipelago, and achieved both objectives.

zh.s: 穆恩海峡海战是第一次世界大战期间阿尔比恩行动中的一场海战，1917年10月16日至11月3日在波罗的海进行，交战双方为德意志帝国与俄罗斯共和国，另有三艘英国潜艇参战。德军意图摧毁俄军并占领西爱沙尼亚群岛，最终达成了这两个目标。

en.s: The Kiel mutiny (German: Kieler Matrosenaufstand) was a revolt by sailors of the German High Seas Fleet against the maritime military command in Kiel. The mutiny broke out on 3 November 1918 after sailors at Wilhelmshaven refused orders on 30 October to sail out for what was to be the final battle against the British Grand Fleet.

zh.s: 基尔兵变是德国公海舰队水兵反抗基尔海军指挥部的一场起义。1918年11月3日，威廉港水兵于10月30日拒绝执行出海命令后，兵变爆发。原计划是出海与英国大舰队进行最后一战。

en.s: The 1919 Newfoundland general election was held on 3 November 1919 to elect members of the 24th General Assembly of Newfoundland in the Dominion of Newfoundland. The Liberal Reform Party, an alliance between the Liberals led by Richard Squires and the Fishermen's Protective Union of William Coaker, formed the government. The People's Party, became the Liberal-Labour-Progressive party following the election and formed the opposition.

zh.s: 1919年纽芬兰大选于1919年11月3日举行，选出纽芬兰自治领第24届议会的议员。由理查德·斯奎尔斯领导的自由党与威廉·科克领导的渔民保护联盟结成自由党改革联盟并组建政府。人民党在选举后改名为自由党—劳工—进步党，成为反对党。

en.t: Russian Civil War: The Russian Army retreats to Crimea, after a successful offensive by the Red Army and Revolutionary Insurgent Army of Ukraine
en.s: The Russian Civil War was a multi-party civil war in the former Russian Empire, lasting from 1917 to 1922, sparked by the overthrowing of the Russian Provisional Government in the October Revolution, as many factions vied to determine Russia's political future. It resulted in the formation of the Russian Socialist Federative Soviet Republic and later the Soviet Union in most of its territory.

zh.t: 俄国内战：红军和乌克兰革命起义军成功发动攻势后，俄军撤退至克里米亚
zh.s: 俄国内战是1917年至1922年发生在前俄罗斯帝国境内的一场多方内战，起因是十月革命推翻俄罗斯临时政府，各派势力随即争夺俄罗斯未来的政治方向。战争导致俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国成立，后来苏联也在其大部分领土上建立。

en.s: The Northern Taurida operation (6 June – 3 November 1920) was a military campaign in the Russian Civil War between the Red Army and the White Army under Pyotr Wrangel for the possession of Northern Taurida. The campaign can be divided into three stages: the White offensive (6 June – 3 July), trench warfare around the Kakhovka Bridgehead (20 August – 27 October) and the counterattack of the Red Army (28 October – 3 November).

zh.s: 北塔夫里达战役（1920年6月6日至11月3日）是俄国内战期间的一场军事行动，红军与彼得·弗兰格尔率领的白军为争夺北塔夫里达而战。行动分为三个阶段：6月6日至7月3日白军进攻；8月20日至10月27日在卡霍夫卡桥头堡周边进行堑壕战；10月28日至11月3日红军反攻。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1925 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 3, 1925. Democrat A. Harry Moore defeated Republican nominee Arthur Whitney with 51.87% of the vote.

zh.s: 1925年新泽西州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党人A·哈里·摩尔以51.87%的得票率击败共和党候选人阿瑟·惠特尼。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 3, 1925, in two states. Virginia holds its gubernatorial elections in odd numbered years, every 4 years, following the United States presidential election year. New Jersey at this time held gubernatorial elections every 3 years. It would abandon this practice in 1949.

zh.s: 1925年11月3日，美国有两个州举行州长选举。弗吉尼亚州每四年在总统选举年的次年举行州长选举。新泽西州当时每三年举行一次州长选举，直到1949年才改掉这一做法。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1925 occurred on Tuesday, November 3, 1925. Malcolm Nichols, a former member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives and Massachusetts Senate, defeated nine other candidates to be elected mayor. Many votes were split between three Democratic candidates (Glynn, O'Neil, Coakley), which was a factor in the election of Nichols, a Republican.

zh.s: 1925年11月3日星期二举行波士顿市长选举。马尔科姆·尼科尔斯曾任马萨诸塞州众议员和州参议员，他击败另外9名候选人，当选市长。民主党候选人中有三人参选（格林、奥尼尔和科克利），选票因此分散，这也成为共和党人尼科尔斯当选的原因之一。

en.s: The 1925 Indianapolis mayoral election was held on November 3, 1925, and saw the election of Republican Marion County treasurer John L. Duvall, who defeated Democratic former Indianapolis city attorney Walter Myers. The 1925 municipal elections were notable for the presence of the Ku Klux Klan. John L. Duvall backed by the Indiana Klan. However, contemporarily, the election was considered to one of the most tame municipal elections in then-recent memory.

zh.t: 1925年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 1925年11月3日举行印第安纳波利斯市长选举。共和党候选人、马里恩县财政官约翰·L·杜瓦尔击败民主党候选人、前印第安纳波利斯市检察官沃尔特·迈尔斯，当选市长。三K党参与了1925年的市政选举，杜瓦尔得到印第安纳州三K党的支持。不过，当时人们认为这次选举在近年市政选举中算得上最平静的一次。

en.s: The 1925 Pittsburgh mayoral election was held on Tuesday, 3 November 1925. It resulted in a landslide victory for Republican candidate Charles H. Kline.

zh.s: 1925年匹兹堡市长选举于1925年11月3日（星期二）举行。共和党候选人查尔斯·H·克莱因以明显优势获胜。

en.t: 1926 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1926 United States Senate election in Arizona was held on Tuesday November 3, Incumbent Republican Senator Ralph Cameron ran for re-election on his second term, but was defeated by incumbent Democratic Representative Carl Hayden in the general election. Hayden eventually became the longest-serving Senator being re-elected to six more terms until he retired in 1968.

zh.t: 1926年美国联邦参议院亚利桑那州选举
zh.s: 1926年美国联邦参议院亚利桑那州选举于11月3日星期二举行。共和党籍时任参议员拉尔夫·卡梅伦竞选连任第二个任期，但在大选中败给民主党籍时任众议员卡尔·海登。海登后来连任六届，成为任职时间最长的参议员，直到1968年退休。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1931 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 3, 1931. Democrat A. Harry Moore defeated Republican nominee David Baird, Jr. with 57.82% of the vote.

zh.s: 1931年新泽西州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党人A·哈里·摩尔以57.82%的得票率击败共和党候选人大卫·贝尔德二世。

en.s: The 1931 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1931. Democratic nominee Ruby Laffoon defeated Republican nominee William B. Harrison with 54.28% of the vote. Incumbent Republican Governor Flemon “Flem” Sampson was term-limited.

zh.s: 1931年11月3日举行肯塔基州州长选举。民主党候选人鲁比·拉丰以54.28%的得票率击败共和党候选人威廉·B·哈里森。现任共和党州长弗莱蒙·“弗莱姆”·桑普森因任期限制无法竞选连任。

en.s: The 1931 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1931, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Theodore G. Bilbo was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second term. As was common at the time, the Democratic candidate ran unopposed in the general election, so therefore the Democratic primary was the real contest, and winning the primary was considered tantamount to election.

en.s: The 1930 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 3, 1936. Incumbent United States Senator James E. Landon took 56.39% of the vote, to Roosevelt's 43.24%, a margin of 13.15%.

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1936
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 3, 1936 in Minnesota as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. The Democratic candidate, incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt won the state over Kansas governor Alf Landon by a margin of 348,350 votes, or 30.83%—nearly double Landon's overall share of the state's vote. Nationally, Roosevelt was soundly re-elected, with 523 electoral votes and a landslide 24.26% lead over Landon in the popular vote. Landon carried only two states: Maine and Vermont. Roosevelt won the second-highest percentage of the national popular vote in any U.S. presidential election since the uncontested election of 1820, surpassed only by Lyndon B.

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1936 was the 38th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 3, 1936. In terms of electoral votes, it was the most lopsided presidential election in the history of the United States. In terms of the popular vote, it was the second-biggest victory for the winner since the election of 1820, which was not seriously contested. The election took place as the Great Depression entered its eighth year. Incumbent President and Democratic candidate Franklin D. Roosevelt was still working to push the provisions of his New Deal economic policy through Congress and the courts.

zh.s: 1936年美国总统选举是第38次四年一度的总统选举，于1936年11月3日星期二举行。按选举人票计算，这是美国历史上差距最大的一次总统选举；按普选票计算，这是自1820年那场几乎没有竞争的选举以来，胜方第二大的一次胜利。选举时，大萧条已进入第八年。民主党籍现任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福仍在推动其新政经济政策通过国会和法院。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by the Democratic candidate, incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.s: 1936年美国怀俄明州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。怀俄明州选民选出3名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。该州支持民主党候选人、时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

en.s: The 1936 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Democratic nominee Frank Murphy defeated incumbent Republican Frank Fitzgerald with 51.02% of the vote.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行密歇根州州长选举。民主党提名人弗兰克·墨菲以51.02%的得票率击败在任共和党州长弗兰克·菲茨杰拉德。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Kansas took place on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Republican Senator Arthur Capper ran for re-election to a fourth term. He was challenged by former Wichita Mayor Omar Ketchum, the 1934 Democratic nominee for Governor. Even though Kansas Governor Alf Landon was the Republican nominee against President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1936年美国堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1936年美国堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任参议员阿瑟·卡珀竞选第四个任期。挑战者是威奇托前市长奥马尔·凯彻姆，他曾是1934年民主党州长候选人。尽管堪萨斯州州长阿尔夫·兰登代表共和党挑战总统富兰克林·D。

en.s: The 1936 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Democratic incumbent Frank Gaines Harris defeated Republican nominee Manvel H. Davis with 59.80% of the vote.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行密苏里州副州长选举。在任民主党人弗랭克·盖恩斯·哈里斯以59.80%的得票率击败共和党提名人曼维尔·H·戴维斯。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Nebraska was held on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Senator George W. Norris, who had previously been elected as a Republican, ran for re-election to a fifth term as an independent candidate. He was challenged in the general election by former Congressman Robert G. Simmons, the Republican nominee, and former Congressman Terry Carpenter, the Democratic nominee.

zh.t: 1936年内布拉斯加州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州联邦参议院选举。曾以共和党人身份当选的在任参议员乔治·W·诺里斯以独立候选人身份竞选连任第五届。大选对手包括共和党提名人、前联邦众议员罗伯特·G·西蒙斯，以及民主党提名人、前联邦众议员特里·卡彭特。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Wyoming was held on November 3, 1936. First-term Republican Senator Robert D. Carey ran for re-election. In a rematch of the 1930 race, he once again faced Harry Schwartz, who had since been elected to the State Senate. Carey's fortunes turned considerably from six years prior; he lost re-election to Schwartz by a decisive margin as President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1936年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1936年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍首任参议员罗伯特·D·凯里竞选连任。这是1930年选举的重赛，对手哈里·施瓦茨此后已当选州参议员。与六年前相比，凯里的选情大幅逆转；他以明显差距败给施瓦茨。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Arkansas took place on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Democratic Senator and Senate Majority Leader Joseph T. Robinson was re-elected to a fifth term in office. He defeated two Democratic opponents in the primary election and then dispatched Republican G.C. Ledbetter in the general election.

zh.t: 1936年阿肯色州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日，阿肯色州举行联邦参议院选举。在任民主党参议员、参议院多数党领袖约瑟夫·T·罗宾逊连任第五届。他在党内初选中击败两名民主党对手，随后在大选中击败共和党人G·C·莱德贝特。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. Louisiana voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the passage of a new constitution in 1898, Louisiana had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1936年路易斯安那州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行美国总统选举，路易斯安那州选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。1898年新宪法通过后，路易斯安那州一直由民主党主导，成为一党制州。

en.s: The 1936 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1936, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent attorney general Harry H. Peterson defeated Republican nominee Oscar Youngdahl and Democratic nominee Thomas F. Gallagher.

zh.t: 1936年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行明尼苏达州总检察长选举。农民劳工党提名人、在任总检察长哈里·H·彼得森击败共和党提名人奥斯卡·扬达尔和民主党提名人托马斯·F·加拉格尔。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Republican Senator Lester J. Dickinson ran for re-election to a second term but was defeated by Democratic Governor Clyde L. Herring. This was the first time since 1855 that Democrats held both of the state's senate seats.

zh.t: 1936年艾奥瓦州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行艾奥瓦州联邦参议院选举。在任共和党参议员莱斯特·J·迪金森竞选连任第二届，但败给民主党州长克莱德·L·赫林。这是自1855年以来，民主党首次同时掌握艾奥瓦州的两个联邦参议院席位。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate special election in Florida (Class 1)
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate special election in Florida was held on November 3, 1936. Charles O. Andrews was easily elected to fill the seat.

zh.t: 1936年佛罗里达州联邦参议院第一类席位特别选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行佛罗里达州联邦参议院第一类席位特别选举。查尔斯·O·安德鲁斯轻松当选，填补该席位。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Delaware was held on November 3, 1936. The state voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Delaware voted for Democratic Party candidate and incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt, who defeated Republican nominee, Kansas Governor Alf Landon.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日，特拉华州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。特拉华州支持民主党候选人、在任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福，击败共和党提名人、堪萨斯州州长阿尔夫·兰登。

en.s: The 1936 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Governor Benjamin Baker Moeur ran for reelection, but he was defeated in the Democratic primary by former judge of the Maricopa County Superior Court Rawghlie Clement Stanford. Rawghlie Clement Stanford defeated former Governor Thomas Edward Campbell by more than 40 points in the general election, and was sworn into his first and only term as governor on January 4, 1937, becoming Arizona's fifth governor.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行亚利桑那州州长选举。在任州长本杰明·贝克·莫厄尔在民主党初选中败给前马里科帕县高等法院法官罗利·克莱门特·斯坦福。斯坦福在大选中以超过40个百分点的优势击败前州长托马斯·爱德华·坎贝尔，并于1937年1月4日宣誓就职，开始其唯一一届任期，成为亚利桑那州第五任州长。

en.s: The 1936 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Democratic nominee Teller Ammons defeated Republican nominee Charles M. Armstrong with 54.57% of the vote.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行科罗拉多州州长选举。民主党提名人特勒·阿蒙斯以54.57%的得票率击败共和党提名人查尔斯·M·阿姆斯特朗。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska was won by the incumbent Democratic President, Franklin Roosevelt from New York, running with Vice President John Nance Garner, with 57.14% of the popular vote, against the Republican nominee, Governor of Kansas Alf Landon, running with Frank Knox, with 40.74% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1936年内布拉斯加州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行美国总统选举，内布拉斯加州选民选出7名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统、来自纽约州的富兰克林·罗斯福与副总统约翰·南斯·加纳搭档，以57.14%的普选票赢得该州。共和党候选人、堪萨斯州州长阿尔夫·兰登与弗兰克·诺克斯搭档，获得40.74%的普选票。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 3, 1936, as part of 1936 United States presidential election held in all forty-eight contemporary states. Kansas voters chose nine electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Kansas had been a powerfully Republican state during the 1920s (as it had been during its first quarter-century of statehood), although it did not possess the isolationist sentiment found in Appalachia or the Upper Midwest.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日，堪萨斯州举行美国总统选举，选出9名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。20世纪20年代，堪萨斯州一直是共和党占优势的州，建州后的前25年也是如此；但该州没有阿巴拉契亚地区或中西部上部地区的孤立主义情绪。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. State voters chose 26 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ohio was decisively won by Democratic Party candidate, incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt, with 57.99% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日，俄亥俄州举行美国总统选举，选出26名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、在任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福以57.99%的普选票大幅赢得该州。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate special election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate special election in Minnesota took place on November 3, 1936. The election was held to fill the vacancy in the seat formerly held by Thomas D. Schall for the final two months of Schall's unexpired term. Governor Floyd B. Olson had appointed Elmer Benson to fill the seat in 1935, but this appointment was temporary and subject to a special election held in the next general election year thereafter—1936.

zh.t: 1936年明尼苏达州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行明尼苏达州联邦参议员特别选举，以填补托马斯·D·沙尔的席位空缺，任期还剩最后两个月。州长弗洛伊德·B·奥尔森于1935年任命埃尔默·本森接任，但这只是临时任命，按规定还要在之后最近一个大选年，也就是1936年举行特别选举。

en.s: The 1936 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1936, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mike Holm defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Paul C. Hartig, Democratic nominee Hugh T. Kennedy and Socialist nominee Vincent R. Dunne.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行明尼苏达州州务卿选举。共和党候选人、现任州务卿迈克·霍尔姆击败农民劳工党候选人保罗·C·哈蒂格、民主党候选人休·T·肯尼迪和社会党候选人文森特·R·邓恩。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the nationwide presidential election. Voters chose eleven representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. In Alabama, voters voted for electors individually instead of as a slate, as in the other states. Since the 1890s, Alabama had been effectively a one-party state ruled by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 1936年阿拉巴马州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日，阿拉巴马州举行美国总统选举。选民选出11名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。与其他州采用候选人名单不同，阿拉巴马州选民逐一投票选举人。自19世纪90年代以来，阿拉巴马州实际上一直是一党制州，由民主党统治。

en.s: The 1936 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Democratic nominee Wilkins P. Horton defeated Republican nominee J. Samuel White with 70.14% of the vote.

zh.t: 1936年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行北卡罗来纳州副州长选举。民主党候选人威尔金斯·P·霍顿以70.14%的得票率击败共和党候选人J·塞缪尔·怀特。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.t: 1936年北达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日，北达科他州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。

en.s: The 1936 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Democrat Martin L. Davey defeated Republican nominee John W. Bricker with 52.02% of the vote.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行俄亥俄州州长选举。现任民主党州长马丁·L·戴维以52.02%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·W·布里克。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Tennessee took place on November 3, 1936, concurrently with the U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Senator Nathan L. Bachman won re-election to a full term, defeating Republican candidate Dwayne D.

zh.t: 1936年美国田纳西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1936年美国田纳西州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行，与总统选举、其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议员选举及各级州和地方选举同期进行。民主党籍时任参议员内森·L·巴赫曼赢得连任，获得完整任期；他击败了共和党候选人德韦恩·D。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Democratic Senator Thomas Gore ran for re-election to his second consecutive term, and fifth term overall. He ended up easily losing renomination, however; he placed a distant fourth in the Democratic primary. A runoff election between Congressman Joshua B. Lee and Governor Ernest W. Marland resulted in a landslide win for Lee.

zh.t: 1936年俄克拉何马州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行俄克拉何马州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党参议员托马斯·戈尔竞选连任，争取第二个连续任期，也是他第五个任期，但最终未能获得党内提名，在民主党初选中远远落后，排名第四。国会众议员约书亚·B·李和州长欧内斯特·W·马兰在决选中对决，李以压倒性优势获胜。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. All contemporary forty-eight states took part in the national election, and Utah voters selected four voters to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日，犹他州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。当时美国全部48个州都参加了全国选举。犹他州选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Rhode Island was held on November 3, 1936. The state voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island voted for Democratic Party candidate and incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt, who won the state by a margin of 12.92%. Roosevelt was the first Democrat to ever win Newport County.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日，罗得岛州举行美国总统选举。该州选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。罗得岛州支持民主党候选人、时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福，领先12.92个百分点。罗斯福是首位赢得纽波特县的民主党人。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in New Hampshire was held on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. The state voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Hampshire voted for Democratic Party candidate and incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt, who won the state by a narrow margin of 1.75%, after early reports showed Landon carrying the state.

zh.t: 1936年新罕布什尔州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日，新罕布什尔州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。新罕布什尔州以1.75个百分点的微弱优势支持民主党候选人、时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福；此前的早期报道曾显示兰登领先。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. Kentucky voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kentucky was won by incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.s: 1936年美国肯塔基州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。肯塔基州选民选出11名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。该州支持民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Idaho was won by incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.s: 1936年美国爱达荷州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。爱达荷州选民选出4名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。该州支持民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

en.s: The 1936 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Walter H. Jurgensen, a Democrat, defeating Republican nominee George A. Williams, who was a former Nebraska Lieutenant Governor.

zh.t: 1936年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州副州长选举。现任民主党副州长沃尔特·H·尤尔根森击败共和党候选人乔治·A·威廉姆斯；威廉姆斯曾任内布拉斯加州副州长。

en.s: The 1936 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Democratic nominee Gordon Browning defeated Republican nominee Pat H. Thach with 80.4% of the vote. Incumbent Democratic governor Hill McAlister angered Memphis political boss E. H. Crump by proposing a state sales tax, and did not seek re-election. Gordon Browning sought the party's nomination, his chief opponent being Campbell County school superintendent Burgin Dossett.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行田纳西州州长选举。民主党候选人戈登·布朗宁以80.4%的得票率击败共和党候选人帕特·H·萨奇。现任民主党州长希尔·麦卡利斯特因提议征收州销售税而激怒了孟菲斯政治头目E·H·克朗普，因此没有竞选连任。戈登·布朗宁寻求获得党内提名，主要对手是坎贝尔县学区负责人伯金·多塞特。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Morris Sheppard was re-elected to a fifth term in office, easily dispatching his challengers.

zh.t: 1936年得克萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行得克萨斯州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党联邦参议员莫里斯·谢泼德轻松击败对手，成功连任第五个任期。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in New Hampshire took place on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Republican Senator Henry W. Keyes did not run for re-election. Governor of New Hampshire Styles Bridges won the open election to succeed him, defeating former Senator George H. Moses in the Republican primary and Democratic U.S. Representative William N. Rogers in the general election.

zh.t: 1936年新罕布什尔州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行新罕布什尔州联邦参议员选举。现任共和党参议员亨利·W·凯斯没有竞选连任。新罕布什尔州州长斯泰尔斯·布里奇斯赢得选举，接替凯斯；他先在共和党初选中击败前参议员乔治·H·摩西，再在大选中击败民主党联邦众议员威廉·N·罗杰斯。

en.s: The 1936 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Primary elections were held on September 15, 1936. Incumbent Progressive Governor Philip La Follette won re-election, defeating Republican nominee Alexander Wiley and Democratic nominee Arthur W. Lueck. As of 2022, this is the last time that Shawano County did not vote for the Republican nominee for governor and the last time Dodge County voted Democratic for governor.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行威斯康星州州长选举，初选于同年9月15日举行。现任进步党州长菲利普·拉福莱特成功连任，击败共和党候选人亚历山大·威利和民主党候选人阿瑟·W·卢克。截至2022年，这是肖瓦诺县最后一次没有支持共和党州长候选人，也是道奇县最后一次支持民主党州长候选人。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. West Virginia voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia was won by incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1936年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1936年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。西弗吉尼亚州选民选出8名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。该州支持民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Texas took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. Texas voters chose 23 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Texas was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), with 87.08% of the popular vote, over Governor Alf Landon (R–Kansas), with 12.32% of the popular vote, a landslide victory margin of 74.76%.

zh.t: 1936年得克萨斯州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日，得克萨斯州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。得克萨斯州选出23名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。得克萨斯州支持民主党候选人、时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福，得票率为87.08%；共和党候选人、堪萨斯州州长阿尔夫·兰登的得票率为12.32%，罗斯福领先74.76个百分点，获得压倒性胜利。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Vice President John Nance Garner, won Oregon in a landslide over Governor Alf Landon (R–Kansas) and running mate Frank Knox.

zh.s: 1936年美国俄勒冈州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与副总统约翰·南斯·加纳搭档，以压倒性优势赢得俄勒冈州，击败堪萨斯州州长阿尔夫·兰登及其竞选搭档弗兰克·诺克斯。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. The Democratic ticket of the incumbent president of the United States Franklin D. Roosevelt and the vice president of the United States John Nance Garner defeated the Republican ticket of the governor of Kansas Alf Landon and the publisher of the Chicago Daily News Frank Knox.

zh.t: 1936年美国总统选举印第安纳州选情
zh.s: 1936年美国总统选举期间，印第安纳州于11月3日举行投票。民主党候选人、时任美国总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福和副总统约翰·南斯·加纳组成的竞选搭档，击败了共和党候选人、堪萨斯州州长阿尔夫·兰登和《芝加哥每日新闻》出版人弗兰克·诺克斯。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Kentucky took place on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Democratic Senator M. M. Logan was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican Robert H. Lucas.

zh.t: 1936年肯塔基州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1936年肯塔基州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任参议员M·M·洛根击败共和党人罗伯特·H·卢卡斯，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1936 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Democratic Governor James V Allred defeated Republican nominee C. O. Harris with 92.87% of the vote.

zh.s: 1936年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任州长詹姆斯·V·奥尔雷德击败共和党提名人C·O·哈里斯，得票率为92.87%。

en.s: The 1936 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Democratic nominee Robert E. Quinn defeated Republican nominee Charles P. Sisson with 53.66% of the vote.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行罗得岛州州长选举。民主党提名人罗伯特·E·奎因以53.66%的得票率击败共和党提名人查尔斯·P·西森。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. Voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oklahoma was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Vice President John Nance Garner, with 66.83 percent of the popular vote, against Governor Alf Landon (R–Kansas), running with Frank Knox, with 32.69 percent of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1936年俄克拉何马州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日，俄克拉何马州举行美国总统选举。选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与副总统约翰·南斯·加纳搭档，以66.83%的普选票赢得该州。共和党候选人、堪萨斯州州长阿尔夫·兰登与弗兰克·诺克斯搭档，获得32.69%的普选票。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Maine was held on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. The state voters chose five electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine voted for Republican Party candidate Alf Landon of Kansas, over Democratic Party candidate and incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行美国总统选举，缅因州选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。缅因州支持共和党候选人、堪萨斯州州长阿尔夫·兰登，击败民主党候选人、在任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

en.s: The 1936 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Democrat Wilbur Lucius Cross defeated Republican nominee Arthur M. Brown with 55.29% of the vote.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行康涅狄格州州长选举。在任民主党州长威尔伯·卢修斯·克罗斯以55.29%的得票率击败共和党提名人阿瑟·M·布朗。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in California was held on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. State voters chose twenty-two electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California voted for the Democratic candidate, incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1936年美国加利福尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1936年美国加利福尼亚州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。加利福尼亚州选民选出22名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。该州支持民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Dakota voted for the Democratic candidate Franklin D. Roosevelt over Republican candidate Alf Landon. Roosevelt won the state by a margin of 11.53%.

zh.t: 1936年南达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日，南达科他州举行美国总统选举。选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。南达科他州支持民主党候选人富兰克林·D·罗斯福，击败共和党候选人阿尔夫·兰登。罗斯福在该州领先11.53个百分点。

en.s: The 1936 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Democratic Governor Tom Berry ran for re-election to a third term, the first Governor of South Dakota to do so. Berry was challenged by Republican Leslie Jensen, the former Collector of Internal Revenue for the state of South Dakota. Both Berry and Jensen won their primaries uncontested and advanced to the general election.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行南达科他州州长选举。在任民主党州长汤姆·贝里竞选第三届，成为该州首位这样做的州长。共和党对手是前南达科他州国内税收官莱斯利·詹森。贝里和詹森均在初选中没有对手，直接进入大选。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Democratic Senator William J. Bulow ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by businessman Chan Gurney, who defeated former Congressman Charles A. Christopherson in the Republican primary. Bulow, likely aided by President Franklin D. Roosevelt's landslide victory in South Dakota, narrowly defeated Gurney to win his second term, though he significantly underperformed Roosevelt.

zh.t: 1936年南达科他州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行南达科他州联邦参议院选举。在任民主党参议员威廉·J·布洛竞选连任第二届。商人钱·格尼击败前联邦众议员查尔斯·A·克里斯托弗森，赢得共和党初选。布洛可能受益于富兰克林·D·罗斯福在南达科他州大胜，最终以微弱优势击败格尼，连任第二届；不过他的表现明显不如罗斯福。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator James J. Couzens ran for re-election to a third term in office, but was defeated in the Republican primary by Governor Wilber Brucker. Brucker was defeated in the general election by Democratic U.S. Representative Prentiss M. Brown, becoming the first Democrat to win this seat since 1853.

zh.t: 1936年密歇根州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行密歇根州联邦参议院选举。在任共和党参议员詹姆斯·J·考曾斯竞选连任第三届，但在共和党初选中败给州长威尔伯·布鲁克。布鲁克在大选中又败给民主党联邦众议员普伦蒂斯·M·布朗。自1853年以来，这是民主党首次赢得该席位。

en.s: The 1936 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Incumbent first-term governor Henry Horner, a Democrat, won reelection, defeating Republican nominee, future Senator C. Wayland Brooks with 53.13% of the vote.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行伊利诺伊州州长选举。首个任期的在任民主党州长亨利·霍纳以53.13%的得票率击败共和党提名人、后来的参议员C·韦兰·布鲁克斯，成功连任。

en.s: The 1936 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Democratic nominee M. Clifford Townsend defeated Republican nominee Raymond S. Springer with 55.36% of the vote.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行印第安纳州州长选举。民主党提名人M·克利福德·汤森德以55.36%的得票率击败共和党提名人雷蒙德·S·斯普林格。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. North Carolina voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. As a former Confederate state, North Carolina had a history of Jim Crow laws, disfranchisement of its African-American population and dominance of the Democratic Party in state politics.

zh.t: 1936年北卡罗来纳州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日，北卡罗来纳州举行美国总统选举，选出13名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。作为前邦联州，北卡罗来纳州长期存在吉姆·克劳法、剥夺非裔美国人选举权以及民主党主导州政治的情况。

en.s: The 1936 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Democratic nominee Clyde R. Hoey defeated Republican nominee Gilliam Grissom with 66.69% of the vote.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行北卡罗来纳州州长选举。民主党候选人克莱德·R·霍伊以66.69%的得票率击败共和党候选人吉利亚姆·格里森。

en.s: The 1936 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Democratic Governor James Michael Curley chose to run for United States Senate rather than seek a second term in office. Incumbent Democratic Treasurer Charles F. Hurley was elected governor over former Republican State Treasurer John W. Haigis.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行马萨诸塞州州长选举。民主党州长詹姆斯·迈克尔·柯利选择竞选联邦参议员，没有竞选连任。民主党籍现任州财政部长查尔斯·F·赫尔利击败共和党前州财政部长约翰·W·海吉斯，当选州长。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 3, 1936. Primaries were held April 14, 1936. The elections overall saw a strong performance by the Democratic Party. Democrats retained their control of both chambers of the Illinois General Assembly and all statewide executive offices, winning all the statewide executive offices by broad margins. Democrats swept the election for University of Illinois trustees.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日星期二，伊利诺伊州举行选举，初选于同年4月14日举行。民主党整体表现强劲，继续控制伊利诺伊州议会两院和所有全州行政职位，并以较大优势赢得这些职位。民主党还赢得了伊利诺伊大学校董选举的全部席位。

en.s: The 1936 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Republican nominee Francis P. Murphy defeated Democratic nominee Amos Blandin with 56.60% of the vote.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。共和党候选人弗朗西斯·P·墨菲以56.60%的得票率击败民主党候选人阿莫斯·布兰丁。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Colorado voted for the Democratic candidate Franklin D. Roosevelt over Republican candidate Alf Landon. Roosevelt won Colorado by a margin of 23.28%, carrying every county except Elbert, Kit Carson and Rio Blanco.

zh.t: 1936年科罗拉多州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日，科罗拉多州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。科罗拉多州支持民主党候选人富兰克林·D·罗斯福，领先共和党候选人阿尔夫·兰登23.28个百分点；除埃尔伯特县、基特卡森县和里奥布兰科县外，罗斯福赢得了该州所有县。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Connecticut was held on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. The state voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut voted for Democratic Party candidate and incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt, who won the state by a margin of 14.97%.

zh.t: 1936年康涅狄格州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日，康涅狄格州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选出8名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。康涅狄格州支持民主党候选人、时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福，领先14.97个百分点。

en.s: The 1936 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. The election featured incumbent Governor Robert L. Cochran, a Democrat, who defeated the Republican nominee, newspaper publisher and former state legislator Dwight Griswold, to win a second two-year term in office. Former State Attorney General Ora S. Spillman unsuccessfully ran for the Republican nomination.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州州长选举。民主党籍现任州长罗伯特·L·科克伦击败共和党候选人、报纸出版商和前州议员德怀特·格里斯沃尔德，赢得第二个两年任期。前州总检察长奥拉·S·斯皮尔曼竞选共和党提名失败。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Incumbent Democratic President Franklin D. Roosevelt of New York (running with Vice President John Nance Garner of Texas) carried Arkansas in a landslide, taking 81.8% of the state's vote to Republican Alf Landon's 17.86%.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日，阿肯色州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选出9名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福（与来自得克萨斯州的副总统约翰·南斯·加纳搭档）以压倒性优势赢得阿肯色州，得票率为81.8%；共和党候选人阿尔夫·兰登获得17.86%。

en.s: The 1936 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936, in order to elect the Governor of Arkansas. Democratic nominee Carl E. Bailey defeated Republican nominee Osro Cobb.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行阿肯色州州长选举。民主党候选人卡尔·E·贝利击败共和党候选人奥斯罗·科布。

en.s: The 1936 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 3, 1936, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor Forrest Smith defeated Republican nominee and former state auditor George Ernst Hackman, Communist nominee Jesse Alspaugh and Socialist Labor nominee James Wagoner.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行密苏里州州审计长选举。民主党候选人、现任州审计长福里斯特·史密斯击败共和党候选人、前州审计长乔治·恩斯特·哈克曼、共产党候选人杰西·阿尔斯波和社会主义工党候选人詹姆斯·瓦戈纳。

en.s: The 1936 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Democrat Henry H. Blood defeated Republican nominee Ray E. Dillman with 50.95% of the vote.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行犹他州州长选举。现任民主党州长亨利·H·布拉德以50.95%的得票率击败共和党候选人雷·E·迪尔曼。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. Voters chose 19 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Michigan was won by Democratic incumbents president Franklin D. Roosevelt and vice president John Nance Garner, defeating Republican candidate Alf Landon and his running mate Frank Knox by 317,061 votes, or a margin of 17.57%.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日，密歇根州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出19名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福和副总统约翰·南斯·加纳赢得密歇根州，以317,061票、17.57个百分点的优势击败共和党候选人阿尔夫·兰登及其竞选搭档弗兰克·诺克斯。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nevada was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Vice President John Nance Garner, with 72.81% of the popular vote, against Governor Alf Landon (R–Kansas), running with Frank Knox, with 27.19% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日，内华达州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选出3名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与副总统约翰·南斯·加纳赢得内华达州，得票率为72.81%；共和党候选人、堪萨斯州州长阿尔夫·兰登与弗兰克·诺克斯搭档，得票率为27.19%。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The United States Senate elections of 1936 in New Jersey was held on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Republican William W. Barbour, who was appointed and then elected to succeed Dwight Morrow, ran for a full term in office but was defeated by State Senator William H. Smathers. Democrats would not win this seat again until 1978, and would not win either seat until 1958.

zh.t: 1936年新泽西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行新泽西州联邦参议员选举。现任共和党参议员威廉·W·巴伯曾获任命，并在随后选举中接替德怀特·莫罗；他这次竞选完整任期，但败给州参议员威廉·H·斯马瑟斯。民主党直到1978年才再次赢得这个席位，直到1958年才再次赢得该州两个参议员席位中的任意一个。

en.s: The 1936 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 3, 1936, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee Robert W. Winn defeated Republican nominee Arch D. Williams, Communist nominee Mary Lewis and Socialist Labor nominee Theodore Baeff.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行密苏里州财政部长选举。民主党候选人罗伯特·W·温击败共和党候选人阿奇·D·威廉姆斯、共产党候选人玛丽·刘易斯和社会主义工党候选人西奥多·贝夫。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Arizona
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arizona was won by incumbent President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1936年美国亚利桑那州总统选举
zh.s: 1936年美国亚利桑那州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。亚利桑那州选民选出3名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。该州支持民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in South Carolina was held on November 3, 1936. The state voters chose 8 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. With Roosevelt winning 98.57% of the vote, this was the widest margin of victory for any presidential candidate in a contested election for any state in American history.

zh.t: 1936年南卡罗来纳州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日，南卡罗来纳州举行美国总统选举。该州选出8名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。罗斯福获得98.57%的选票，这是美国历史上任何州的总统候选人在有竞争的选举中取得的最大胜选优势。

en.s: The 1936 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Democratic nominee Nelson G. Kraschel narrowly defeated Republican nominee George A. Wilson with 48.56% of the vote.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行艾奥瓦州州长选举。民主党候选人纳尔逊·G·克拉舍尔以48.56%的得票率险胜共和党候选人乔治·A·威尔逊。

en.s: The 1936 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Republican Governor C. Douglass Buck was barred from seeking re-election to a third term, creating an open race. A challenging contest developed on the Republican side to succeed Buck, with Harry L. Cannon, former State Senator I. Dolphus Short and Assistant Motor Vehicle Commissioner George S. Williams all emerging as frontrunners.

zh.s: 1936年特拉华州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任州长C·道格拉斯·巴克因任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期，因此该职位成为开放席位。共和党内竞争激烈，多名候选人争夺接替巴克的机会：哈里·L·坎农、前州参议员I·多尔弗斯·肖特和机动车辆委员会助理专员乔治·S·威廉姆斯都成为热门人选。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Farmer–Laborite Elmer A. Benson, who had been temporarily appointed by Governor Floyd B. Olson in 1935 to fill the seat of the deceased Republican U.S. Senator Thomas D. Schall, opted to run for Governor rather than seek election to a full term or to fill the remainder of the unexpired term.

zh.t: 1936年明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举。现任农民劳工党议员埃尔默·A·本森于1935年获州长弗洛伊德·B·奥尔森临时任命，接替去世的共和党联邦参议员托马斯·D·沙尔。他选择竞选州长，没有竞选完整任期，也没有竞选填补剩余任期的席位。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. Mississippi voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Mississippi was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Vice President John Nance Garner, with 97.03% of the popular vote, against Governor Alf Landon (R–Kansas), running with Frank Knox, with 2.75% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1936年密西西比州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日，密西西比州举行美国总统选举，选出9名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与副总统约翰·南斯·加纳搭档，以97.03%的普选票赢得该州。共和党候选人、堪萨斯州州长阿尔夫·兰登与弗兰克·诺克斯搭档，获得2.75%的普选票。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Democrat J. Hamilton Lewis was elected to a second consecutive, and third overall, term as United States senator. The primaries and general election coincided with those for other federal (president and House) and those for state elections. The primaries were held April 14, 1936.

zh.t: 1936年伊利诺伊州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行伊利诺伊州联邦参议院选举。在任民主党人J·汉密尔顿·刘易斯当选，开始连续第二届、累计第三届联邦参议员任期。初选和大选与其他联邦职位（总统和联邦众议院）及州级选举同时进行。初选于1936年4月14日举行。

en.s: The 1936 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1936, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent secretary of state Dwight H. Brown defeated Republican nominee and former State Treasurer of Missouri Lorenzo Dow Thompson, Communist nominee John Day and Socialist Labor nominee Peter Tendler.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行密苏里州州务卿选举。在任民主党州务卿德怀特·H·布朗击败共和党提名人、密苏里州前财长洛伦佐·道·汤普森、共产党提名人约翰·戴和社会主义工党提名人彼得·滕德勒。

en.t: 1936 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1936 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday November 3, 1936 to elect the state's at-large member to serve in the United States House of Representatives. Incumbent congressman John Dempsey ran for re-election to a second term and won by a large margin of 25.87%. This election coincided with the state's Governor election and other state and local offices.

zh.t: 1936年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日举行新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举，选出该州不分区选区的联邦众议员。在任联邦众议员约翰·登普西竞选连任第二届，并以25.87个百分点的优势获胜。选举与该州州长和其他州及地方职位选举同时举行。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate special election in Iowa
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate Special Election within the State of Iowa occurred on November 3, 1936, following the death of incumbent Senator Richard Louis Murphy in an automobile accident. Representative Guy Mark Gillette (D-IA) and Editor of the Chariton Herald-Patriot, Berry F. Halden(R-IA) were the two major party contenders in this election. George F. Buresh (FL-IA) and two other candidates also ran.

zh.t: 1936年艾奥瓦州联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1936年11月3日，艾奥瓦州举行联邦参议院特别选举，填补在任参议员理查德·路易斯·墨菲因车祸去世后留下的席位。主要政党候选人是民主党联邦众议员盖伊·马克·吉列和共和党人、《查里顿先驱爱国者报》编辑贝里·F·霍尔登。自由党候选人乔治·F·布雷什及另外两名候选人也参加竞选。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. Iowa voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Vice President John Nance Garner, with 54.41% of the popular vote, against Governor Alf Landon (R–Kansas), running with Frank Knox, with 42.70% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日，艾奥瓦州举行美国总统选举，选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福与副总统约翰·南斯·加纳搭档，以54.41%的普选票赢得该州。共和党候选人、堪萨斯州州长阿尔夫·兰登与弗兰克·诺克斯搭档，获得42.70%的普选票。

en.s: The 1936 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1936. Minnesota Farmer–Labor Party candidate Gottfrid Lindsten defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger Arthur E. Nelson and Minnesota Democratic Party candidate A. C. Knudson.

zh.s: 1936年明尼苏达州副州长选举于11月3日举行。明尼苏达州农民—劳工党候选人戈特弗里德·林德斯滕击败了明尼苏达州共和党候选人阿瑟·E·纳尔逊和明尼苏达州民主党候选人A·C·克努森。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Democratic Senator Edward P. Costigan did not seek a second term in office. Democratic Governor Ed Johnson won the open race to succeed him over Raymond L. Sauter. Primary elections were held September 8. Johnson defeated former Governor William E. Sweet for the Democratic nomination. Sauter was unopposed for the Republican nomination.

zh.t: 1936年科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1936年科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任参议员爱德华·P·科斯蒂根没有竞选连任。民主党籍州长埃德·约翰逊在这场开放席位的选举中击败雷蒙德·L·索特，当选参议员。初选于9月8日举行，约翰逊击败前州长威廉·E·斯威特，赢得民主党提名；索特则未遇对手，获得共和党提名。

en.s: The 1936 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1936, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general Roy McKittrick defeated Republican nominee J. Grant Frye and Socialist Labor nominee Theodore Vaszily.

zh.s: 1936年密苏里州总检察长选举于11月3日举行，选出该州总检察长。民主党提名人、时任总检察长罗伊·麦基特里克击败共和党提名人J·格兰特·弗莱和社会主义工党提名人西奥多·瓦西利。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. For over a century after the Civil War, Tennessee was divided according to political loyalties established in that war.

zh.s: 1936年美国田纳西州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。田纳西州选民选出11名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。南北战争结束后的一百多年里，田纳西州的政治分野一直受到战争时期各方政治忠诚的影响。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Washington was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Vice President John Nance Garner, with 66.38% of the popular vote, against Governor Alf Landon (R–Kansas), running with Frank Knox, with 29.88% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1936年美国总统选举华盛顿州选情
zh.s: 1936年美国总统选举华盛顿州选情于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统、纽约州民主党人富兰克林·D·罗斯福与副总统约翰·南斯·加纳搭档，在华盛顿州获胜，得票率为66.38%；堪萨斯州州长阿尔夫·兰登与弗兰克·诺克斯搭档，得票率为29.88%。

en.s: The 1936 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1936, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Democrat Clyde Tingley won reelection to a second term. Tingley was the first Democrat to ever carry San Miguel County and Valencia County in a gubernatorial election; the latter did not back a Democrat again until 1954.

zh.s: 1936年新墨西哥州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任州长克莱德·廷格利成功连任第二个任期。他是首位在州长选举中赢得圣米格尔县和瓦伦西亚县的民主党人；此后直到1954年，瓦伦西亚县才再次支持民主党候选人。

en.s: The 1936 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Democratic nominee Walter A. Huxman defeated Republican nominee Will G. West with 51.09% of the vote. Incumbent Governor Alf Landon did not seek reelection, and instead unsuccessfully ran for President and failing to win Kansas in the presidential race.

zh.s: 1936年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党提名人沃尔特·A·赫克斯曼击败共和党提名人威尔·G·韦斯特，得票率为51.09%。时任州长阿尔夫·兰登没有竞选连任，而是转而竞选总统，但最终未能当选，也未能赢得堪萨斯州。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. Voters chose 15 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Missouri was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Vice President John Nance Garner, with 60.76 percent of the popular vote, against Governor Alf Landon (R–Kansas), running with Frank Knox, with 38.16 percent of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1936年美国总统选举密苏里州选情
zh.s: 1936年美国总统选举密苏里州选情于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出15名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统、纽约州民主党人富兰克林·D·罗斯福与副总统约翰·南斯·加纳搭档，在密苏里州获胜，得票率为60.76%；堪萨斯州州长阿尔夫·兰登与弗兰克·诺克斯搭档，得票率为38.16%。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the 1936 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maryland was won by incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt (D–New York), running with Vice President John Nance Garner, with 62.35% of the popular vote, against Governor Alf Landon (R–Kansas), running with Frank Knox, with 37.04% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1936年美国总统选举马里兰州选情
zh.s: 1936年美国总统选举马里兰州选情于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统、纽约州民主党人富兰克林·D·罗斯福与副总统约翰·南斯·加纳搭档，在马里兰州获胜，得票率为62.35%；堪萨斯州州长阿尔夫·兰登与弗兰克·诺克斯搭档，得票率为37.04%。

en.s: The 1936 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1936. Incumbent Democrat Clarence D. Martin defeated Republican nominee Roland H. Hartley with 69.36% of the vote. Martin's popular vote share is the largest achieved by any gubernatorial candidate in Washington. This is the most recent gubernatorial election in which a candidate swept every county in the state.

zh.s: 1936年华盛顿州州长选举于1936年11月3日举行。民主党籍现任州长克拉伦斯·D·马丁以69.36%的选票击败共和党候选人罗兰·H·哈特利。马丁的得票率是华盛顿州州长选举史上最高的；此后也没有候选人在州内所有县全部获胜。

en.t: 1936 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1936 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 3, 1936, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. With the exception of a handful of historically Unionist North Georgia counties – chiefly Fannin but also to a lesser extent Pickens, Gilmer and Towns – Georgia since the 1880s had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 1936年美国佐治亚州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。佐治亚州选民选出12名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。自19世纪80年代以来，佐治亚州一直是一党主导的州，由民主党控制；只有北佐治亚州少数历史上支持联邦的县例外，主要是范宁县，皮肯斯、吉尔默和汤斯县的情况较弱。

en.s: The 1936 New York state election was held on November 3, 1936, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the state comptroller, the attorney general, a judge of the New York Court of Appeals and two U.S. Representatives-at-large, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1936年纽约州选举于1936年11月3日举行，选出州长、副州长、州审计长、州检察长、纽约州上诉法院法官、两名联邦众议员（不分区席位），以及纽约州众议院和参议院的全体议员。

en.s: The 1936 Florida gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday November 3, to elect the next Governor of Florida. Democratic candidate and president of the florida State Senate Fred P. Conel defeated Republican candidate E.E. Callaway with 80.91% of the vote.

zh.s: 1936年佛罗里达州州长选举于11月3日星期二举行，选出下一任州长。民主党候选人、佛罗里达州参议院议长弗雷德·P·科内尔击败共和党候选人E·E·卡拉韦，得票率为80.91%。

en.t: 1936 United States Senate election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 1936 United States Senate election in Massachusetts was held on November 3. Incumbent Democratic Senator Marcus A. Coolidge declined to stand for re-election. Republican Henry Cabot Lodge Jr. won the race to succeed him over Democratic Boston mayor James Michael Curley and former Suffolk County prosecutor Thomas C. O'Brien. The election was notable because although Democrats expanded their overall Senate majority to 74 seats, Massachusetts was the only seat gained by Republicans.

zh.t: 1936年美国联邦参议院马萨诸塞州选举
zh.s: 1936年美国联邦参议院马萨诸塞州选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任参议员马库斯·A·柯立芝决定不竞选连任。共和党人小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇击败民主党人、波士顿市长詹姆斯·迈克尔·柯利和萨福克县前检察官托马斯·C·奥布莱恩，当选参议员。民主党在全美参议院的多数席位扩大到74席，但马萨诸塞州是共和党唯一赢得的席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1936 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1936 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 32 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1936 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1936年爱荷华州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。爱荷华州选民在州参议院50个选区中的32个选区选出议员，州参议员任期四年。爱荷华州议会提供了1936年州参议院50个选区的全州地图。

en.s: The 1936 United States Senate elections coincided with the reelection of President Franklin D. Roosevelt. The 32 seats of Class 2 were contested in regular elections, and special elections were held to fill vacancies. The Great Depression continued and voters backed progressive candidates favoring Roosevelt's New Deal in races across the country. The Democrats gained 5 net seats during the election, and in combination with Democratic and Farmer–Labor interim appointments and the defection of George W.

zh.s: 1936年11月3日，美国举行联邦参议员选举，第二组的32个席位进行常规改选，另有补缺选举。选举与罗斯福总统连任同日举行，民主党净增5席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1936 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 3. Vying for an open seat, Democratic nominee Barzilla Clark defeated Republican nominee Frank Stephan with 57.19% of the vote. Three-term incumbent governor C. Ben Ross opted to run for the U.S. Senate against its dean, Republican William Borah, who won a sixth term.

zh.s: 1936年爱达荷州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党提名人巴齐拉·克拉克击败共和党提名人弗兰克·斯蒂芬，得票率为57.19%，当选州长。这是一次开放席位的选举：连任三届的时任州长C·本·罗斯转而竞选联邦参议员，对手是参议院资深议员、共和党人威廉·博拉；博拉赢得第六个任期。

en.s: The 1937 FA Charity Shield was the 24th FA Charity Shield, a football match between the winners of the previous season's First Division and FA Cup competitions. The match was contested by league champions Manchester City and FA Cup winners Sunderland, and was played at Maine Road, the home ground of Manchester City. Manchester City won the game, 2–0.

zh.s: 1937年英格兰足总慈善盾杯是第24届英格兰足总慈善盾杯，由上赛季英格兰足球顶级联赛和足总杯冠军对阵。联赛冠军曼彻斯特城对阵足总杯冠军桑德兰，比赛在曼彻斯特城主场缅因路球场举行。曼彻斯特城以2比0获胜。
