en.t: 1938 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1938 United States Senate elections in Arizona took place on November 3, 1938. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Carl Hayden ran for reelection to a third term, defeating Republican nominee Burt H. Clingan in the general election. In contrast to previous elections, Hayden was easily reelected, receiving only token opposition from a relatively unknown Republican challenger.

zh.t: 1938年亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1938年亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任联邦参议员卡尔·海登竞选连任第三个任期，并在大选中击败共和党提名人伯特·H·克林根。与此前的选举不同，这次海登轻松连任，对手是一名名不见经传的共和党候选人，未能构成实质挑战。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1942
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 3, 1942. Incumbent United States Senator James E. Murray, who was first elected to the Senate in a special election in 1934 and was re-elected in 1936, ran for re-election. Following his victory in a competitive Democratic primary, Murray advanced to the general election, where he was opposed by former United States Attorney for the District of Montana Wellington D. Rankin, the Republican nominee and brother of representative Jeannette Rankin. In a closely fought election, Murray narrowly defeated Rankin to win re-election to his third term and his second full term in the Senate.

zh.t: 1942年蒙大拿州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1942年蒙大拿州联邦参议员选举于1942年11月3日举行。联邦参议员詹姆斯·E·默里于1934年在特别选举中首次当选，并在1936年连任，此次再次竞选连任。他先在竞争激烈的民主党初选中胜出，对手是代表蒙大拿州第一国会选区的联邦众议员约瑟夫·P·莫纳汉。大选中，默里的对手是共和党提名人、前蒙大拿州联邦检察官惠灵顿·D·兰金，他也是联邦众议员珍妮特·兰金的兄弟。默里以微弱优势击败兰金，赢得参议院第三个任期，也是第二个完整任期。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1942
en.s: The 1942 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 3, 1942 to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. All six incumbents were re-elected and the composition of the state delegation remained solely Democratic.

zh.t: 1942年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日，南卡罗来纳州举行联邦众议院选举，选出6名任期两年的代表。6名现任议员全部连任，该州代表团仍全部由民主党人组成。

en.t: United States Senate election in Virginia, 1942
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Democratic Senator Carter Glass defeated Socialist Lawrence S. Wilkes and was elected to his fifth term in office.

zh.t: 1942年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举。在任民主党参议员卡特·格拉斯击败社会党人劳伦斯·S·威尔克斯，连任第五届。

en.s: The Pennsylvania gubernatorial election of 1942 occurred on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Republican governor Arthur James was not a candidate for re-election. Republican candidate Edward Martin defeated Democratic candidate F. Clair Ross to become Governor of Pennsylvania.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行宾夕法尼亚州州长选举。在任共和党州长阿瑟·詹姆斯没有竞选连任。共和党候选人爱德华·马丁击败民主党候选人F·克莱尔·罗斯，当选州长。

en.t: United States Senate election in Massachusetts, 1942
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1942 in Massachusetts was held on November 3, 1942, with Republican incumbent Henry Cabot Lodge, Jr. defeating his challengers.

zh.t: 1942年马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举。在任共和党参议员小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇击败其他候选人。

en.s: The 1942 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1942. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Harold Stassen defeated Farmer–Labor Party challenger Hjalmar Petersen. This was the last election in which the Democratic Party of Minnesota and the Farmer–Labor Party ran separate candidates; in 1944, both parties ran under the umbrella of the Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party.

zh.s: 1942年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月3日举行。明尼苏达州共和党候选人哈罗德·斯塔森击败农民—劳工党候选人海尔马·彼得森。这是明尼苏达州民主党和农民—劳工党分别派出候选人参选的最后一次选举；1944年，两党共同组成明尼苏达民主党—农民—劳工党参选。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1942
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1942 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 3, 1942. California gained three districts as a result of the 1940 Census, two of which were won by Democrats and one by Republicans.

zh.t: 1942年加利福尼亚州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1942年加利福尼亚州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，选出该州联邦众议院代表团。根据1940年人口普查结果，加利福尼亚州增加了三个国会选区，其中两个由民主党赢得，一个由共和党赢得。

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1942 took place on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Republican William H. Wills ran successfully for re-election to a second term as Governor of Vermont, defeating Democratic candidate Park H. Pollard.

zh.s: 1942年佛蒙特州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任州长威廉·H·威尔斯成功连任，赢得第二个任期，击败民主党候选人帕克·H·波拉德。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Oregon gubernatorial election of 1942 took place on November 3, 1942 to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. Republican candidate and Oregon Secretary of State Earl W. Snell defeated state senator Lew Wallace by a more than 3–1 margin, the largest margin of victory for any Oregon governor.

zh.s: 1942年俄勒冈州州长选举于11月3日举行，选出该州州长。共和党候选人、俄勒冈州州务卿厄尔·W·斯内尔击败州参议员卢·华莱士，得票数超过对手的三倍；这是俄勒冈州州长选举中最大的领先幅度。

en.s: The California gubernatorial election, 1942 was held on November 3, 1942.

zh.s: 1942年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月3日举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1942, in 33 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 3, 1942. Elections took place on September 14 in Maine. In Georgia, the governor was elected to a 4-year term for the first time, instead of a 2-year term.

zh.s: 1942年美国州长选举于11月3日举行，与联邦众议员和联邦参议员选举同时进行，共有33个州举行州长选举。缅因州的选举于9月14日举行。乔治亚州州长首次当选四年任期，此前任期为两年。

en.s: The 1942 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Republican John W. Bricker defeated Democratic nominee John McSweeney with 60.50% of the vote.

zh.s: 1942年俄亥俄州州长选举于1942年11月3日举行。共和党籍现任州长约翰·W·布里克击败民主党候选人约翰·麦克斯威尼，获得60.50%的选票。

en.s: The 1942 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Republican Governor Julius P. Heil was defeated by Progressive nominee Orland S. Loomis in a rematch of the 1940 election with 49.65% of the vote. As of 2023, this is the last time Waupaca and Dodge counties did not vote for the Republican candidate for governor. Primary elections were held on September 15, 1942.

zh.s: 1942年威斯康星州州长选举于1942年11月3日举行。进步党候选人奥兰德·S·卢米斯在与1940年选举的重赛中击败共和党籍现任州长朱利叶斯·P·海尔，获得49.65%的选票。截至2023年，这是沃帕卡县和道奇县最后一次没有投票支持共和党州长候选人。初选于1942年9月15日举行。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in Kansas took place on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Republican Senator Arthur Capper ran for re-election to a fifth and final term. He won renomination in the Republican primary and faced former Senator George McGill, the Democratic nominee, in the general election. Capper defeated McGill in a landslide, as Republicans performed well nationwide.

zh.t: 1942年堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举。现任共和党参议员阿瑟·卡珀竞选连任第五个、也是最后一个任期。他赢得共和党提名，在大选中对阵民主党候选人、前参议员乔治·麦吉尔。共和党在全国表现强劲，卡珀以压倒性优势击败麦吉尔。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate election in Alabama
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in Alabama was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent two term Senator John H. Bankhead II won re-election to a third term unopposed. However, Bankhead would not complete his term as he died on June 12, 1946.

zh.t: 1942年阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举。现任参议员约翰·H·班克黑德二世已任职两届，在没有对手的情况下成功连任第三个任期。但他未能完成任期，于1946年6月12日去世。

en.s: The 1942 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. It featured incumbent Governor Dwight Griswold, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee, former Governor Charles W. Bryan, to win a second two-year term in office.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州州长选举。共和党籍现任州长德怀特·格里斯沃尔德击败民主党候选人、前州长查尔斯·W·布莱恩，赢得第二个两年任期。

en.s: The 1942 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Democratic Governor Coke R. Stevenson defeated Republican nominee Caswell K. McDowell with 96.83% of the vote.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行得克萨斯州州长选举。现任民主党州长科克·R·史蒂文森以96.83%的得票率击败共和党候选人卡斯韦尔·K·麦克道尔。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in Wyoming was held on November 3, 1942. Democratic Senator Harry Schwartz ran for re-election to his second term. He was challenged by businessman Edward V. Robertson, who emerged from a close and hotly contested Republican primary as the narrow winner. Aided in part by the national swing toward Republicans in 1942, Robertson defeated Schwartz for re-election by a decisive margin.

zh.t: 1942年怀俄明州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行怀俄明州联邦参议员选举。民主党参议员哈里·施瓦茨竞选连任第二个任期。他的对手是商人爱德华·V·罗伯逊，后者在竞争激烈的共和党初选中以微弱优势胜出。1942年全国选民转向共和党，这对罗伯逊有利；他以明显优势击败施瓦茨。

en.s: The 1942 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Democrat Edward P. Carville defeated Republican nominee Aaron V. Tallman with 60.26% of the vote.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行内华达州州长选举。现任民主党州长爱德华·P·卡维尔以60.26%的得票率击败共和党候选人亚伦·V·托尔曼。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Democratic Senator Joshua B. Lee ran for re-election to a second consecutive term. After winning the Democratic primary against several strong opponents, Lee advanced to the general election, where he was originally set to face former Republican Senator William B. Pine. However, shortly after winning the Republican primary, Pine died; the state Republican Party tapped businessman Edward H.

zh.t: 1942年美国俄克拉何马州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1942年美国俄克拉何马州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任参议员约书亚·B·李竞选连任第二个连续任期。他在民主党初选中击败多名强劲对手，晋级大选，原定对阵共和党前参议员威廉·B·派恩。但派恩在赢得共和党初选后不久去世。

en.s: The 1942 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Republican Governor Nels H. Smith ran for a second term as governor. After defeating several opponents in the Republican primary, he advanced to the general election, where he was opposed by Lester C. Hunt, the Wyoming Secretary of State and the Democratic nominee.

zh.s: 1942年怀俄明州州长选举于1942年11月3日举行。共和党籍现任州长内尔斯·H·史密斯竞选连任第二个任期。他在共和党初选中击败多名对手后进入大选，对手是怀俄明州州务卿、民主党候选人莱斯特·C·亨特。

en.t: 1942 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1942 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 78th United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 3, 1942, while Maine held theirs on September 14. This was the first election after the congressional reapportionment based on the 1940 census, and was held in the middle of President Franklin D.

zh.s: 1942年美国联邦众议院选举旨在选出第78届国会的议员，大部分州于11月3日举行选举，缅因州则于9月14日投票。这是根据1940年人口普查结果重新分配国会席位后的首次选举。

en.s: The 1942 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Republican Assemblyman Frederick F. Houser narrowly defeated incumbent Democratic Lieutenant Governor Ellis E. Patterson with 50.30% of the vote.

zh.t: 1942年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行加利福尼亚州副州长选举。共和党州众议员弗雷德里克·F·豪瑟以50.30%的得票率险胜现任民主党副州长埃利斯·E·帕特森。

en.s: The 1942 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Republican Governor Harlan J. Bushfield declined to seek re-election to a third term and instead successfully ran for the U.S. Senate. A crowded Republican primary developed to succeed him, and because no candidate received 35% of the vote, the nomination was decided at the state Republican convention, where former Attorney General Merrell Q.

zh.t: 1942年美国南达科他州州长选举
zh.s: 1942年美国南达科他州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任州长哈兰·J·布什菲尔德放弃竞选第三个任期，转而成功竞选联邦参议员。共和党内多人竞争接替他；由于无人获得35%的选票，州共和党代表大会决定提名人选。

en.s: The 1942 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Republican nominee Andrew Frank Schoeppel defeated Democratic nominee William H. Burke with 56.68% of the vote.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行堪萨斯州州长选举。共和党候选人安德鲁·弗兰克·舍佩尔以56.68%的得票率击败民主党候选人威廉·H·伯克。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Democratic Senator Clyde Herring ran for re-election to a second term but was defeated by Republican Governor George A. Wilson.

zh.t: 1942年艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行艾奥瓦州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党参议员克莱德·赫林竞选连任第二个任期，但败给共和党州长乔治·A·威尔逊。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate special election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate special election in Minnesota took place on November 3, 1942. The election was held to fill the vacancy in the seat formerly held by the late Ernest Lundeen for the final two months of Lundeen's unexpired term. Governor Harold Stassen had appointed Joseph H. Ball to fill the seat in 1940, but this appointment was temporary and subject to a special election held in the next general election year thereafter—1942.

zh.t: 1942年明尼苏达州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行明尼苏达州联邦参议员特别选举，以填补欧内斯特·伦丁去世后留下的席位空缺，任期还剩最后两个月。州长哈罗德·斯塔森于1940年任命约瑟夫·H·鲍尔接任，但这只是临时任命，按规定还要在之后最近一个大选年，也就是1942年举行特别选举。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Democratic Senator Edwin C. Johnson was re-elected to second term over Republican Governor Ralph L. Carr. The major issue in this race was Carr's dual ambitions for both Senate seats. As Governor, he appointed Eugene Milliken following the death of Senator Alva B. Adams and then wanted to get elected himself over Senator Johnson.

zh.t: 1942年科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党参议员埃德温·C·约翰逊击败共和党州长拉尔夫·L·卡尔，成功连任第二个任期。这场选举的主要议题是卡尔同时觊觎两个参议员席位。作为州长，他在参议员阿尔瓦·B·亚当斯去世后任命尤金·米利金接任，之后又想击败约翰逊，当选另一席参议员。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Republican Charles W. Brooks was reelected. The primaries and general election coincided with those for House and those for state elections. Primaries were held April 14, 1942.

zh.t: 1942年伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举。现任共和党参议员查尔斯·W·布鲁克斯成功连任。初选和大选与联邦众议院及州级选举同期举行。初选于1942年4月14日举行。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Republican Joseph H. Ball, who had been temporarily appointed by Governor Harold Stassen in 1940 to fill the seat of the deceased Farmer–Labor U.S. Senator Ernest Lundeen, defeated Farmer–Labor former U.S. Senator and former Governor Elmer Benson, independent candidate Martin A.

zh.t: 1942年美国明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1942年美国明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任参议员约瑟夫·H·鲍尔在1940年由州长哈罗德·斯塔森临时任命，接替去世的农工党参议员欧内斯特·伦丁；此次他击败了农工党前参议员、前州长埃尔默·本森。

en.s: The 1942 Connecticut Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1942, in order to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Republican nominee and incumbent Attorney General Francis A. Pallotti defeated Democratic nominee Reinhart L. Gideon and Socialist nominee Harry Schwartz.

zh.t: 1942年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行康涅狄格州总检察长选举。共和党候选人、现任总检察长弗朗西斯·A·帕洛蒂击败民主党候选人莱因哈特·L·吉迪恩和社会党候选人哈里·施瓦茨。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate special election in Colorado
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate special election in Colorado took place on November 3, 1942. Democratic senator Alva B. Adams died in office on December 1, 1941, and Republican Governor Ralph L. Carr appointed Denver oilman Eugene Millikin to fill the vacancy. Millikin ran for election for the remainder of Adams's term. He was opposed in the general election by James A.

zh.t: 1942年美国科罗拉多州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1942年美国科罗拉多州联邦参议员特别选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍参议员阿尔瓦·B·亚当斯于1941年12月1日在任内去世，共和党州长拉尔夫·L·卡尔任命丹佛石油商尤金·米利金接替空缺。米利金竞选亚当斯剩余任期。

en.s: The 1942 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Democratic Governor Homer Martin Adkins was re-elected to a second term in office. After winning the Democratic primary by a large margin over Fred Keller on July 28, Adkins won re-election to a second term without opposition in the general election.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行阿肯色州州长选举。现任民主党州长霍默·马丁·阿德金斯成功连任第二个任期。他在7月28日举行的民主党初选中以较大优势击败弗雷德·凯勒，随后在没有对手的大选中连任。

en.s: The 1942 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democratic nominee Robert S. Kerr defeated Republican nominee William Otjen. Edward W. Fickinger was also on the ballot representing the Prohibition Party. Gomer Griffith Smith and Robert Burns unsuccessfully sought the Democratic nomination.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行俄克拉何马州州长选举。民主党提名人罗伯特·S·克尔击败共和党提名人威廉·奥特延。禁酒党候选人爱德华·W·菲克金格也参加了选举。戈默·格里菲斯·史密斯和罗伯特·伯恩斯曾竞选民主党提名，但未成功。

en.s: The 1942 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 3, 1942, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Stafford King defeated Democratic nominee W. L. Kelly.

zh.t: 1942年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行明尼苏达州州审计长选举。在任共和党州审计长斯塔福德·金击败民主党提名人W·L·凯利。

en.s: The 1942 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Republican incumbent Leverett Saltonstall defeated Democrat Roger Putnam, Communist candidate Otis A. Hood, Socialist candidate Joseph Massidda, Socialist Labor candidate Henning A. Blomen, and Prohibition candidate Guy S. Williams.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行马萨诸塞州州长选举。在任共和党州长莱弗里特·索尔顿斯托尔击败民主党人罗杰·普特南、共产党候选人奥蒂斯·A·胡德、社会党候选人约瑟夫·马西达、社会主义工党候选人亨宁·A·布洛门和禁酒党候选人盖伊·S·威廉姆斯。

en.s: The 1942 Massachusetts general election was held on November 3, 1942, throughout Massachusetts. Primary elections took place on September 15. At the federal level, Republican Incumbent Henry Cabot Lodge Jr. was reelected to the United States Senate over Democratic U.S. Representative Joseph E. Casey and Republicans won ten of fourteen seats in the United States House of Representatives. In the race for Governor, Republican incumbent Leverett Saltonstall defeated Democrat Roger Putnam.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日，马萨诸塞州举行大选，初选于9月15日举行。在联邦层面，共和党在任参议员小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇击败民主党联邦众议员约瑟夫·E·凯西，成功连任；共和党还赢得了联邦众议院14个席位中的10席。在州长选举中，共和党在任州长莱弗里特·索尔顿斯托尔击败民主党人罗杰·普特南。

en.s: The 1942 Wisconsin lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Walter Goodland was re-elected to another term, defeating Progressive Henry Berquist and Democrat John Brophy. This race was notable due to the death of governor elect Orland Steen Loomis, and the ensuing court battle over who would hold office in his stead.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行威斯康星州副州长选举。在任副州长沃尔特·古德兰击败进步党人亨利·伯奎斯特和民主党人约翰·布罗菲，成功连任。该选举受到州长当选人奥兰德·斯廷·卢米斯去世及随后围绕由谁接任的诉讼影响。

en.s: The 1942 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1942, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mike Holm defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Daniel D. Collins and Democratic nominee Austin T. Haley.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行明尼苏达州州务卿选举。在任共和党州务卿迈克·霍尔姆击败农民劳工党提名人丹尼尔·D·柯林斯和民主党提名人奥斯汀·T·黑利。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in Tennessee took place on November 3, 1942, concurrently with United States Senate elections in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Senator Tom Stewart won re-election to a full term, defeating Republican candidate F. Todd Meacham.

zh.t: 1942年田纳西州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日，田纳西州举行联邦参议院选举，与其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。在任民主党参议员汤姆·斯图尔特击败共和党候选人F·托德·米查姆，成功当选完整任期。

en.t: 1942 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1942 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday November 3, 1942 to elect the states two at-large representatives. New Mexico got another district due to the 1940 Census. Both representatives were elected at large. Democrats won both at large districts, making the state's delegation solely Democratic.

zh.t: 1942年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日，举行新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举，选出该州两名不分区代表。根据1940年人口普查，新墨西哥州新增一个选区，但两名代表仍由全州选举产生。民主党赢得两个不分区席位，该州代表团因此全部由民主党人组成。

en.s: The 1942 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1942, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Joseph A. A. Burnquist defeated Farmer–Labor nominee David J. Erickson and Democratic nominee Patrick A. Burke.

zh.t: 1942年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行明尼苏达州总检察长选举。在任共和党总检察长约瑟夫·A·A·伯恩奎斯特击败农民劳工党提名人大卫·J·埃里克森和民主党提名人帕特里克·A·伯克。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in Nebraska was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent George W. Norris, who was re-elected to his fifth term in 1936 as an independent, ran for a sixth term. He was challenged by Kenneth S. Wherry, the Chairman of the Nebraska Republican Party, and Democratic nominee Foster May, a prominent radio announcer.

zh.t: 1942年内布拉斯加州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州联邦参议院选举。在任参议员乔治·W·诺里斯曾以独立人士身份连任第五届，这次竞选第六届。对手包括内布拉斯加州共和党主席肯尼思·S·惠里和民主党提名人、知名电台播音员福斯特·梅。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1942 in New Jersey was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Democratic Senator William Smathers ran for re-election to a second term, but was defeated by Republican businessman Albert Hawkes. As of 2026, this is the last time an incumbent U.S. Senator from New Jersey lost re-election, although in 2002 incumbent Senator Robert Torricelli dropped out in late September while trailing in the polls.

zh.t: 1942年新泽西州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行新泽西州联邦参议院选举。在任民主党参议员威廉·斯马瑟斯竞选连任第二届，但败给共和党商人阿尔伯特·霍克斯。截至2026年，这是新泽西州在任联邦参议员最后一次竞选连任失败。2002年，参议员罗伯特·托里切利在民调落后时于9月下旬退出竞选。

en.s: The 1942 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Republican nominee Bourke B. Hickenlooper defeated Democratic nominee Nelson G. Kraschel with 62.75% of the vote.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行艾奥瓦州州长选举。共和党提名人伯克·B·希肯卢珀以62.75%的得票率击败民主党提名人纳尔逊·G·克拉舍尔。

en.s: The 1942 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Republican Robert O. Blood defeated Democratic nominee William J. Neal with 52.18% of the vote.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。在任共和党州长罗伯特·O·布拉德击败民主党提名人威廉·J·尼尔，得票率为52.18%。

en.s: The 1942 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Democrat John Moses defeated Republican nominee Oscar W. Hagen with 57.62% of the vote.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行北达科他州州长选举。在任民主党州长约翰·摩西以57.62%的得票率击败共和党提名人奥斯卡·W·哈根。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in Kentucky took place on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Democratic Senator Happy Chandler was re-elected to a full term in office over Republican Richard J. Colbert.

zh.t: 1942年肯塔基州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行肯塔基州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党参议员“快乐”钱德勒击败共和党候选人理查德·J·科尔伯特，成功当选完整任期。

en.s: The 1942 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Democratic governor Prentice Cooper defeated Republican nominee C. N. Frazier with 70.2% of the vote. In the Democratic primary, Judge John Ridley Mitchell, who despised Memphis political boss E. H. Crump, sought the party's nomination for governor but was defeated by Cooper, 171,259 votes to 124,037.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行田纳西州州长选举。现任民主党州长普伦蒂斯·库珀以70.2%的得票率击败共和党候选人C·N·弗雷泽。在民主党初选中，法官约翰·里德利·米切尔厌恶孟菲斯政治头目E·H·克朗普，因此竞选州长提名，但最终以124,037票败给库珀，库珀获得171,259票。

en.t: 1942 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida
en.s: The 1942 United States House of Representatives Elections in Florida were held on November 3, 1942, to determine who would represent the state of Florida in the United States House of Representatives. Representatives are elected for two-year terms; those elected served in the 78th Congress from January 1943 until January 1945. Florida had 6 seats including one at-large district due to redistricting.

zh.t: 1942年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举，以选出代表佛罗里达州的联邦众议员。众议员任期两年，当选者于1943年1月至1945年1月在第78届国会任职。因选区重新划分，佛罗里达州共有6个席位，其中一个为全州选区。

en.s: The 1942 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Republican nominee Harry Kelly defeated incumbent Democrat Murray Van Wagoner with 52.60% of the vote. This was the sixth consecutive gubernatorial election in Michigan in which the incumbent party was defeated.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行密歇根州州长选举。共和党候选人哈里·凯利以52.60%的得票率击败现任民主党州长默里·范·瓦戈纳。这是密歇根州连续第六次在州长选举中由在任政党败选。

en.s: The 1942 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Governor Sidney Preston Osborn ran for reelection, and easily defeated a challenge from former Governor Robert Taylor Jones in the Democratic primary, who Osborn also defeated in 1940. In a virtually identical race to 1940, Sidney Preston Osborn defeated Jerrie W. Lee in the general election, and was sworn into his second term as Governor on January 5, 1943.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行亚利桑那州州长选举。现任州长西德尼·普雷斯顿·奥斯本竞选连任，在民主党初选中轻松击败前州长罗伯特·泰勒·琼斯；奥斯本在1940年的初选中也曾击败他。1942年的大选与1940年几乎一样，奥斯本击败杰里·W·李，当选连任，并于1943年1月5日宣誓就职，开始第二个州长任期。

en.s: The 1942 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 3, 1942, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general William C. Walsh defeated Republican nominee Horace P. Whitworth.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行马里兰州总检察长选举。民主党候选人、现任总检察长威廉·C·沃尔什击败共和党候选人霍勒斯·P·惠特沃思。

en.s: The 1942 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Democrat Herbert O'Conor defeated Republican nominee Theodore McKeldin with 52.55% of the vote.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行马里兰州州长选举。现任民主党州长赫伯特·奥康纳以52.55%的得票率击败共和党候选人西奥多·麦凯尔丁。

en.s: The 1942 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1942, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Democrat John E. Miles was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a third consecutive term. Former U.S. Representative John J. Dempsey won the open seat.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行新墨西哥州州长选举。现任民主党州长约翰·E·迈尔斯因任期限制，不能连续竞选第三个任期。前联邦众议员约翰·J·邓普西赢得空缺席位，当选州长。

en.s: The 1942 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1942. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Edward John Thye defeated Minnesota Farmer–Labor Party challenger Juls J. Anderson and Minnesota Democratic Party candidate Joseph Kowalkowski.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行明尼苏达州副州长选举。明尼苏达州共和党候选人爱德华·约翰·泰击败明尼苏达州农民劳工党候选人朱尔斯·J·安德森和明尼苏达州民主党候选人约瑟夫·科瓦尔科夫斯基。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Democratic Senator William J. Bulow ran for re-election to a third term. During the primary, Bulow was attacked for being insufficiently supportive of President Franklin Roosevelt's foreign policy and war preparedness. Former Governor Tom Berry, Bulow's chief opponent, drew a contrast between Bulow's isolationism and his support for Roosevelt's policies.

zh.t: 1942年南达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行南达科他州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党参议员威廉·J·布洛竞选连任第三个任期。初选期间，有人批评他对罗斯福总统的外交政策和战备支持不足。主要对手、前州长汤姆·贝里则将布洛的孤立主义立场与他对罗斯福政策的支持作对比。

en.s: The 1942 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1942, to elect the governor of Alabama. Incumbent Democrat Frank M. Dixon was term limited, and could not seek a second consecutive term.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行阿拉巴马州州长选举。现任民主党州长弗兰克·M·迪克森因任期限制，不能竞选连续第二个任期。

en.s: The 1942 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Democrat J. Howard McGrath defeated Republican nominee James O. McManus with 58.54% of the vote.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行罗得岛州州长选举。现任民主党州长J·霍华德·麦格拉思以58.54%的得票率击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·O·麦克马纳斯。

en.t: 1942 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1942 United States Senate election in New Hampshire took place on November 3, 1942. Incumbent Republican Senator Styles Bridges won re-election to a second term in office, defeating Democratic former Governor Francis P. Murphy. Primary elections were held on September 15, 1942.

zh.t: 1942年新罕布什尔州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行新罕布什尔州联邦参议员选举。现任共和党参议员斯泰尔斯·布里奇斯击败民主党候选人、前州长弗朗西斯·P·墨菲，成功连任第二个任期。初选于1942年9月15日举行。

en.s: The 1942 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 3, 1942, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller J. Millard Tawes won re-election as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行马里兰州审计长选举。民主党候选人、现任审计长J·米勒德·陶斯没有对手，成功连任。

en.s: The 1942 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. It was a rematch of the 1940 Connecticut gubernatorial election. The Republican party nominee, Raymond E. Baldwin, defeated the Democratic party incumbent, Robert A. Hurley, with 48.93% of the vote.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行康涅狄格州州长选举，这是1940年州长选举的再次对决。共和党候选人雷蒙德·E·鲍德温以48.93%的得票率击败民主党籍现任州长罗伯特·A·赫尔利。

en.s: The 1942 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942, and featured Roy W. Johnson, the Republican nominee, defeating Democratic nominee Harry P. Conklin. The incumbent lieutenant governor, William E. Johnson, decided not to seek reelection in order to run for United States House of Representatives in Nebraska's First District in 1942.

zh.t: 1942年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州副州长选举。共和党候选人罗伊·W·约翰逊击败民主党候选人哈里·P·康克林。现任副州长威廉·E·约翰逊决定不竞选连任，转而竞选内布拉斯加州第一国会选区的联邦众议员。

en.s: The 1942 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942. Republican nominee John Charles Vivian defeated Democratic nominee Homer Bedford with 56.23% of the vote.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日举行科罗拉多州州长选举。共和党候选人约翰·查尔斯·维维安以56.23%的得票率击败民主党候选人霍默·贝德福德。

en.s: The 1942 Alabama Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 3, 1942, to elect 35 representatives to serve four-year terms in the Alabama Senate. The election used the same districts first drawn by the Alabama Constitution of 1901. As the Democratic Party was dominant in the state, state legislative seats were generally decided at the Democratic primary election.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日星期二，阿拉巴马州举行参议院选举，选出35名任期四年的阿拉巴马州参议员。选区沿用1901年阿拉巴马州宪法首次划定的范围。由于民主党在该州占主导地位，州议会席位通常由民主党初选决定。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 3, 1942. Primaries were held April 14, 1942.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日星期二，伊利诺伊州举行选举。初选于同年4月14日举行。

en.s: The 1942 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1942, to elect the Governor of New York. Incumbent Democratic governor Herbert H. Lehman was not a candidate for re-election. Republican Thomas E. Dewey defeated New York Attorney General John J. Bennett Jr. and Dean Alfange in the general election.

zh.s: 1942年纽约州州长选举于1942年11月3日举行。民主党籍现任州长赫伯特·H·莱曼没有竞选连任。共和党人托马斯·E·杜威在大选中击败纽约州总检察长约翰·J·贝内特和迪恩·阿尔凡格。

en.s: The 1942 New York state election was held on November 3, 1942, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the state comptroller, the attorney general and two U.S. Representatives At-large, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1942年纽约州选举于1942年11月3日举行，选出州长、副州长、州审计长、州检察长、两名联邦众议员（不分区席位），以及纽约州众议院和参议院的全体议员。

en.s: The 1942 United States Senate elections were held November 3, 1942, midway through Franklin D. Roosevelt's third term as president. The 32 seats of Class 2 were contested in regular elections, and two special elections were held to fill vacancies. Although this election took place during World War II, the opposition Republican party made major gains, taking eight seats from the Democrats and one from an independent.

zh.s: 1942年美国联邦参议院选举于1942年11月3日举行，当时富兰克林·D·罗斯福正处于第三个总统任期中。常规选举改选第2组的32个席位，另举行两场补选填补空缺。尽管正值第二次世界大战，共和党仍大幅增加席位，从民主党手中赢下8席，并从一名独立人士手中赢下1席。

en.s: The 1942 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 3. Republican nominee and former governor C. A. Bottolfsen defeated Democratic incumbent Chase Clark with 50.15% of the vote. This was a rematch of the 1940 election, with different results.

zh.s: 1942年爱达荷州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党提名人、前州长C·A·博托尔夫森以50.15%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长蔡斯·克拉克。这是1940年选举的重赛，但结果不同。

en.s: The 1942 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1942 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 23 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1942 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1942年爱荷华州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。爱荷华州选民在州参议院50个选区中的23个选区选出议员，州参议员任期四年。爱荷华州议会提供了1942年州参议院50个选区的全州地图。

en.s: The Koli Point action, during 3–12 November 1942, was an engagement between U.S. Marine Corps and U.S. Army forces and Imperial Japanese Army forces around Koli Point on Guadalcanal during the Guadalcanal campaign. The U.S. forces were under the overall command of Major General Alexander Vandegrift, while the Japanese forces were under the overall command of Lieutenant General Harukichi Hyakutake. U.S.

zh.s: 1942年11月3日，美军与日军在瓜达尔卡纳尔岛的科利角一带交战。战斗持续到11月12日，是瓜达尔卡纳尔岛战役的一部分，美军参战部队包括海军陆战队和陆军。

en.s: The Raid on Choiseul (Operation Blissful) was a small unit engagement that occurred from 28 October to 3 November 1943, during the Solomon Islands campaign of the Pacific War. The raid was launched to divert the Japanese from the Allied landings at Cape Torokina on Bougainville Island.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 乔伊瑟尔岛突袭（又称“快乐行动”）是太平洋战争所罗门群岛战役中的一次小规模交战，发生于1943年10月28日至11月3日。此次突袭旨在分散日军注意力，牵制其兵力，以支援盟军在布干维尔岛托罗基纳角登陆。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Landings at Cape Torokina (1–3 November 1943), also known as Operation Cherryblossom, took place at the beginning of the Bougainville campaign in World War II. The amphibious landings were carried out by elements of the United States Marine Corps in November 1943 on Bougainville Island in the South Pacific, as part of Allied efforts to advance towards the main Japanese base around Rabaul under Operation Cartwheel.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 托罗基纳角登陆战（又称“樱花行动”）于1943年11月1日至3日举行，是第二次世界大战布干维尔战役的开端。美国海军陆战队部队在南太平洋布干维尔岛实施两栖登陆，作为盟军“车轮行动”的一部分，旨在向日军拉包尔主要基地推进。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Slovak National Uprising (Slovak: Slovenské národné povstanie, abbreviated SNP; alternatively also Povstanie roku 1944, English: The Uprising of 1944) was an attempted insurrection organised by the Slovak resistance during the Second World War. It was directed on the one hand against the German invasion of Slovakia by the Wehrmacht, which began on 29 August 1944, and on the other against the Slovak collaborationist regime of the Ludaks under Jozef Tiso.
en.n: World War II: Two supreme commanders of the Slovak National Uprising, Generals Ján Golian and Rudolf Viest, are captured, tortured and later executed by German forces.

zh.s: 斯洛伐克民族起义（斯洛伐克语：Slovenské národné povstanie，简称SNP；也称Povstanie roku 1944，英文：The Uprising of 1944）是第二次世界大战期间斯洛伐克抵抗力量组织的一场未遂起义。一方面，起义反抗自1944年8月29日开始入侵斯洛伐克的德国国防军；另一方面，也反抗约瑟夫·蒂索领导的斯洛伐克人民党合作政权。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：斯洛伐克民族起义的两位最高指挥官扬·戈利安将军和鲁道夫·维斯特将军被德军俘虏、遭受酷刑，后来被处决。

en.s: The Breskens Pocket was a pocket of fortified German resistance against the Canadian First Army in the Battle of the Scheldt during the Second World War. It was chiefly situated on the southern shore of the Scheldt estuary in the southern Netherlands, near the Belgian border. It was named after the town of Breskens, which was later freed from German occupation during Operation Switchback.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 布雷斯肯斯突出部是第二次世界大战斯海尔德战役期间，德国对加拿大第一军进行坚固防守的一处突出部，主要位于荷兰南部、靠近比利时边境的斯海尔德河口南岸。该地区以布雷斯肯斯镇命名；该镇后来在“回旋行动”中摆脱德国占领。

en.s: The Constitution of Japan is the supreme law of Japan. Written primarily by American civilian officials during the occupation of Japan after World War II, it was adopted on 3 November 1946 and came into effect on 3 May 1947, succeeding the Meiji Constitution of 1889. The constitution consists of a preamble and 103 articles grouped into 11 chapters.

zh.s: 日本国宪法是日本的最高法律。第二次世界大战后日本被占领期间，该宪法主要由美国文职官员起草，于1946年11月3日通过，并于1947年5月3日生效，取代1889年的明治宪法。宪法由序言和103条条文组成，分为11章。

en.s: Constitutional Assembly elections were held in the Socialist Republic of Montenegro on 3 November 1946. They were the first elections in Montenegro in which women had the right to vote, and three women were elected to the Assembly; Lidija Jovanović, Dobrila Ojdanić and Draginja Vušović.

zh.s: 1946年11月3日，南斯拉夫社会主义联邦共和国的黑山社会主义共和国举行制宪会议选举。这是黑山女性首次拥有投票权的选举，共有三名女性当选议员：莉迪娅·约万诺维奇、多布里拉·奥伊达尼奇和德拉金娅·武绍维奇。

en.s: The Battle of Badgam was a small defensive encounter which took place at Badgam in the Kashmir valley on 3 November 1947 between troops of the Indian Army whose strength was just ~50 and tribal raiders from Pakistan who were ~500 in number during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1947. The small battle was decisive in that one company of 4th Battalion, Kumaon Regiment under Major Som Nath Sharma, who won a posthumous Param Vir Chakra, was decimated but by causing severe casualties on the advancing tribal "lashkars" halted their momentum, thus gaining time for additional Indian forces to fly in and save the Kashmir Valley from falling in the nick of time.

zh.s: 巴德加姆战役于1947年11月3日在克什米尔山谷的巴德加姆爆发，是1947年印巴战争中的一场小规模防御战。印度军队约有50人，巴基斯坦部族武装约有500人。库玛翁团第四营一个连由少校索姆·纳特·夏尔马率领，后来他被追授帕拉姆·维尔脉轮勋章。这个连几乎全军覆没，但重创了正在推进的部族武装并阻止其继续前进，为更多印度军队空运增援争取了时间，避免克什米尔山谷失守。

en.s: The Battle of Dengbu Island (Chinese: 登步島戰役; pinyin: Dēngbù Dǎo Zhànyì) was a conflict between the Republic of China Army and People's Liberation Army over Dengbu Island (in the Zhoushan Islands) near mainland China. This conflict occurred from 3 November 1949 to 5 November 1949 and resulted in a Republic of China Army's victory.

zh.s: 登步岛战役是中华民国国军和中国人民解放军围绕舟山群岛中、靠近中国大陆的登步岛发生的战斗。战役从1949年11月3日持续至11月5日，最终中华民国国军获胜。

en.s: Air India Flight 245 was a scheduled Air India passenger flight from Bombay to London via Cairo and Geneva. On the morning of 3 November 1950, the Lockheed L-749A Constellation serving the flight crashed into Mont Blanc, France, while approaching Geneva. All 48 aboard were killed. The plane operating the flight was named Malabar Princess, registered as VT-CQP. It was piloted by Captain Alan R.

zh.s: 印度航空245号班机是印度航空一班定期客运航班，从孟买经开罗和日内瓦飞往伦敦。1950年11月3日上午，执行该航班的洛克希德L-749A“星座”式客机在飞往日内瓦途中撞上法国勃朗峰。机上48人全部遇难。该机名为“马拉巴公主”号，注册编号VT-CQP，由艾伦·R机长驾驶。

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1953 occurred on Tuesday, November 3, 1953, with the Democratic candidate, Manhattan Borough President Robert F. Wagner, Jr. winning a decisive plurality in a 3-way race. Wagner defeated the Republican nominee, lawyer and Postmaster of New York City, Harold Riegelman, as well as the Liberal Party nominee, New York City Council President Rudolph Halley. Halley additionally ran on the Independent Citizens ballot line. Wagner enjoyed the support of the powerful Tammany Hall political machine, easily securing him a victory. Wagner received 46.33% of the vote to Riegelman's 29.97%, a Democratic victory margin of 16.36%.

zh.s: 1953年纽约市市长选举于11月3日星期二举行。民主党候选人、曼哈顿区区长罗伯特·F·瓦格纳以明显优势赢得三方角逐。他击败了共和党提名人、律师兼纽约市邮政局长哈罗德·里格尔曼，以及自由党提名人、纽约市议会议长鲁道夫·哈利。哈利还以独立公民党候选人的身份参选。强大的塔马尼政治机器支持瓦格纳，助他轻松获胜。瓦格纳得票率为46.33%，里格尔曼为29.97%，民主党领先16.36个百分点。

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1953 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 3, 1953. David Lawrence of the Democratic Party won the right to serve a third term. With a broad base of support among both labor and minority voters, as well as the quiet background support of many GOP business leaders (who lauded the mayor's urban renewal projects), Lawrence coasted to an election win. His victory came over Leonard Kane, a real estate developer and the brother of the Allegheny County Treasurer.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长选举于1953年11月3日星期二举行。民主党人戴维·劳伦斯赢得第三个任期。劳伦斯得到工会和少数族裔选民的广泛支持，也得到许多共和党商界领袖私下支持；这些商界人士赞扬了他的城市更新项目。他轻松赢得选举，击败房地产开发商莱纳德·凯恩；凯恩是阿勒格尼县财政官员的兄弟。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1953 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 3, 1953. Democrat Robert B. Meyner defeated Republican nominee Paul L. Troast with 53.17% of the vote.

zh.s: 1953年新泽西州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党人罗伯特·B·迈纳以53.17%的得票率击败共和党候选人保罗·L·特罗斯特。

en.s: The 1953 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1953, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Virginia. Democratic nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor Allie Edward Stakes Stephens defeated Republican nominee Stephen D. Timberlake.

zh.s: 1953年11月3日举行弗吉尼亚州副州长选举。民主党候选人、现任副州长阿利·爱德华·斯泰克斯·斯蒂芬斯击败共和党候选人斯蒂芬·D·廷伯莱克。

en.s: Philadelphia's municipal election of November 3, 1953, was the second held under the city charter of 1951 and represented the first test of the Democratic city government of Mayor Joseph S. Clark Jr. In the 1951 election, the voters had elected a Democratic mayor for the first time in 67 years, breaking the Republican hold on political power in the city.

zh.s: 1953年11月3日，费城举行市政选举。这是1951年城市章程通过后的第二次市政选举，也是对市长约瑟夫·S·克拉克领导的民主党市政府的首次检验。1951年选举中，选民时隔67年首次选出民主党市长，打破了共和党对该市政治权力的掌控。

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1953 saw the election of Anthony J. Celebrezze.

zh.s: 安东尼·J·塞莱布雷兹当选克利夫兰市长。

en.s: In the 1953 Virginia gubernatorial election, incumbent Governor John S. Battle, a Democrat, was unable to seek re-election due to term limits.

zh.s: 1953年11月3日，弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举。现任民主党州长约翰·巴特尔受任期限制，无法再次参选。

en.s: The Khan Yunis massacre took place on 3 November 1956, perpetrated by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) in the Palestinian town of Khan Yunis and the nearby refugee camp of the same name in the Gaza Strip during the Suez Crisis. According to Benny Morris, during an IDF operation to reopen the Egyptian-blockaded Straits of Tiran, Israeli soldiers shot two hundred Palestinians in Khan Yunis and Rafah.

zh.s: 汗尤尼斯大屠杀发生于1956年11月3日。苏伊士危机期间，以色列国防军在巴勒斯坦城镇汗尤尼斯及当地难民营实施了这场屠杀。据本尼·莫里斯记述，在一次重开埃及封锁的蒂朗海峡的行动中，以色列士兵在汗尤尼斯和拉法枪杀了200名巴勒斯坦人。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Portugal on 3 November 1957. The ruling National Union won all 120 seats.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1957年11月3日举行议会选举。执政党国民联盟赢得全部120个席位。

en.t: Sputnik program: The Soviet Union launches Sputnik 2. On board is the first animal to enter orbit, a dog named Laika
en.s: The Soviet Union, officially the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (USSR), was a transcontinental country that spanned much of Eurasia from its formation in 1922 until its dissolution in 1991. It was the world's third-most populous country, the largest by area, and bordered twelve other countries. A diverse multinational state, it was organized as a federal union of national republics, with the largest and most populous being the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic (SFSR).

zh.t: 斯普特尼克计划：苏联发射斯普特尼克2号，首次将动物送入轨道，机上是一只名叫莱卡的狗
zh.s: 苏联正式名称为苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟（USSR），是一个横跨欧亚大陆大部分地区的国家，于1922年成立，1991年解体。它是世界人口第三多、面积最大的国家，与12个国家接壤。苏联是多民族国家，实行由各加盟共和国组成的联邦制，其中最大、人口最多的是俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国（SFSR）。

en.s: General elections were held in Cuba on 3 November 1958. The three major presidential candidates were Carlos Márquez Sterling of the Partido del Pueblo Libre, Ramón Grau of the Partido Auténtico and Andrés Rivero Agüero of the Coalición Progresista Nacional. There was also a minor party candidate on the ballot, Alberto Salas Amaro for Partido Union Cubana, who received 1% of the vote.

zh.s: 1958年11月3日，古巴举行大选。三名主要总统候选人分别是自由人民党候选人卡洛斯·马尔克斯·斯特林、真诚党候选人拉蒙·格劳和全国进步联盟候选人安德烈斯·里韦罗·阿圭罗。小党古巴联盟党候选人阿尔贝托·萨拉斯·阿马罗也参加选举，获得1%的选票。

en.s: The special Mayoral election of 1959 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 3, 1959. The winner of the 1957 election, Democrat David Lawrence, had resigned from his position in January 1959 because he was elected Governor of Pennsylvania. City Council President Tom Gallagher moved up to the position of mayor as per the city charter. At 75 years old, he chose not to seek reelection. Joe Barr, also a Democrat, won the special election and the remainder of Lawrence's term. Barr, a powerful State Senator and a longtime Lawrence associate, defeated Republican Paul Reinhold, the president of a company that distributed road repair equipment.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长特别选举于1959年11月3日星期二举行。1957年当选的民主党人戴维·劳伦斯于1959年1月当选宾夕法尼亚州州长后辞去市长职务。根据城市宪章，市议会主席汤姆·加拉格尔接任市长。年满75岁的加拉格尔决定不竞选连任。另一名民主党人乔·巴尔赢得特别选举，完成劳伦斯剩余任期。巴尔是有影响力的州参议员，也是劳伦斯的长期盟友；他击败了共和党人保罗·莱因霍尔德，后者是一家道路维修设备经销公司的总裁。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1959 occurred on Tuesday, November 3, 1959 between former Boston City Council member John F. Collins and Senate President member John E. Powers. Collins was elected to his first term. The nonpartisan municipal preliminary election was held on September 22, 1959.

zh.s: 波士顿市长选举于1959年11月3日星期二举行，候选人是前波士顿市议会议员约翰·F·柯林斯和参议院议长约翰·E·鲍尔斯。柯林斯当选，开始第一个任期。无党派市政初选于1959年9月22日举行。

en.s: The 1959 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1959. Democratic nominee Bert Combs defeated Republican nominee John M. Robsion Jr. with 60.56% of the vote.

zh.s: 1959年11月3日举行肯塔基州州长选举。民主党提名人伯特·康姆斯以60.56%的得票率击败共和党提名人小约翰·M·罗布西恩。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 1959 took place on November 3, 1959, and saw the reelection of Charles H. Boswell, who had become mayor eleven months earlier, after Philip L. Bayt resigned to become Marion County Prosecutor. Boswell defeated Republican William T. Sharp.

zh.t: 1959年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 1959年11月3日举行印第安纳波利斯市长选举。查尔斯·H·博斯韦尔成功连任。11个月前，菲利普·L·贝特辞职出任马里昂县检察官后，博斯韦尔接任市长。博斯韦尔击败共和党人威廉·T·夏普。

en.s: The 1959 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 3, 1959, with incumbent George Christopher being reelected with 59% percent of the vote. As of 2023, this is the last time a Republican has been elected mayor of San Francisco.

zh.s: 1959年旧金山市长选举于1959年11月3日举行。现任市长乔治·克里斯托弗再次当选，获得59%的选票。截至2023年，这是共和党人最后一次当选旧金山市长。

en.s: The 1959 New Jersey Senate elections were held on November 3. The elections took place midway through the second term of Governor Robert Meyner. Eleven of New Jersey's 21 counties held regular elections for Senator; Cumberland County also held a special election to complete the unexpired term of W. Howard Sharp, who died in December 1958.

zh.s: 1959年新泽西州参议院选举于11月3日举行，时间在州长罗伯特·梅纳第二个任期中段。新泽西州21个县中有11个举行常规参议员选举；坎伯兰县还举行特别选举，填补W·霍华德·夏普于1958年12月去世后留下的未满任期。

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1959 saw the third re-election of incumbent mayor Anthony J. Celebrezze.

zh.s: 时任市长安东尼·J·塞莱布雷兹第三次连任克利夫兰市长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: 1959 Philadelphia's municipal election, held on November 3, involved contests for mayor, all seventeen city council seats, and several other executive and judicial offices. Citywide, the Democrats took majorities of over 200,000 votes, continuing their success from the elections four years earlier. Richardson Dilworth, who had been elected mayor in 1955, was re-elected over Republican nominee Harold Stassen.

zh.s: 费城市政选举于1959年11月3日举行，改选市长、全部17个市议会席位以及其他几个行政和司法职位。民主党在全市范围内领先超过20万票，延续了四年前的胜势。1955年当选市长的理查德·迪尔沃思击败共和党提名人哈罗德·斯塔森，成功连任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1960 Labour Party leadership election was held when, for the first time since 1955, the incumbent leader Hugh Gaitskell was challenged for re-election. Normally the annual re-election of the leader had been a formality. Gaitskell had lost the 1959 general election and had seen the Labour Party conference adopt a policy of unilateral nuclear disarmament which he considered disastrous and refused to support.

zh.s: 工党于1960年举行党魁选举，这是自1955年以来首次有挑战者反对时任党魁休·盖茨克尔连任。此前，党魁每年连任通常只是例行程序。盖茨克尔在1959年大选中失利；工党大会随后通过单方面核裁军政策，他认为这会造成灾难性后果，因此拒绝支持。

en.s: In the United States, an act of Congress is a statute passed by both the Senate and the House of Representatives of the United States Congress and signed into law by the president. Acts may apply only to individual entities (called private laws), or to the general public (public laws).
en.n: The land that would become the Great Swamp National Wildlife Refuge is established by an Act of Congress after a year-long legal battle that pitted local residents against Port Authority of New York and New Jersey officials wishing to turn the Great Swamp into a major regional airport for jet aircraft.

zh.s: 在美国，国会法案是由美国国会参议院和众议院通过并由总统签署生效的法律。法案可能只适用于特定个人或实体（称为私人法案），也可能适用于全体公众（称为公共法案）。
zh.n: 大沼泽国家野生动物保护区所在地通过国会法案正式设立。此前，地方居民与纽约和新泽西港务局官员围绕该地用途展开了一年法律斗争；港务局希望将大沼泽改建成大型区域喷气式飞机机场。

en.t: U Thant is unanimously appointed as the 3rd Secretary-General of the United Nations, becoming the first non-European individual to occupy the post
en.s: Thant (Burmese: သန့်, MLCTS: san., pronounced [θa̰ɰ̃]; 22 January 1909 – 25 November 1974), known honorifically as U Thant (), was a Burmese diplomat and the third secretary-general of the United Nations from 1961 to 1971, the first Asian to hold the position. He held the office for a record 10 years and one month. A native of Pantanaw, Thant was educated at the National High School and at Rangoon University.

zh.t: 吴丹一致当选联合国第三任秘书长，成为首位担任这一职务的非欧洲人
zh.s: 丹（缅甸语：သန့်；MLCTS转写：san；读作[θa̰ɰ̃]；1909年1月22日—1974年11月25日），尊称吴丹，是缅甸外交官，1961年至1971年担任联合国第三任秘书长，也是首位担任该职务的亚洲人。他在任时间创纪录，达10年零1个月。丹出生于潘塔瑙，曾就读国立高中和仰光大学。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: A United Nations Secretary-General selection was held in 1961 to replace Dag Hammarskjöld after he was killed in a plane crash. After initial Soviet attempts to replace the secretary-general with a troika, it was agreed that an acting secretary-general would be appointed for the remainder of Hammarskjöld's term. Within two weeks, U Thant of Burma emerged as the only candidate who was acceptable to both the Soviet Union and the United States.

zh.s: 联合国于1961年举行秘书长遴选，以接替在飞机失事中遇难的达格·哈马舍尔德。苏联最初试图以“三人执政团”取代秘书长，之后各方同意任命一名代理秘书长，完成哈马舍尔德剩余任期。两周内，缅甸的吴丹脱颖而出，成为苏联和美国都能接受的唯一候选人。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 3 November 1963. They resulted in a narrow victory for the Center Union of Georgios Papandreou after three consecutive victories of Konstantinos Karamanlis and his National Radical Union party and after 11 years, during which the conservative parties (Greek Rally and its successor, the National Radical Union) ruled Greece.

zh.s: 希腊于1963年11月3日举行议会选举。乔治·帕潘德里欧领导的中间联盟以微弱优势获胜。此前，康斯坦丁·卡拉曼利斯领导的国民激进联盟连续三次获胜；在这场选举前的11年里，希腊一直由保守党派——希腊联盟及其继任者国民激进联盟——执政。

en.s: The 1963 Australia Cup final was the second Australia Cup Final, the final match of the 1963 Australia Cup. It was played at Olympic Park Stadium in Melbourne, Australia, on 3 November 1963, contested by Port Melbourne Slavia and Polonia Melbourne. The Final ended in a 0–0 draw with Port Melbourne Slavia winning the replay 3–2, with a hat-trick from Des Palmer.

zh.s: 1963年澳大利亚杯决赛是第二届澳大利亚杯决赛，也是1963年澳大利亚杯的最后一场比赛。比赛于1963年11月3日在澳大利亚墨尔本的奥林匹克公园球场举行，由墨尔本港斯拉维亚队对阵墨尔本波洛尼亚队。决赛以0比0结束，墨尔本港斯拉维亚队在重赛中以3比2获胜，德斯·帕尔默上演帽子戏法。

en.t: United States Senate election in North Dakota, 1964
en.s: The 1964 U.S. Senate election for the state of North Dakota was held November 3, 1964. The incumbent, Dem-NPL Senator Quentin Burdick, sought and received re-election to his second term, defeating Republican candidate Thomas S. Kleppe, who later became the United States Secretary of the Interior. Only Burdick filed as a Dem-NPLer, and the endorsed Republican candidate was Thomas S. Kleppe, who would go on to serve two terms as a Representative for North Dakota's second congressional district from 1967 to 1971. Burdick and Kleppe won the primary elections for their respective parties.

zh.t: 1964年北达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年北达科他州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。现任民主党—无党派联盟（Dem-NPL）参议员昆廷·伯迪克竞选连任，并击败共和党候选人托马斯·S·克莱普，赢得第二个任期。伯迪克是唯一登记参选的Dem-NPL候选人；共和党提名人是克莱普。他后来于1967年至1971年代表北达科他州第二国会选区担任联邦众议员，并曾任美国内政部长。伯迪克和克莱普分别赢得本党初选。

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1964
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 3, 1964 in Minnesota as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. The Democratic Party candidate, incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson, who had assumed the presidency less than a year earlier following the assassination of John F. Kennedy, won the state over U.S. Senator Barry Goldwater of Arizona by a margin of 431,493 votes, or 27.76%. Johnson went on to win the election nationally, by a landslide margin of 22.58% of the popular vote. Goldwater carried only six states, including his home state of Arizona, together with the five southern states of Alabama, Georgia, Louisiana, Mississippi, and South Carolina.

zh.s: 1964年明尼苏达州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。民主党候选人、时任总统林登·B·约翰逊击败来自亚利桑那州的联邦参议员巴里·戈德华特，在该州领先431,493票，得票率高出27.76个百分点。约翰逊还以22.58个百分点的得票率优势赢得全国选举。戈德华特只赢得六个州，包括他的家乡亚利桑那州，以及南方五州：阿拉巴马州、佐治亚州、路易斯安那州、密西西比州和南卡罗来纳州。

en.t: United States presidential election in Ohio, 1964
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 3, 1964. The Democratic Party nominee, incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson, overwhelmingly won the state of Ohio with 62.94% of the vote against Barry Goldwater's 37.06%, carrying its 26 electoral votes. The 1964 election marks the last time a Democratic candidate for President won Ohio with over 60% of the popular vote, won the state carrying more counties than the Republican candidate, and the last time the margin of victory for the Democratic candidate was in double digits.

zh.s: 1964年俄亥俄州总统选举于11月3日举行。民主党候选人、时任总统林登·B·约翰逊以62.94%的得票率大胜巴里·戈德华特（得票率37.06%），赢得该州26张选举人票。此后，民主党总统候选人再未在俄亥俄州以超过60%的普选票胜出、赢得比共和党候选人更多的县，或以两位数优势获胜；1964年是这三项纪录的最后一次。

en.t: United States presidential election in Rhode Island, 1964
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states and D.C. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Rhode Island voted overwhelmingly for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson of Texas, over the Republican nominee, Senator Barry Goldwater of Arizona. Johnson ran with incumbent Vice President Hubert H. Humphrey of Minnesota, while Goldwater's running mate was Congressman William E. Miller of New York.

zh.s: 1964年罗得岛州总统选举于11月3日举行，是在美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区举行的全国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。罗得岛州以明显优势支持民主党候选人、时任总统林登·B·约翰逊（来自得克萨斯州），而非共和党候选人、来自亚利桑那州的参议员巴里·戈德华特。约翰逊的竞选搭档是时任副总统、来自明尼苏达州的休伯特·H·汉弗莱；戈德华特的竞选搭档是来自纽约州的联邦众议员威廉·E·米勒。

en.t: United States presidential election in Vermont, 1964
en.s: The 1964 United States Presidential Election in Vermont took place on November 3, 1964 as part of the 1964 United States Presidential Election which was held throughout all 50 states and the District of Columbia. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Vermont voted overwhelmingly for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson of Texas, over the Republican nominee, Senator Barry Goldwater of Arizona. Johnson ran with Senator Hubert H. Humphrey of Minnesota, while Goldwater's running mate was Congressman William E. Miller of New York.

zh.s: 1964年佛蒙特州总统选举于11月3日举行，是在美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区举行的全国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。佛蒙特州以明显优势支持民主党候选人、时任总统林登·B·约翰逊（来自得克萨斯州），而非共和党候选人、来自亚利桑那州的参议员巴里·戈德华特。约翰逊的竞选搭档是来自明尼苏达州的参议员休伯特·H·汉弗莱；戈德华特的竞选搭档是来自纽约州的联邦众议员威廉·E·米勒。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1964
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 3, 1964. Incumbent United States Senator Mike Mansfield, who was first elected to the Senate in 1952 and was re-elected in 1958, ran for re-election. Mansfield won the Democratic primary in a landslide, and advanced to the general election, where he faced Alex Blewett, the Majority Leader of the Montana House of Representatives and the Republican nominee. Though Mansfield's margin was significantly reduced from 1958, he still overwhelmingly defeated Blewett and won his third term in the Senate.

zh.t: 1964年蒙大拿州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年蒙大拿州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。时任联邦参议员迈克·曼斯菲尔德竞选连任；他于1952年首次当选，并在1958年再次当选。曼斯菲尔德以压倒性优势赢得民主党初选，进入大选后对阵蒙大拿州众议院多数党领袖、共和党候选人亚历克斯·布莱韦特。虽然曼斯菲尔德的领先幅度比1958年明显缩小，他仍以明显优势击败布莱韦特，赢得第三个参议员任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1964
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 3, 1964. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1964 United States presidential election. New York voters chose forty three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by incumbent Democratic President Lyndon B. Johnson, who was running against Republican Senator Barry Goldwater of Arizona. Johnson ran with Senator Hubert Humphrey of Minnesota, and Goldwater ran with Representative William E. Miller of New York.

zh.s: 1964年纽约州总统选举于11月3日举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。纽约州选民选出43名选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统林登·B·约翰逊在该州击败共和党参议员巴里·戈德华特。约翰逊的竞选搭档是参议员休伯特·汉弗莱；戈德华特的竞选搭档是联邦众议员威廉·E·米勒。

en.s: The 1964 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Governor of Montana Tim M. Babcock, who became Governor upon the death of previous Governor Donald Grant Nutter, ran for re-election. He won the Republican primary unopposed, and advanced to the general election, where he faced Roland Renne, the former President of Montana State College and the Democratic nominee, in the general election. Despite the fact that then-President Lyndon B. Johnson won the state handily in that year's presidential election, Babcock managed to narrowly defeat Renne to win his second and final term as governor.

zh.s: 1964年蒙大拿州州长选举于11月3日举行。时任州长蒂姆·M·巴布科克竞选连任；此前州长唐纳德·格兰特·纳特去世后，他接任州长。巴布科克在共和党初选中没有对手，随后进入大选，对阵蒙大拿州立大学前校长、民主党候选人罗兰·伦内。尽管时任总统林登·B·约翰逊在同年的总统选举中轻松赢得蒙大拿州，巴布科克仍以微弱优势击败伦内，赢得第二个也是最后一个州长任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Idaho, 1964
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 3, 1964 as part of the 1964 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states and D.C. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Idaho was one of 44 states carried in a national landslide by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson. However, it was by far the weakest state that Johnson carried in the election. Johnson carried the state by a margin of 5,363 votes, or 1.83%, making Idaho’s vote about 20.75% more Republican than the national average.

zh.s: 1964年爱达荷州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年全国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。在约翰逊大获全胜的全国选举中，爱达荷州是他赢下的44个州之一，但也是他获胜幅度最小的州。约翰逊在该州以5,363票、1.83个百分点的优势胜出；与全国平均水平相比，爱达荷州的投票倾向共和党约20.75个百分点。

en.t: United States presidential election in Mississippi, 1964
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Mississippi was held on November 3, 1964. The state showed Republican candidate Barry Goldwater's best performance in the 1964 election. He defeated the Incumbent President Johnson by a margin of 74.28 percentage points, giving Goldwater 7 electoral votes. Goldwater won all of Mississippi's 82 counties, some by over 90%. Goldwater's opposition to the Civil Rights Act appealed to the southern United States, and won him most states in the Deep South. He lost the general election to Johnson, who won with 61% of the national vote.

zh.s: 1964年密西西比州总统选举于11月3日举行。共和党候选人巴里·戈德华特在该州的表现优于他在1964年其他州的表现。他以74.28个百分点的优势击败时任总统林登·B·约翰逊，赢得7张选举人票。戈德华特赢下密西西比州全部82个县，其中一些县的领先幅度超过90%。他反对《民权法案》，这一立场受到美国南方选民欢迎，并帮助他赢得深南部大多数州。戈德华特最终输给约翰逊；约翰逊赢得了全国61%的选票。

en.t: United States presidential election in Montana, 1964
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Montana took place on November 3, 1964, throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 1964 United States presidential election. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Montana overwhelmingly voted for the Democratic nominee, President Lyndon B. Johnson, over the Republican nominee, Senator Barry Goldwater. Johnson won Montana by a large margin of 18.38%. This is the last presidential election where a Democrat won Montana by a majority of the popular vote (Bill Clinton would win the state by a plurality in 1992).

zh.s: 1964年蒙大拿州总统选举于11月3日举行，是在美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区举行的全国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。蒙大拿州以明显优势支持民主党候选人、总统林登·B·约翰逊，而非共和党候选人、参议员巴里·戈德华特。约翰逊在该州领先18.38个百分点。这是民主党总统候选人最后一次在蒙大拿州赢得过半普选票；比尔·克林顿于1992年在该州以相对多数胜出。

en.t: United States presidential election in Texas, 1964
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Texas was held on November 3, 1964. The Democratic Party candidate, incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson, comfortably won his home state of Texas with 63.32% of the vote against the Republican Party candidate, Senator Barry Goldwater of Arizona, giving him the state's 25 electoral votes. Johnson carried 238 out of the state's 254 counties, and all 23 congressional districts. 1964 marks the last time a Democratic candidate for president would win Texas by double digit margins.

zh.s: 1964年得克萨斯州总统选举于11月3日举行。民主党候选人、时任总统林登·B·约翰逊以63.32%的得票率轻松赢下家乡得克萨斯州，击败得票率为37.06%的共和党候选人、来自亚利桑那州的参议员巴里·戈德华特，并赢得该州25张选举人票。约翰逊赢得该州254个县中的238个和全部23个国会选区。1964年是民主党总统候选人最后一次在得克萨斯州以两位数优势胜出。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 1964
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 3, 1964. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1964 United States presidential election. New Jersey voters chose 17 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New Jersey was won overwhelmingly by the Democratic nominees, incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson of Texas and his running mate Senator Hubert H. Humphrey of Minnesota. Johnson and Humphrey defeated the Republican nominees, Senator Barry Goldwater of Arizona and his running mate Congressman William E. Miller of New York.

zh.s: 1964年新泽西州总统选举于11月3日举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。新泽西州选民选出17名选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自得克萨斯州的时任总统林登·B·约翰逊及其竞选搭档、来自明尼苏达州的参议员休伯特·H·汉弗莱，以压倒性优势胜出。他们击败了共和党候选人、来自亚利桑那州的参议员巴里·戈德华特及其竞选搭档、来自纽约州的联邦众议员威廉·E·米勒。

en.t: United States presidential election in Alaska, 1964
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Alaska took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Alaska was won by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson (D-Texas) with 65.9% of the popular vote against U.S. Senator Barry Goldwater (R-Arizona) with 34.1%. Johnson won the national vote as well, defeating Goldwater and serving another term after finishing John F. Kennedy's term.

zh.s: 1964年阿拉斯加州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年全国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统林登·B·约翰逊（民主党，来自得克萨斯州）以65.9%的普选票胜过美国参议员巴里·戈德华特（共和党，来自亚利桑那州）的34.1%，赢得阿拉斯加州。约翰逊也赢得全国选举；他在完成约翰·F·肯尼迪的任期后，继续担任总统。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1964
en.s: The 1964 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 3, 1964 to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. The primary elections were held on June 9 and the runoff elections were held two weeks later on June 23. All five incumbents who ran were re-elected and the open seat in the 5th congressional district was retained by the Democrats. The composition of the state delegation thus remained solely Democratic.

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1964 was the 45th quadrennial presidential election. It was held on Tuesday, November 3, 1964. Democratic candidate and incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson had come to office less than a year earlier following the assassination of his predecessor John F. Kennedy. Johnson, who had successfully associated himself with Kennedy's popularity, won 61.1% of the popular vote, the highest won by a candidate since James Monroe's re-election in 1820. It was the most lopsided US presidential election in terms of popular votes, and the sixth-most lopsided presidential election in the history of the United States in terms of electoral votes.

zh.s: 1964年美国总统选举是美国第45次每四年举行一次的总统选举，于11月3日星期二举行。民主党候选人、时任总统林登·B·约翰逊在前任总统约翰·F·肯尼迪遇刺身亡后不到一年接任总统。约翰逊成功借助肯尼迪的声望，以61.1%的普选票胜出，这是自詹姆斯·门罗1820年连任以来最高的得票率。这是美国总统选举中普选票差距最大的一次，也是按选举人票差距计算的美国历史上第六大胜选。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1964
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 3, 1964. All 50 states and the District of Columbia were part of the 1964 United States presidential election. Virginia voters chose 12 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President of the United States. Virginia was won by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson of Texas with 53.54% of the vote, who was running against U.S. Senator Barry Goldwater of Arizona. Johnson also won the national election in a landslide with 61.05% of the vote. However, the state would not vote for another Democratic candidate until 2008.

zh.s: 1964年弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月3日举行，是全国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出12名选举人，由他们选出美国总统和副总统。来自得克萨斯州的时任总统林登·B·约翰逊以53.54%的得票率赢得弗吉尼亚州，击败来自亚利桑那州的美国参议员巴里·戈德华特。约翰逊还以61.05%的得票率在全国大胜。不过，直到2008年，该州才再次支持民主党总统候选人。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 1964
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 3, 1964. All 50 states and The District of Columbia, were part of the 1964 United States presidential election. New Mexico voters chose four electors to represent them in the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by President Lyndon Johnson in a 19-point landslide. Johnson had won after serving as President for one year following the assassination of John F. Kennedy. Arizona Senator Barry Goldwater lost most of the United States in this election, except for his home state and portions of the American South.

en.t: United States presidential election in Massachusetts, 1964
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states and D.C. Voters chose 14 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Massachusetts voted overwhelmingly for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson of Texas, over the Republican nominee, Senator Barry Goldwater of Arizona. Johnson ran with incumbent Vice President Hubert H. Humphrey of Minnesota, while Goldwater's running mate was Congressman William E. Miller of New York.
