en.s: The 1964 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964. Democratic nominee Robert W. Scott defeated Republican nominee Clifford L. Bell with 60.77% of the vote.

zh.t: 1964年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 1964年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党提名人罗伯特·W·斯科特击败共和党提名人克利福德·L·贝尔，得票率为60.77%。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kansas was won by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson (D–Texas), with 54.09 percent of the popular vote, against Senator Barry Goldwater (R–Arizona), with 45.06 percent of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1964年美国总统选举堪萨斯州选情
zh.s: 1964年美国总统选举堪萨斯州选情于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统、得克萨斯州民主党人林登·B·约翰逊在堪萨斯州获胜，得票率为54.09%；亚利桑那州参议员、共和党人巴里·戈德华特得票率为45.06%。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Missouri was won by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson (D–Texas), with 64.05 percent of the popular vote, against Senator Barry Goldwater (R–Arizona), with 35.95 percent.

zh.t: 1964年美国总统选举密苏里州选情
zh.s: 1964年美国总统选举密苏里州选情于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统、得克萨斯州民主党人林登·B·约翰逊在密苏里州获胜，得票率为64.05%；亚利桑那州参议员、共和党人巴里·戈德华特得票率为35.95%。

en.s: The 1964 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 3, 1964. Voters elected members of the Arizona House of Representatives in all 80 of the state's House districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate. Primary elections were held on September 8, 1964.

zh.s: 1964年亚利桑那州众议院选举于11月3日举行。选民从该州全部80个众议院选区中选出州众议员，任期两年。选举与州长、联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州参议员等职位的选举同时举行。初选于1964年9月8日举行。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. North Dakota was won by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson (D–Texas), with 57.97% of the popular vote, against Senator Barry Goldwater (R–Arizona), with 41.88% of the popular vote, a 16.09% margin of victory.

zh.t: 1964年美国总统选举北达科他州选情
zh.s: 1964年美国总统选举北达科他州选情于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统、得克萨斯州民主党人林登·B·约翰逊在北达科他州获胜，得票率为57.97%；亚利桑那州参议员、共和党人巴里·戈德华特得票率为41.88%，约翰逊领先16.09个百分点。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Michigan took place on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Philip Hart was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican Elly Peterson.

zh.t: 1964年密歇根州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年密歇根州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任联邦参议员菲利普·哈特击败共和党人埃莉·彼得森，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1964 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1964, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Democrat Jack M. Campbell ran for reelection to a second term against Republican Merle H. Tucker. Campbell defeated Tucker in a landslide, receiving the largest share of the vote by any New Mexico gubernatorial candidate to that point.

zh.s: 1964年新墨西哥州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任州长杰克·M·坎贝尔竞选连任第二个任期，对手是共和党人默尔·H·塔克。坎贝尔以明显优势击败塔克，得票率创下当时该州州长候选人的最高纪录。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by incumbent Democratic President Lyndon B. Johnson, with 56.56% of the popular vote, against the Republican nominee, Arizona Senator Barry Goldwater, with 43.44% of the popular vote, representing a margin of victory of 13.2%.

zh.t: 1964年美国总统选举怀俄明州选情
zh.s: 1964年美国总统选举怀俄明州选情于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。时任民主党总统林登·B·约翰逊在怀俄明州获胜，得票率为56.56%；亚利桑那州参议员、共和党提名人巴里·戈德华特得票率为43.44%，约翰逊领先13.2个百分点。

en.s: The 1964 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964. Democratic nominee Dan K. Moore defeated Republican nominee Robert L. Gavin with 56.59% of the vote.

zh.s: 1964年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党提名人丹·K·摩尔击败共和党提名人罗伯特·L·加文，得票率为56.59%。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. Louisiana voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Louisiana was won by the Republican ticket of U.S. Senator Barry Goldwater, running with U.S. Representative William E.

zh.t: 1964年美国路易斯安那州总统选举
zh.s: 1964年美国路易斯安那州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。路易斯安那州选民选出10名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、联邦参议员巴里·戈德华特赢得该州。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Arizona took place on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Barry Goldwater decided not to run for reelection to a third term, instead running for President of the United States as the Republican Party nominee against president Lyndon B. Johnson. Arizona Governor Paul Fannin ran unopposed in the Republican primary, and defeated Democratic nominee Roy Elson, who was a staff member for U.S.

zh.t: 1964年美国亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年美国亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任联邦参议员巴里·戈德华特放弃竞选第三个任期，转而以共和党候选人身份竞选总统，与林登·B·约翰逊对决。亚利桑那州州长保罗·范宁在共和党初选中没有对手，并在大选中击败民主党候选人罗伊·埃尔森。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in West Virginia was held on November 3, 1964, alongside the 1964 United States presidential election. Incumbent Senator Robert Byrd won re-election in a landslide.

zh.t: 1964年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举于11月3日与美国总统选举同时举行。时任参议员罗伯特·伯德以明显优势连任。

en.s: The 1964 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Governor Paul Fannin decided not to run for reelection to a fourth term as governor, instead deciding to successfully run for the United States Senate when incumbent U.S. Senator Barry Goldwater decided to run for President of the United States.

zh.s: 1964年亚利桑那州州长选举于11月3日举行。时任州长保罗·范宁决定不竞选第四个任期，转而竞选联邦参议员。此前，时任联邦参议员巴里·戈德华特决定竞选总统，范宁最终成功当选参议员。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all fifty states and D.C. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine was won by incumbent Democratic President Lyndon B. Johnson of Texas in a landslide over Republican U.S.

zh.s: 1964年美国缅因州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。缅因州选民选出4名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统林登·B·约翰逊以压倒性优势赢得缅因州，击败共和党候选人。

en.s: The 1964 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Delaware House of Representatives Sherman W. Tribbitt defeated Republican nominee William T. Best.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行特拉华州副州长选举。民主党候选人、现任特拉华州众议员谢尔曼·W·特里比特击败共和党候选人威廉·T·贝斯特。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Utah
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Utah was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democratic Senator Frank Moss was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Republican Ernest L. Wilkinson, the president of Brigham Young University.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行犹他州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党参议员弗兰克·莫斯击败共和党候选人、杨百翰大学校长欧内斯特·L·威尔金森，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1964 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964, and featured 31-year-old Philip Sorensen, a Democrat, defeating Republican nominee Charles Thone. Incumbent lieutenant governor Dwight Burney decided to run for Governor of Nebraska and thus did not run for reelection as lieutenant governor.

zh.t: 1964年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州副州长选举。31岁的民主党人菲利普·索伦森击败共和党候选人查尔斯·索恩。现任副州长德怀特·伯尼决定竞选州长，因此没有竞选连任副州长。

en.s: The 1964 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democrat John W. King defeated Republican nominee John Pillsbury with 66.77% of the vote.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。现任民主党州长约翰·W·金以66.77%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·皮尔斯伯里。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Washington was won by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson (D–Texas), with 61.97% of the popular vote, against Senator Barry Goldwater (R–Arizona), with 37.37% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日，华盛顿州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选出9名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统林登·B·约翰逊获得华盛顿州61.97%的普选票，击败共和党候选人、参议员巴里·戈德华特，后者获得37.37%的普选票。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Missouri took place on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Stuart Symington was re-elected to a third term in office over Republican Jean Paul Bradshaw.

zh.t: 1964年密苏里州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行密苏里州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党联邦参议员斯图尔特·西明顿击败共和党候选人让·保罗·布拉德肖，成功连任第三个任期。

en.t: 1964 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1964 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Republican Congressman William Henry Harrison ran for re-election. He was challenged in the general election by Democratic nominee Teno Roncalio, an attorney and former member of the International Joint Commission. Aided by President Lyndon B. Johnson's landslide victory in the presidential election, Roncalio narrowly defeated Harrison, becoming the first Democrat to win a U.S.

zh.t: 1964年美国怀俄明州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1964年美国怀俄明州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任联邦众议员威廉·亨利·哈里森竞选连任。民主党候选人特诺·朗卡利奥是一名律师，曾任国际联合委员会成员。受总统选举中林登·B·约翰逊大胜的影响，朗卡利奥以微弱优势击败哈里森。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon was overwhelmingly won by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson (D–Texas), with 63.72% of the popular vote, against Senator Barry Goldwater (R–Arizona), with 35.96% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日，俄勒冈州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统林登·B·约翰逊以压倒性优势赢得俄勒冈州，获得63.72%的普选票；共和党候选人、参议员巴里·戈德华特获得35.96%的普选票。

en.s: The 1964 Illinois gubernatorial election was held in Illinois on November 3, 1964. The Democratic nominee, incumbent Governor Otto Kerner Jr., won reelection against the Republican nominee, Charles H. Percy.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行伊利诺伊州州长选举。民主党候选人、现任州长奥托·克纳二世击败共和党候选人查尔斯·H·珀西，成功连任。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Incumbent Democratic president Lyndon B. Johnson won Tennessee with 55.50% of the vote to Republican nominee Barry Goldwater's 44.49%.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日，田纳西州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选出11名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统林登·B·约翰逊以55.50%的得票率赢得田纳西州；共和党候选人巴里·戈德华特获得44.49%。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democrat Harrison A. Williams defeated Republican nominee Bernard M. Shanley with 61.91% of the vote. Primary elections were held on April 21, 1964. Both candidates were unopposed. This was the first time since 1888 that Democrats were re-elected to the Senate from New Jersey, and the first since 1856 to this seat.

zh.t: 1964年新泽西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行新泽西州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党参议员哈里森·A·威廉姆斯以61.91%的得票率击败共和党候选人伯纳德·M·尚利。初选于1964年4月21日举行，两党候选人都没有对手。这是自1888年以来民主党首次在新泽西州成功连任联邦参议员，也是自1856年以来首次在这个席位上连任。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Hawaii
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Hawaii took place on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Republican U.S Senator Hiram Fong was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Democratic U.S. Representative Thomas Gill.

zh.t: 1964年夏威夷州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行夏威夷州联邦参议员选举。现任共和党联邦参议员希拉姆·方击败民主党联邦众议员托马斯·吉尔，成功连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Republican Senator James Glenn Beall ran for re-election to a third term, but was defeated by Democratic former State Representative Joseph D. Tydings in a landslide. Tydings was the adopted son of former Senator Millard Tydings.

zh.t: 1964年马里兰州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行马里兰州联邦参议员选举。现任共和党参议员詹姆斯·格伦·比尔竞选连任第三个任期，但以压倒性差距败给民主党候选人、前州众议员约瑟夫·D·泰丁斯。泰丁斯是前参议员米勒德·泰丁斯的养子。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Alabama on November 3, 1964. Primary elections were held on May 5, 1964, and primary runoffs were held on June 2, 1964.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日，阿拉巴马州举行大选。初选于同年5月5日举行，初选决选于6月2日举行。

en.s: A Massachusetts general election was held on November 3, 1964, in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. The election included: statewide elections for United States Senator, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Secretary of the Commonwealth, Treasurer, and Auditor; district elections for U.S. Representatives, State Representatives, State Senators, and Governor's Councillors; and ballot questions at the state and local levels. Democratic and Republican candidates were selected in party primaries held on September 10, 1964.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日，马萨诸塞州举行大选，选举范围包括全州职位，如联邦参议员、州长、副州长、总检察长、州务卿、财政部长和审计长；各选区的联邦众议员、州众议员、州参议员和州行政委员会委员；以及州和地方层面的公投议题。民主党和共和党候选人由9月10日举行的党内初选选出。

en.s: The 1964 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Republican Governor Archie M. Gubbrud did not run for re-election. Republican nominee Nils Boe defeated Democratic nominee John F. Lindley with 51.68% of the vote.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行南达科他州州长选举。现任共和党州长阿奇·M·古布鲁德没有竞选连任。共和党候选人尼尔斯·博以51.68%的得票率击败民主党候选人约翰·F·林德利。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska was won by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson (D–Texas), with 52.61% of the popular vote, against Senator Barry Goldwater (R–Arizona), with 47.39% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1964年内布拉斯加州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日，内布拉斯加州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统林登·B·约翰逊获得52.61%的普选票，击败共和党候选人、参议员巴里·戈德华特，后者获得47.39%的普选票。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democrat William Proxmire was re-elected to a second full term in office over Republican Wilbur Renk.

zh.t: 1964年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行威斯康星州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党参议员威廉·普罗克斯迈尔击败共和党候选人威尔伯·伦克，成功连任完整任期。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 3, 1964, concurrently with the presidential election. Elections were held in 25 states and 1 territory. These were the last gubernatorial elections for Florida, Massachusetts, Michigan, and Nebraska to take place in a presidential election year. Florida switched its governor election years to midterm years, while the other three expanded their terms from two to four years.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日，美国各州举行州长选举，与总统选举同期进行，共有25个州和1个属地举行了选举。这是佛罗里达州、马萨诸塞州、密歇根州和内布拉斯加州最后一次在总统选举年举行州长选举。之后，佛罗里达州将州长选举改到中期选举年举行，其他三个州则把州长任期从两年延长到四年。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Nebraska took place on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Republican Senator Roman Hruska ran for re-election. He was challenged by the Democratic nominee, Raymond W. Arndt, the personnel director at the Nebraska Public Power District. Despite Democratic President Lyndon B. Johnson's narrow victory over Barry Goldwater in Nebraska, Hruska won re-election in a landslide, winning 61% of the vote and winning every county in the state except for Saline County.

zh.t: 1964年内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举。现任共和党参议员罗曼·赫鲁斯卡竞选连任，面对民主党候选人、内布拉斯加州公共电力区人事主管雷蒙德·W·阿恩特。尽管民主党籍总统林登·B·约翰逊在内布拉斯加州险胜巴里·戈德华特，赫鲁斯卡仍以压倒性优势连任，获得61%的选票，并赢得该州除萨林县外的所有县。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democratic senator Gale W. McGee ran for re-election to his second term. In the general election, he faced Republican nominee John S. Wold, the former chairman of the Republican Party of Wyoming and a former state representative. Despite Wyoming's long conservative streak, McGee was aided by the strong performance by President Lyndon B.

zh.t: 1964年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任参议员盖尔·W·麦吉竞选第二个任期。大选中，他的对手是共和党候选人约翰·S·沃尔德，后者曾任怀俄明州共和党主席和州众议员。尽管怀俄明州长期倾向保守派，麦吉仍受益于总统林登·B·约翰逊的强势表现。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Florida was held November 3, 1964. All contemporary fifty states and the District of Columbia took part, and Florida voters selected fourteen electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Although Johnson won the state amidst his national landslide, Florida weighed in as a massive 20.28% more Republican than the nation at large, and was the second-closest state won by Johnson, after Idaho.

zh.t: 1964年佛罗里达州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行美国总统选举，全美当时的50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。佛罗里达州选民选出14名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。尽管约翰逊在全国大胜并赢得佛罗里达州，该州的共和党倾向仍比全国平均高出20.28个百分点，是约翰逊获胜的州中差距第二小的，仅次于爱达荷州。

en.s: The 1964 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 3, 1964, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee and former state treasurer Mount Etna Morris defeated Republican nominee Perry Compton.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行密苏里州州财长选举。民主党提名人、前州财长蒙特·埃特纳·莫里斯击败共和党提名人佩里·康普顿。

en.s: The 1964 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964. Democratic nominee Thomas Eagleton defeated Republican nominee Jewett M. Fulkerson with 64.78% of the vote.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行密苏里州副州长选举。民主党提名人托马斯·伊格尔顿以64.78%的得票率击败共和党提名人朱厄特·M·福尔克森。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. Voters chose 21 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Michigan was won by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson (D–Texas), with 66.70% of the popular vote, against Senator Barry Goldwater (R–Arizona), with 33.10% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日，密歇根州举行美国总统选举，选出21名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统林登·B·约翰逊以66.70%的普选票赢得该州；共和党参议员巴里·戈德华特获得33.10%的普选票。

en.s: The 1964 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1964, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee Norman H. Anderson defeated Republican nominee Daniel Bartlett Jr..

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行密苏里州总检察长选举。民主党提名人诺曼·H·安德森击败共和党提名人小丹尼尔·巴特利特。

en.t: 1964 United States House of Representatives election in Alaska
en.s: The Alaska congressional election of 1964 was held on Tuesday, November 3, 1964. The term of the state's sole Representative to the United States House of Representatives expired on January 3, 1965. The winning candidate would serve a two-year term from January 3, 1965, to January 3, 1967. Incumbent representative Ralph Rivers won re-election to a fourth term by 3 percentage points.

zh.t: 1964年阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举。该州唯一一名联邦众议员的任期于1965年1月3日届满，胜选者将从该日起任职两年，至1967年1月3日结束。在任议员拉尔夫·里弗斯以3个百分点的优势连任第四届。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Delaware took place on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John J. Williams was narrowly re-elected to a fourth term in office over then Democratic Governor Elbert Carvel in a rematch of the 1958 campaign.

zh.t: 1964年特拉华州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行特拉华州联邦参议院选举。在任共和党参议员约翰·J·威廉姆斯以微弱优势击败当时的民主党州长埃尔伯特·卡维尔，成功连任第四届。这是两人在1958年竞选中的再次交锋。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate special election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate special election in Oklahoma took place on November 3, 1964. Democratic senator Robert S. Kerr, who won re-election to his third term in 1960, died in office on January 1, 1963. Governor J. Howard Edmondson resigned from office so that his lieutenant governor, George Nigh, could appoint him to the U.S. Senate.

zh.t: 1964年美国俄克拉何马州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1964年美国俄克拉何马州联邦参议员特别选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍参议员罗伯特·S·克尔曾于1960年赢得第三个任期，后于1963年1月1日在任内去世。州长J·霍华德·埃德蒙森辞职，以便其副州长乔治·奈接任州长后任命他进入联邦参议院。

en.s: The 1964 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1964, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee James Kirkpatrick defeated Republican nominee William J. Jones.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行密苏里州州务卿选举。民主党提名人詹姆斯·柯克帕特里克击败共和党提名人威廉·J·琼斯。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. The Democratic ticket of the incumbent president of the United States Lyndon B. Johnson and the senior U.S. senator from Minnesota Hubert Humphrey defeated the Republican ticket of the junior U.S. senator from Arizona Barry Goldwater and the U.S. representative from New York's 40th congressional district William E.

zh.t: 1964年美国印第安纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日，印第安纳州举行总统选举，属于当年美国总统选举的一部分。民主党候选人、时任美国总统林登·B·约翰逊与来自明尼苏达州的资深联邦参议员休伯特·汉弗莱，击败了共和党候选人、来自亚利桑那州的联邦参议员巴里·戈德华特。

en.s: The 1964 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964, and featured incumbent Governor Frank B. Morrison, a Democrat, defeating Republican nominee, Lieutenant Governor Dwight Burney, to win a third and final two-year term in office. Eight years earlier, Frank B. Morrison faced Dwight Burney in the 1956 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election, though in that election, Burney had defeated Morrison to become Nebraska Lieutenant Governor.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州州长选举。在任民主党州长弗兰克·B·莫里森击败共和党提名人、副州长德怀特·伯尼，成功连任第三届、也是最后一届两年任期。8年前，两人曾在1956年内布拉斯加州副州长选举中交锋，当时伯尼击败莫里森，当选副州长。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states and D.C. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut voted overwhelmingly for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Lyndon B.

zh.t: 1964年美国康涅狄格州总统选举
zh.s: 1964年美国康涅狄格州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分；全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。康涅狄格州选民选出8名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。该州以压倒性优势支持民主党候选人、时任总统林登·B·约翰逊。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Utah was won by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson (D–Texas), with 54.71 percent of the popular vote, against Senator Barry Goldwater (R–Arizona), with 45.29 percent of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日，犹他州举行美国总统选举，选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统林登·B·约翰逊以54.71%的普选票赢得该州；共和党参议员巴里·戈德华特获得45.29%的普选票。

en.t: 1964 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: The 1964 United States Virgin Islands legislative election was held on Tuesday, November 3, 1964, to elect members of the 6th Virgin Islands Legislature. 11 senators were elected, who elected incumbent Earle B. Ottley as president.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行美属维尔京群岛第六届立法机关选举，选出11名参议员，由他们选出在任议长厄尔·B·奥特利继续担任议长。

en.s: The 1964 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democratic Governor Orval Faubus won election to a sixth term, defeating Republican nominee Winthrop Rockefeller with 57.00% of the vote.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行阿肯色州州长选举。在任民主党州长奥瓦尔·福布斯以57.00%的得票率击败共和党提名人温思罗普·洛克菲勒，赢得第六届任期。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in California was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democratic Senator Clair Engle, who had been first elected in 1958, underwent surgery for a brain tumor in August 1963. Facing a primary challenge from Alan Cranston and deteriorating health, he withdrew from the race in April 1964. The primary election was won by Pierre Salinger, Press Secretary to President Lyndon Johnson.

zh.t: 1964年美国加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年美国加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任参议员克莱尔·恩格尔于1958年首次当选，1963年8月接受脑瘤手术。面对艾伦·克兰斯顿的初选挑战且健康状况恶化，他于1964年4月退出竞选。总统林登·约翰逊的新闻秘书皮埃尔·塞林杰赢得民主党初选。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nevada was won by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson (D–Texas), with 58.58% of the popular vote, against Senator Barry Goldwater (R–Arizona), with 41.42% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日，内华达州举行美国总统选举，选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统林登·B·约翰逊以58.58%的普选票赢得该州；共和党参议员巴里·戈德华特获得41.42%的普选票。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Rhode Island took place on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator John Pastore successfully sought re-election, defeating Republican Ronald Lagueux with 82.73% of the vote.

zh.t: 1964年罗得岛州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1964年罗得岛州联邦参议院选举于1964年11月3日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员约翰·帕斯托雷成功连任，以82.73%的选票击败共和党候选人罗纳德·拉戈。

en.t: 1964 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1964 United States House of Representatives elections was an election for the United States House of Representatives on November 3, 1964, to elect members to serve in the 89th United States Congress. They coincided with the election to a full term of President Lyndon B. Johnson. Johnson's landslide victory over Barry Goldwater allowed his Democratic Party to gain a net of 36 seats from the Republican Party, giving them a two-thirds majority in the House for the first time since 1936.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行美国联邦众议院选举，选出第89届国会的议员，与林登·B·约翰逊总统完整任期选举同期进行。约翰逊以压倒性优势击败巴里·戈德华特，帮助民主党净增36个席位，在众议院取得三分之二多数。这是自1936年以来民主党首次在众议院获得三分之二多数。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. District of Columbia voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. President Lyndon B. Johnson won Washington, D.C. by an overwhelming margin, receiving over 85% of the vote.

zh.t: 1964年哥伦比亚特区美国总统选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日，哥伦比亚特区举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。哥伦比亚特区选出3名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。林登·B·约翰逊总统以压倒性优势赢得华盛顿特区，获得超过85%的选票。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Dakota was won by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson (D–Texas), with 55.61 percent of the popular vote, against Senator Barry Goldwater (R–Arizona), with 44.39% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1964年南达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日，南达科他州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统林登·B·约翰逊获得55.61%的普选票，击败共和党候选人、参议员巴里·戈德华特，后者获得44.39%的普选票。

en.t: 1964 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware
en.s: The 1964 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware took place on November 3, 1964. Incumbent representative, Harris McDowell won re-election to a fifth term with 56.55 percent of the vote against Republican candidate, James Snowden who got 43.41 percent. This would be the last time a Democrat would win Delaware's at-large congressional district until 1982.

zh.t: 1964年特拉华州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行特拉华州联邦众议院选举。现任众议员哈里斯·麦克道尔以56.55%的得票率击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·斯诺登，成功当选第五个任期；斯诺登获得43.41%的得票率。民主党直到1982年才再次赢得特拉华州单一国会选区的席位。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate special election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate special election in Tennessee was held on November 3, 1964, concurrently with the U.S. presidential election as well the other regularly scheduled U.S. Senate election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1964年田纳西州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行田纳西州联邦参议员特别选举，与美国总统选举、该州按计划举行的另一场联邦参议员选举、其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 3, 1964. All fifty states and The District of Columbia were part of the 1964 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson of Texas, the Democratic Party candidate, won Oklahoma with an 11.49 percent margin of victory against Senator Barry Goldwater of Arizona, winning its eight electoral votes.

zh.t: 1964年俄克拉何马州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日，俄克拉何马州举行美国总统选举。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。选民选出8名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自得克萨斯州的时任总统林登·B·约翰逊以11.49个百分点的优势击败共和党候选人、来自亚利桑那州的参议员巴里·戈德华特，赢得俄克拉何马州的8张选举人票。

en.s: The 1964 Arizona Senate election was held on November 3, 1964. Voters elected all 28 members of the Arizona Senate to serve two-year terms. At the time, each of Arizona's 14 counties elected two state senators for a total of 28 members of the Arizona Senate. Primary elections were held on September 8, 1964. Prior to the elections, the Democrats held a supermajority of 24 seats over the 4 Republican seats.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行亚利桑那州参议院选举，选出全部28名任期两年的州参议员。当时，该州14个县各选出两名州参议员。初选于1964年9月8日举行。选举前，民主党在州参议院占有24席，拥有绝对多数；共和党有4席。

en.s: The 1964 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964. Republican nominee William H. Avery defeated Democratic nominee Harry G. Wiles with 50.9% of the vote. This marks the last time in Kansas history that the elected Governor was of the same party as the outgoing Governor.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行堪萨斯州州长选举。共和党候选人威廉·H·艾弗里以50.9%的得票率击败民主党候选人哈里·G·怀尔斯。这是堪萨斯州历史上最后一次由与卸任州长同党派的候选人当选州长。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Florida
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Florida was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Spessard Holland was re-elected to a fourth term in office, defeating J. Brailey Oldham in the primary and Republican Claude R. Kirk Jr. in the general election. Kirk would go on to be elected governor in 1966. This was the first time since 1950 that a Republican won a county in a U.S.

zh.t: 1964年美国佛罗里达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年美国佛罗里达州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任联邦参议员斯佩萨德·霍兰德成功连任第四个任期：他在民主党初选中击败J·布雷利·奥尔德姆，并在大选中击败共和党候选人克劳德·R·柯克二世。柯克后来于1966年当选州长。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in California took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. State voters chose 40 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California voted for the incumbent Democratic President, Lyndon B. Johnson of Texas, in a landslide over the Republican nominee, Senator Barry Goldwater of Arizona.

zh.t: 1964年加利福尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日，加利福尼亚州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选出40名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。加利福尼亚州以压倒性优势支持民主党籍时任总统、来自得克萨斯州的林登·B·约翰逊，击败共和党候选人、来自亚利桑那州的参议员巴里·戈德华特。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. Kentucky voters chose 9 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kentucky was won by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson (D–Texas), with 64.01% of the popular vote, against Senator Barry Goldwater (R–Arizona), with 35.65% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日，肯塔基州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选出9名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统林登·B·约翰逊获得64.01%的普选票，击败共和党候选人、参议员巴里·戈德华特，后者获得35.65%的普选票。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Eugene McCarthy defeated Republican challenger Wheelock Whitney Jr., to win a second term.

zh.t: 1964年明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党联邦参议员尤金·麦卡锡击败共和党候选人惠洛克·惠特尼二世，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1964 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democratic Governor Matthew E. Welsh was term-limited. Democratic nominee Roger D. Branigin defeated Republican nominee Richard O. Ristine with 56.18% of the vote. This would be the last time until 1988 in which the Democrats won the governorship. As of 2023, this marks the most recent time that Democrats won the races for governor and for president concurrently.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行印第安纳州州长选举。现任民主党州长马修·E·威尔士因任期限制不能连任。民主党候选人罗杰·D·布拉尼金以56.18%的得票率击败共和党候选人理查德·O·里斯廷。直到1988年，民主党才再次赢得印第安纳州州长选举。截至2023年，这是民主党最近一次同时赢得该州州长选举和总统选举。

en.s: The 1964 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democratic Governor Elbert N. Carvel was term-limited, having served two non-consecutive terms. Carvel instead ran for the U.S. Senate. Democratic nominee Charles L. Terry Jr. defeated Republican nominee David P. Buckson with 51.35% of the vote.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行特拉华州州长选举。现任民主党州长埃尔伯特·N·卡维尔已担任两个非连续任期，因任期限制不能连任。他转而竞选联邦参议员。民主党候选人查尔斯·L·特里二世以51.35%的得票率击败共和党候选人大卫·P·巴克森。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 3, 1964. Primaries were held on April 14, 1964.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日星期二，伊利诺伊州举行选举。初选于同年4月14日举行。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Vance Hartke was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican D. Russell Bontrager.

zh.t: 1964年印第安纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行印第安纳州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党联邦参议员万斯·哈特克击败共和党候选人D·拉塞尔·邦特拉格，成功连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Maine
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Maine was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democrat Edmund Muskie was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican U.S. Representative Clifford McIntire. This was the first senate race for this particular seat in which the election was held in November and not September. This was the first time ever that an incumbent Democratic Senator from Maine was re-elected to a second full term.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行缅因州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党参议员埃德蒙·马斯基击败共和党联邦众议员克利福德·麦金泰尔，成功连任第二个任期。这是该席位首次在11月而非9月举行选举，也是缅因州民主党籍现任参议员首次成功连任完整任期。

en.s: The 1964 Alabama Public Service Commission election was held on November 3, 1964, to elect the president of the Alabama Public Service Commission. Primary elections were held on May 5, 1964. The primary runoff election was held on June 2, 1964.

zh.t: 1964年阿拉巴马州公共服务委员会选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行阿拉巴马州公共服务委员会选举，以选出委员会主席。初选于同年5月5日举行，初选决选于6月2日举行。

en.s: The U.S. state of Illinois held an election on November 3, 1964, for all 177 members of the state's House of Representatives for the 74th Illinois General Assembly, alongside other state and federal elections. Due to the state's failure to redistrict, all of the seats were elected at-large by plurality block voting, with voters choosing up to 177 candidates to support.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日，伊利诺伊州举行选举，选出州众议院全部177名议员，组成第74届伊利诺伊州议会，并与其他州级和联邦选举同期进行。由于该州没有重新划分选区，所有席位都由全州选民通过区块投票制选出，每位选民最多可投给177名候选人。

en.s: The 1964 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Republican John Chafee defeated Democratic nominee Edward P. Gallogly with 61.15% of the vote.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行罗得岛州州长选举。现任共和党州长约翰·查菲以61.15%的得票率击败民主党候选人爱德华·P·加洛格利。

en.s: The 1964 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democrat Harold Hughes defeated Republican nominee Evan Hultman with 68.05% of the vote.

zh.s: 1964年艾奥瓦州州长选举于1964年11月3日举行。民主党籍现任州长哈罗德·休斯击败共和党候选人埃文·赫尔特曼，获得68.05%的选票。

en.s: The 1964 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democratic governor C. Farris Bryant was ineligible for a second consecutive full term under the 1885 State Constitution. Democratic nominee W. Haydon Burns defeated Republican nominee Charles R. Holley with 56.12% of the vote.

zh.s: 1964年佛罗里达州州长选举于1964年11月3日举行。根据1885年州宪法，民主党籍现任州长C·法里斯·布莱恩特不能连续竞选第二个完整任期。民主党候选人W·海登·伯恩斯以56.12%的选票击败共和党候选人查尔斯·R·霍利。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. West Virginia voters chose seven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia was won by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson (D–Texas), with 67.94 percent of the popular vote, against Senator Barry Goldwater (R–Arizona), with 32.06 percent of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1964年西弗吉尼亚州总统选举于1964年11月3日举行，是1964年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出7名选举人，进入选举人团投票。现任总统、民主党人林登·B·约翰逊（来自得克萨斯州）以67.94%的普选票赢得该州，共和党人巴里·戈德华特（来自亚利桑那州）获得32.06%。

en.s: The 1964 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democrat William L. Guy defeated Republican nominee Donald M. Halcrow with 55.74% of the vote.

zh.s: 1964年北达科他州州长选举于1964年11月3日举行。民主党籍现任州长威廉·L·盖伊击败共和党候选人唐纳德·M·哈尔克罗，获得55.74%的选票。

en.s: The 1964 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964. Democratic nominee Cal Rampton defeated Republican nominee Mitchell Melich with 56.99% of the vote.

zh.s: 1964年犹他州州长选举于1964年11月3日举行。民主党候选人卡尔·兰普顿击败共和党候选人米切尔·梅利奇，获得56.99%的选票。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1964 presidential election in Arkansas was held on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. State voters chose six electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson won the state of Arkansas with 56.06% of the popular vote, which was a substantial increase upon John F.

zh.s: 1964年美国阿肯色州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。阿肯色州选民选出6名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统林登·B·约翰逊以56.06%的普选票赢得阿肯色州。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. South Carolina voters chose 8 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.t: 1964年南卡罗来纳州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日，南卡罗来纳州举行美国总统选举。选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Tennessee was held on November 3, 1964, concurrently with the U.S. presidential election as well the other U.S. Senate special election in Tennessee, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1964年田纳西州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行田纳西州联邦参议院选举，与总统选举、该州另一场联邦参议院特别选举、其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 1964 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Republican George W. Romney defeated Democratic nominee Neil O. Staebler with 55.87% of the vote. This was the first election in which the governor and lieutenant governor were elected on a joint ticket. Previously, both offices were elected separately.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行密歇根州州长选举。在任共和党州长乔治·W·罗姆尼以55.87%的得票率击败民主党提名人尼尔·O·斯泰布勒。此次选举首次改为州长和副州长共同搭档参选；此前，这两个职位分别选举产生。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Alabama was held on November 3, 1964. Alabama voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice-president. In Alabama, voters voted for electors individually instead of as a slate, as in the other states. Goldwater received 77% of the white vote.

zh.t: 1964年阿拉巴马州美国总统选举
zh.s: 1964年11月3日举行美国总统选举，阿拉巴马州选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。与其他州不同，阿拉巴马州选民分别投票选举每一位总统选举人，而不是对一组候选人投票。戈德华特获得77%的白人选票。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election. Iowa voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa was won by incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson (D–Texas), with 61.88% of the popular vote, against Senator Barry Goldwater (R–Arizona), with 37.92% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1964年11月3日，艾奥瓦州举行美国总统选举，选民选出9名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统林登·B·约翰逊以61.88%的普选票赢得该州；共和党参议员巴里·戈德华特获得37.92%的普选票。

en.t: 1964 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1964 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 3, 1964, as part of the 1964 United States presidential election, which was held on that day throughout all 50 states and The District of Columbia. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Republican nominee and U.S.

zh.s: 1964年美国佐治亚州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年总统选举在全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区举行的一部分。佐治亚州选民选出12名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Democrat Henry M. Jackson won a third term in office with a landslide victory over Republican Superintendent of Instruction Lloyd J. Andrews.

zh.t: 1964年华盛顿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1964年华盛顿州联邦参议院选举于1964年11月3日举行。民主党籍现任参议员亨利·M·杰克逊以明显优势获胜，开始第三个任期。

en.s: The 1964 Washington gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1964, between incumbent Democratic governor Albert Rosellini and Republican nominee Daniel J. Evans. Rosellini, a former state senator, was elected governor in 1956 and re-elected in 1960; he had become unpopular after a series of scandals and increasing partisan division in the state legislature. Evans was a member of the state house of representatives and became the minority leader for the Republicans.

zh.s: 1964年华盛顿州州长选举于1964年11月3日举行，民主党籍现任州长阿尔伯特·罗塞利尼与共和党候选人丹尼尔·J·埃文斯角逐。罗塞利尼曾任州参议员，1956年当选州长，1960年连任。由于一系列丑闻以及州议会党派分歧加剧，他的支持度下降。埃文斯是州众议员，后来成为共和党少数党领袖。

en.t: 1964 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1964 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 3, 1964. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Kenneth Keating ran for re-election to a second term, but was defeated by Robert F. Kennedy.

zh.s: 1964年纽约州联邦参议院选举于1964年11月3日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员肯尼思·基廷竞选连任第二个任期，但败给罗伯特·F·肯尼迪。

en.s: The 1964 United States Senate elections were held on November 3. The 33 seats of Class 1 were contested in regular elections. Special elections were also held to fill vacancies. They coincided with the election of President Lyndon B. Johnson by an overwhelming majority, to a full term. His Democratic Party picked up a net two seats from the Republicans.

zh.s: 1964年美国联邦参议院选举于11月3日举行，第1组33个席位通过常规选举改选，另举行特别选举填补空缺。选举与林登·B·约翰逊以压倒性优势当选总统、开始完整任期同时举行。约翰逊所属的民主党从共和党手中净增两个席位。

en.s: The 1964 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1964 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 39 of the state senate's 59 districts. At that time, the Iowa Senate still had several multi-member districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. The Iowa Senate was expanded from 50 to 59 members and new district maps were drawn for the 1964 election.

zh.s: 1964年爱荷华州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。爱荷华州选民在州参议院59个选区中的39个选区选出议员。当时，爱荷华州参议院仍设有数个多议席选区。州参议员任期四年。1964年选举前，爱荷华州参议院席位由50个增至59个，并重新划分了选区。

en.s: General elections were held in Barbados on 3 November 1966. Unlike previous elections, which used single-member constituencies, this election was contested using two-member constituencies, in which each voter had two votes. The result was a victory for the Democratic Labour Party, which won 14 of the 24 seats. Voter turnout was 79.7%.

zh.s: 巴巴多斯于1966年11月3日举行大选。与以往采用单一议员选区的选举不同，这次选举采用双议员选区，每位选民有两票。民主工党获胜，赢得24个席位中的14席。投票率为79.7%。

en.s: Operation Santa Fe was a security operation conducted during the Vietnam War by the U.S. 1st Brigade, 9th Infantry Division, the 1st Australian Task Force and the Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) 18th Division against the May Tao Secret Zone, South Vietnam from 3 November 1967 to 5 January 1968.

zh.s: 圣菲行动是越南战争期间的一次安全行动，由美国陆军第9步兵师第1旅、澳大利亚特遣部队和越南共和国陆军第18师联合实施，目标是南越梅陶秘密区。行动从1967年11月3日持续至1968年1月5日。

en.s: The Battle of Dak To (Vietnamese: Chiến dịch Đắk Tô - Tân Cảnh) in Vietnam was a series of major engagements of the Vietnam War that took place between 3 and 23 November 1967, in Kontum Province, in the Central Highlands of the Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam). The action at Đắk Tô was one of a series of People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) offensive initiatives that began during the second half of the year.

zh.s: 达克托战役（越南语：Chiến dịch Đắk Tô - Tân Cảnh）是越南战争中的一系列重要交战，发生于1967年11月3日至23日，地点在越南共和国（南越）中部高地昆嵩省。达克托的战事是越南人民军当年下半年发起的一系列攻势之一。

en.t: United States Senate election in Oklahoma, 1968
en.s: The 1968 United States Senate election in Oklahoma was held November 3, 1968. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Mike Monroney was running for re-election to a fourth term, but was defeated by Republican Henry Bellmon.

zh.t: 1968年俄克拉何马州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1968年俄克拉何马州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任联邦参议员迈克·门罗尼竞选第四个任期，但被共和党人亨利·贝尔蒙击败。

en.s: Operation Jeb Stuart III was a U.S. Army operation during the Vietnam War conducted by the 1st Cavalry Division. It took place in Quảng Trị and Thừa Thiên Provinces of I Corps, South Vietnam from 17 May to 3 November 1968.

zh.t: 杰布·斯图尔特三号行动
zh.s: 杰布·斯图尔特三号行动是越南战争期间美国陆军第一骑兵师在南越第一军区实施的一次军事行动，地点包括广治省和承天省，行动时间为1968年5月17日至11月3日。

en.t: Vietnam War: U.S. President Richard M. Nixon addresses the nation on television and radio, asking the "silent majority" to join him in solidarity on the Vietnam War effort and to support his policies
en.s: Richard Milhous Nixon (January 9, 1913 – April 22, 1994) was the 37th president of the United States, serving from 1969 until his resignation in 1974. A member of the Republican Party, he represented California in both houses of the United States Congress before serving as the 36th vice president under President Dwight D. Eisenhower from 1953 to 1961.

zh.t: 越南战争：美国总统理查德·M·尼克松通过电视和广播向全国发表讲话，呼吁“沉默的大多数”团结支持越战和他的政策
zh.s: 理查德·米尔豪斯·尼克松（1913年1月9日—1994年4月22日）是美国第37任总统，1969年就任，1974年辞职。他是共和党成员，曾代表加利福尼亚州在美国国会参众两院任职，之后于1953年至1961年担任德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔总统的第36任副总统。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1970
en.s: The 1970 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 3, 1970 to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. The primary elections were held on June 9 and the runoff elections were held two weeks later on June 23. All five incumbents who ran were re-elected and the open seat in the 2nd district was retained by the Republicans. The composition of the state delegation remained five Democrats and one Republican.

zh.t: 1970年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1970年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，选出该州6名联邦众议员，任期两年。初选于6月9日举行，决选于两周后的6月23日举行。所有竞选连任的5名现任议员均成功连任；第二国会选区的空缺席位由共和党保住。该州代表团最终由5名民主党人和1名共和党人组成。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1970
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 3, 1970. Incumbent United States Senator Mike Mansfield, who was first elected to the Senate in 1952 and was re-elected in 1958 and 1964, ran for re-election. Mansfield won the Democratic primary against several opponents, and advanced to the general election, where he was opposed by Harold E. Wallace, a sporting goods salesman and the Republican nominee. While his margin of victory decreased slightly from 1964, Mansfield still managed to defeat Wallace in a landslide, winning his fourth and final term in the Senate.

zh.t: 1970年蒙大拿州联邦参议员选举

en.s: The 1970 Maine gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democratic Governor of Maine Kenneth M. Curtis chose to seek re-election. Curtis won a landslide victory in the Democratic primary. His general election opponent was Maine Attorney General James Erwin, the Republican nominee. Erwin had also easily won his respective party primary and received the Republican nomination for governor. Curtis narrowly defeated challenger in one of the tightest elections in Maine history – the final margin of victory was a mere 890 votes. Curtis received 163,138 votes (50.14%), while Erwin had 162,248 votes (49.86%).

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections, 1970
en.s: The U.S. House election, 1970 was an election for the United States House of Representatives held on November 3, 1970, in the middle of President Richard M. Nixon's first term. The President's Republican Party lost seats, in this case a net of 12, to the Democratic Party, which thus increased modestly its majority in the House. Many viewed the results as the American public showing fatigue over the ongoing Vietnam War. This was also the first House election when all 50 states were using the same regional single-member district system to elect Representatives instead of using at-large congressional districts.

zh.s: 1970年美国联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，当时理查德·M·尼克松总统的第一个任期过半。共和党失去席位，净减少12席；民主党因此小幅扩大了在众议院的多数优势。许多人认为，选举结果反映了美国公众对持续进行的越南战争感到厌倦。这也是美国50个州首次全部采用相同的单一选区制度选举联邦众议员，而不再使用由各州选区不均等选出议员的制度。
