zh.t: 1970年美国夏威夷州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1970年美国夏威夷州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任参议员希勒姆·方成功连任第三个任期，以微弱优势击败民主党商人塞西尔·赫夫特尔。据《檀香山星报晚报》报道，方支持越南战争，使他在1970年选举中险些落败。

en.s: The 1970 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970, and featured Nebraska Secretary of State Frank Marsh, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee Ronald E. Reagan. This was the last Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial general election where the candidates were elected independently of those in the Nebraska gubernatorial election.

zh.t: 1970年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州副州长选举。共和党人、内布拉斯加州州务卿弗兰克·马什击败民主党提名人罗纳德·E·里根。这是内布拉斯加州副州长最后一次与州长分别选举。

en.s: The 1970 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970 in the U.S. state of Connecticut. Incumbent Democratic Governor John N. Dempsey decided not to run for re-election. Republican nominee Thomas Meskill defeated Democratic nominee Emilio Q. Daddario with 53.76% of the vote. This was the only time a Republican was elected Governor from 1954 to 1990.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行康涅狄格州州长选举。在任民主党州长约翰·N·登普西决定不竞选连任。共和党提名人托马斯·梅斯基尔以53.76%的得票率击败民主党提名人埃米利奥·Q·达达里奥。1954年至1990年间，只有这一次由共和党人当选州长。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Vance Hartke was narrowly re-elected to a third term in office over Republican U.S. Representative Richard Roudebush. As of 2024, this is the last time that an incumbent Democratic Senator from Indiana won re-election for this seat.

zh.t: 1970年印第安纳州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行印第安纳州联邦参议院选举。在任民主党参议员万斯·哈特克以微弱优势击败共和党联邦众议员理查德·劳德布什，连任第三届。截至2024年，这是印第安纳州民主党在任参议员最后一次赢得该席位的连任选举。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democrat Harrison A. Williams defeated Republican nominee Nelson G. Gross with 54.02% of the vote. Primary elections were held on June 2, 1970. Williams held off a challenge from the Hudson County party organization in the form of State Senator Frank Guarini, while Gross prevailed over two candidates without organizational support.

zh.t: 1970年新泽西州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行新泽西州联邦参议院选举。民主党在任参议员哈里森·A·威廉姆斯以54.02%的得票率击败共和党提名人纳尔逊·G·格罗斯。初选于1970年6月2日举行。威廉姆斯击退了哈德逊县党组织支持的州参议员弗兰克·瓜里尼的挑战；格罗斯则击败了两名没有党组织支持的对手。

en.s: The 1970 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democrat Frank Licht very narrowly defeated Republican nominee Herbert F. DeSimone with 50.07% of the vote.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行罗得岛州州长选举。在任民主党州长弗兰克·利希特以50.07%的得票率险胜共和党提名人赫伯特·F·德西蒙。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Eugene McCarthy opted not to seek reelection. Former Democratic U.S. Senator, former Vice President and 1968 presidential nominee Hubert Humphrey defeated Republican U.S. Representative Clark MacGregor.

zh.t: 1970年明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党联邦参议员尤金·麦卡锡没有竞选连任。民主党候选人休伯特·汉弗莱曾任联邦参议员、副总统，也是1968年总统选举的民主党候选人；他击败共和党联邦众议员克拉克·麦格雷戈，当选参议员。

en.s: The 1970 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 3, 1970, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general Francis B. Burch defeated Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Maryland Senate Thomas M. Anderson Jr.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行马里兰州总检察长选举。民主党候选人、现任总检察长弗朗西斯·B·伯奇击败共和党候选人、现任马里兰州参议员托马斯·M·安德森二世。

en.s: The 1970 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 3, 1970, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller Louis L. Goldstein defeated Republican nominee Harold Cross.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行马里兰州审计长选举。民主党候选人、现任审计长路易斯·L·戈德斯坦击败共和党候选人哈罗德·克罗斯。

en.s: The 1970 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970. Republican William Milliken won the election, defeating Democratic nominee Sander Levin.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行密歇根州州长选举。共和党候选人威廉·米利肯击败民主党候选人桑德·莱文，当选州长。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate special election in Alaska
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate special election in Alaska was held on November 3, 1970, to fill a seat in the United States Senate following the December 1968 death of Democrat Bob Bartlett, who had been Alaska's senior Senator since statehood in 1959. Republican Ted Stevens was appointed to the seat temporarily on December 24, 1968, to serve until the election could be held.

zh.t: 1970年阿拉斯加州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行阿拉斯加州联邦参议员特别选举，以填补民主党参议员鲍勃·巴特利特于1968年12月去世后留下的席位空缺。巴特利特自1959年阿拉斯加建州以来一直是该州资历较深的联邦参议员。1968年12月24日，共和党人特德·史蒂文斯获任命临时接任，直到举行选举。

en.s: The 1970 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970. Democratic nominee John J. Gilligan defeated Republican nominee Roger Cloud with 54.19% of the vote.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行俄亥俄州州长选举。民主党候选人约翰·J·吉利根以54.19%的得票率击败共和党候选人罗杰·克劳德。

en.s: The 1970 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat David Hall narrowly defeated Republican incumbent Dewey F. Bartlett, a result that was not clear for 21 days as a ballot recount was conducted. American Party candidate Reuel Little, who had helped form the party to back the 1968 presidential campaign of George Wallace, received over 24 thousand votes, dwarfing the difference between Hall and Bartlett.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行俄克拉何马州州长选举。民主党候选人大卫·霍尔险胜共和党籍现任州长杜威·F·巴特利特。由于重新计票，结果过了21天才确定。美国党候选人鲁埃尔·利特尔曾帮助成立该党，以支持乔治·华莱士参加1968年总统选举；他获得了超过2.4万张选票，远多于霍尔和巴特利特之间的票数差距。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Michigan took place on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Philip Hart was re-elected to a third term in office over former First Lady of Michigan Lenore Romney.

zh.t: 1970年密歇根州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行密歇根州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党联邦参议员菲利普·哈特击败密歇根州前第一夫人莱诺尔·罗姆尼，成功连任第三个任期。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Mississippi was held on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator John C. Stennis won re-election to his fifth term, easily defeating independent candidate William Richard Thompson. This race would be one of only two races where Stennis would face a general election challenger; as in his other races he had no general election opposition.

zh.t: 1970年密西西比州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行密西西比州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党联邦参议员约翰·C·斯坦尼斯轻松击败独立候选人威廉·理查德·汤普森，成功连任第五个任期。这是斯坦尼斯仅有的两次面对大选对手之一；他其他竞选中均没有大选对手。

en.s: The 1970 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970, and featured businessman James Exon, a Democrat, defeating incumbent Republican governor Norbert Tiemann.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州州长选举。民主党商人詹姆斯·埃克森击败共和党籍现任州长诺伯特·蒂曼。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate special election in Illinois
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate special election in Illinois was held on November 3, 1970, to fill the remainder of the term of Republican Everett Dirksen, who had died in office. Republican Ralph Tyler Smith had been appointed to fill the seat after Dirksen's death, and he lost the special election to Democrat Adlai Stevenson III.

zh.t: 1970年伊利诺伊州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行伊利诺伊州联邦参议员特别选举，以填补共和党参议员埃弗里特·德克森去世后留下的剩余任期。德克森去世后，共和党人拉尔夫·泰勒·史密斯获任命接任，但他在特别选举中败给民主党人阿德莱·史蒂文森三世。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Arizona took place on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Paul Fannin decided to run for reelection to a second term, running unopposed in the Republican primary. Fannin defeated Democratic nominee Sam Grossman in the general election. This was the last time until 1994 that Republicans won Arizona's Class 1 Senate Seat.

zh.t: 1970年亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行亚利桑那州联邦参议员选举。现任共和党联邦参议员保罗·范宁决定竞选连任第二个任期，并在共和党初选中没有对手。范宁在大选中击败民主党候选人萨姆·格罗斯曼。共和党直到1994年才再次赢得亚利桑那州第一类联邦参议员席位。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Nebraska took place on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Republican Senator Roman Hruska ran for re-election and was challenged by former Governor Frank B. Morrison, the Democratic nominee, in a rematch of the 1958 race. Despite a Democratic victory in the gubernatorial election, Morrison was unable to defeat Hruska, who was re-elected to his final term in the Senate with 52% of the vote.

zh.t: 1970年内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州联邦参议员选举。现任共和党参议员罗曼·赫鲁斯卡竞选连任，民主党候选人、前州长弗兰克·B·莫里森向他发起挑战。这是两人继1958年后再次对决。尽管民主党赢得州长选举，莫里森仍未能击败赫鲁斯卡；赫鲁斯卡以52%的得票率成功连任参议院最后一个任期。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in Maine
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Maine was held on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democrat Edmund Muskie defeated Republican nominee Neil S. Bishop with 61.74% of the vote. It's believed Muskie's coattails helped Democratic Governor Kenneth Curtis narrowly win reelection in the concurrent gubernatorial election. Bishop had crossed party lines to support Muskie's first run for high office, becoming a prominent Republican endorser when Muskie ran for Governor of Maine in 1954.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行缅因州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党参议员埃德蒙·马斯基以61.74%的得票率击败共和党候选人尼尔·S·毕晓普。有人认为，马斯基的带动效应帮助民主党籍州长肯尼思·柯蒂斯在同期州长选举中险胜、成功连任。毕晓普曾在1954年马斯基首次竞选重要公职时跨党派支持他；当时马斯基竞选缅因州州长，毕晓普因此成为一位重要的共和党支持者。

en.s: The 1970 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Republican Robert D. Ray narrowly defeated Democratic nominee Robert D. Fulton with 50.98% of the vote.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行艾奥瓦州州长选举。现任共和党州长罗伯特·D·雷以50.98%的得票率险胜民主党候选人罗伯特·D·富尔顿。

en.s: The 1970 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970. Primary elections were held on June 2, 1970. Incumbent Republican Governor Frank Farrar was defeated by Democratic nominee Richard F. Kneip who won 54.85% of the vote. This is the last time that an incumbent governor of South Dakota lost re-election.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行南达科他州州长选举，初选于同年6月2日举行。民主党候选人理查德·F·克奈普以54.85%的得票率击败现任共和党州长弗兰克·法勒。这是南达科他州最后一次由现任州长在连任竞选中落败。

en.s: The 1970 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970, to elect the next governor of Tennessee. Incumbent Democratic governor Buford Ellington was term-limited and was prohibited by the Constitution of Tennessee from seeking another term. Republican nominee Winfield Dunn, defeated Democratic opponent John Jay Hooker with 52.0% of the vote. Winfield Dunn became the first Republican to win a Tennessee gubernatorial election in fifty years, marking a significant political shift in the state.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行田纳西州州长选举，选出下一任州长。现任民主党州长布福德·埃灵顿因任期限制，按照田纳西州宪法不能再竞选一届。共和党候选人温菲尔德·邓恩以52.0%的得票率击败民主党候选人约翰·杰伊·胡克。邓恩是50年来首位赢得田纳西州州长选举的共和党人，标志着该州政治格局发生重大变化。

en.t: 1970 United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska, 1970 was an election for Nebraska's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 3, 1970.

zh.t: 1970年内布拉斯加州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州联邦众议院选举，作为当年联邦众议院大选的一部分，以选出内布拉斯加州的联邦众议员。

en.s: The 1970 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Republican Governor Walter R. Peterson Jr. defeated Democratic nominee Roger J. Crowley with 45.99% of the vote.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。现任共和党州长沃尔特·R·彼得森二世以45.99%的得票率击败民主党候选人罗杰·J·克劳利。

en.t: 1970 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: The 1970 United States Virgin Islands general election in large part took place on November 3, 1970, to elect public officials in the United States Virgin Islands, with a run-off for the gubernatorial race taking place on November 17, 1970. Candidates for United States Virgin Islands's at-large congressional district and the legislature did not have their political affiliations listed on election returns.

zh.s: 1970年美属维尔京群岛大选的大部分选举于11月3日举行，以选出美属维尔京群岛的公职人员；州长选举决选于11月17日举行。选举结果中没有列出美属维尔京群岛单一国会选区和立法机构候选人的党派。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Missouri took place on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Stuart Symington was re-elected to a fourth term in office over Republican John Danforth (who would eventually succeed the retiring Symington in 1976).

zh.t: 1970年密苏里州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行密苏里州联邦参议院选举。在任民主党参议员斯图尔特·赛明顿击败共和党人约翰·丹福斯，连任第四届。1976年赛明顿退休后，丹福斯接替了他的席位。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Maryland took place on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Joseph Tydings ran for re-election to a second term, but was narrowly defeated by Republican U.S. Representative J. Glenn Beall Jr. Tydings had defeated Beall's father, Senator James Glenn Beall six years earlier. Tydings's own adoptive father Millard had served as senator as well as Beall Sr., making this a rare dynastic election between the sons of former senators.

zh.t: 1970年马里兰州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行马里兰州联邦参议院选举。在任民主党参议员约瑟夫·泰丁斯竞选连任第二届，但以微弱差距败给共和党联邦众议员小J·格伦·比尔。6年前，泰丁斯曾击败比尔的父亲、参议员詹姆斯·格伦·比尔。泰丁斯的养父米勒德也曾任参议员，因此这是一场少见的前参议员之子之间的选举。

en.s: The 1970 Alabama Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 3, 1970, to elect 35 representatives to serve four-year terms in the Alabama Senate. Every single seat was won by a white male Democrat. In the previous general election, one Republican, Leland Childs, was elected, but had unsuccessfully sought re-election as a Democrat. The Democratic primaries were held on May 5 with runoffs on June 2, which candidates had until February 28 to qualify for.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行阿拉巴马州参议院选举，选出35名任期四年的州参议员。所有席位均由白人男性民主党人赢得。上届大选中，共和党人利兰·柴尔兹当选，但这次以民主党人身份竞选连任失败。民主党初选于5月5日举行，决选于6月2日举行；候选人须在2月28日前登记参选。

en.s: The 1970 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1970, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Due to term limits, incumbent Republican David Cargo was ineligible to seek a third term as governor. This election was the first in which the governor was elected for a four-year term. Prior to this, the governor was elected to a two-year term, renewable once.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行新墨西哥州州长选举。在任共和党州长戴维·卡戈受任期限制，不能竞选第三届。这是新墨西哥州首次选举四年任期的州长；此前州长任期为两年，且只能连任一次。

en.s: The 1970 California Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1970. Democratic nominee Jerry Brown narrowly defeated Republican nominee James L. Flournoy with 50.41% of the vote.

zh.t: 1970年加利福尼亚州州务卿选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行加利福尼亚州州务卿选举。民主党提名人杰里·布朗以50.41%的得票率险胜共和党提名人詹姆斯·L·弗洛诺伊。

en.t: 1970 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware
en.s: The 1970 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware took place on November 3, 1970. Incumbent representative William Roth decided to run in the concurrent US Senate election instead of running for re-election to a third term. Republican candidate, Pete du Pont won the open seat against Democrat John Daniello by a 9 point margin.

zh.t: 1970年特拉华州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行特拉华州联邦众议院选举。在任议员威廉·罗斯决定参加同期举行的联邦参议院选举，没有竞选第三届。共和党候选人皮特·杜邦击败民主党人约翰·达尼埃洛，以9个百分点的优势赢得空缺席位。

en.s: The 1970 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Republican John Arthur Love defeated Democratic nominee Mark Anthony Hogan with 52.46% of the vote. This would be the last time until 1998 that Colorado elected a Republican as Governor and also the last time Denver County, Boulder County, and San Miguel County voted for the Republican candidate.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行科罗拉多州州长选举。在任共和党州长约翰·亚瑟·洛夫以52.46%的得票率击败民主党提名人马克·安东尼·霍根。这是科罗拉多州直到1998年最后一次选出共和党州长，也是丹佛县、博尔德县和圣米格尔县最后一次支持共和党候选人。

en.s: The 1970 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democrat Marvin Mandel defeated Republican nominee Charles Stanley Blair with 65.73% of the vote. This election was the first of eight consecutive Democratic gubernatorial victories in Maryland, a streak not broken until the election of Republican Bob Ehrlich in 2002.

zh.s: 1970年马里兰州州长选举于1970年11月3日举行。民主党籍现任州长马文·曼德尔以65.73%的选票击败共和党候选人查尔斯·斯坦利·布莱尔。这是马里兰州连续8次由民主党人当选州长的首次，这一纪录直到2002年共和党人鲍勃·埃利希当选才被打破。

en.t: 1970 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico
en.s: The 1970 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday November 3, 1970 to elect the state's two representatives to serve in the United States House of Representatives. Republicans retained the 1st District while Democrats flipped the 2nd District. This made the state's delegation evenly split.

zh.t: 1970年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1970年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举于1970年11月3日（星期二）举行，选出该州两名联邦众议员。共和党保住第1选区，民主党赢下第2选区，因此该州代表团两党席位各占一半。

en.s: The 1970 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 3, 1970, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee Rolland Hatfield defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Jon Wefald and Communist nominee Betty M. Smith.

zh.s: 1970年明尼苏达州审计长选举于1970年11月3日举行，选出该州审计长。共和党候选人罗兰·哈特菲尔德击败民主党—农民—劳工党候选人乔恩·韦法尔德和共产党候选人贝蒂·M·史密斯。

en.s: The 1970 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Republican governor Stanley Hathaway ran for re-election to a second term. He faced Democratic nominee John J. Rooney, a state representative and the former chairman of the Wyoming Democratic Party. Despite Democratic senator Gale W. McGee's strong performance in the U.S. Senate race, Hathaway's popularity proved an insurmountable obstacle for Rooney to overcome, and the Governor won a second term in a landslide.

zh.s: 1970年怀俄明州州长选举于1970年11月3日举行。共和党籍现任州长斯坦利·哈撒韦竞选连任第二个任期，对手是州众议员、怀俄明州民主党前主席、民主党候选人约翰·J·鲁尼。尽管民主党籍联邦参议员盖尔·W·麦吉在联邦参议院选举中表现强劲，哈撒韦仍凭借高支持度以明显优势再次当选。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democrat William Proxmire was easily re-elected to a third full term in office over Republican John E. Erickson, taking more than 70% of the vote, and defeating Erickson by more than 42 percentage points.

zh.t: 1970年威斯康星州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1970年威斯康星州联邦参议院选举于1970年11月3日举行。民主党籍现任联邦参议员威廉·普罗克斯迈尔轻松连任第三个完整任期，击败共和党候选人约翰·E·埃里克森，获得超过70%的选票，领先对手逾42个百分点。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in California was held on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Republican Senator George Murphy lost re-election to a second term to Democratic Congressman John V. Tunney. After this election the Democrats ended up with both of the state's Senate seats, the first since 1860.

zh.t: 1970年加利福尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1970年加利福尼亚州联邦参议院选举于1970年11月3日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员乔治·墨菲未能连任，民主党籍联邦众议员约翰·V·坦尼当选。此次选举后，民主党首次自1860年以来同时占据该州两个联邦参议院席位。

en.s: The 1970 California Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1970. Republican nominee Evelle J. Younger defeated Democratic nominee Charles A. O'Brien with 49.28% of the vote.

zh.t: 1970年加利福尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1970年加利福尼亚州总检察长选举于11月3日举行。共和党提名人埃维尔·J·扬格以49.28%的得票率击败民主党提名人查尔斯·A·奥布莱恩。

en.s: The 1970 Florida Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1970. Robert Shevin would be elected winning 61.43% of the vote and defeated Thom Rumberger.

zh.t: 1970年佛罗里达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1970年佛罗里达州总检察长选举于11月3日举行。罗伯特·谢文当选，得票率为61.43%，击败了汤姆·伦伯格。

en.s: The 1970 Connecticut Attorney General election took place on November 3, 1970, to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Robert K. Killian was appointed to the office by Governor John N. Dempsey in 1967 to fill the vacancy left by Harold M. Mulvey, who resigned a year into his term to accept an appointment to the Connecticut Superior Court.

zh.t: 1970年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1970年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于1970年11月3日举行，选出该州总检察长。民主党籍现任总检察长罗伯特·K·基利安于1967年获州长约翰·N·邓普西任命，填补哈罗德·M·马尔维辞职后的空缺。马尔维在任职一年后辞职，转任康涅狄格州高等法院法官。

en.s: The 1970 Arizona Senate election was held on November 3, 1970. Voters elected all 30 members of the Arizona Senate to serve two-year terms. The 1970 election ushered in the restructuring of the Arizona Legislature to its current format. There are 30 electoral districts across the state, each district electing a single state senator and two state representatives. Primary elections were held on September 8, 1970.

zh.s: 1970年亚利桑那州参议院选举于11月3日举行。选民选出亚利桑那州参议院全部30名议员，任期两年。这次选举推动亚利桑那州议会改为现行架构。全州划分为30个选区，每个选区选出一名州参议员和两名州众议员。初选于1970年9月8日举行。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in Utah
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Utah was held on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democratic Senator Frank Moss was re-elected to a third term in office, defeating Republican U.S. Representative Laurence J. Burton. As of the 2024 Senate election, this is the last time a Democrat won a U.S. Senate election in Utah.

zh.t: 1970年美国联邦参议院犹他州选举
zh.s: 1970年犹他州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任参议员弗兰克·莫斯击败共和党籍联邦众议员劳伦斯·J·伯顿，成功连任第三个任期。截至2024年参议院选举，这是民主党人最后一次赢得犹他州联邦参议员选举。

en.s: The 1970 Massachusetts general election was held on November 3, 1970, throughout Massachusetts. Democratic and Republican candidates were selected in party primaries held September 15, 1970. At the federal level, Ted Kennedy was re-elected to the United States Senate and ten of the commonwealth's twelve incumbents were re-elected to the United States House of Representatives. One retired and one lost re-nomination. No seats switched parties.

zh.s: 1970年马萨诸塞州大选于11月3日在全州举行。民主党和共和党候选人通过9月15日举行的党内初选产生。在联邦层面，特德·肯尼迪连任联邦参议员，联邦众议院的12名现任议员中有10人连任；一人退休，一人未能获得本党提名。两党在各席位上的分布没有变化。

en.s: The 1970 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Republican Edwin Reinecke defeated Democratic nominee Al Alquist with 54.79% of the vote.

zh.t: 1970年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1970年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任副州长埃德温·赖内克击败民主党提名人阿尔·阿尔奎斯特，得票率为54.79%。

en.s: The 1970 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1970. State Senator Rudy Perpich of the Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party defeated Duluth Mayor Ben Boo of the Republican Party of Minnesota. The 1970 lieutenant gubernatorial election was the final lieutenant gubernatorial election held before the Minnesota Constitution was amended to provide for elections of the Governor and Lieutenant Governor on a joint ticket.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行明尼苏达州副州长选举。明尼苏达州民主农民劳工党州参议员鲁迪·佩皮奇击败共和党候选人、德卢斯市长本·布。根据修订后的明尼苏达州宪法，之后州长和副州长将通过联合竞选名单一起选举；这是此前最后一次单独选举副州长。

en.s: The 1970 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 3, 1970, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Republican nominee Kit Bond defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor Haskell Holman.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行密苏里州州审计长选举。共和党候选人基特·邦德击败民主党候选人、现任州审计长哈斯克尔·霍尔曼。

en.s: The 1970 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 3, 1970. Voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate. The 1970 election ushered in the restructuring of the Arizona Legislature to its current format.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行亚利桑那州众议院选举，选出州众议院全部60名议员，组成任期两年的州议会。议员由多席选区选出。选举与州长、联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州参议员等其他职位选举同期举行。1970年选举后，亚利桑那州议会进行了重组，形成如今的格局。

en.s: The 1970 Alabama Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1970, to elect the Secretary of State of Alabama to a four-year term.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行阿拉巴马州州务卿选举，选出任期四年的州务卿。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in West Virginia was held on November 3, 1970. Incumbent senator Robert Byrd won re-election by the biggest margin at that point in his career.

zh.t: 1970年西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行西弗吉尼亚州联邦参议员选举。现任参议员罗伯特·伯德成功连任，胜选差距创下他当时个人竞选纪录。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democratic Senator Gale W. McGee ran for re-election to his third term. In a rematch of the 1964 election, he once again faced Republican John S. Wold, who at this time represented Wyoming in the U.S.

zh.t: 1970年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1970年美国怀俄明州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任参议员盖尔·W·麦吉竞选第三个任期，再次面对共和党候选人约翰·S·沃尔德。

en.s: The 1970 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Republican Governor Winthrop Rockefeller ran for a third term but was defeated by Democratic nominee Dale Bumpers who won 61.66% of the vote. As of 2022, this was the last time Lee County voted for the Republican candidate.

zh.s: 1970年阿肯色州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任州长温思罗普·洛克菲勒竞选第三个任期，但败给民主党候选人戴尔·邦普斯；邦普斯获得61.66%的选票。截至2022年，这也是李县最后一次支持共和党候选人。

en.s: The 1970 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1970, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Warren Spannaus defeated Republican nominee Robert A. Forsythe.

zh.t: 1970年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行明尼苏达州总检察长选举。民主农民劳工党候选人沃伦·斯潘纳斯击败共和党候选人罗伯特·A·福赛思。

en.t: 1970 United States House of Representatives election in Nevada
en.s: The 1970 United States House of Representatives election in Nevada was held on Tuesday November 3, 1970, to elect the state's at-large representative. Primary elections were held on September 1, 1970. Incumbent Democrat Walter S. Baring Jr. who had represented the district consecutively since 1956 won re-election to an 8th consecutive term and 10th term non-consecutively.

zh.t: 1970年内华达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日星期二举行内华达州联邦众议院选举，选出该州的单一国会选区代表。初选于同年9月1日举行。民主党籍现任众议员沃尔特·S·巴林二世自1956年以来一直连续代表该选区，他成功连任第8个连续任期，也是非连续计算的第10个任期。

en.s: The 1970 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Governor Jack Williams ran for reelection to a third term as governor. United States Ambassador to Bolivia Raúl Héctor Castro won the Democratic nomination, and narrowly lost the general election to Williams by 1.78%. Williams was sworn into his third and final term as Governor on January 5, 1971.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行亚利桑那州州长选举。现任州长杰克·威廉姆斯竞选第三个任期。美国驻玻利维亚大使劳尔·埃克托·卡斯特罗赢得民主党提名，但在大选中以1.78个百分点之差败给威廉姆斯。威廉姆斯于1971年1月5日宣誓就职，开始第三个、也是最后一个州长任期。

en.t: 1970 United States House of Representatives election in Alaska
en.s: The Alaska congressional election of 1970 was held on Tuesday, November 3, 1970. The term of the state's sole Representative to the United States House of Representatives expired on January 3, 1971. Incumbent Howard Wallace Pollock retired to run for Governor of Alaska. The winning candidate would serve a two-year term from January 3, 1971, to January 3, 1973.

zh.t: 1970年阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日星期二举行阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举。该州唯一联邦众议员的任期于1971年1月3日届满。现任众议员霍华德·华莱士·波洛克退出竞选，转而竞选阿拉斯加州州长。当选者将于1971年1月3日至1973年1月3日担任两年任期。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democratic Senator Stephen M. Young did not run for re-election to a third term in office. U.S. Representative Robert Taft Jr. won the open seat over Democrat Howard Metzenbaum. Primary elections were held on May 5, the day after four students were killed during the Kent State shootings.

zh.t: 1970年俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行俄亥俄州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党参议员斯蒂芬·M·杨没有竞选第三个任期。共和党联邦众议员小罗伯特·塔夫脱击败民主党候选人霍华德·梅岑鲍姆，赢得空缺席位。初选于5月5日举行，也就是肯特州立大学枪击事件造成4名学生死亡的第二天。

en.s: The 1970 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970. Incumbent Democrat Robert Docking defeated Republican nominee Kent Frizzell with 54.3% of the vote.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行堪萨斯州州长选举。现任民主党州长罗伯特·多金以54.3%的得票率击败共和党候选人肯特·弗里泽尔。

en.s: The 1970 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1970, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota House of Representatives Arlen Erdahl defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Daniel D. Donovan.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行明尼苏达州州务卿选举。共和党候选人、明尼苏达州众议员阿伦·埃达尔击败民主农民劳工党候选人丹尼尔·D·多诺万。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 3, 1970. Primaries were held on March 17, 1970. Additionally, on December 15, 1970, a special election was held in which Illinois voters voted in support of adopting a new proposed state constitution.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日星期二，伊利诺伊州举行选举。初选于同年3月17日举行。12月15日还举行了一次特别选举，伊利诺伊州选民投票支持通过一部新的州宪法。

en.s: The 1970 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970 to elect the governor and lieutenant governor of New York. Incumbent Republican Governor Nelson Rockefeller defeated the Democratic nominee, former UN Ambassador and U.S. Supreme Court Justice Arthur Goldberg, by more than ten percentage points. On January 1, 1971, Rockefeller was sworn in for his fourth term as governor.

zh.s: 1970年纽约州州长选举于1970年11月3日举行，选出州长和副州长。共和党籍现任州长纳尔逊·洛克菲勒以超过10个百分点的优势击败民主党候选人、前联合国大使兼美国最高法院大法官亚瑟·戈德堡。1971年1月1日，洛克菲勒宣誓就任第四个任期。

en.s: The 1970 Georgia gubernatorial election was held in the U.S. state on November 3, 1970. It was marked by the election as Governor of Georgia of the relatively little-known former state senator Jimmy Carter after a hard battle in the Democratic primary. This election is famous because Carter, who was often regarded as one of the New South Governors, later ran for president in 1976 on his gubernatorial record and won.

zh.s: 1970年美国佐治亚州州长选举于11月3日举行。前州参议员吉米·卡特在民主党初选中历经激烈竞争后，当选州长。这场选举广为人知，因为常被视为“新南方州长”之一的卡特，后来凭借州长任内的政绩竞选总统，并于1976年获胜。

en.t: 1970 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1970 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 3, 1970. The Democratic incumbent Henry M. Jackson won a fourth term in office with a landslide victory over Republican state senator Charles Elicker.

zh.t: 1970年华盛顿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日举行华盛顿州联邦参议院选举。在任民主党参议员亨利·M·杰克逊以压倒性优势击败共和党州参议员查尔斯·埃利克，连任第四届。

en.s: The 1970 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1970, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee and incumbent governor of Georgia Lester Maddox defeated Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Georgia State Senate Frank G. Miller.

zh.t: 1970年美国佐治亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1970年美国佐治亚州副州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党候选人、佐治亚州时任州长莱斯特·马多克斯击败共和党候选人、时任州参议员弗兰克·G·米勒。

en.s: The 1970 Alabama gubernatorial election was marked by a competitive Democratic primary battle between incumbent moderate Governor Albert Brewer and segregationist former governor and 1968 independent presidential candidate George Wallace. The Alabama Constitution was amended in 1968, allowing a governor to serve two consecutive terms.

zh.t: 1970年美国阿拉巴马州州长选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日，阿拉巴马州举行州长选举。选前的民主党初选竞争激烈，主要对手是现任州长阿尔伯特·布鲁尔和前州长乔治·华莱士。1968年的州宪法修正案允许州长连任，使布鲁尔得以再次参选。

en.s: The 1970 Idaho gubernatorial election took place on November 3 to elect the governor of Idaho, concurrently with other scheduled governor races, as well as Idaho's two congress members in the House of Representatives and a number of statewide offices. Incumbent Republican governor Don Samuelson sought re-election to a second consecutive term as governor.

zh.s: 1970年11月3日，爱达荷州举行州长选举，与联邦众议员及其他州级职位的选举同日进行。共和党现任州长唐·萨缪尔森寻求第二个连续任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1970 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1970 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 27 of the state senate's 50 districts. Due to redistricting following the amending of the Iowa Constitution in 1968 mandating single-member districts, the Iowa Senate downsized from 61 to 50 members following the 1970 election. State senators typically serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate.

zh.s: 1970年爱荷华州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。爱荷华州选民在州参议院50个选区中的27个选区选出议员。1968年修订州宪法，要求改用单议席选区；因此，1970年选举后，州参议院席位从61个减至50个。州参议员通常任期四年。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1970 Pennsylvania gubernatorial election was held on November 3. Democrat Milton Shapp challenged incumbent Republican Lieutenant Governor Ray Broderick.

zh.t: 1970年美国宾夕法尼亚州州长选举
zh.s: 1970年11月3日，宾夕法尼亚州举行州长选举。民主党候选人米尔顿·沙普与共和党候选人、现任副州长雷·布罗德里克角逐州长职位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1970 United States Senate elections was an election for the United States Senate. It took place on November 3, with the 33 seats of Class 1 contested in regular elections. Special elections were also held to fill vacancies. These races occurred in the middle of Richard Nixon's first term as president.

zh.s: 1970年美国联邦参议院选举于11月3日举行，第1组33个席位通过常规选举改选，另举行特别选举填补空缺。这些选举在理查德·尼克松总统第一个任期中段举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Dhalai was fought between India and Pakistan before the formal start 1971 India-Pakistan War for the liberation of Bangladesh. The battle started after an attack by Indian Army on Pakistani border outpost (BOP) in East Pakistan on 28 October and lasted until 3 November 1971.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 达莱战役是印度和巴基斯坦之间的一场战斗，发生在孟加拉国解放战争及1971年印巴战争正式爆发前。印度军队于10月28日袭击东巴基斯坦的一处巴基斯坦边防哨所后，战斗随即爆发，并持续至1971年11月3日。

en.t: Mariner program: NASA launches the Mariner 10 toward Mercury. On March 29, 1974, it becomes the first space probe to reach that planet
en.s: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA; ) is an independent agency of the U.S. federal government responsible for the United States' civil space program, as well as research in aeronautics and space. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., NASA operates ten field centers across the US and is organized into three mission directorates: Human Spaceflight, Research and Technology, and Science.

zh.t: 水手计划：美国国家航空航天局发射水手10号探测器前往水星；它于1974年3月29日成为首个抵达水星的太空探测器
zh.s: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）是美国联邦政府的独立机构，负责美国民用航天计划以及航空学和太空领域的研究。NASA总部设在华盛顿特区，在美国设有十个中心，并分为三个任务部门：载人航天、研究与技术、科学。

en.t: United States Senate election in Oklahoma, 1974
en.s: The 1974 United States Senate election in Oklahoma was held November 3, 1974. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Henry Bellmon narrowly won re-election to a second term, beating Representative Ed Edmondson (D-OK) by nearly 4,000 votes.

zh.t: 1974年俄克拉何马州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1974年11月3日举行俄克拉何马州联邦参议院选举。在任共和党参议员亨利·贝尔蒙以微弱优势连任第二届，以近4,000票之差击败民主党联邦众议员埃德·埃德蒙森。

en.s: The 3 November 1975 Bangladeshi coup d'état was organised by Brig. Khaled Mosharraf against President Khondaker Mostaq Ahmad to remove him from the presidency and the assassins of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman from power: Capt. Abdul Majed, Maj. Syed Faruque Rahman, Maj. Khandaker Abdur Rashid, and Maj. Shariful Haque Dalim. The coup resulted in a return of Mujibist forces in Bangladeshi politics for a short time.

zh.s: 1975年11月3日，哈立德·穆沙拉夫准将发动政变，目标是让总统孔达克尔·莫斯塔克·艾哈迈德下台，并推翻杀害谢赫·穆吉布·拉赫曼的人员。参与暗杀的人员包括阿卜杜勒·马吉德上尉、赛义德·法鲁克·拉赫曼少校、坎达克尔·阿卜杜尔·拉希德少校和沙里富尔·哈克·达利姆少校。这场政变使支持穆吉布的势力短暂重返孟加拉国政坛。

en.s: Dominica officially the Commonwealth of Dominica, is an island country in the Caribbean. It is part of the Windward Islands chain in the Lesser Antilles archipelago in the Caribbean Sea. The capital, Roseau, is located on the western side of the island. Dominica's closest neighbours are two constituent territories of the European Union, both overseas departments of France: Guadeloupe to the northwest and Martinique to the south-southeast.

zh.s: 多米尼克正式名称为多米尼克国，是加勒比海的岛国，位于小安的列斯群岛的向风群岛链上。首都罗索位于岛屿西侧。多米尼克最近的邻国是两个欧盟组成领土，均为法国海外省：西北方的瓜德罗普和东南偏南的马提尼克。

en.s: The Greensboro massacre is the term for an event which took place on November 3, 1979, when members of the Communist Workers' Party and others demonstrating against the Ku Klux Klan in Greensboro, North Carolina, United States engaged in confrontation with members of the Ku Klux Klan and the American Nazi Party. Four members of the Communist Workers' Party, and one other individual were killed and ten other demonstrators were wounded. The CWP had supported workers' rights activism among mostly black textile industrial workers in the area.

zh.s: “格林斯伯勒大屠杀”指1979年11月3日发生的一起事件。当时，共产主义工人党成员及其他人士在美国北卡罗来纳州格林斯伯勒举行示威，抗议三K党，随后与三K党和美国纳粹党成员发生冲突。四名共产主义工人党成员和另一人死亡，另有十名示威者受伤。共产主义工人党曾支持当地以黑人纺织业工人为主的劳工权利运动。

en.t: United States Senate election in Oklahoma, 1980
en.s: The 1980 United States Senate election in Oklahoma was held November 3, 1980. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Henry Bellmon decided to retire, instead of seeking a third term. Republican nominee Don Nickles won the open seat.

zh.t: 1980年俄克拉何马州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1980年11月3日举行俄克拉何马州联邦参议院选举。在任共和党参议员亨利·贝尔蒙决定退休，不再竞选第三届。共和党提名人唐·尼克尔斯赢得这个空缺席位。

en.s: On 3 November 1980, a Latin Carga Convair 880 crashed in Caracas, Venezuela. The aircraft involved was a Convair CV-880F, (registered as YV-145C, with serial number 22-00-64) built in 1962. Four crew members took off from Simón Bolivar International Airport on November 3, 1980, on a training flight to Panama. Soon after take-off, the plane plummeted and crashed at the end of the runway, bursting into flames and causing the deaths of all 4 occupants.

zh.s: 1980年11月3日，一架Latin Carga康维尔CV-880客机在委内瑞拉加拉加斯坠毁。涉事飞机是1962年制造的康维尔CV-880F，注册号YV-145C，序列号22-00-64。四名机组人员于1980年11月3日从西蒙·玻利瓦尔国际机场起飞，执行飞往巴拿马的训练飞行。起飞后不久，飞机急速下坠，在跑道尽头坠毁并起火，机上4人全部遇难。

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1981 occurred on Tuesday, November 3, 1981, with Democratic incumbent Mayor Ed Koch being re-elected to a second term by a landslide margin. Koch, a Democrat, also received the endorsement of and ran on the Republican Party ballot line. Koch received an overwhelming 74.64% of the vote citywide. Koch also swept all five boroughs by landslide margins, breaking 60% of the vote in Manhattan and breaking 70% of the vote in Brooklyn, the Bronx, Queens and Staten Island. Koch's closest competitor was the short-lived New York Unity Party nominee Frank J.

zh.s: 1981年纽约市市长选举于11月3日（星期二）举行，民主党籍现任市长埃德·科赫以压倒性优势连任第二个任期。科赫还获得共和党背书，并以共和党候选人身份参选。他在全市获得74.64%的选票，并以巨大优势赢下五个行政区；在曼哈顿得票率超过60%，在布鲁克林、布朗克斯、皇后区和史泰登岛均超过70%。

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1981 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 3, 1981. The incumbent mayor, Richard Caliguiri of the Democratic Party chose to run for his second full term. Caliguiri won by a particularly large margin, eclipsing 80% of the vote, a figure that even surpasses the city's heavily Democratic voter registration advantage. This is in part due to the particularly polarizing nature of Republican candidate Fred Goehringer, a KDKA broadcaster. Goehringer was a Barry Goldwater admirer but campaigned against Caligiuri's Renaissance III corporate benefits, alienating some GOP power brokers. A total of 83,683 votes were cast.

zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡市长选举于1981年11月3日星期二举行。民主党籍时任市长理查德·卡利吉里决定竞选第二个完整任期。他以超过80%的得票率大幅胜出，领先幅度甚至超过了匹兹堡作为民主党选民占绝大多数城市的优势。这部分是因为共和党候选人、KDKA电台播音员弗雷德·戈林格引发了强烈争议。戈林格仰慕巴里·戈德华特，但竞选时反对卡利吉里的“复兴计划III”企业福利政策，因此疏远了一些共和党重要人物。共有83,683票投出。

en.s: The United States gubernatorial elections of 1981 were held on November 3, 1981 in two states, New Jersey and Virginia. Both seats were open due to term limits and both also switched parties resulting in zero net change for both parties.

zh.s: 1981年11月3日，新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举。两个州的职位都因任期限制而空缺，选举结果也都导致政党更替，因此两党席位总数没有变化。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1981 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 3, 1981. Republican Thomas Kean narrowly defeated Democrat James Florio with 49.46% of the vote following a recount of the ballots.

zh.s: 1981年11月3日举行新泽西州州长选举。共和党人托马斯·基恩在重新计票后以49.46%的得票率险胜民主党人詹姆斯·弗洛里奥。

en.s: The 1981 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1981. Democratic nominee Dick Davis defeated Republican nominee Nathan H. Miller with 55.44% of the vote.

zh.s: 1981年11月3日举行弗吉尼亚州副州长选举。民主党候选人迪克·戴维斯以55.44%的得票率击败共和党候选人内森·H·米勒。

en.t: 1981 New York City Council presidential election
en.s: An election was held on November 3, 1981 to elect the President of the New York City Council. Democratic incumbent Carol Bellamy was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican Assemblyman Guy J. Velella.

zh.s: 1981年11月3日举行纽约市议会主席选举。民主党籍现任主席卡罗尔·贝拉米击败共和党州众议员盖伊·J·维莱拉，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: An election for Brooklyn District Attorney was held on November 3, 1981. Elizabeth Holtzman, a former member of the United States House of Representatives, defeated Norman Rosen, the executive assistant to the sitting district attorney, in both the Democratic primary and general election. Eugene Gold, who was first elected as district attorney in 1968, declined to seek reelection and endorsed Rosen.

zh.t: 1981年布鲁克林地区检察官选举
zh.s: 1981年11月3日举行布鲁克林地区检察官选举。曾任联邦众议员的伊丽莎白·霍尔茨曼在民主党初选和大选中都击败了现任地区检察官的行政助理诺曼·罗森。尤金·戈尔于1968年首次当选地区检察官，这次没有竞选连任，并为罗森背书。

en.s: The 1981 Cleveland mayoral election took place on November 3, 1981, to elect the Mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the September 29 primary advancing to the general election. This was the first Cleveland mayoral election to a four-year term.

zh.s: 1981年11月3日举行俄亥俄州克利夫兰市长选举。选举正式设为无党派选举，9月29日初选中得票最高的两名候选人进入大选。这是克利夫兰首次举行四年任期市长选举。

en.s: The 1981 Durham mayoral election was held on November 3, 1981, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the election of Charles Markham, who unseated incumbent mayor Harry E. Rodenhizer Jr.

zh.s: 1981年11月3日举行北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市长选举。查尔斯·马克姆当选，击败在任市长小哈里·E·罗登海泽。

en.s: In the 1981 Virginia gubernatorial election, Republican incumbent Governor John N. Dalton was unable to seek re-election due to term limits. Chuck Robb, the Lieutenant Governor of Virginia, was nominated by the Democratic Party to run against the Republican nominee, state Attorney General J. Marshall Coleman. Robb's victory ended 12 consecutive years of Republican control of the Governor's Mansion.

zh.s: 共和党籍时任州长约翰·N·道尔顿受任期限制，不能参加1981年弗吉尼亚州州长选举。弗吉尼亚州副州长查克·罗布获得民主党提名，对阵共和党提名人、州总检察长J·马歇尔·科尔曼。罗布获胜，结束了共和党连续12年执掌州长职位的局面。

en.s: The 1981 New Jersey Senate elections were held on November 3. The New Jersey legislature reapportioned its state legislative districts in advance of the 1981 election. The new districts resulted in many senators running for re-election in newly re-numbered districts. The election coincided with a tightly contested gubernatorial election between Thomas Kean and James Florio. Republicans gained five seats, narrowing the Democratic majority to 22–18.

zh.s: 1981年新泽西州参议院选举于11月3日举行。新泽西州议会在选举前重新划分了州议会选区，因此许多州参议员在重新编号后的选区竞选连任。选举与托马斯·基恩和詹姆斯·弗洛里奥之间竞争激烈的州长选举同时举行。共和党增加5席，将民主党的多数席位缩小至22比18。

en.s: The Virginia House of Delegates election of 1981 was held on Tuesday, November 3. Primary elections were held on September 8, 1981. The districts were established by the Assembly Act of August 11, 1981 (Acts of Assembly, 1981 Special Session, Chapter 5). They were challenged in Federal District Court, which found the map unconstitutional in Cosner v. Dalton.

zh.s: 1981年弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于11月3日星期二举行。初选于1981年9月8日举行。选区由弗吉尼亚州议会1981年特别会议第5号法案划定。有人向联邦地区法院提出质疑，法院在“科斯纳诉道尔顿案”中裁定该选区地图违宪。

en.s: The 1982 Salang Tunnel fire occurred on 3 November 1982 in Afghanistan's Salang Tunnel during the Soviet–Afghan War. Details are uncertain and officially the number of casualties was recorded as between 168–176 Soviet and Afghan soldiers and civilians. Despite this, contemporary Western media said the incident may have been the deadliest known road accident, and one of the deadliest fires of modern times, with the death toll estimated at 2,700 people, including 700 Soviet soldiers.

zh.s: 1982年11月3日，苏阿战争期间，阿富汗萨朗隧道发生火灾。详情尚不确定；官方记录的伤亡人数为168至176人，包括苏联和阿富汗士兵及平民。尽管如此，当时的西方媒体称，这可能是已知最严重的道路事故之一，也是现代最严重的火灾之一；估计死亡人数达2,700人，其中包括700名苏联士兵。

en.t: United States Senate election in Wisconsin, 1986
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 3, 1986. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Bob Kasten won re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 1986年11月3日举行威斯康星州联邦参议院选举。在任共和党参议员鲍勃·卡斯滕成功连任第二届。

en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Oklahoma was held November 3, 1986. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Don Nickles won re-election to his second term.

zh.t: 1986年俄克拉何马州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1986年11月3日举行俄克拉何马州联邦参议院选举。在任共和党参议员唐·尼克尔斯成功连任第二届。

en.t: 1986 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1986 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 3, 1986. Incumbent Republican Senator Slade Gorton lost re-election to former Transportation Secretary Brock Adams. Gorton later won Washington's other Senate seat in 1988 and 1994 before losing re-election again in 2000. To date, this remains the last time anyone other than Patty Murray won this senate seat.

zh.t: 1986年华盛顿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1986年11月3日举行华盛顿州联邦参议院选举。在任共和党参议员斯莱德·戈顿败给前交通部长布罗克·亚当斯。戈顿后来于1988年和1994年赢得该州另一个联邦参议院席位，2000年又在该席位竞选连任时落败。截至目前，除帕蒂·默里外，还没有其他人赢得该席位。

en.s: The Houston Mayoral Election of 1987 took place on November 3, 1987. Incumbent Mayor Kathy Whitmire was re-elected to a fourth term.

zh.s: 1987年11月3日举行休斯敦市长选举。在任市长凯西·惠特迈尔连任第四届。

en.s: The United States gubernatorial elections of 1987 were held on November 3, 1987 in three states: Kentucky, Louisiana, and Mississippi. Democrats retained all three seats up for election although three new people were elected governor.

zh.s: 1987年11月3日，肯塔基州、路易斯安那州和密西西比州举行州长选举。民主党保住了全部三个待选席位，但新当选的州长共有三人。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1987 occurred on Tuesday, November 3, 1987 between Mayor Raymond Flynn and City Council member Joseph M. Tierney. Flynn was re-elected to his second term. The nonpartisan municipal preliminary election was held on September 22, 1987.

zh.s: 1987年11月3日，波士顿市长雷蒙德·弗林与市议员约瑟夫·M·蒂尔尼角逐市长职位，弗林成功连任第二届。无党派市政初选于1987年9月22日举行。

en.s: All 40 seats in the Senate of Virginia were up for election on November 3, 1987, alongside the Virginia House of Delegates election.

zh.s: 1987年11月3日，弗吉尼亚州参议院全部40个席位都进行选举，同时举行弗吉尼亚州众议院选举。

en.s: The 1987 Kentucky Attorney General election took place on November 3, 1987, to elect the Attorney General of Kentucky. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General David L. Armstrong, who was ineligible for reelection, ran for Lieutenant Governor. Democratic State Representative Fred Cowan beat Republican nominee and former Estill County attorney Christopher S. Combs, 70% to 30%.

zh.s: 1987年肯塔基州总检察长选举于11月3日举行，选出该州总检察长。民主党籍时任总检察长戴维·L·阿姆斯特朗因不符合连任资格，转而竞选副州长。民主党籍州众议员弗雷德·考恩以70%比30%击败共和党提名人、前埃斯蒂尔县检察官克里斯托弗·S·库姆斯。

en.s: The 1987 Kentucky lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1987, to elect the lieutenant governor of Kentucky. Incumbent Democratic lieutenant governor Steve Beshear chose not to seek re-election to a second term, instead choosing to run for governor. Woodford County millionaire horse breeder and farmer Brereton C. Jones managed to easily beat Republican nominee and Pikeville attorney Lawrence R. "Larry" Webster, 73% to 26%.

zh.s: 1987年肯塔基州副州长选举于11月3日举行，选出该州副州长。民主党籍时任副州长史蒂夫·贝希尔没有竞选连任第二个任期，而是转而竞选州长。伍德福德县的百万富翁、赛马养殖者兼农民布雷雷顿·C·琼斯以明显优势击败共和党提名人、派克维尔律师劳伦斯·R·“拉里”·韦伯斯特，得票率为73%比26%。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 1987 took place on November 3, 1987, and saw the reelection of Republican William H. Hudnut III to a fourth term. Hundut defeated Democratic nominee J. Bradford Senden, a self-employed political consultant.

zh.t: 1987年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 1987年印第安纳波利斯市长选举于11月3日举行。共和党人威廉·H·哈德纳特三世连任，开始第四个任期。他击败了民主党提名人J·布拉德福德·森登，后者是一名独立执业的政治顾问。

en.s: The 1987 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1987. Democratic nominee Wallace Wilkinson defeated Republican nominee John Harper with 64.50% of the vote.

zh.s: 1987年11月3日举行肯塔基州州长选举。民主党提名人华莱士·威尔金森以64.50%的得票率击败共和党提名人约翰·哈珀。

en.s: The 1987 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1987 to elect the governor of Mississippi. This is the most recent Mississippi gubernatorial election in which the Democratic candidate received a majority of votes. In January 2000, Ronnie Musgrove was elected by the Mississippi House of Representatives after neither he nor Republican Mike Parker received a majority in the 1999 general election.

zh.s: 1987年11月3日举行密西西比州州长选举。这是该州最近一次民主党候选人获得过半数选票的州长选举。1999年大选中，民主党人罗尼·马斯格罗夫和共和党人迈克·帕克都没有获得过半数选票，州众议院于2000年1月选出马斯格罗夫担任州长。

en.s: The 1987 Toledo mayoral election took place on November 3, 1987. Incumbent Mayor Donna Owens ran for re-election to a second term, and was challenged by City Councilman Carty Finkbeiner. In the primary election, owing to an aggressive get-out-the-vote campaign, Finkbeiner placed first by a wide margin, winning 63 percent of the vote to Owens's 37 percent.

zh.t: 1987年俄亥俄州托莱多市长选举
zh.s: 1987年托莱多市长选举于11月3日举行。时任市长唐娜·欧文斯竞选连任第二个任期，市议员卡蒂·芬克拜纳向她发起挑战。在初选中，芬克拜纳积极动员选民，以较大优势排名第一，获得63%的选票；欧文斯获得37%。

en.s: The 1987 Anchorage mayoral election was held on October 12 and November 3, 1987, to elect the mayor of Anchorage, Alaska. It saw election of Tom Fink. Incumbent mayor Tony Knowles was term-limited. Since at no candidate received 40% of the vote in the first round (which at least one candidate was required to obtain to avoid a runoff), a runoff was held between the top-two finishers of the first round.

zh.s: 1987年10月12日和11月3日，阿拉斯加州安克雷奇举行市长选举。汤姆·芬克当选。在任市长托尼·诺尔斯受任期限制，不能竞选连任。首轮投票中没有候选人获得避免决选所需的40%选票，因此得票最高的两名候选人进入决选。

en.s: The 1987 Snohomish County Executive election took place on November 3, 1987, to elect the county executive of Snohomish County, Washington. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Willis Tucker ran for re-election to a third term. He was challenged by Republican Michael Glanz, an architect who filed on the final day of candidate qualifying. In the primary election, Tucker placed first by a wide margin, winning 57 percent of the vote to Glanz's 43 percent.

zh.t: 1987年斯诺霍米什县行政长官选举
zh.s: 斯诺霍米什县于1987年11月3日举行县行政长官选举。时任民主党行政长官威利斯·塔克竞选第三个任期。共和党候选人迈克尔·格兰茨向他发起挑战；格兰茨是一名建筑师，在候选人资格登记的最后一天才提交申请。初选中，塔克以57%对43%的得票率大幅领先格兰茨，排名第一。

en.s: The Virginia House of Delegates election of 1987 was held on Tuesday, November 3. Primary elections were held on June 9, 1987.

zh.s: 1987年弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于11月3日星期二举行。初选于1987年6月9日举行。

en.s: The 1987 Philadelphia mayoral election saw the reelection of Wilson Goode over former mayor Frank Rizzo, who had switched to the Republican Party.

zh.s: 威尔逊·古德在1987年费城市长选举中连任，击败了转投共和党的前市长弗兰克·里佐。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1987 Baltimore mayoral election saw the election of Kurt Schmoke. Incumbent mayor Clarence Burns was defeated in the Democratic primary.

zh.s: 库尔特·施莫克在1987年巴尔的摩市长选举中当选。民主党初选中，时任市长克拉伦斯·伯恩斯败选。

en.t: Mayoral elections in Fort Wayne, Indiana
en.s: Elections are held in Fort Wayne, Indiana to elect the city's mayor. Currently, such elections are regularly scheduled to be held every four years, in the year immediately preceding that of United States presidential elections.

zh.t: 印第安纳州韦恩堡市长选举
zh.s: 印第安纳州韦恩堡举行市长选举，选出该市市长。目前，市长选举通常每四年举行一次，安排在美国总统选举年的前一年。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Elections are held every two years to elect the mayor of Worcester, Massachusetts. Worcester held its first direct election for mayor in 1987. The city has a council–manager government in which the mayor's role is to chair both the Worcester City Council and the city's school committee.

zh.t: 马萨诸塞州伍斯特市市长选举
zh.s: 马萨诸塞州伍斯特每两年举行一次市长选举。该市于1987年首次通过直接选举产生市长。伍斯特实行市议会—经理制，市长负责主持伍斯特市议会和市教育委员会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1987 New Jersey Senate election was held on November 3. The election took place mid-way through the second term of Governor Thomas Kean. The elections were marked by extreme stability; only one seat, that of Peter P. Garibaldi in the 18th district, did not return its incumbent Senator. Multiple Senators were re-elected unopposed.

zh.s: 1987年新泽西州参议院选举于11月3日举行，时间在州长托马斯·基恩第二个任期中段。这次选举结果十分稳定：只有第18选区的参议员彼得·P·加里巴尔迪未能连任。多名参议员在没有对手的情况下当选连任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: An election was held on November 3 and December 8, 1987, to elect the 39th mayor of San Francisco. Dianne Feinstein, then the incumbent, had served as mayor since the 1978 assassination of mayor George Moscone and supervisor Harvey Milk and had been elected to full terms in 1979 and 1983, and was thus term-limited.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 旧金山市长选举于1987年11月3日和12月8日举行，选出第39任市长。时任市长黛安·范斯坦自1978年乔治·莫斯科尼市长和哈维·米尔克市政委员遭暗杀后一直担任市长，并在1979年和1983年两次当选完整任期，因此受任期限制，不能再参选。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的首轮日期。

en.s: The 1988 Maldives coup d'état attempt was an attempt by a group of Sri Lankans and Maldivians led by businessman Abdullah Luthufee and assisted by armed mercenaries of a Tamil secessionist organization from Sri Lanka, the People's Liberation Organization of Tamil Eelam (PLOTE), to overthrow the government of the Republic of Maldives. The attempt was thwarted with Indian assistance in Operation Cactus.

zh.s: 1988年，一群由商人阿卜杜拉·卢图菲领导的斯里兰卡人和马尔代夫人企图推翻马尔代夫共和国政府，并得到斯里兰卡泰米尔分离主义组织泰米尔伊拉姆人民解放组织（PLOTE）的武装雇佣兵协助。印度发起“仙人掌行动”并提供援助，挫败了这次政变企图。

en.t: 1990 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: The 1990 House elections in Georgia occurred on November 3, 1990 to elect the members of the State of Georgia's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Georgia had ten seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1980 United States census. These elections were held concurrently with the United States Senate elections of 1990 (including one election in Georgia), the United States House elections in other states, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1990年美国佐治亚州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1990年美国佐治亚州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，改选佐治亚州在联邦众议院的全部议席。该州在众议院有10个席位，按1980年美国人口普查结果分配。选举与1990年联邦参议员选举（包括佐治亚州的一席）、其他州的联邦众议员选举以及各级州和地方选举同期举行。

en.s: The 1990 San Jose mayoral election was held to elect the mayor of San Jose, California. It saw an initial election held on June 5, 1990, followed by a runoff election on November 3, 1990, after no candidate managed to obtain a majority in the initial election. The runoff was won by Susan Hammer. Incumbent mayor Tom McEnery was term limited.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1990年圣何塞市长选举用于选出该市市长。首轮选举于1990年6月5日举行，由于无人获得过半选票，11月3日举行了决选，苏珊·哈默获胜。受任期限制，时任市长汤姆·麦克埃纳里没有参选。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的决选日期。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose thirty-three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New York was won by Governor Bill Clinton (D-Arkansas) with 49.73% of the popular vote over incumbent President George H.W. Bush (R-Texas) with 33.88%. Businessman Ross Perot (I-Texas) finished in third with 15.75% of the popular vote. Clinton ultimately won the national vote, defeating incumbent President Bush.

zh.s: 1992年纽约州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出33名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。阿肯色州州长比尔·克林顿（民主党）以49.73%的普选票赢得纽约州，领先时任总统乔治·H·W·布什（得克萨斯州共和党）33.88%的得票率。商人罗斯·佩罗（得克萨斯州独立候选人）以15.75%的得票率排名第三。克林顿最终赢得全国选举，击败时任总统布什。

en.t: United States presidential election in Arkansas, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Arkansas was won by the state's Governor Bill Clinton (D) with 53.21% of the popular vote over incumbent President George H.W. Bush (R-Texas) with 35.48%. Businessman Ross Perot (I-Texas) finished in third with 10.43% of the popular vote. Clinton ultimately won the national vote, defeating incumbent President Bush.

zh.s: 1992年阿肯色州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。阿肯色州州长比尔·克林顿（民主党）以53.21%的普选票赢得该州，领先时任总统乔治·H·W·布什（得克萨斯州共和党）的35.48%。商人罗斯·佩罗（得克萨斯州独立候选人）以10.43%的得票率排名第三。克林顿最终赢得全国选举，击败时任总统布什。

en.t: United States presidential election in Hawaii, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Hawaii took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Hawaii was won by Governor Bill Clinton (D-Arkansas) with 48.09% of the popular vote over incumbent President George H.W. Bush (R-Texas) with 36.70%. Businessman Ross Perot (I-Texas) finished in third with 14.22% of the popular vote. Clinton ultimately won the national vote, defeating incumbent President Bush. Clinton comfortably won Hawaii by a margin of 11.39%.

zh.s: 1992年夏威夷州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。阿肯色州州长比尔·克林顿（民主党）以48.09%的普选票赢得夏威夷州，领先时任总统乔治·H·W·布什（得克萨斯州共和党）的36.70%。商人罗斯·佩罗（得克萨斯州独立候选人）以14.22%的得票率排名第三。克林顿最终赢得全国选举，击败时任总统布什。他在夏威夷州的领先幅度为11.39%，胜选较为轻松。

en.s: The 1992 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1992. Incumbent Governor of Montana Stan Stephens, who was first elected in 1988, declined to seek re-election. Marc Racicot, the Attorney General of Montana, won the Republican primary and advanced to the general election, where he faced State Representative Dorothy Bradley, who had emerged from a crowded Democratic primary as the nominee of her party. A close election ensued, but in the end, Racicot ended up defeating Bradley to win his first of two terms as governor.

zh.s: 1992年蒙大拿州州长选举于11月3日举行。时任州长斯坦·斯蒂芬斯于1988年首次当选，他决定不再竞选连任。蒙大拿州总检察长马克·拉西科特赢得共和党初选，进入大选后对阵州众议员、多名候选人竞争后赢得民主党提名的多萝西·布拉德利。选举竞争激烈，但最终拉西科特击败布拉德利，赢得两个州长任期中的第一个任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Illinois, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose twenty-two representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Illinois was won by Governor Bill Clinton (D-Arkansas) with 48.58% of the popular vote over incumbent President George H.W. Bush (R-Texas) with 34.34%. Businessman Ross Perot (I-Texas) finished in third with 16.64% of the popular vote. Clinton ultimately won the national vote, defeating incumbent President Bush.

zh.s: 1992年伊利诺伊州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出22名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。阿肯色州州长比尔·克林顿（民主党）以48.58%的普选票赢得伊利诺伊州，领先时任总统乔治·H·W·布什（得克萨斯州共和党）的34.34%。商人罗斯·佩罗（得克萨斯州独立候选人）以16.64%的得票率排名第三。克林顿最终赢得全国选举，击败时任总统布什。

en.t: United States presidential election in Michigan, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose eighteen representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Michigan was won by Governor Bill Clinton (D-Arkansas) with 43.77% of the popular vote over incumbent President George H.W. Bush (R-Texas) with 36.38%. Businessman Ross Perot (I-Texas) finished in third with 19.30% of the popular vote. Clinton ultimately won the national vote, defeating incumbent President Bush. This was the first time that a Democratic presidential candidate carried Michigan since 1968.

zh.s: 1992年密歇根州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出18名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。阿肯色州州长比尔·克林顿（民主党）以43.77%的普选票赢得密歇根州，领先时任总统乔治·H·W·布什（得克萨斯州共和党）的36.38%。商人罗斯·佩罗（得克萨斯州独立候选人）以19.30%的得票率排名第三。克林顿最终赢得全国选举，击败时任总统布什。这是民主党总统候选人自1968年以来首次赢得密歇根州。

en.t: United States presidential election in West Virginia, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. West Virginia was won by Governor Bill Clinton (D-Arkansas) with 48.41% of the popular vote over incumbent President George H.W. Bush (R-Texas) with 35.39%. Businessman Ross Perot (I-Texas) finished in third with 15.92% of the popular vote. Clinton ultimately won the national vote, defeating incumbent President Bush.

zh.s: 1992年西弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。阿肯色州州长比尔·克林顿（民主党）以48.41%的普选票赢得西弗吉尼亚州，领先时任总统乔治·H·W·布什（得克萨斯州共和党）的35.39%。商人罗斯·佩罗（得克萨斯州独立候选人）以15.92%的得票率排名第三。克林顿最终赢得全国选举，击败时任总统布什。

en.t: United States Senate special election in California, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States Senate special election in California took place on November 3, 1992, at the same time as the regular election to the United States Senate in California. Both of California's present Senators were elected for the first time. This is not a unique occurrence; it would happen again in Tennessee in 1994 and Kansas in 1996. In the 1990 gubernatorial election, Republican Senator Pete Wilson had beaten Democrat Dianne Feinstein for governor. He appointed John F. Seymour to the Senate to replace himself. In this special election held simultaneously with the regular Senate election, Feinstein defeated Seymour to serve the remaining 2 years of the term.

zh.t: 1992年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1992年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员特别选举于11月3日举行，与该州常规联邦参议员选举同时进行。加利福尼亚州当时的两名联邦参议员都是首次当选；类似情况并非只此一次，1994年田纳西州和1996年堪萨斯州也出现过。在1990年州长选举中，共和党参议员皮特·威尔逊击败民主党人黛安·范斯坦，当选州长。威尔逊随后任命约翰·F·西摩接替自己担任参议员。在这场与常规参议员选举同时举行的特别选举中，范斯坦击败西摩，完成剩余两年的任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Nebraska, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Nebraska was won by incumbent President George H.W. Bush (R-Texas) with 46.58% of the popular vote over Governor Bill Clinton (D-Arkansas) with 29.40%. Businessman Ross Perot (I-Texas) finished in third with 23.63% of the popular vote. Clinton ultimately won the national vote, defeating both incumbent President Bush and Perot.

zh.s: 1992年内布拉斯加州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。时任总统乔治·H·W·布什（得克萨斯州共和党）以46.58%的普选票赢得内布拉斯加州，领先阿肯色州州长比尔·克林顿（民主党）的29.40%。商人罗斯·佩罗（得克萨斯州独立候选人）以23.63%的得票率排名第三。克林顿最终赢得全国选举，击败布什和佩罗。

en.t: United States presidential election in Montana, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Montana took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Montana had two seats in the House of Representatives in 1988, it lost one seat in 1992. Therefore, there was only one seat in 1992, and the seat hasn't returned since (it might return in 2024 according to the very high population for its number of seats). This was also the only time since 1964 when Montana voted Democratic.

zh.s: 1992年蒙大拿州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。蒙大拿州在1988年有两个联邦众议院席位，1992年失去一个席位，因此该州当年只有一个席位，此后也一直只有一个；根据其人口与席位数的比例，该州可能会在2024年恢复第二个席位。这也是蒙大拿州自1964年以来唯一一次支持民主党总统候选人。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose fifteen representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New Jersey was won by Governor Bill Clinton (D-Arkansas) with 42.95% of the popular vote over incumbent President George H.W. Bush (R-Texas) with 40.58%, a 2.37% margin of victory. Businessman Ross Perot (I-Texas) finished in third with 15.61% of the popular vote. Clinton ultimately won the national vote, defeating incumbent President Bush.

zh.s: 1992年新泽西州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出15名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。阿肯色州州长比尔·克林顿（民主党）以42.95%的普选票赢得新泽西州，领先时任总统乔治·H·W·布什（得克萨斯州共和党）的40.58%，胜出幅度为2.37个百分点。商人罗斯·佩罗（得克萨斯州独立候选人）以15.61%的得票率排名第三。克林顿最终赢得全国选举，击败时任总统布什。

en.t: United States presidential election in Alaska, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Alaska took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Alaska was won by incumbent President George H.W. Bush (R-Texas) with 39.4% of the popular vote over Governor Bill Clinton (D-Arkansas) with 30.2%. Bush won Alaska by a margin of 9.2%. Businessman Ross Perot (I-Texas) finished in third with 28.4% of the popular vote. Clinton ultimately won the national vote, defeating incumbent President Bush.

en.t: United States presidential election in Delaware, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Delaware was won by Governor Bill Clinton (D-Arkansas) with 43.52%% of the popular vote over incumbent President George H.W. Bush (R-Texas) with 35.33%. Businessman Ross Perot (I-Texas) finished in third with 20.45% of the popular vote. Clinton ultimately won the national vote, defeating incumbent President Bush. Clinton comfortably won Delaware by a margin of 8.19%, and that confirmed the state's status as reliably Democratic, and it has voted Democratic in every election since.

en.t: United States Senate election in Alaska, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States Senate election in Alaska was held on November 3, 1992. Incumbent Republican United States Senator Frank Murkowski sought re-election to a third term in the United States Senate. Tony Smith, the Democratic nominee and a former Commissioner of Economic Development, won his party's nomination in a crowded primary and faced off against Murkowski in the general election. Though Murkowski was held to a lower vote percentage than he received six years prior, he was ultimately re-elected.

en.t: United States presidential election in Arizona, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Arizona was won by incumbent President George H.W. Bush (R-Texas) with 38.47% of the popular vote over Governor Bill Clinton (D-Arkansas) with 36.52%. Businessman Ross Perot (I-Texas) finished in third with 23.79% of the popular vote. Clinton ultimately won the national vote, defeating incumbent President Bush. Bush very narrowly won in Arizona by a margin of 1.95%, and Clinton went on to win the state in the 1996 election narrowly over Bob Dole.

en.t: United States Senate election in North Dakota, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States Senate election in North Dakota was held on November 3, 1992 along other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent North Dakota Democratic NPL Party U.S. Senator Kent Conrad retired, having given a pledge that he would not run for re-election if the federal budget deficit was higher than when he was first elected; however when the other Senate seat became vacant, he ran in the special election. Dem-NPL U.S. Congressman Byron Dorgan won the open seat.

en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. en.t: United States presidential election in Alabama, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 3, 1992 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose 9 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Alabama was won by President George H.W. Bush (R-TX). The presidential contest in Alabama was not a surprise, with Bush winning 47.65% to 40.88% over Governor Bill Clinton (D), a margin of 7.77%. Despite the fact that Clinton was a Southern Democrat, Alabama remained a reliably Republican state.

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1992 was the 52nd quadrennial presidential election. It was held on Tuesday, November 3, 1992. There were three major candidates: Incumbent Republican President George H. W. Bush; Democratic Arkansas Governor Bill Clinton, and independent Texas businessman Ross Perot. Bush had alienated much of his conservative base by breaking his 1988 campaign pledge against raising taxes. The economy was in recession and Bush's perceived greatest strength, foreign policy, was regarded as much less important following the dissolution of the Soviet Union and the relatively peaceful climate in the Middle East after the defeat of Iraq in the Gulf War.

zh.s: 1992年美国总统选举是美国第52次每四年举行一次的总统选举，于11月3日星期二举行。主要候选人有：时任共和党总统乔治·H·W·布什、民主党候选人兼阿肯色州州长比尔·克林顿，以及来自得克萨斯州的独立候选人、商人罗斯·佩罗。布什在1988年竞选时承诺不提高税收，但后来违背承诺，疏远了许多保守派支持者。当时经济正处于衰退；苏联解体、伊拉克在海湾战争中战败后，中东局势相对平静，布什原本被认为最强的外交政策议题也不再那么受关注。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Hampshire, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. en.t: United States presidential election in Florida, 1992
en.s: Florida held an election for president of the United States on November 3, 1992. The race was extremely close -- so close in fact that some news networks mistakenly reported that Democratic challenger Bill Clinton had won in the state, although incumbent President George H. W. Bush was eventually declared the winner. Bush received 40.89% of the vote to Clinton's 39.00%. The final result in Florida reflected the reluctance of many Southern states to back Clinton, although Clinton was polling well in other parts of the country.

zh.s: 佛罗里达州于1992年11月3日举行总统选举。选情极为接近，一些新闻媒体甚至误报民主党挑战者比尔·克林顿赢得该州，但最终宣布获胜的是时任总统乔治·H·W·布什。布什获得40.89%的选票，克林顿获得39.00%。佛罗里达州的最终结果反映了许多南方州不愿支持克林顿，尽管克林顿在美国其他地区的民调表现不错。

en.t: United States presidential election in Connecticut, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Connecticut was won by Governor Bill Clinton (D-Arkansas) with 42.21% of the popular vote over incumbent President George H.W. Bush (R-Texas) with 35.78%. Businessman Ross Perot (I-Texas) finished in third with 21.58% of the popular vote. Clinton won Connecticut by a margin of 6.43%, ending the state's status as a swing state, as it has voted Democratic in every election since.

en.s: The North Carolina gubernatorial election of 1992 was held on November 3, 1992. Incumbent Governor James G. Martin was unable to run for a third consecutive term due to term limits, and his Lieutenant Governor, Jim Gardner, was chosen to replace him as the Republican nominee. Former Governor Jim Hunt decided to seek his third term as the Democratic nominee. The race became one of the nastiest and most talked about races in the country, with Hunt winning a third term easily over Gardner and Libertarian nominee Scott McLaughlin.

en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. en.s: The 1992 United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 3, 1992 in twelve United States states. Going into the elections, six of the seats were held by Democrats and six by Republicans. After the elections, eight seats were held by Democrats and four by Republicans. The elections coincided with the 1992 U.S. presidential election. This was the last year in which Rhode Island held a gubernatorial election on the same year as the presidential election. The length of gubernatorial terms for Rhode Island's governor would be extended from two-years to four years with elections taking place in Midterm election years.

en.t: United States Senate election in California, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States Senate election in California took place on November 3, 1992, at the same time as the special election to the United States Senate in California. Incumbent Democrat Alan Cranston decided to retire. Democrat Barbara Boxer won the open seat. Both of California's present Senators were elected for the first time. Fellow Democrat Dianne Feinstein, California's senior senator, won the special election and was inaugurated in November 1992.

en.t: United States presidential election in Indiana, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Indiana took place on November 3, 1992, throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Indiana was won by President George H.W. Bush (R-TX). The presidential contest in Indiana was not a surprise, with Bush winning 42.91% to 36.79% over Governor Bill Clinton (D). Still, the margin of victory was lesser than in earlier elections; Clinton won in every state bordering Indiana, and except for the Midwest Bush finished first in no state more northern than Indiana.

zh.s: 1992年印第安纳州总统选举于11月3日举行，是覆盖美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区的全国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名代表（选举人），由他们投票选出总统和副总统。乔治·H·W·布什（共和党，得克萨斯州）赢得印第安纳州。结果并不意外：布什获得42.91%的选票，阿肯色州州长比尔·克林顿（民主党）获得36.79%。不过，布什的领先幅度低于此前的选举；克林顿赢得了印第安纳州周边的每个州，而在中西部以外，布什没有赢得任何比印第安纳州更靠北的州。

en.t: United States presidential election in California, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in California took place on November 3, 1992 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose 54 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. This was the first time that California had voted for a Democratic presidential nominee since Lyndon B. Johnson in the 1964 election, and Clinton's win in this state changed its status from reliably Republican to decisively Democratic to the present, and the state maintains the largest number of electoral votes in the Electoral College.

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1992
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose ten representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Minnesota was won by Governor Bill Clinton (D-Arkansas) with 43.48% of the popular vote over incumbent President George H.W. Bush (R-Texas) who took 31.85%, a victory margin of 11.63%. Businessman Ross Perot (I-Texas) finished in third with 23.96% of the popular vote. Clinton ultimately won the national vote, defeating incumbent President Bush.
