zh.t: 1992年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行北卡罗来纳州副州长选举。民主党提名人丹尼斯·A·威克以53.50%的得票率击败共和党提名人阿特·波普。

en.s: The 1992 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 3, 1992. Voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve a two-year term. These were the first elections following the 1990 United States redistricting cycle. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行亚利桑那州众议院选举，选出全部60名州众议员，在多席位选区任职两年。这是1990年美国选区重划后的首次选举。选举还与联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州参议院等其他职位选举同时举行。

en.s: The 1992 Arizona Senate election was held on November 3, 1992. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 8, 1992. Prior to the elections, the Democrats held a majority of 17 seats over the Republicans' 13 seats.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行亚利桑那州参议院选举，选出该州全部30个立法选区的州参议员，任期两年。初选于1992年9月8日举行。选举前，民主党以17席对共和党的13席占多数。

en.s: The 1992 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1992, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Delaware Senate Ruth Ann Minner defeated Republican nominee and incumbent member of the New Castle County Council Philip D. Cloutier and Libertarian nominee Lawrence D. Sullivan. Thereby becoming the first woman to hold the office of lieutenant governor.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行特拉华州副州长选举。民主党提名人、在任州参议员露丝·安·米纳击败共和党提名人、纽卡斯尔县议会在任议员菲利普·D·克劳蒂尔和自由党提名人劳伦斯·D·沙利文。米纳成为首位担任该州副州长的女性。

en.t: 1992 United States House of Representatives elections in Tennessee
en.s: The 1992 congressional elections in Tennessee was held on November 3, 1992, to determine who will represent the state of Tennessee in the United States House of Representatives. Following the 1992 elections, no seats changed hands, leaving the Tennessee delegation at a 6-3 Democratic majority.

zh.t: 1992年田纳西州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行田纳西州联邦众议院选举，选出该州的联邦众议员。选举后没有席位易手，田纳西州代表团仍由民主党以6席对3席占多数。

en.s: The 1992 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1992, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri Senate Jay Nixon defeated Republican nominee and former member of the Missouri House of Representatives David Steelman and Libertarian nominee Mitchell J. Moore.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行密苏里州总检察长选举。民主党提名人、在任州参议员杰伊·尼克松击败共和党提名人、前州众议员戴维·斯蒂尔曼和自由党提名人米切尔·J·摩尔。

en.t: 1992 United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina
en.s: The 1992 United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina were held on November 3, 1992, to elect the six U.S. representatives from the state of South Carolina, one from each of the state's six congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 1992 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1992年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1992年11月3日，南卡罗来纳州举行联邦众议院选举，选出来自该州6个国会选区的6名联邦众议员。选举与1992年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 1992 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1992. Incumbent Democrat Bruce Sundlun defeated Republican nominee Elizabeth A. Leonard with 61.55% of the vote. A Democrat would not be elected Governor of Rhode Island again until Gina Raimondo did so in 2014.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行罗得岛州州长选举。在任民主党州长布鲁斯·桑德伦以61.55%的得票率击败共和党提名人伊丽莎白·A·伦纳德。直到2014年吉娜·雷蒙多当选之前，民主党人一直未能再次当选罗得岛州州长。

en.s: The 1992 Utah Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1992, in order to elect the Attorney General of Utah. Democratic nominee Jan Graham defeated Republican nominee Scott Burns and Libertarian nominee John M. Coombs.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行犹他州总检察长选举。民主党提名人简·格雷厄姆击败共和党提名人斯科特·伯恩斯和自由党提名人约翰·M·库姆斯。

en.s: The 1992 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 3, 1992, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee and former member of the Missouri House of Representatives Bob Holden defeated Republican nominee Gary Melton and Libertarian nominee Janet Lewis.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行密苏里州州财长选举。民主党提名人、密苏里州前众议员鲍勃·霍尔登击败共和党提名人加里·梅尔顿和自由党提名人珍妮特·刘易斯。

en.t: 1992 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Missouri was held on November 3, 1992, as part of the broader 1992 United States presidential election in all fifty states and the District of Columbia. Voters chose 11 electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice-president. From 1904 to 2004, Missouri voted for the eventual winner of every presidential election except 1956.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日，密苏里州举行美国总统选举，是覆盖全部50个州和哥伦比亚特区的全国大选的一部分。选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。1904年至2004年间，除1956年外，密苏里州在每次总统选举中都支持了最终胜选者。

en.s: An election was held on November 3, 1992, to elect the Attorney General of West Virginia. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Mario Palumbo chose not to seek re-election to a full term, instead choosing to run for governor. Democratic nominee Darrell McGraw beat Republican nominee and lawyer Robert Gould.

zh.t: 1992年西弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行西弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举。在任民主党总检察长马里奥·帕隆布没有竞选完整任期，转而竞选州长。民主党提名人达雷尔·麦格劳击败共和党提名人、律师罗伯特·古尔德。

en.t: 1992 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 3, 1992, and was part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Utah was won by President George H. W. Bush (R-TX) by a 16.0 percent margin of victory.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日，犹他州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选举总统和副总统。共和党候选人、来自得克萨斯州的乔治·H·W·布什总统以16个百分点的优势赢得犹他州。

en.s: The 1992 Jersey City special mayoral election was held on November 3, 1992. The election filled a vacancy created when mayor of Jersey City Gerald McCann was convicted on federal criminal charges. It was noted for the large number of competitive candidates and the low threshold for election. Bret Schundler won with less than 18 percent of the vote to become the first Republican mayor of Jersey City since 1917 and the first elected since 1905.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行泽西市市长特别选举，以填补市长杰拉尔德·麦肯因联邦刑事指控被定罪而留下的空缺。这次选举竞争者众多，当选所需得票门槛较低。布雷特·尚德勒以不到18%的得票率获胜，成为泽西市自1917年以来首位共和党籍市长，也是自1905年以来首位民选共和党籍市长。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 3, 1992. Primary elections were held on March 17.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日星期二，伊利诺伊州举行选举。初选于3月17日举行。

en.s: The 1992 Delaware gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1992. Incumbent Republican governor Mike Castle, barred by term limits from seeking another term as Governor of Delaware, instead sought election to the United States House of Representatives. Congressman and Democratic nominee Tom Carper defeated Republican nominee B. Gary Scott in a landslide, winning his first term in office and becoming Delaware's first Democratic governor since 1977.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行特拉华州州长选举。现任共和党州长迈克·卡斯尔因任期限制不能继续连任，转而竞选联邦众议员。民主党候选人、联邦众议员汤姆·卡珀以压倒性优势击败共和党候选人B·加里·斯科特，赢得首个州长任期，成为自1977年以来特拉华州首位民主党州长。

en.s: The 1992 North Dakota gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1992. Incumbent Democratic-NPL Governor George A. Sinner retired. Republican nominee Ed Schafer defeated Democratic State Attorney General Nicholas Spaeth in a landslide. This was the only gubernatorial seat which the Republicans gained during this election cycle.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行北达科他州州长选举。民主党无党派联盟籍现任州长乔治·A·辛纳退休。共和党候选人埃德·谢弗以压倒性优势击败民主党候选人、州总检察长尼古拉斯·斯帕思。这是本轮选举中共和党唯一赢得的州长职位。

en.t: 1992 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 3, 1992, the District of Columbia held a U.S. House of Representatives election for its shadow representative. Unlike its non-voting delegate, the shadow representative is only recognized by the district and is not officially sworn or seated. One-term incumbent and inaugural office-holder Charles Moreland ran for reelection and won.

zh.t: 1992年哥伦比亚特区影子联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1992年11月3日，哥伦比亚特区举行影子联邦众议员选举。影子众议员与没有投票权的代表不同，只由哥伦比亚特区承认，不会正式宣誓就职，也不会正式进入国会任职。首任、已任职一届的查尔斯·莫兰德竞选连任并成功当选。

en.s: The 1992 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1992, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee Judith Moriarty defeated Republican nominee John R. Hancock and Libertarian nominee Eric Harris. Thereby becoming the first woman to be elected secretary of state of Missouri.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行密苏里州州务卿选举。民主党候选人朱迪思·莫里亚蒂击败共和党候选人约翰·R·汉考克和自由党候选人埃里克·哈里斯，当选密苏里州首位女性州务卿。

en.s: The 1992 Vermont gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1992. After Republican Governor Richard Snelling died in office on August 13, 1991, Lieutenant Governor Howard Dean, a Democrat, took over for the remainder of his term. Dean ran successfully for election to a full term as Governor of Vermont, defeating Republican candidate John McClaughry. Dean's 74.7% of the vote is the best Democratic performance for governor in the history of the state.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行佛蒙特州州长选举。共和党州长理查德·斯内林于1991年8月13日在任内去世后，民主党籍副州长霍华德·迪恩接任州长，完成剩余任期。迪恩成功竞选连任，击败共和党候选人约翰·麦克劳克里，正式当选一个完整任期。他获得74.7%的选票，是该州历史上民主党候选人竞选州长的最佳表现。

en.s: The 1992 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1992. Democratic nominee Roger B. Wilson defeated Republican nominee Margaret B. Kelly with 49.50% of the vote.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行密苏里州副州长选举。民主党候选人罗杰·B·威尔逊以49.50%的得票率击败共和党候选人玛格丽特·B·凯利。

en.t: 1992 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 3, 1992, as part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Louisiana was won by Governor Bill Clinton, a major swing from the statewide results in 1988 when Republican nominee George H. W.

zh.t: 1992年美国路易斯安那州总统选举
zh.s: 1992年美国路易斯安那州总统选举于11月3日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名总统选举人，由选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。州长比尔·克林顿赢得路易斯安那州。

en.t: 1992 San Juan, Puerto Rico, mayoral election
en.s: San Juan, Puerto Rico, held an election for mayor on November 3, 1992. It was held as part of the 1992 Puerto Rican general election. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Héctor Luis Acevedo, a member of the Popular Democratic Party.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日，波多黎各圣胡安市举行市长选举，作为1992年波多黎各大选的一部分。人民民主党籍现任市长埃克托·路易斯·阿塞维多成功连任。

en.t: 1992 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas
en.s: The 1992 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas occurred on November 3, 1992, to elect the members of the state of Texas's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Texas had thirty seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States census. Intraparty conflict embroiled the Texas Democratic Party, who had gained complete control of Texas' government following Ann Richards' victory in the 1990 gubernatorial election.

zh.t: 1992年得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举，以选出得克萨斯州的联邦众议员。根据1990年美国人口普查的结果，得克萨斯州分得30个众议院席位。安·理查兹在1990年州长选举中获胜后，民主党完全控制了得克萨斯州政府，党内冲突也随之加剧。

en.s: The 1992 Utah gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1992. Republican nominee Michael Leavitt won the three-way election.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行犹他州州长选举。共和党候选人迈克尔·利维特赢得三方角逐。

en.s: The 1992 West Virginia State Auditor election took place on November 3, 1992, to elect the West Virginia State Auditor. Incumbent Democratic State Auditor Glen Gainer Jr. chose not to seek re-election to a fifth term. Gainer's son, Glen Gainer III won unopposed, as the Republicans did not field a candidate.

zh.t: 1992年西弗吉尼亚州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行西弗吉尼亚州州审计长选举。现任民主党州审计长格伦·盖纳二世没有竞选第五个任期。他的儿子格伦·盖纳三世在没有对手的情况下当选，因为共和党没有提名候选人。

en.s: The 1992 Wyoming Senate election was held on November 3, 1992, to elect members to the Wyoming Senate for its 52nd session as part of the 1992 United States elections. Partisan primaries were held on August 18. This was the first state senate election held after the state's county-based apportionment plan was struck down by the courts in Gorin v. Karpan in favor of a single-member district plan.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行怀俄明州参议院选举，选出第52届州参议院议员，作为当年美国选举的一部分。党内初选于8月18日举行。这是怀俄明州以县为基础的选区划分方案被法院在戈林诉卡潘案中推翻，改为单一选区方案后的首次州参议院选举。

en.t: 1992 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1992 United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 3, 1992, to elect U.S. Representatives to serve in the 103rd United States Congress. They coincided with the 1992 presidential election, in which Democrat Bill Clinton was elected president, defeating Republican incumbent President George H. W. Bush. Despite this, however, the Democrats lost a net of nine seats in the House to the Republicans, in part due to redistricting following the 1990 census.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行美国联邦众议院选举，选出第103届国会议员，与总统选举同期进行。民主党候选人比尔·克林顿在总统选举中击败共和党籍现任总统乔治·H·W·布什，当选总统。尽管如此，民主党在联邦众议院净失9席，席位转至共和党，部分原因是1990年人口普查后重新划分了选区。

en.t: 1992 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1992 United States Senate election in New York took place on November 3, 1992, alongside other elections to the United States Senate in other states, as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Senator Al D'Amato narrowly won re-election to a third term. As of 2026, this is the last time Republicans won a U.S.

zh.t: 1992年美国联邦参议员选举（纽约州）
zh.s: 纽约州于1992年11月3日举行联邦参议员选举，与其他州的参议员选举、联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。时任参议员阿尔·达马托险胜，连任第三届。截止2026年，这是共和党最后一次赢得美国……

en.s: The 1992 San Diego mayoral election was held on November 3, 1992, to elect the mayor for San Diego. Incumbent mayor Maureen O'Connor chose not to run for reelection. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though some candidates do receive funding and support from various political parties. The non-partisan primary was held June 2, 1992. Peter Navarro and Susan Golding received the most votes and advanced to the November general election.

zh.s: 1992年圣迭戈市长选举于1992年11月3日举行，选出该市市长。现任市长莫琳·奥康纳决定不竞选连任。加利福尼亚州的市政选举名义上不分党派，但一些候选人会获得政党的资助和支持。初选于1992年6月2日举行，彼得·纳瓦罗和苏珊·戈尔丁得票最高，进入11月的大选。

en.s: The 1992 United States Senate elections, held November 3, 1992, were elections for the United States Senate. The 34 seats of Class 3 were contested in regular elections, along with special elections to fill vacancies. They coincided with Bill Clinton's victory in the presidential election. This was the first time since 1956 that the balance of the Senate remained the same.

zh.s: 1992年美国联邦参议院选举于11月3日举行，改选第3组34个席位，另举行特别选举填补空缺。这些选举与比尔·克林顿赢得总统选举同时举行。自1956年以来，这是参议院席位分布首次没有变化。

en.s: The 1992 Washington Secretary of State election took place on November 3, 1992. Incumbent secretary of state Ralph Munro was re-elected.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行华盛顿州州务卿选举。在任州务卿拉尔夫·芒罗成功连任。

en.s: The 1992 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1992. Incumbent Democratic Governor Booth Gardner chose not to run for a third term. This resulted in an open race for Governor of Washington in which Democrat Mike Lowry narrowly defeated Republican Ken Eikenberry. This is the last time that a gubernatorial nominee and a lieutenant gubernatorial nominee of different political parties were elected governor and lieutenant governor of Washington.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行华盛顿州州长选举。在任民主党州长布斯·加德纳决定不竞选第三届，州长职位因此开放。民主党人迈克·洛瑞以微弱优势击败共和党人肯·艾肯伯里。这是最后一次由不同政党的州长和副州长候选人当选华盛顿州州长和副州长。

en.t: 1992 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1992 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 3, 1992. Incumbent Democratic Senator Brock Adams chose not to run for re-election to a second term after eight different women made allegations that he had engaged in various acts of sexual misconduct, including harassment and rape. Adams denied the allegations, but his popularity statewide was weakened considerably by them, and he chose to retire rather than risk costing the party his seat.

zh.t: 1992年华盛顿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行华盛顿州联邦参议院选举。在任民主党参议员布罗克·亚当斯在8名女性指控他有骚扰和强奸等性行为不端后，决定不竞选连任第二届。亚当斯否认这些指控，但其全州支持率明显下滑；他选择退休，以免自己的丑闻导致该党失去席位。

en.t: 1992 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: The 1992 House elections in Georgia occurred on November 3, 1992 to elect the members of the State of Georgia's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Georgia had eleven seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States census. These elections were held concurrently with the United States Senate elections of 1992 (including one election in Georgia), the United States House elections in other states, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1992年美国佐治亚州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1992年美国佐治亚州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，改选佐治亚州在联邦众议院的全部议席。该州在众议院有11个席位，按1990年美国人口普查结果分配。选举与1992年联邦参议员选举（包括佐治亚州的一席）、其他州的联邦众议员选举以及各级州和地方选举同期举行。

en.t: 1992 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 1992 United States Senate election in Georgia was held on November 3, 1992. In the general election, which occurred simultaneously with the presidential election, incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Wyche Fowler received more votes, but did not achieve a simple majority. Under Georgia law, this demanded a runoff. Paul Coverdell, the former Director of the Peace Corps, edged out Fowler in the November 24 runoff by a narrow margin, flipping the seat to the Republicans.

zh.t: 1992年美国佐治亚州参议员选举
zh.s: 1992年11月3日，美国佐治亚州举行联邦参议员选举。民主党现任议员怀奇·福勒得票领先，但未过半数，因此需要举行第二轮投票。11月24日，保罗·科弗德尔在决选中以微弱优势胜出，共和党夺得这一席位。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 3, 1992. Primaries were held March 17, 1992. Elections were held for Clerk of the Circuit Court, Recorder of Deeds, State's Attorney, three seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 1992年11月3日举行伊利诺伊州库克县大选，初选于1992年3月17日举行。选举职位包括巡回法院书记官、契据登记官、州检察官、水务管理区董事会3个席位，以及库克县巡回法院法官职位。

en.t: 1992 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1992 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 3, 1992, and was part of the 1992 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Georgia was won by Governor Bill Clinton (D-AR). The presidential contest in Georgia was the closest of any state that year, with Clinton winning 43.47% to 42.88% over Incumbent President George H.

zh.t: 1992年美国总统选举：佐治亚州投票
zh.s: 1992年11月3日，美国佐治亚州在全国总统选举中投票，选出13名总统选举人。民主党候选人比尔·克林顿赢得该州。这是当年各州中最接近的一场总统选举，克林顿得票率为43.47%，现任总统老布什为42.88%。

en.s: The 1992 Texas Senate elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state senators in all 31 State Senate districts due to redistricting. Originally, half of the seats were elected for two-year terms and the other half were elected for four-year terms, but subsequent redistricting forced all Senators to run for re-election again in 1994.

zh.s: 1992年得克萨斯州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。由于重新划分选区，得克萨斯州选民在州参议院全部31个选区选出议员。原定一半席位的当选者任期两年，另一半任期四年；但此后再次划分选区，迫使所有参议员在1994年重新竞选。

en.s: The 1992 Texas House of Representatives elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state representatives in all 150 State House of Representatives districts. The winners of this election served in the 73rd Texas Legislature, with seats apportioned according to the 1990 United States census. State representatives serve for two-year terms. Democrats maintained their majority of 92 out of 150 seats.

zh.s: 1992年得克萨斯州众议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。得克萨斯州选民在州众议院全部150个选区选出议员。胜选者进入第73届得克萨斯州议会。州众议员任期两年。民主党保住多数席位，在150席中获得92席。

en.s: The 1992 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1992 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 32 of the state senate's 50 districts—all 25 of the even-numbered seats were up for regularly scheduled elections and, due to the oddities of redistricting following the 1990 Census, seven of the odd-numbered seats were up as well.

zh.s: 1992年爱荷华州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。爱荷华州选民在州参议院50个选区中的32个选区选出议员，包括按计划改选的全部25个偶数编号选区，以及受1990年人口普查后选区重划影响而额外改选的7个奇数编号选区。

en.t: United States Senate election in Wyoming, 1994
en.s: The 1994 United States Senate election in Wyoming was held on November 3, 1994. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Malcolm Wallop decided to retire instead of seeking a fourth term. Republican Craig L. Thomas won the open seat.

zh.t: 1994年怀俄明州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1994年11月3日举行怀俄明州联邦参议院选举。在任共和党参议员马尔科姆·沃洛普决定退休，不再竞选第四届。共和党人克雷格·L·托马斯赢得空缺席位。

en.s: STS-66 was a Space Shuttle program mission that was flown by the Space Shuttle Atlantis. STS-66 launched on November 3, 1994, at 11:59:43.060 am EDT from Launch Pad 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center. Atlantis landed at Edwards Air Force Base on November 14, 1994, at 10:33:45 am EST.

zh.s: STS-66是航天飞机计划的一次任务，由亚特兰蒂斯号航天飞机执行。亚特兰蒂斯号于1994年11月3日上午11:59:43.060（美国东部夏令时间）从美国国家航空航天局肯尼迪航天中心39B发射台升空，并于11月14日上午10:33:45（美国东部标准时间）在爱德华兹空军基地着陆。

en.s: The Battle of Kupres (Bosnian, Croatian and Serbian: Bitka za Kupres) was a battle of the Bosnian War, fought between the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina (ARBiH) and the Croatian Defence Council (HVO) on one side and the Army of Republika Srpska (VRS) on the other from 20 October to 3 November 1994.

zh.s: 库普雷斯战役是波斯尼亚战争中的一场战斗，发生于1994年10月20日至11月3日。交战一方是波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那共和国军与克罗地亚国防委员会，另一方是塞族共和国军。

en.s: The Susurluk car crash was a car crash that took place on 3 November 1996 in the small town of Susurluk, in Turkey's Balıkesir Province. It resulted in the deaths of three of the passengers: Abdullah Çatlı, a former ultra-rightist militant wanted by police for multiple murders and drug trafficking; Huseyin Kocadağ, a senior police official; and beauty queen and Çatlı's girlfriend Gonca Us.

zh.s: 苏苏尔卢克车祸发生于1996年11月3日，地点在土耳其巴勒克埃西尔省的小镇苏苏尔卢克。事故造成3名乘客死亡：阿卜杜拉·恰特勒曾是极右翼武装分子，因多起谋杀和贩毒案件被警方通缉；侯赛因·科贾达是高级警官；贡贾·乌斯是选美冠军，也是恰特勒的女友。

en.s: The 1996 Scottish Challenge Cup final was an association football match between Stranraer and St Johnstone on 3 November 1996 at Broadwood Stadium in Cumbernauld. It was the seventh final of the Scottish Challenge Cup since it was first organised in 1990 to celebrate the centenary of the Scottish Football League.

zh.s: 1996年11月3日，斯特兰拉尔队与圣庄士东队在坎伯诺尔德的布罗德伍德体育场举行苏格兰挑战杯决赛。这是苏格兰足球联赛为庆祝其成立一百周年而于1990年创办该赛事以来的第七届决赛。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Bulgaria on 27 October 1996, with a second round on 3 November. A presidential primary was held earlier in 1996, which resulted in Petar Stoyanov of the United Democratic Forces being selected as the candidate of the three largest opposition parties. He won with 59.7% of the vote in the second round. Voter turnout was 63.3% in the first round and 61.8% in the second.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1996年保加利亚总统选举首轮于10月27日举行，第二轮于11月3日举行。此前的党内初选选出佩塔尔·斯托扬诺夫代表民主力量联盟参选，他是三个最大反对党的共同候选人。斯托扬诺夫在第二轮中以59.7%的得票率获胜。首轮和第二轮的投票率分别为63.3%和61.8%。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的第二轮日期。

en.s: The 1998 California gubernatorial election was an election that occurred on November 3, 1998, resulting in the election of Gray Davis, the state's first Democratic governor in 16 years. Davis won the general election by an almost 20% margin over his closest opponent, Republican Dan Lungren. Davis succeeded Pete Wilson who was term limited out of office for life. The 1998 California gubernatorial election featured the state's only gubernatorial blanket primary, a practice which was later struck down in United States Supreme Court in California Democratic Party v. Jones in 2000. The primary occurred on June 2, 1998.

zh.s: 1998年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月3日举行，格雷·戴维斯当选，成为该州16年来首位民主党州长。戴维斯在大选中以近20个百分点的优势击败最接近的对手、共和党人丹·伦格伦。他接替因任期限制而不能继续担任州长的皮特·威尔逊。这次选举是加利福尼亚州唯一一次采用不分党派、由所有候选人同场竞争的初选制度。美国最高法院后来在2000年的“加利福尼亚民主党诉琼斯案”中裁定该制度违宪。初选于1998年6月2日举行。

en.s: The Maryland gubernatorial election of 1998 was held on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Democratic Governor Parris Glendening sought re-election. Governor Glendening emerged victorious from the Democratic primary after defeating several candidates. Former State Delegate Ellen Sauerbrey, who was the 1994 Republican nominee for governor, ran again for governor and won her party's nomination. The election between Glendening and Sauerbrey four years prior was extremely contentious, and ended with the Sauerbrey campaign challenging the results. Ultimately, despite the controversial nature of the previous election, Governor Glendening comfortably beat back Sauerbrey's spirited challenge, winning his second and final term as governor.

zh.s: 1998年马里兰州州长选举于11月3日举行。时任民主党州长帕里斯·格伦登宁竞选连任，并在击败多名候选人后赢得民主党初选。前州众议员艾伦·索尔布雷曾是1994年共和党州长候选人，这次再次参选并赢得党内提名。四年前，格伦登宁和索尔布雷的选举竞争十分激烈，索尔布雷阵营曾对结果提出质疑。尽管上一场选举争议不断，格伦登宁最终仍轻松击退索尔布雷的有力挑战，赢得第二个也是最后一个州长任期。

en.s: The 1998 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1998. Reform Party candidate Jesse Ventura defeated Republican Party challenger Norm Coleman and Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party challenger Hubert H. "Skip" Humphrey III. Ventura governed with a DFL-controlled state Senate and a Republican-controlled state House. Ventura's victory as a third party candidate was considered a historic major upset. He ran on the Reform Party ticket, a party which had been founded by two-time presidential candidate Ross Perot who had received 23% of the vote in Minnesota in the 1992 presidential election and 12% in the 1996 election.

zh.s: 1998年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月3日举行。改革党候选人杰西·文图拉击败共和党候选人诺姆·科尔曼和明尼苏达民主党—农民—劳工党候选人小休伯特·H·“斯基普”·汉弗莱。文图拉执政期间，州参议院由民主党—农民—劳工党控制，州众议院由共和党控制。作为第三党候选人，文图拉获胜被视为历史性的大冷门。他代表改革党参选，该党由曾两次竞选总统的罗斯·佩罗创立；佩罗在1992年和1996年的明尼苏达州总统选举中分别获得23%和12%的选票。

en.t: United States Senate election in Alabama, 1998
en.s: The 1998 United States Senate election in Alabama took place on November 3, 1998 alongside other elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Richard Shelby won re-election to a third term. Shelby had been elected in 1986 and 1992 as a Democrat, but switched to the Republican party in 1994, making this the first election he competed in as a Republican.

zh.t: 1998年阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1998年阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行，与其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议员选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍时任联邦参议员理查德·谢尔比成功连任，赢得第三个任期。谢尔比于1986年和1992年以民主党人身份当选，1994年转入共和党；这是他首次以共和党人身份参加选举。

en.s: The 1998 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1998 to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Republican Governor George W. Bush was reelected in a landslide over 4-term Democrat Texas Land Commissioner Garry Mauro, winning 68% of the vote to Mauro's 31%. Bush's 37% margin of victory was the largest won by any candidate since 1966 and is, to date, the largest ever won by a Republican candidate. Bush carried 239 counties, while Mauro carried just 15. Exit polls revealed that Bush won 27% of the African American vote, which was the highest percentage for any Republican statewide candidate, and 40% of the Latino vote.

zh.s: 1998年得克萨斯州州长选举于11月3日举行，选出该州州长。共和党籍时任州长乔治·W·布什以压倒性优势击败任职四届的民主党候选人、得克萨斯州土地专员加里·莫罗，成功连任。布什获得68%的选票，莫罗获得31%。布什领先37个百分点，是1966年以来任何候选人的最大领先幅度，也是截至当时共和党候选人的最大领先幅度。布什赢得239个县，莫罗赢得15个县。出口民调显示，布什获得27%的非裔美国人选票，是共和党州级候选人中最高的比例；他还获得40%的拉丁裔选票。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina, 1998
en.s: The United States House of Representative elections of 1998 in North Carolina were held on 3 November 1998 as part of the biennial election to the United States House of Representatives. All twelve seats in North Carolina, and 435 nationwide, were elected. The Republicans won seven seats to the Democrats' five. Eleven incumbents won re-election, while Democrat Bill Hefner's retirement in the 8th district allowed Republican Robin Hayes to enter the House for the first time. The Libertarian Party ran in every district, almost quadrupling their total vote share, but their vote was smaller than the margin of victory in all races.

zh.t: 1998年北卡罗来纳州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1998年北卡罗来纳州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，是每两年一次的美国联邦众议院选举的一部分。北卡罗来纳州的12个席位和全国435个席位都进行改选。共和党赢得7席，民主党赢得5席。11名现任议员成功连任；民主党人比尔·赫夫纳从第八国会选区退休后，共和党人罗宾·海斯首次进入联邦众议院。自由党在所有选区都推出了候选人，其总得票比例接近四倍增长，但在所有选举中都低于获胜差距。

en.s: The 1998 Florida Gubernatorial Election was held on November 3, 1998 to determine the Governor for the State of Florida. Two-term Democratic incumbent Governor Lawton Chiles was term-limited and could not run for re-election. John Ellis "Jeb" Bush, who had previously run for Governor in 1994 was the Republican nominee, and incumbent Lieutenant Governor Kenneth Hood "Buddy" MacKay was the Democratic nominee. Bush defeated MacKay by nearly 11% of the vote, and won his first of two terms as governor. Jeb Bush was one of four GOP pickups nationwide in the 1998 gubernatorial elections. But the Republican party still netted a loss of one governorship.

zh.s: 1998年佛罗里达州州长选举于11月3日举行。任满两届的民主党籍州长劳顿·奇利斯受任期限制，不能竞选连任。曾在1994年竞选州长的约翰·埃利斯·“杰布”·布什获得共和党提名；时任副州长肯尼思·胡德·“巴迪”·麦凯获得民主党提名。布什以近11个百分点的优势击败麦凯，赢得两个州长任期中的第一个任期。杰布·布什是共和党在1998年全国州长选举中赢得的四个州长职位之一，但共和党最终净失去一个州长职位。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 1998
en.s: The 1998 South Carolina United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 3, 1998, to select six Representatives for two-year terms from the state of South Carolina. The primary elections for the Democrats and the Republicans were held on June 9 and the runoff elections were held two weeks later on June 23. All five incumbents who ran were re-elected and the open seat in the 4th congressional district was retained by the Republicans. The composition of the state delegation remained four Republicans and two Democrats.

zh.t: 1998年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1998年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，选出该州6名联邦众议员，任期两年。民主党和共和党的初选均于6月9日举行，决选于两周后的6月23日举行。所有竞选连任的5名现任议员均成功连任；第四国会选区的空缺席位由共和党保住。该州代表团最终由4名共和党人和2名民主党人组成。

State Assemblyman and Speaker of the Assembly Cruz Bustamante, the Democratic nominee, decisively defeated the Republican nominee, State Senator Tim Leslie, for the office previously held by incumbent Gray Davis, who chose not to seek re-election in favor of running for governor.

zh.t: 1998年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行加利福尼亚州副州长选举，初选于同年6月2日举行。民主党候选人、州众议员兼众议院议长克鲁兹·布斯塔曼特以明显优势击败共和党提名人、州参议员蒂姆·莱斯利，赢得原由格雷·戴维斯担任的职位。戴维斯没有竞选连任，转而竞选州长。

en.s: The Pennsylvania Gubernatorial election of 1998 was held on November 3, 1998. It was between incumbent Republican Tom Ridge and Democrat Ivan Itkin. Ridge, a popular moderate, won with 57% of the votes cast.

en.s: The 1998 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1998, to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of the state of Michigan. Incumbent Governor John Engler, a member of the Republican Party, was re-elected over Democratic Party nominee Geoffrey Fieger, a lawyer who had represented the assisted suicide advocate Jack Kevorkian.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行密歇根州州长和副州长选举。在任共和党州长约翰·恩格勒击败民主党提名人杰弗里·菲格尔，成功连任。菲格尔是一名律师，曾代理支持协助自杀的杰克·凯沃尔基安。

en.s: The 1998 California State Controller election occurred on November 3, 1998. The primary elections took place on June 3, 1998. Every candidate was unopposed in the primary.

zh.t: 1998年加利福尼亚州州审计长选举

en.s: The 1998 House elections in Texas occurred on November 3, 1998, to elect the members of the State of Texas's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Texas had thirty seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States Census. These elections occurred simultaneously with the United States Senate elections of 1998, the United States House elections in other states, and various state and local elections.

en.s: The 1998 United States Senate election in Illinois was held on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Democrat U.S. Senator Carol Moseley Braun decided to run for re-election, despite the number of controversies that she had in during her first term. Republican State Senator Peter Fitzgerald won his party's primary with a slim margin of victory. He ended up defeating the incumbent with a margin of victory of approximately 3%.

zh.t: 1998年伊利诺伊州联邦参议院选举

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行康涅狄格州州长选举。在任共和党州长约翰·G·罗兰击败民主党提名人、联邦女众议员芭芭拉·肯内利，成功连任。

en.t: United States Senate election in Arkansas, 1998
en.s: The 1998 United States Senate election in Arkansas was held November 3, 1998. Incumbent Dale Bumpers did not run for re-election, as he was retiring. U.S. Representative Blanche Lincoln won the open seat.

zh.t: 1998年阿肯色州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行阿肯色州联邦参议院选举。在任参议员戴尔·邦珀斯退休，没有竞选连任。联邦众议员布兰奇·林肯赢得空缺席位。

en.t: United States Senate election in Indiana, 1998
en.s: The 1998 United States Senate election in Indiana was held on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Dan Coats decided to retire instead of seeking a second full term. Democratic nominee Evan Bayh won the open seat his father once held.

zh.t: 1998年印第安纳州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行印第安纳州联邦参议院选举。在任共和党参议员丹·科茨决定退休，没有竞选完整任期。民主党提名人埃文·贝赢得空缺席位，这个席位曾由他父亲担任。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Vermont, 1998
en.s: The 1998 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont was held on Tuesday, November 3, 1998 to elect the U.S. Representative from the state's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including an election to the U.S. Senate.

zh.t: 1998年佛蒙特州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日，佛蒙特州举行联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州不分区国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与联邦参议院选举等其他联邦和州级职位选举同时举行。

en.s: The 1998 California Attorney General election occurred on November 3, 1998. The primary elections took place on June 3, 1998. The Democratic nominee, Bill Lockyer, defeated the Republican nominee, Dave Stirling, for the office previously held by incumbent Dan Lungren, who chose not to seek re-election in favor of running for governor.

zh.t: 1998年加利福尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行加利福尼亚州总检察长选举，初选于同年6月3日举行。民主党提名人比尔·洛克耶击败共和党提名人大卫·斯特林，接替没有竞选连任、转而竞选州长的在任总检察长丹·伦格伦。

en.t: United States Senate election in Ohio, 1998
en.s: The 1998 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 3, 1998. It was concurrent with elections to the United States House of Representatives. Incumbent Democratic U.S Senator John Glenn decided to retire, instead of seeking a fifth term. Republican Governor George Voinovich won the open seat.

zh.t: 1998年俄亥俄州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行俄亥俄州联邦参议院选举，与联邦众议院选举同时进行。在任民主党参议员约翰·格伦决定退休，不再竞选第五届。共和党州长乔治·沃伊诺维奇赢得空缺席位。

en.t: United States Senate election in Wisconsin, 1998
en.s: The 1998 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Russ Feingold won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1998年威斯康星州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行威斯康星州联邦参议院选举。在任民主党参议员拉斯·费因戈尔德成功连任第二届。

en.t: United States Senate election in Kentucky, 1998
en.s: The 1998 United States Senate election in Kentucky took place on November 3, 1998. It was concurrent with elections to the United States House of Representatives. Incumbent Democratic U.S Senator Wendell Ford decided to retire, instead of seeking a fifth term. Republican Representative Jim Bunning won the open seat.

zh.t: 1998年肯塔基州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行肯塔基州联邦参议院选举，与联邦众议院选举同时进行。在任民主党参议员温德尔·福特决定退休，不再竞选第五届。共和党联邦众议员吉姆·邦宁赢得空缺席位。

en.s: The Nevada gubernatorial election of 1998 occurred on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Democratic governor Bob Miller was term-limited. Republican candidate Kenny Guinn defeated Democratic candidate Jan Laverty Jones to become Governor of Nevada.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行内华达州州长选举。受任期限制，在任民主党州长鲍勃·米勒无法竞选连任。共和党候选人肯尼·奎因击败民主党候选人简·拉弗蒂·琼斯，当选州长。

en.t: United States Senate election in North Carolina, 1998
en.s: The 1998 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Lauch Faircloth decided to seek re-election to a second term, but was unseated by Democrat John Edwards.

zh.t: 1998年北卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行北卡罗来纳州联邦参议院选举。在任共和党参议员劳奇·费尔克洛斯竞选连任第二届，但被民主党人约翰·爱德华兹击败。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming, 1998
en.s: The 1998 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming were held on November 3, 1998 to determine who will represent the state of Wyoming in the United States House of Representatives. Wyoming has one, at large district in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States Census, due to its low population. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 1998年怀俄明州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行怀俄明州联邦众议院选举，决定由谁代表怀俄明州出任联邦众议员。怀俄明州人口较少，只分得一个不分区席位，席位分配依据1990年美国人口普查结果。联邦众议员任期两年。

en.s: The 1998 Maine gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1998. Independent Governor Angus King sought a second and final term as governor. King faced off against former United States Congressman James B. Longley, Jr., the Republican nominee; attorney Thomas J. Connolly, the Democratic nominee; and several other independent candidates. 1998 was the first and, to date, the last Maine gubernatorial election since 1982 in which the winning candidate received greater than 50% of the vote.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行缅因州州长选举。在任独立人士州长安格斯·金竞选第二届、也是最后一届任期。他的对手包括共和党提名人、前联邦众议员小詹姆斯·B·朗利，民主党提名人、律师托马斯·J·康诺利，以及其他几名独立候选人。自1982年以来，这是缅因州首次、也是迄今唯一一次州长选举中胜选者得票超过50%。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in the District of Columbia, 1998
en.s: The 1998 congressional election for the Delegate from the District of Columbia was held on November 3, 1998. The winner of the race was Eleanor Holmes Norton (D), who won her fourth re-election. All elected members would serve in 106th United States Congress. The non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives from the District of Columbia is elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 1998年哥伦比亚特区联邦众议院代表选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行哥伦比亚特区联邦众议院代表选举。民主党人埃莉诺·霍姆斯·诺顿胜出，成功连任第四届。当选者将在第106届美国国会任职。哥伦比亚特区的联邦众议院代表没有投票权，任期两年。

en.t: United States Senate election in Iowa, 1998
en.s: The 1998 United States Senate election in Iowa was held on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Republican United States Senator Chuck Grassley sought re-election to a fourth term in the United States Senate, facing off against former State Representative David Osterberg, who won the Democratic nomination unopposed. Grassley had not faced a competitive election since 1980; this year proved no different, and Grassley crushed Osterberg to win a fourth term.

zh.t: 1998年艾奥瓦州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行艾奥瓦州联邦参议院选举。在任共和党参议员查克·格拉斯利竞选第四届，对手是前州众议员、民主党提名人戴维·奥斯特伯格。奥斯特伯格没有遇到党内对手。格拉斯利自1980年以来一直没有遇到势均力敌的选战，这次也是如此；他以明显优势击败奥斯特伯格，成功连任第四届。

en.s: The 1998 Hawaii gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Democratic Governor of Hawaii Ben Cayetano ran for re-election to a second and final term, and he faced off against Maui Mayor Linda Lingle. The race between Cayetano and Lingle was hard-fought, but ultimately, Cayetano narrowly edged her out to win re-election.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行夏威夷州州长选举。在任民主党州长本·卡耶塔诺竞选第二届、也是最后一届任期，对手是毛伊岛市长琳达·林格尔。两人的竞争十分激烈，最终卡耶塔诺以微弱优势胜出并成功连任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1998 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1998. Democratic nominee John Kitzhaber easily defeated Republican Bill Sizemore to win a second term.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行俄勒冈州州长选举。民主党提名人约翰·基茨哈伯轻松击败共和党人比尔·西泽莫尔，成功连任第二届。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1998 Orange County, Florida, Chairman election took place on November 3, 1998, following a primary election on September 1, 1998. Incumbent Chairman Linda Chapin was term-limited and barred from seeking a third consecutive term. Though the race was formally nonpartisan, two Republican candidates advanced to the general election. State Senator John Ostalkiewicz placed first in the primary with 41 percent of the vote, and Orlando Utilities Commission President Mel Martínez placed second with 40 percent.

zh.t: 1998年佛罗里达州奥兰治县委员会主席选举
zh.s: 1998年佛罗里达州奥兰治县委员会主席选举于11月3日举行，初选在9月1日举行。时任主席琳达·查平因任期限制，不能连续第三次竞选。虽然选举形式上不设党派，但两名共和党候选人晋级大选。州参议员约翰·奥斯塔尔凯维奇在初选中以41%的得票率排名第一；奥兰多公用事业委员会主席梅尔·马丁内斯以40%排名第二。

en.s: The 1998 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1998, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Incumbent Republican Frank Keating won re-election in a landslide against Democratic State Representative Laura Boyd. The Reform Party, the first alternative party to be able to run a candidate for governor in the state since 1970, had Hoppy Heidelberg as its candidate.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行俄克拉何马州州长选举。共和党籍现任州长弗兰克·基廷以压倒性优势击败民主党候选人、州众议员劳拉·博伊德，成功连任。改革党是自1970年以来首个能在俄克拉何马州提名州长候选人的第三党，该党候选人为霍皮·海德堡。

en.t: 1998 Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries election
en.s: The 1998 Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries election was held on November 3, 1998 to elect the Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries. Jack Thompson lost re-election to a second consecutive term.

zh.t: 1998年阿拉巴马州农业和工业专员选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行阿拉巴马州农业和工业专员选举。杰克·汤普森未能连任第二个连续任期。

en.s: The 1998 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1998. Term limits prevented incumbent Governor Ben Nelson, a Democrat, from seeking a third term in office. Republican nominee Mike Johanns, Mayor of Lincoln, defeated Democratic nominee, attorney Bill Hoppner. As of 2026, this was the last gubernatorial election in Nebraska in which the margin of victory was within single digits.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州州长选举。民主党籍现任州长本·尼尔森因任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。共和党候选人、林肯市市长迈克·约翰斯击败民主党候选人、律师比尔·霍普纳。截至2026年，这是内布拉斯加州最后一次州长选举胜选差距在10个百分点以内。

en.s: The 1998 Connecticut Attorney General election took place on November 3, 1998, to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Richard Blumenthal won re-election to a third term, defeating Republican nominee Santa Mendoza.

zh.t: 1998年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行康涅狄格州总检察长选举。现任民主党总检察长理查德·布卢门撒尔击败共和党候选人桑塔·门多萨，成功当选第三个任期。

en.s: The 1998 Florida Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1998. Democratic incumbent Bob Butterworth defeated Republican nominee David H. Bludworth with 59.56% of the vote. As of 2026, this was the last time a Democrat was elected Florida Attorney General.

zh.t: 1998年佛罗里达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行佛罗里达州总检察长选举。在任民主党总检察长鲍勃·巴特沃思以59.56%的得票率击败共和党提名人大卫·H·布卢德沃思。截至2026年，这是民主党人最后一次当选佛罗里达州总检察长。

en.s: General elections were held in Guam on November 3, 1998. A Democratic Party primary was held to decide the party's gubernatorial candidates on 7 September.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日，关岛举行大选。民主党于9月7日举行初选，确定该党的州长候选人。

en.s: The 1998 Connecticut State Treasurer election took place on November 3, 1998, to elect the Connecticut State Treasurer. Incumbent Republican State Treasurer Paul J. Silvester was appointed to the office by Governor John G. Rowland to complete the term of Chris Burnham, who resigned to work at an investment firm. Silvester lost election to a full term to Democratic nominee Denise L.

zh.t: 1998年美国康涅狄格州州财长选举
zh.s: 1998年康涅狄格州州财长选举于11月3日举行，旨在选出州财长。共和党籍时任州财长保罗·J·西尔维斯特由州长约翰·G·罗兰任命，接替辞职去投资公司工作的克里斯·伯纳姆，完成其任期。西尔维斯特竞选完整任期，但败给民主党候选人丹妮丝·L。

en.s: The 1998 Michigan Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Republican Candice Miller defeated Democratic nominee Mary Lou Parks with 67.68% of the vote. To date, this is the most recent statewide election in which Wayne County voted for the Republican candidate.

zh.s: 1998年密歇根州州务卿选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任州务卿坎迪斯·米勒以67.68%的得票率击败民主党提名人玛丽·卢·帕克斯。这是截至目前最近一次韦恩县在全州选举中投票支持共和党候选人。

en.t: 1998 West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals special election
en.s: The 1998 West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals special election took place on November 3, 1998, to elect a Justice of the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia for the next six years. The election was held to complete the unexpired term of Democratic Justice Thomas McHugh, who retired in December 1997. Republican governor Cecil H. Underwood appointed John F. McCuskey to fill the vacancy.

zh.t: 1998年西弗吉尼亚州最高上诉法院特别选举
zh.s: 1998年西弗吉尼亚州最高上诉法院特别选举于1998年11月3日举行，选出一名任期六年的法官。此次选举用于填补民主党籍法官托马斯·麦克休于1997年12月退休后留下的空缺。共和党籍州长塞西尔·H·安德伍德任命约翰·F·麦克斯基接任。

en.s: The 1998 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 3, 1998, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general J. Joseph Curran Jr. defeated Republican nominee Paul H. Rappaport.

zh.s: 1998年马里兰州总检察长选举于11月3日举行。民主党提名人、时任总检察长J·约瑟夫·柯伦二世击败共和党提名人保罗·H·拉帕波特。

en.t: 1998 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1998 United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 3, 1998, to elect U.S. Representatives to serve in the 106th United States Congress. They were part of the midterm elections held during President Bill Clinton's second term. They were a major disappointment for the Republicans, who were expecting to gain seats due to the embarrassment Clinton suffered during the Monica Lewinsky scandal and the "six-year itch" effect observed in most second-term midterm elections.

zh.s: 1998年美国联邦众议院选举于1998年11月3日举行，选出第106届国会的联邦众议员。这是比尔·克林顿总统第二个任期内举行的中期选举。共和党原本预计会因克林顿的莱温斯基丑闻以及常见于总统第二任期中期选举的“六年之痒”效应而增加席位，但选举结果令该党大失所望。

en.s: The 1998 Arizona Senate election was held on November 3, 1998. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 8, 1998. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 18 seats over the Democrats' 12 seats.

zh.s: 1998年亚利桑那州参议院选举于1998年11月3日举行，选出州参议院全部30个选区的议员，任期两年。初选于1998年9月8日举行。选举前，共和党占18席，民主党占12席。

en.s: The 1998 Arkansas gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1998 for the post of Governor of Arkansas. Incumbent Republican governor Mike Huckabee defeated Democratic nominee Bill Bristow to win a full term in office.

zh.s: 1998年阿肯色州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任州长迈克·赫卡比击败民主党提名人比尔·布里斯托，赢得完整任期。

en.s: The 1998 Illinois gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Republican Governor Jim Edgar did not run for a third term in office. Republican nominee George Ryan, the Illinois Secretary of State, narrowly won the election against Democratic Congressman Glenn Poshard. With this election Corinne Wood became the first female lieutenant governor of the state.

zh.s: 1998年伊利诺伊州州长选举于11月3日举行。共和党籍时任州长吉姆·埃德加没有竞选第三个任期。共和党提名人、伊利诺伊州州务卿乔治·瑞安以微弱优势击败民主党联邦众议员格伦·波沙德，当选州长。科琳·伍德也因此成为该州首位女性副州长。

en.s: The 1998 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 3, 1998, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Judi Dutcher defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Nancy A. Larson, Constitution nominee Patricia G.V. Becker, Libertarian nominee Bob Odden and Progressive Minnesota nominee Joseph G. Peschek.

zh.t: 1998年明尼苏达州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1998年明尼苏达州州审计长选举于11月3日举行，选出该州州审计长。共和党提名人、时任州审计长朱迪·达彻击败民主党—农民—劳工党提名人南希·A·拉森、宪法党提名人帕特里夏·G·V·贝克尔、自由意志党提名人鲍勃·奥登和明尼苏达进步党提名人约瑟夫·G·佩舍克。

en.s: The 1998 Iowa gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Republican Governor Terry Branstad did not seek re-election to a fifth consecutive term; he later successfully ran again in 2010 and 2014. To replace him, State Senator Tom Vilsack narrowly won the nomination of the Democratic Party while former United States Congressman Jim Ross Lightfoot, who was previously the Republican nominee for the United States Senate in 1996, won his party's nomination.

zh.s: 1998年艾奥瓦州州长选举于1998年11月3日举行。共和党籍现任州长特里·布兰斯塔德没有竞选连续第五个任期；他后来在2010年和2014年再次成功当选。接替他的候选人中，州参议员汤姆·维尔萨克以微弱优势赢得民主党提名；前联邦众议员吉姆·罗斯·莱特富特曾在1996年获共和党提名竞选联邦参议员，此次赢得州长选举的共和党提名。

en.s: The Maryland county executive elections of 1998 took place on November 3, 1998. Anne Arundel County, Baltimore County, Harford County, Howard County, Montgomery County, and Prince George's County elected county executives.

zh.t: 1998年马里兰州县行政长官选举
zh.s: 1998年马里兰州县行政长官选举于11月3日举行。安妮阿伦德尔县、巴尔的摩县、哈福德县、霍华德县、蒙哥马利县和乔治王子县选出了县行政长官。

en.s: The 1998 Maryland House of Delegates elections were held on November 3, 1998, as part of the 1998 United States elections, including the 1998 Maryland gubernatorial election. All 141 of Maryland's state delegates were up for reelection. Republicans hoped that gubernatorial nominee Ellen Sauerbrey would provide the party with enough coattails to continue making gains in the Maryland House of Delegates.

zh.s: 1998年马里兰州众议院选举于1998年11月3日举行，是1998年美国选举的一部分，也与1998年马里兰州州长选举同时举行。州众议院全部141个席位都进行改选。共和党希望州长候选人艾伦·索尔斯伯里能带动选情，帮助该党继续增加州众议院席位。

en.s: A Massachusetts general election was held on November 3, 1998 in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. The election included: statewide elections for governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, Secretary of the Commonwealth, treasurer, and auditor; district elections for U.S. Representatives, State Representatives, State Senators, and Governor's Councillors; and ballot questions at the state and local levels. Democratic and Republican candidates were selected in party primaries held September 15, 1998.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州大选于1998年11月3日举行。选举包括州长、副州长、总检察长、州务卿、州财政部长和州审计长等全州职位，以及联邦众议员、州众议员、州参议员、州长委员会成员等选区职位的选举，也包括州和地方层级的公投议案。民主党和共和党候选人通过1998年9月15日举行的党内初选产生。

en.s: The 1998 West Virginia Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 3, 1998. State senate seats in West Virginia are staggered, with senators serving 4-year terms. 18 of the 34 state senate seats were up for election, with SD 2 holding an additional special election for Larry Wiedebusch's seat, who died on October 25, 1997. Jeffrey V. Kessler was appointed to fill the seat and was re-elected by a wide margin.

zh.t: 1998年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 1998年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举于1998年11月3日（星期二）举行。州参议员任期错开，每届任期四年；34个席位中有18席改选。第2选区还举行补选，填补拉里·维德布施于1997年10月25日去世后留下的席位。杰弗里·V·凯斯勒获任命接替该席位，此次以明显优势再次当选。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 3, 1998. Primary elections were held on March 17, 1998. These elections saw Democrats make gains. The Democratic Party went from holding no statewide offices, to holding two.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日，伊利诺伊州举行选举。初选于1998年3月17日举行。民主党有所斩获，从未掌握州级职位转为赢得两个州级职位。

en.t: 1998 Connecticut Secretary of the State election
en.s: The 1998 Connecticut Secretary of the State election took place on November 3, 1998, to elect the Secretary of the State of Connecticut. Incumbent Democrat Miles S. Rapoport did not seek re-election to a second term, instead opting to run for the open CT-01 seat in the U.S. House of Representatives. Democratic nominee and state representative from the 100th district Susan Bysiewicz defeated Republican nominee Ben Andrews.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行康涅狄格州州务卿选举。在任民主党人迈尔斯·S·拉波波特没有竞选连任第二届，转而竞选联邦众议院康涅狄格州第一选区的空缺席位。民主党提名人、州众议员苏珊·拜西维奇击败共和党提名人本·安德鲁斯。

en.s: The 1998 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 3, 1998, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and former governor of Maryland William Donald Schaefer defeated Republican nominee Larry Mark Epstein.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行马里兰州审计长选举。民主党提名人、马里兰州前州长威廉·唐纳德·谢弗击败共和党提名人拉里·马克·爱泼斯坦。

en.s: The 1998 elections for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives were held on November 3, 1998, with all districts being decided. Primary elections were held on May 19, 1998. The term of office for those elected in 1998 began when the House of Representatives convened in January 1999. Pennsylvania State Representatives are elected for two-year terms, with all 203 seats up for election every two years.

zh.t: 1998年宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举，所有选区都进行了选举。初选于1998年5月19日举行。1998年当选的议员于1999年1月众议院开会时开始任职。州众议员任期两年，全部203个席位每两年改选一次。

en.s: The 1998 Wyoming Senate election was held on November 3, 1998, to elect members to the Wyoming Senate for its 55th session as part of the 1998 United States elections. Partisan primaries were held on August 18. All odd-numbered seats were up for election. Republicans flipped one Democratic seat and Democrats flipped two Republican seats, leading to one net seat gained for the Democrats.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行怀俄明州参议院选举，选出第55届州参议院议员，作为当年美国选举的一部分。党内初选于8月18日举行。所有奇数编号席位都进行选举。共和党赢得一个民主党席位，民主党赢得两个共和党席位，因此民主党净增一个席位。

en.s: The 1998 Maryland Senate election were held on November 3, 1998, to elect senators in all 47 districts of the Maryland Senate. Members were elected in single-member constituencies to four-year terms. These elections were held concurrently with various federal and state elections, including for Governor of Maryland.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行马里兰州参议院选举，选出全部47个选区的州参议员。议员由单一议员选区选出，任期四年。选举与马里兰州州长选举等联邦和州级选举同期举行。

en.s: The 1998 Texas lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1998, to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Texas. The Incumbent, Bob Bullock did not run for re-election due to his declining health and advancing age. The Republican, Incumbent Agriculture Commissioner; Rick Perry was elected against incumbent Democratic Comptroller; John Sharp. Perry became the second Republican to be elected as lieutenant governor and the first to do so since 1869.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行得克萨斯州副州长选举。现任副州长鲍勃·布洛克因健康状况逐渐恶化、年事已高，没有竞选连任。共和党候选人、现任农业专员里克·佩里击败民主党候选人、现任州审计长约翰·夏普，当选副州长。佩里是自1869年以来第二位当选副州长的共和党人，也是1869年以来首位当选的共和党人。

en.t: 1998 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1998 United States Senate election in California was held November 3, 1998. Incumbent Democratic Senator Barbara Boxer won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican Matt Fong.

zh.t: 1998年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举。现任民主党参议员芭芭拉·博克瑟击败共和党候选人马特·方，成功连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1998 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: The 1998 United States Virgin Islands general election was held on November 3, 1998, to elect the Governor of the United States Virgin Islands, 15 members of the Legislature and the Delegate to United States House of Representatives. In the gubernatorial race, Democrat Charles Wesley Turnbull defeated incumbent Governor Roy Schneider.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行美属维尔京群岛大选，选出州长、15名立法机构成员和一名联邦众议院代表。州长选举中，民主党候选人查尔斯·韦斯利·特恩布尔击败现任州长罗伊·施奈德。

en.s: An election took place on November 3, 1998, to elect the Florida Commissioner of Agriculture. The incumbent, Robert B. Crawford, easily defeated Republican Rich Faircloth to win re-election; he served under three governors, Lawton Chiles, Buddy MacKay, and Jeb Bush.

zh.t: 1998年佛罗里达州农业专员选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行佛罗里达州农业专员选举。现任农业专员罗伯特·B·克劳福德轻松击败共和党候选人里奇·费尔克洛思，成功连任。他曾在劳顿·奇利斯、巴迪·麦凯和杰布·布什三位州长任内任职。

en.s: The 1998 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 3, 1998, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and former member of the Missouri House of Representatives Claire McCaskill defeated Republican nominee Charles A. Pierce, Libertarian nominee Gerald R. Geier and Reform nominee and former member of the Missouri House of Representatives George D. Weber.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行密苏里州州审计长选举。民主党候选人、前密苏里州众议员克莱尔·麦卡斯基尔击败共和党候选人查尔斯·A·皮尔斯、自由党候选人杰拉尔德·R·盖尔和改革党候选人、前密苏里州众议员乔治·D·韦伯。

en.s: On November 3, 1998, Washington, D.C., held an election for its mayor. The Democratic candidate, former chief financial officer (CFO) Anthony A. Williams, defeated Republican candidate Carol Schwartz, a member of the Council of the District of Columbia. The parties' primary elections had been held on September 15, 1998.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日，华盛顿特区举行市长选举。民主党候选人、前首席财务官安东尼·A·威廉姆斯击败共和党候选人、哥伦比亚特区议会议员卡罗尔·施瓦茨。两党的初选于1998年9月15日举行。

en.s: The 1998 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 1998, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee Mary Kiffmeyer defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from the 63B district Edwina Garcia, Reform nominee Alan Shilepsky and Libertarian nominee Kenneth Iverson.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行明尼苏达州州务卿选举。共和党候选人玛丽·基夫迈尔击败民主农民劳工党候选人、现任明尼苏达州众议员埃德温娜·加西亚、改革党候选人艾伦·希莱普斯基和自由党候选人肯尼思·艾弗森。

en.s: The 1998 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Republican Governor of Ohio George Voinovich could not seek a third term due to term limits, and ran for the United States Senate instead. To replace him, former Attorney General of Ohio Lee Fisher and Ohio Secretary of State Bob Taft won the Democratic and Republican primaries, respectively.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行俄亥俄州州长选举。共和党籍现任州长乔治·沃伊诺维奇因任期限制不能竞选第三个任期，因此转而竞选联邦参议员。前州总检察长李·费舍尔和州务卿鲍勃·塔夫脱分别赢得民主党和共和党初选。

en.s: The 1998 Texas Attorney General election took place on November 3, 1998, to elect the Texas Attorney General. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Dan Morales chose not to seek re-election to a third term. Former Justice of the Texas Supreme Court John Cornyn beat Democratic nominee and former Attorney General Jim Mattox, 54% to 44%. Cornyn became the first Republican elected Attorney General since Reconstruction.

zh.t: 1998年得克萨斯州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行得克萨斯州总检察长选举。现任民主党总检察长丹·莫拉莱斯没有竞选第三个任期。前得克萨斯州最高法院法官约翰·康宁以54%对44%的得票率击败民主党候选人、前总检察长吉姆·马托克斯。康宁是重建时期结束后首位当选的共和党总检察长。

en.s: The 1998 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on Tuesday, November 3, 1998 to elect the Minnesota Attorney General for a four-year term. Incumbent DFL Attorney General Skip Humphrey ran for governor, and DFLer Mike Hatch won the election to replace him. The election marked the eighth attorney general race in a row won by the DFL since 1970.

zh.t: 1998年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日星期二举行明尼苏达州总检察长选举，选出任期四年的总检察长。现任民主农民劳工党总检察长斯基普·汉弗莱竞选州长，民主农民劳工党候选人迈克·哈奇赢得选举，接替他。这是民主农民劳工党自1970年以来连续第八次赢得总检察长选举。

en.s: The 1998 Arizona House of Representatives election took place on Tuesday, November 3, 1998, with the primary election held on Tuesday, September 8, 1998. Arizona voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Arizona state elections, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House, Governor, and Arizona Senate.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日星期二举行亚利桑那州众议院选举，初选于同年9月8日星期二举行。亚利桑那州选民选出州众议院全部60名议员，任期两年。议员由多席选区选出。选举与美国全国选举和亚利桑那州选举同期举行，包括联邦参议员、联邦众议员、州长和州参议员选举。

en.s: The 1998 Michigan Attorney General election was held on November 3, 1998. Democratic nominee Jennifer Granholm defeated Republican nominee John Smietanka with 52.09% of the vote.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行密歇根州总检察长选举。民主党候选人詹妮弗·格兰霍姆以52.09%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·斯米坦卡。

en.s: The 1998 Florida Education Commissioner election took place on November 3, 1998, to elect the Education Commissioner of Florida. The election was won by former Treasurer Tom Gallagher, who took office on January 5, 1999. This was the last regularly scheduled election for this office, as a 1998 amendment to the Florida Constitution turned this office into one appointed directly by the governor.

zh.t: 1998年佛罗里达州教育专员选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行佛罗里达州教育专员选举。前财政部长汤姆·加拉格尔当选，并于1999年1月5日就职。这是该职位最后一次按计划举行的选举，因为佛罗里达州宪法于1998年修订后，该职位改为由州长直接任命。

en.t: 1998 United States House of Representatives elections in Tennessee
en.s: The 1998 congressional elections in Tennessee was held on November 3, 1998, to determine who will represent the state of Tennessee in the United States House of Representatives. Following the 1998 elections, no seats changed hands, leaving the Tennessee delegation at a 5-4 Republican majority.

zh.t: 1998年田纳西州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行田纳西州联邦众议院选举，以确定谁将代表该州进入联邦众议院。选举后没有席位易手，田纳西州代表团仍由共和党以5比4占多数。

en.s: The 1998 St. Charles County Executive election took place on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Republican County Executive Joe Ortwerth ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged in the Republican primary by former State Representative Ron Stivison, and he won renomination with 78 percent of the vote. In the Democratic primary, St.

zh.t: 1998年圣查尔斯县行政长官选举
zh.s: 圣查尔斯县于1998年11月3日举行行政长官选举。时任共和党行政长官乔·奥特沃思竞选连任第二届。他在共和党初选中遭前州众议员罗恩·斯蒂维森挑战，并以78%的得票率再次获得提名。民主党初选中，斯特……

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 3, 1998. Primaries were held on March 17, 1998. Elections were held for Assessor, Clerk, Sheriff, Treasurer, President of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, all 17 seats of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, all 3 seats of the Cook County Board of Review, 4 seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州库克县大选于1998年11月3日举行，初选于同年3月17日举行。选举包括评估官、书记官、警长、财政部长、库克县委员会主席、委员会全部17个席位、库克县评估委员会全部3个席位、水务管理区委员会4个席位，以及库克县巡回法院法官的选举。

en.t: 1998 United States House of Representatives elections in New York
en.s: The 1998 United States House of Representatives elections in New York were held on November 3, 1998, to elect the 31 United States representatives from the State of New York, one from each of the state's 31 congressional districts. The elections were held concurrently with other elections in the state for U.S. Senate, Governor/Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Comptroller, and various other local offices.

zh.s: 1998年纽约州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，选出该州31名联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。选举与该州联邦参议员、州长和副州长、总检察长、州审计长以及其他地方职位的选举同时举行。

en.s: The 1998 San Jose mayoral election was held on June 2 and November 3, 1998, to elect the Mayor of San Jose, California. It saw the election of Ron Gonzales. Incumbent mayor Susan Hammer was term limited. Because no candidate managed to receive a majority of the vote in the initial round of the election, a runoff election was held between the first round's top-two finishers.

zh.s: 1998年圣何塞市长选举于1998年6月2日和11月3日举行，选出加利福尼亚州圣何塞市的市长。罗恩·冈萨雷斯当选。时任市长苏珊·哈默受任期限制，不能参选。首轮投票无人获得过半数，因此由首轮得票前两名进入第二轮。

en.t: 1998 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 1998 United States Senate election in Georgia was held November 3, 1998. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Paul Coverdell won a second term in office, becoming the first of his party to ever win reelection to the U.S. Senate from Georgia. Coverdell would remain in the Senate until his death on July 18, 2000.

zh.t: 1998年美国佐治亚州参议员选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日，佐治亚州举行联邦参议员选举。共和党现任议员保罗·科弗德尔连任，成为该党首位在佐治亚州赢得联邦参议员连任的候选人。

en.s: The 1998 United States Senate elections were held on November 3, 1998, with the 34 seats of Class 3 contested in regular elections. This was seen as an even contest between the Republican Party and Democratic Party. While the Democrats had to defend more seats up for election, the Republican attacks on the morality of President Bill Clinton failed to connect with voters and the anticipated Republican gains did not materialize.

zh.s: 1998年美国联邦参议院选举于11月3日举行，第3组34个席位通过常规选举改选。共和党和民主党原本势均力敌。民主党需要守住更多待改选席位；共和党攻击比尔·克林顿总统的个人品行未能奏效，原本预期的共和党席位增长也没有实现。

en.t: 1998 San Francisco Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 1998 San Francisco Board of Supervisors elections occurred on November 3, 1998. Five of the eleven seats were contested. Five incumbents, three of whom were appointed by Mayor Willie Brown, were up for election. This election was the last using at-large seats, a system that effectively reduces representation of minority points of view. Subsequent Board of Supervisors elections were to district seats through a plan ratified by the voters in 1996.

zh.s: 1998年旧金山监事会选举于11月3日举行，11个席位中有5个改选。5名时任监事参选，其中3人由市长威利·布朗任命。这是最后一次采用全市不分区选举席位的选举；这种制度实际上会减少少数群体观点的代表性。此后，监事会选举改为按选区进行，依据的是选民于1996年批准的方案。

en.t: 1998 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1998 United States Senate election in New York was held November 3, 1998, along with elections to the United States Senate in other states, as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Senator Al D'Amato lost his bid for a fourth term to Democrat Chuck Schumer in what was considered by many to be the "high[est] profile and nastiest" contest of the year.

zh.t: 1998年美国联邦参议院纽约州选举
zh.s: 1998年美国联邦参议院纽约州选举于11月3日举行，同时还举行了其他州的联邦参议员、联邦众议员以及州和地方选举。共和党籍时任参议员阿尔·达马托争取第四个任期失败，败给民主党人查克·舒默。许多人认为，这是当年关注度最高、竞争最激烈的选战。

en.s: The 1998 New York State Comptroller election was held on November 3, 1998. Democratic incumbent Carl McCall defeated Republican challenger Bruce Blakeman by a wide margin.

zh.s: 1998年纽约州审计长选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任审计长卡尔·麦考尔以明显优势击败共和党挑战者布鲁斯·布莱克曼。

en.s: The 1998 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1998, to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia, concurrently with the 1998 gubernatorial election, as well as elections to the United States Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Georgia is one of 21 states that elects its lieutenant governor separately from its governor.

zh.t: 1998年美国佐治亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日，佐治亚州举行副州长选举，与州长、联邦参众两院及地方选举同日进行。佐治亚州的副州长与州长分别选举产生。

en.t: 1998 Cook County Board of Commissioners election
en.s: The 1998 Cook County Board of Commissioners election was held on November 3, 1998. It was preceded by a primary election held on March 17, 1998. It coincided with other 1998 Cook County, Illinois, elections (including the election for president of the Cook County Board of Commissioners). It saw all seventeen seats of the Cook County Board of Commissioners up for election to four-year terms.

zh.s: 1998年库克县委员会选举于11月3日举行。初选于1998年3月17日举行。这次选举与伊利诺伊州库克县的其他选举同时举行，包括库克县委员会主席选举。库克县委员会全部17个席位均改选，任期四年。

en.t: 1998 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1998 United States Senate election in Washington was held November 3, 1998. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Patty Murray won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1998年美国联邦参议院华盛顿州选举
zh.s: 1998年美国联邦参议院华盛顿州选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任联邦参议员帕蒂·默里成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 3, 1998, in 36 states and two territories. Going into the election cycle, 24 of the seats were held by Republicans, 11 by Democrats, and one by an Independent. The elections changed the national balance of power by the loss of one Republican and the gain of one Independent, although political party dominance was shifted in nine states.

zh.s: 美国于1998年11月3日在36个州和两个属地举行州长选举。选举开始前，共和党占有24个州长席位，民主党占11席，另有1席由无党派人士担任。选举后，共和党失去1席，无党派人士增加1席；共有9个州的政党主导地位发生变化。

en.s: The 1998 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Democratic governor Zell Miller was unable to seek re-election due to term limits, therefore creating an open seat. To replace him, State Representative Roy Barnes won the Democratic Party's nomination after a close and highly contested primary election, while businessman Guy Millner, who had run for governor and the United States Senate in the previous four years, won the nomination of the Republican Party.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。现任民主党州长泽尔·米勒因任期限制不能再参选，选举因此没有现任州长参与。民主党推举州众议员罗伊·巴恩斯，共和党则推举商人盖伊·米尔纳。

en.t: 1998 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: The 1998 House elections in Georgia occurred on November 3, 1998, to elect the members of the State of Georgia's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Georgia had eleven seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1990 United States census. These elections were held concurrently with the United States Senate elections of 1998 (including one election in Georgia), the United States House elections in other states, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1998年美国佐治亚州众议员选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日，佐治亚州举行联邦众议员选举，选出该州的11名众议员。这场选举与联邦参议员选举及其他州和地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1998 New York gubernatorial election was an election for the state governorship held on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Republican governor George Pataki was re-elected with 54.3% of the vote. This remains the last statewide election in New York where a Republican won a majority of the vote.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行纽约州州长选举。在任共和党州长乔治·帕塔基以54.3%的得票率成功连任。截至目前，这是纽约州最后一次由共和党人在全州选举中赢得过半数选票。

en.s: The 1998 New York Attorney General election took place on November 3, 1998 along with elections to the United States Senate in other states as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Democratic challenger Eliot Spitzer unseated one-term Republican incumbent Dennis Vacco in a major upset, with Vacco conceding on December 14, after accusing New York City voters, primarily in predominantly Black and Latino areas, of voter fraud.

zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行纽约州总检察长选举，与其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。民主党挑战者埃利奥特·斯皮策意外击败一届任期的共和党在任总检察长丹尼斯·瓦科。瓦科曾指控纽约市以黑人和拉丁裔居民为主的地区存在选举舞弊，后于12月14日承认败选。

en.s: The 1998 St. Louis County Executive election took place on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Buzz Westfall ran for re-election to a third term. Though local Republicans attempted to recruit a well-known challenger to Westfall, he faced minimal opposition. He won the Democratic primary and then was opposed by Republican Joe Passanise, a retired county engineer, in the general election.

zh.t: 1998年圣路易斯县行政长官选举
zh.s: 1998年11月3日举行圣路易斯县行政长官选举。在任民主党行政长官巴兹·韦斯特福尔竞选连任第三届。当地共和党人试图招募一位知名对手，但他面临的竞争并不激烈。他赢得民主党初选后，在大选中对阵共和党人乔·帕萨尼斯。帕萨尼斯曾任县工程师。

en.s: The 1998 Jackson County Executive election took place on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Katheryn Shields ran for re-election to a second term. Shields was challenged for renomination by former County Executive Dale Baumgardner, whom she narrowly defeated in the 1994 Democratic primary. However, despite the closeness of her 1994 campaign, Shields defeated Baumgardner in a landslide, winning the Democratic primary with 70 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 杰克逊县于1998年11月3日举行行政长官选举。时任民主党行政长官凯瑟琳·希尔兹竞选连任第二届。前行政长官戴尔·鲍姆加德纳曾在1994年民主党初选中险些击败希尔兹，此次再次挑战她争取提名。不过，尽管1994年竞争激烈，希尔兹仍以压倒性优势击败鲍姆加德纳，在民主党初选中获得70%的选票。

en.t: Mayoral elections in Providence, Rhode Island
en.s: Elections are held in Providence, Rhode Island to elect the city's mayor. Such elections are regularly scheduled to be held in United States midterm election years.

zh.t: 罗得岛州普罗维登斯市长选举
zh.s: 罗得岛州普罗维登斯举行市长选举，选出该市市长。此类选举通常安排在美国中期选举年份举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1998 New Mexico gubernatorial election was a contest to elect the next governor of New Mexico. The winner of the election would serve a term from January 1, 1999 until January 1, 2003. Incumbent Republican (now Libertarian) Governor Gary Johnson was elected to a second term. As of 2026, this is the last time a non-Hispanic was elected governor of New Mexico.

zh.s: 1998年新墨西哥州州长选举选出下一任州长。胜选者的任期为1999年1月1日至2003年1月1日。共和党籍时任州长加里·约翰逊成功连任第二个任期；他现为自由意志党人。截至2026年，这是新墨西哥州最后一次选出非西班牙裔州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1998 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1998 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in half of the state senate's districts—the 25 odd-numbered state senate districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate, with half of the seats up for election each cycle. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the year 1998 is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1998年爱荷华州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。爱荷华州选民在州参议院一半的选区中选出议员，即全部25个奇数编号选区。州参议员任期四年，每两年改选一半席位。爱荷华州议会提供了1998年州参议院50个选区的全州地图。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1998 Texas Senate elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state senators in 16 State Senate districts. All of the seats up for this election were for four-year terms, with senators up for re-election in the 2002 elections. The winners of this election served in the 76th Texas Legislature.

zh.s: 1998年得克萨斯州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。得克萨斯州选民在16个州参议院选区选出议员。所有改选席位的任期均为四年，议员将在2002年选举中竞选连任。胜选者进入第76届得克萨斯州议会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1998 elections for the Pennsylvania State Senate were held on November 3, with 25 of 50 districts being contested. Primary elections were held on May 19, 1998. The term of office for those elected in 1998 began when the Senate convened in January 1999. Pennsylvania State Senators are elected for four-year terms, with half of the seats up for election every two years.

zh.t: 1998年宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举于1998年11月3日举行，50个选区中有25个改选。初选于1998年5月19日举行。1998年当选议员的任期于1999年1月州参议院召开会议时开始。宾夕法尼亚州参议员任期四年，每两年改选一半席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1998 Texas House of Representatives elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state representatives in all 150 State House of Representatives districts. The winners of this election served in the 76th Texas Legislature. State representatives serve for two-year terms. Republicans gained four seats from the Democrats, reducing the Democratic majority to 78 out of 150 seats.

zh.s: 1998年得克萨斯州众议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。得克萨斯州选民在州众议院全部150个选区选出议员。胜选者进入第76届得克萨斯州议会。州众议员任期两年。共和党从民主党手中增加4席，将民主党的多数席位缩小至150席中的78席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1999 J.League Cup final was the 7th final of the J.League Cup competition. The final was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on November 3, 1999. Kashiwa Reysol won the championship.

zh.s: 1999年日本联赛杯决赛是该项赛事的第七届决赛，于1999年11月3日在东京国立竞技场举行。柏太阳神夺得冠军。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina, 2000
en.s: The United States House of Representative elections of 2000 in North Carolina were held on 3 November 2000 as part of the biennial election to the United States House of Representatives. All twelve seats in North Carolina, and 435 nationwide, were elected. As in 1998, no districts changed hands, with the Republicans winning seven and the Democrats winning five of the twelve seats. All incumbents ran for office again, with all winning, meaning that no new representatives were elected. It is not to be confused with the election to the North Carolina House of Representatives, which was held on the same day.

zh.t: 2000年北卡罗来纳州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2000年北卡罗来纳州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，是每两年一次的美国联邦众议院选举的一部分。北卡罗来纳州的12个席位和全国435个席位都进行改选。与1998年一样，没有选区易手；共和党赢得12席中的7席，民主党赢得5席。所有现任议员都再次参选并成功当选，因此没有新议员产生。这场选举不要与同日举行的北卡罗来纳州议会选举混淆。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2001 Northern Mariana Islands general election was held on November 3, 2001, electing the governor and members to the legislature. The 2001 elections marked the last general election that the dissolved Reform Party, which merged back into the Democratic Party in 2002, would appear on the ballot.

zh.s: 2001年11月3日举行北马里亚纳群岛大选，选出州长和立法机构成员。这是已解散的改革党最后一次参加大选；该党于2002年重新并入民主党。

en.s: General elections were held in Singapore on 3 November 2001 to elect members of Parliament. They were the eleventh general elections since the introduction of self-government in 1959 and the ninth since independence in 1965. The number of parliamentary seats increased from 83 to 84 following adjustments to electoral boundaries.

zh.s: 2001年11月3日，新加坡举行大选，选出国会议员。这是新加坡自1959年实行自治以来的第11次大选，也是1965年独立以来的第9次。选区调整后，国会议席从83席增至84席。

en.s: The 2001 Rebellion was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the American promotion World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE) and broadcast exclusively in the United Kingdom. It was third annual Rebellion and took place on November 3, 2001, at the Manchester Evening News Arena in Manchester, England.

zh.s: 2001年《Rebellion》是由美国摔角联盟世界摔角联合会（WWF，现为WWE）举办的职业摔角付费观看赛事，仅在英国播出。这是该赛事连续举办的第三年，于11月3日在英格兰曼彻斯特的曼彻斯特晚报体育馆举行。

en.t: 2001 Green Party of Ontario leadership election
en.s: The 2001 Green Party of Ontario leadership election took place November 3, 2001 when Frank de Jong's leadership was challenged by GPO deputy leader Judy Greenwood-Speers of Waterloo, Ontario. De Jong, who had led the GPO since 1993, received 271 votes and defeated Greenwood-Speers.

zh.s: 2001年11月3日，安大略绿党副党魁、来自滑铁卢的朱迪·格林伍德-斯皮尔斯挑战弗兰克·德容的党魁职位。德容自1993年起领导该党，这次以271票击败格林伍德-斯皮尔斯。

en.s: General elections were held in Turkey on 3 November 2002 following the collapse of the Democratic Left Party–Nationalist Movement Party–Motherland Party coalition led by Bülent Ecevit. All 550 members of the Grand National Assembly were up for election. The elections were held during an ongoing economic crisis that followed the 2001 financial crash, which resulted in a deep resentment of coalition governments which had governed the country since the 1980 military coup.

zh.s: 2002年11月3日，土耳其举行大选。布伦特·埃杰维特领导的民主左翼党、民族主义行动党和祖国党联合政府垮台后，选举随之举行。大国民议会550个席位全部改选。选举期间，土耳其仍处于2001年金融危机引发的经济危机中，民众对自1980年军事政变以来执政的联合政府深感不满。

en.s: The 2002 Norwegian Football Cup final was the final match of the 2002 Norwegian Football Cup, the 97th season of the Norwegian Football Cup, the premier Norwegian football cup competition organized by the Football Association of Norway (NFF). The match was played on 3 November 2002 at the Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo, and opposed two Tippeligaen sides Odd Grenland and Vålerenga.

zh.s: 2002年挪威足球杯决赛是该项赛事第97个赛季的决赛，也是挪威足球协会组织的挪威顶级足球杯赛的冠军争夺战。比赛于2002年11月3日在奥斯陆乌勒瓦尔球场举行，由挪超球队奥德格伦兰和瓦勒伦加对阵。

en.s: One hundred and seventy-two municipalities in the Canadian province of Quebec held mayoral and council elections in late 2002. Most held their elections on November 3, although a small number chose alternate dates.

zh.s: 加拿大魁北克省172个市镇于2002年末举行市长和市议会选举。大多数选举在11月3日举行，少数市镇选择了其他日期。

en.s: 2003 J.League Cup final was the 11th final of the J.League Cup competition. The final was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on November 3, 2003. Urawa Reds won the championship.

zh.s: 2003年日本联赛杯决赛是该项赛事的第11届决赛，于2003年11月3日在东京国立竞技场举行。浦和红钻夺得冠军。

en.s: The Hengyang "11.3" especially serious fire was a fire that occurred in Hengzhou Tower, Hengyang, Hunan Province on the early morning of November 3, 2003. The fire did not result in the death of any civilians, though 20 firefighters were killed. The subsequent collapse of the building was listed as an 'especially serious collapse and fire' by government regulators, the public security bureau and various inspectors, and the death of 20 firefighters was the largest loss of firefighters in China since 1949.

zh.s: 2003年11月3日凌晨，湖南省衡阳市衡州大厦发生特大火灾。火灾没有造成平民死亡，但有20名消防员殉职。此后，大楼坍塌一事被政府监管部门、公安部门和多名检查人员列为“特别重大坍塌和火灾事故”。1949年以来，消防员在中国因火灾事故死亡的人数中，此次20人的伤亡规模最大。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina, 2004
en.s: The United States House of Representative elections of 2004 in North Carolina were held on November 3, 2004 as part of the biennial election to the United States House of Representatives. All thirteen seats in North Carolina, and 435 nationwide, were elected. The parties' positions were unchanged. The Democrats gained in the popular vote share across the state, thanks predominantly to running candidates in two districts they hadn't contested in 2002. However, no districts changed hands. Two new Republican representatives were elected to replace non-running incumbents: Patrick McHenry and Virginia Foxx. G. K.

zh.t: 2004年美国北卡罗来纳州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2004年美国北卡罗来纳州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，属于两年一度的联邦众议院选举。北卡罗来纳州的13个席位与全国435个席位全部改选。两党席位分布没有变化。民主党在全州普选票中的占比上升，主要因为他们在两个2002年未推出候选人的选区参选。不过没有选区易手。两名共和党新议员帕特里克·麦克亨利和弗吉尼娅·福克斯取代了不再参选的现任议员。

en.s: The 2004 J.League Cup final was the 12th final of the J.League Cup competition. The final was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on November 3, 2004. FC Tokyo won the championship.

zh.s: 2004年日本联赛杯决赛是该项赛事的第12届决赛，于2004年11月3日在东京国立竞技场举行。东京FC夺得冠军。

en.s: El Castillo del Terror (2005) was the first annual El Castillo del Terror professional wrestling event produced by the International Wrestling Revolution Group. It took place on November 3, 2005, at Arena Naucalpan in Naucalpan, State of Mexico. The show featured the eponymous main event match; a 10-man Steel Cage Match where the last twp men in the cage were forced to wrestle each other and the loser would be forced to unmask or have his hair shaved off under Luchas de Apuestas, or "Bet rules". For the 2005 event Blue Demon, Jr., Cerebro Negro, Dr.

zh.s: 2005年的El Castillo del Terror是国际摔角革命集团主办的首届同名职业摔角赛事。赛事于2005年11月3日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。主赛是一场十人钢铁牢笼赛：最后留在牢笼中的两人必须继续比赛，败者将按“赌注赛”规则摘下面具或剃掉头发。
