en.s: The 2006 J.League Cup final was the 14th final of the J.League Cup competition. The final was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on 3 November 2006. JEF United Chiba won the championship.

zh.s: 2006年J联赛杯决赛是该赛事第14届决赛。比赛于2006年11月3日在东京国立竞技场举行，千叶市原队夺冠。

en.s: General elections were held in the Northern Mariana Islands on 3 November 2007, alongside a double referendum. The Republican Party won a majority of seats in the House of Representatives, whilst both referendums were approved.

zh.s: 2007年11月3日，北马里亚纳群岛举行大选，并同时举行两项公投。共和党赢得众议院多数席位，两项公投也都获得通过。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: 2007 J.League Cup final was the 15th final of the J.League Cup competition. The final was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on November 3, 2007. Gamba Osaka won the championship.

zh.s: 2007年J联赛杯决赛是该赛事第15届决赛。比赛于2007年11月3日在东京国立竞技场举行，大阪钢巴队夺冠。

en.s: The Wech Baghtu wedding party airstrike refers to the killing of 63 people including 37 Afghan civilians, mostly women and children, and 26 insurgents by a United States military airstrike on November 3, 2008. The group was celebrating a wedding at a housing complex in the village of Wech Baghtu, a Taliban stronghold in the Shah Wali Kot District of Kandahar province, Afghanistan.

zh.t: 韦奇巴赫图婚礼空袭事件
zh.s: 韦奇巴赫图婚礼空袭事件指美国军方于2008年11月3日发动空袭，造成63人死亡，其中包括37名阿富汗平民（多数为妇女和儿童）以及26名武装人员。空袭发生时，这群人正在阿富汗坎大哈省沙瓦利科特县、塔利班据点韦奇巴赫图村的一处住宅区参加婚礼。

en.s: The following offices were up for election in the United States State of New Jersey in the general election on November 3, 2009: * Two statewide offices – Governor of New Jersey and Lieutenant Governor of New Jersey – for four-year terms. * All 80 seats in the New Jersey General Assembly, the lower house in the New Jersey Legislature – for two-year terms * Various county and local offices throughout the state Persons 18 years or older on the general election date (born on or before November 3, 1991) were eligible to register and vote in the general election.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日新泽西州举行普选，选出以下职位：州长和副州长，任期四年；新泽西州议会下院新泽西州众议院的全部80个席位，任期两年；以及全州各县和地方的多个职位。凡在普选日年满18岁的人（即1991年11月3日或之前出生者）都可以登记并参加投票。

en.s: The 2009 Minneapolis mayoral election was held on November 3, 2009 to elect the Mayor of Minneapolis for a four-year term. Incumbent R. T. Rybak won re-election for a third term in the first round with 73.6% of the vote. This was the first mayoral election in the city's history to use instant-runoff voting, popularly known as ranked choice voting. Voters had the option of ranking up to three candidates. Municipal elections in Minnesota are nonpartisan, although candidates were able to identify with a political party on the ballot.

zh.s: 2009年明尼阿波利斯市长选举于11月3日举行，选出任期四年的市长。时任市长R·T·赖巴克在第一轮投票中获得73.6%的选票，成功连任第三个任期。这是该市历史上首次使用即时决选投票，也称排序选择投票。选民最多可以为三名候选人排序。明尼苏达州的市政选举不按党派划分，但候选人可以在选票上注明自己的政党。

en.s: A general election was held in Minneapolis on November 3, 2009. Minneapolis's mayor was up for election as well as all the seats on the Minneapolis City Council, the two popularly elected seats on the Board of Estimate and Taxation, and all the seats on the Park and Recreation Board. This was the first election held in Minneapolis to use ranked choice voting, a collective term for instant-runoff voting and the single transferable vote. Because city voters approved a city charter change by referendum in 2006 to use a ranked choice voting system, Minneapolis did not hold a primary election on September 8, the 2009 date for primaries in Minnesota.

zh.s: 明尼阿波利斯于2009年11月3日举行普选，选举市长、市议会全部席位、估值与税务委员会两个民选席位，以及公园与休闲委员会全部席位。这是该市首次采用排序选择投票；该名称统称即时决选投票和单一可转移投票。2006年，市民公投通过修改城市宪章，决定采用排序选择投票制度，因此明尼阿波利斯没有在明尼苏达州原定的2009年9月8日初选日举行初选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2009 Minneapolis City Council elections were held on November 3, 2009 to elect the 13 members of the Minneapolis City Council for four-year terms. Candidates affiliated with the Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL) won 12 seats and the Green Party of Minnesota one seat. Members were elected from single-member districts via instant-runoff voting, popularly known as ranked choice voting. Voters had the option of ranking up to three candidates. Municipal elections in Minnesota are nonpartisan, although candidates were able to identify with a political party on the ballot.

zh.t: 2009年明尼阿波利斯市议会选举
zh.s: 2009年明尼阿波利斯市议会选举于11月3日举行，选出13名市议会议员，任期四年。与明尼苏达民主党—农民—劳工党（DFL）有关联的候选人赢得12席，明尼苏达州绿党候选人赢得1席。议员由单一席位选区选出，采用即时决选投票，也称排序选择投票。选民最多可以为三名候选人排序。明尼苏达州的市政选举不按党派划分，但候选人可以在选票上注明自己的政党。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The United States gubernatorial elections of 2009 were held on November 3, 2009 in the states of New Jersey and Virginia as well as in the U.S. commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands on November 7, 2009. Both state governorships were previously held by Democrats elected in 2005 and as a result of the 2009 elections both are presently held by Republicans; the local Covenant Party maintained control of the governorship of the Marianas. These elections formed part of the 2009 United States elections.

zh.s: 2009年美国州长选举于11月3日在新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州举行，北马里亚纳群岛则于11月7日举行选举。新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州此前的州长职位均由2005年当选的民主党人担任；2009年选举后，两州州长均由共和党人担任。北马里亚纳群岛的州长职位仍由当地盟约党控制。这些选举是2009年美国选举的一部分。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 2009 took place on November 3, 2009. Democratic Governor Jon Corzine was running for a second term and was being challenged by Republican Chris Christie, Independent Christopher Daggett and nine others, in addition to several write-in candidates. Christie won the election, with about 48.5 percent of the vote, to 44.9 percent for Corzine and 5.8 percent for Daggett. Christie won the largest margin for a first term Republican since 1969. Christie assumed office on January 19, 2010. This was the first election to fill the newly created office of Lieutenant Governor.

zh.s: 2009年新泽西州州长选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍州长乔恩·科尔津竞选第二个任期，对手包括共和党人克里斯·克里斯蒂、独立候选人克里斯托弗·达格特和另外9人，此外还有数名写入候选人。克里斯蒂赢得选举，获得约48.5%的选票；科尔津和达格特分别获得44.9%和5.8%。这是自1969年以来，首次竞选州长的共和党候选人取得的最大领先幅度。克里斯蒂于2010年1月19日就任。这也是首次选举新设的副州长职位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Virginia gubernatorial election of 2009 took place on November 3, 2009. The election chose Bob McDonnell as the next Governor, Bill Bolling re-elected as Lieutenant Governor, and Ken Cuccinelli as the next Attorney General of the Commonwealth of Virginia. The winners were inaugurated on January 16, 2010, and will serve until January 2014. The current Governor, Democrat Tim Kaine, was not eligible to run due to term limits established by the Virginia Constitution, though others in the state's executive branch were not restricted. Virginia is the only state that prohibits its Governor from immediate successive terms.

zh.s: 2009年弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月3日举行。选民选出鲍勃·麦克唐纳担任下一任州长、比尔·博林连任副州长，以及肯·库奇内利担任下一任弗吉尼亚州总检察长。胜选者于2010年1月16日宣誓就职，任期至2014年1月。时任民主党州长蒂姆·凯恩受弗吉尼亚州宪法的任期限制，不能参选；州政府行政部门的其他官员则不受此限制。弗吉尼亚州是唯一禁止州长立即连任的州。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: New York City Public Advocate election, 2009
en.s: The election of the New York City Public Advocate took place on Tuesday, November 3, 2009, along with elections for the mayor, the city comptroller, borough presidents, and members of the New York City Council. The Democratic candidate, Bill de Blasio, won election with 77% of the vote against 18% for the Republican nominee, Alex Zablocki, 3.6% for the Conservative nominee, William Lee, and 1.7% for two others. The public advocate has the formal role of presiding over meetings of the New York City Council (although the Speaker elected by the Council itself now does much of this work), and, until the next election, would serve as acting Mayor whenever the elected Mayor is unable to serve.

zh.s: 纽约市公共辩护人选举于2009年11月3日星期二举行，与市长、市审计长、各区区长和纽约市议会议员选举同时进行。民主党候选人比尔·白思豪赢得选举，获得77%的选票；共和党候选人亚历克斯·扎布洛基获得18%，保守党候选人威廉·李获得3.6%，另外两名候选人合计获得1.7%。公共辩护人正式负责主持纽约市议会会议（不过，现在议会自行选出的议长承担了其中大部分工作）；直到下次选举前，若当选市长无法履职，公共辩护人将代理市长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: California's 10th congressional district special election, 2009 was held on November 3, 2009, to fill the vacancy caused in California's 10th congressional district by the resignation of Ellen Tauscher. Democratic Party candidate John Garamendi won against Republican opponent David Harmer.

zh.t: 2009年加利福尼亚州第10国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 2009年11月3日举行加利福尼亚州第10国会选区特别选举，以填补埃伦·陶舍辞职后留下的空缺。民主党候选人约翰·加拉门迪击败共和党对手戴维·哈默。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 2009 occurred on Tuesday, November 3, 2009 between then incumbent mayor Thomas Menino, and Michael Flaherty, current City Councilor and former City Council President. Menino was re-elected and served a fifth term, the first mayor to do so in Boston's history. The nonpartisan municipal preliminary election was held on September 22, 2009.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日，时任市长托马斯·梅尼诺与市议员、前市议会主席迈克尔·弗莱厄蒂角逐波士顿市长。梅尼诺成功连任第五届，成为波士顿首位做到这一点的市长。无党派市政初选于2009年9月22日举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2009 Cincinnati mayoral election took place on November 3, 2009, to elect the Mayor of Cincinnati, Ohio. Usually a nonpartisan primary is held where the top two candidates move on to the general election, however, incumbent mayor Mark Mallory and Brad Wenstrup were the only two candidates to file, so no primary election was held.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日举行辛辛那提市长选举。通常会先举行无党派初选，由得票最高的两名候选人进入大选；但这次只有在任市长马克·马洛里和布拉德·温斯特鲁普登记参选，因此没有举行初选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2009 St. Petersburg, Florida, mayoral election was held on November 3, 2009, following a primary election on September 1, 2009. Incumbent Mayor Rick Baker was barred by term limits from seeking a third term, and a crowded race emerged to succeed him. Former City Councilmember Bill Foster placed first in the primary election with 27 percent of the vote and advanced to the general election against former City Councilmember Kathleen Ford, a 2001 candidate for Mayor.

zh.t: 2009年佛罗里达州圣彼得堡市长选举
zh.s: 2009年佛罗里达州圣彼得堡市长选举于11月3日举行，初选在9月1日举行。时任市长里克·贝克因任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。多名候选人参选，争夺接替他的职位。前市议员比尔·福斯特在初选中以27%的得票率排名第一，晋级大选；他将在大选中对阵前市议员凯瑟琳·福特。福特曾于2001年竞选市长。

en.s: The 2009 New Jersey General Assembly elections were held on November 3, 2009, for all 80 seats in the lower house of the New Jersey Legislature. The election coincided with a gubernatorial election where Democratic incumbent Governor Jon Corzine was defeated by Republican challenger Chris Christie. Democrats held a 48–32 majority in the lower house prior to the election.

zh.s: 2009年新泽西州众议院选举于2009年11月3日举行，改选新泽西州议会下院全部80个席位。此次选举与州长选举同时举行，民主党籍现任州长乔恩·科津败给共和党挑战者克里斯·克里斯蒂。选举前，民主党在州众议院以48比32占多数。

en.s: The 2009 Detroit mayoral election took place on November 3, 2009, following a primary on August 12, 2009. Incumbent Mayor Dave Bing, who was elected Mayor in a May special election, ran for a full term. Bing placed first in the primary by a wide margin, winning 74 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2009年底特律市长选举于11月3日举行，初选在8月12日举行。时任市长戴夫·宾在5月的特别选举中当选，此次竞选完整任期。他在初选中以较大优势排名第一，获得74%的选票。

en.s: The 2009 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 2009, to elect the lieutenant governor of Virginia. Incumbent Republican lieutenant governor Bill Bolling successfully ran for reelection to a second term in office, defeating Democrat Jody Wagner. This is the last time a lieutenant governor was re-elected.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日举行弗吉尼亚州副州长选举。在任共和党副州长比尔·博林击败民主党人乔迪·瓦格纳，成功连任第二届。这是弗吉尼亚州副州长最后一次成功连任。

en.s: The 2009 Virginia attorney general election took place in Virginia on November 3, 2009. Incumbent Attorney General Bob McDonnell was eligible for re-election, but instead opted to successfully run for Governor of Virginia. McDonnell resigned from his position in 2009 to run for governor, being succeeded by his deputy, Bill Mims. The Republican party nominated State Senator Ken Cuccinelli, who easily defeated the Democratic candidate, Delegate Steve Shannon.

zh.t: 2009年弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2009年11月3日举行弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举。在任总检察长鲍勃·麦克唐纳原本可以竞选连任，但他转而竞选州长并成功当选。麦克唐纳于2009年辞职，由副总检察长比尔·米姆斯接任。共和党提名州参议员肯·库奇内利参选，他轻松击败民主党候选人、州众议员史蒂夫·香农。

en.s: The 2009 Toledo, Ohio mayoral election took place on November 3, 2009, to elect the mayor of Toledo, Ohio. Incumbent Mayor Carty Finkbeiner declined to run for re-election to a second consecutive term and fourth term overall. A crowded field emerged to succeed him, including former city fire chief Mike Bell, City Councilman D. Michael Collins, County commissioners Ben Konop, former County Commissioner and 2005 mayoral candidate Keith Wilkowski, and businessman James Moody.

zh.t: 2009年俄亥俄州托莱多市长选举
zh.s: 2009年俄亥俄州托莱多市长选举于11月3日举行。时任市长卡蒂·芬克拜纳放弃竞选连任，因此出现多人争夺市长职位。参选者包括前市消防局长迈克·贝尔、市议员D·迈克尔·柯林斯、县委员本·科诺普、前县委员及2005年市长候选人基思·威尔科夫斯基，以及商人詹姆斯·穆迪。

en.t: 2009 New York City borough president elections
en.s: The 2009 New York City borough president elections were held on November 3, 2009 to elect the presidents of each of the five boroughs in New York City. They coincided with other city elections, including for mayor, comptroller, public advocate, and city council. Primary elections were held on September 15, 2009.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日举行纽约市5个行政区的区长选举，与市长、审计长、公共倡议专员和市议会等职位选举同时进行。初选于2009年9月15日举行。

en.s: The 2009 mayoral election in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania was held on November 3, 2009, and resulted in incumbent Democratic mayor Stephen R. Reed, who had been mayor since 1982, losing in the primary to Linda D. Thompson who went on to defeat Republican Nevin J. Mindlin to become the city's first female and first black mayor.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日举行宾夕法尼亚州哈里斯堡市长选举。在任民主党市长斯蒂芬·R·里德自1982年起担任市长，他在初选中败给琳达·D·汤普森。汤普森随后击败共和党人内文·J·明德林，当选该市首位女性及首位非裔市长。

en.s: The 2009 election for New York City Comptroller was held on November 3, 2009, to coincide with the 2009 mayoral election to determine who would serve as New York City Comptroller. The Democratic and Republican primaries were held on September 15, 2009. There was a run-off election for the Democratic Party nomination on September 29, 2009. Joe Mendola was nominated as the Republican candidate.

zh.s: 2009年纽约市主计长选举于11月3日举行，与市长选举同期进行，以选出纽约市主计长。民主党和共和党初选于9月15日举行；民主党提名还在9月29日举行了决选。乔·门多拉获得共和党提名。

en.s: The 2009 Miami mayoral election took place on November 3, 2009. Incumbent Mayor Manny Diaz was term-limited and unable to seek re-election to a third term. Two candidates ran to succeed him: City Commissioner Tomás Regalado and City Commission Chairman Joe Sanchez.

zh.s: 2009年迈阿密市长选举于2009年11月3日举行。受任期限制，现任市长曼尼·迪亚斯不能竞选第三个任期。两名候选人角逐接替他：市委员托马斯·雷加拉多和市委员会主席乔·桑切斯。

en.s: The 2009 mayoral election in Allentown, Pennsylvania was held on November 3, 2009, and resulted in the incumbent mayor Ed Pawlowski, a member of the Democratic Party, being re-elected to a second term over Republican Party candidate Tony Phillips.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日举行宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦市长选举。民主党籍在任市长埃德·帕夫洛夫斯基击败共和党候选人托尼·菲利普斯，成功连任第二届。

en.s: 2009 Elections to the Virginia House of Delegates were held on November 3, 2009. Prior to the election, Republicans held 53 seats, Democrats held 43 seats, and Independents held 2 seats (both of whom caucus with the Republicans). There were 2 seats previously held by Democrats that were vacant on election day: the 69th (Frank Hall resigned April 14, 2009) and the 80th (Ken Melvin resigned May 1, 2009).

zh.s: 2009年弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于2009年11月3日举行。选举前，共和党占53席，民主党占43席，独立人士占2席（两人都与共和党组成党团）。选举日有两个原由民主党占据的席位空缺：第69选区席位因弗兰克·霍尔于2009年4月14日辞职而空出，第80选区席位因肯·梅尔文于2009年5月1日辞职而空出。

en.s: A mayoral election took place in Buffalo, New York, on November 3, 2009. Incumbent Democratic mayor Byron Brown won re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日，纽约州布法罗举行市长选举。民主党籍现任市长拜伦·布朗再次当选，开始第二个任期。

en.s: 2009 J.League Cup final was the 17th final of the J.League Cup competition. The final was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on November 3, 2009. FC Tokyo won the championship.

zh.s: 2009年J联赛杯决赛是该赛事第17届决赛。比赛于2009年11月3日在东京国立竞技场举行，FC东京队夺冠。

en.s: The 2009 Lehigh County Executive election was held on November 3, 2009. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Don Cunningham ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by Republican nominee Scott Ott, a satirical website publisher. Despite Cunningham's fundraising advantage and stronger name recognition, he was expected to win by a wide margin, but only narrowly defeated Ott, winning 51–49 percent, a margin of just 862 votes.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日举行利海县行政长官选举。在任民主党行政长官唐·坎宁安竞选连任第二届，对手是共和党提名人斯科特·奥特，一名讽刺网站出版人。尽管坎宁安筹款更多、知名度更高，原本被认为会大幅领先，但最终仅以51%对49%的得票率险胜奥特，领先862票。

en.s: The 2009 Cleveland mayoral election took place on November 3, 2009, to elect the Mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the September 8 primary advancing to the general election, regardless of party.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日举行俄亥俄州克利夫兰市长选举。选举正式设为无党派选举，9月8日初选中得票最高的两名候选人进入大选，不受党派限制。

en.s: The 2009 AFC Cup final was a football match played on Tuesday, 3 November 2009 between Al-Kuwait and Al-Karamah. It was the 6th final of the AFC Cup and was the first time the final match to be played in a one-off format. The game was played at Al Kuwait Sports Club Stadium, being the home ground of Al-Kuwait. Al-Kuwait won the title by winning over Al-Karamah 2–1.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日，科威特和卡拉马队进行亚足联杯决赛。这是亚足联杯第六届决赛，也是决赛首次采用单场赛制。比赛在科威特队的主场科威特体育俱乐部体育场举行，科威特队以2比1击败卡拉马队，夺得冠军。

en.s: The 2009 Winston-Salem mayoral election was held on November 3, 2009, to elect the mayor of Winston-Salem, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of Allen Joines.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日，北卡罗来纳州温斯顿-塞勒姆举行市长选举。在任市长艾伦·乔因斯成功连任。

en.s: The 2009 Northampton County Executive election was held on November 3, 2009. Incumbent Democratic County Executive John Stoffa ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged in the Democratic primary by County Council President Ann McHale, and won renomination with 57 percent of the vote. Hoffa was originally set to face Republican nominee J. C.

zh.t: 2009年北安普顿县行政长官选举
zh.s: 北安普顿县于2009年11月3日举行行政长官选举。时任民主党行政长官约翰·斯托法竞选连任第二届。县议会主席安·麦克海尔在民主党初选中挑战他；斯托法以57%的得票率再次获得提名。斯托法原定在大选中对阵共和党候选人J. C。

en.s: The 2009 Houston mayoral election took place on November 3, 2009, to elect the successor to incumbent Mayor Bill White. White was ineligible for re-election, having served three terms. The race is officially nonpartisan. After no candidate received a majority of the votes, the top two candidates – City Controller Annise Parker and former City Attorney Gene Locke – faced each other in a runoff election on December 12, 2009.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日举行休斯敦市长选举，选出接替在任市长比尔·怀特的人选。怀特已任职三届，不能竞选连任。选举正式设为无党派选举。没有候选人获得过半数选票，因此得票最高的两名候选人——市审计长安妮丝·帕克和前市检察官吉恩·洛克——进入12月12日举行的决选。

en.s: The 2009 Lansing mayoral election took place on November 3, 2009, with a primary election taking place on August 4, 2009. Incumbent Mayor Virgil Bernero ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by City Councilwoman Carol Wood and Charles Ford, a member of the Lansing Board of Education. Bernero placed first over Wood in the primary election, 44–38 percent, and then defeated Wood by a wide margin in the general election, winning 62–37 percent.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日举行兰辛市长选举，初选于2009年8月4日举行。在任市长维吉尔·贝尔内罗竞选连任第二届，对手是市议员卡罗尔·伍德和兰辛教育委员会成员查尔斯·福特。贝尔内罗在初选中以44%对38%的得票率领先伍德，并在大选中以62%对37%的得票率大幅获胜。

en.s: The 2009 Durham mayoral election was held on November 3, 2009, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Bill Bell.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日举行北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市长选举。在任市长比尔·贝尔成功连任。

en.t: 2009 New York's 23rd congressional district special election
en.s: The 2009 special election for New York's 23rd congressional district was held on November 3, 2009, to select the successor to Republican John M. McHugh. McHugh was nominated to become United States Secretary of the Army on June 2, 2009, and resigned as representative of New York's 23rd congressional district on September 21, 2009, after being confirmed by the Senate.

zh.t: 2009年纽约州第23国会选区联邦众议员特别选举
zh.s: 2009年纽约州第23国会选区特别选举于2009年11月3日举行，选出共和党人约翰·M·麦克休的继任者。麦克休于2009年6月2日获提名出任美国陆军部长，并于9月21日获参议院确认后辞去联邦众议员职务。

en.s: The 2009 King County Executive election took place on November 3, 2009, following a primary on August 18, 2009. County Executive Ron Sims resigned on May 8, 2009, to become the Deputy Secretary of the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, and designated his chief of staff, Kurt Triplett, as his temporary successor. He was subsequently selected by the County Council to serve as interim County Executive until the November election.

zh.s: 2009年金县行政长官选举于2009年11月3日举行，初选于8月18日举行。县行政长官罗恩·西姆斯于2009年5月8日辞职，转任美国住房和城市发展部副部长，并指定其幕僚长库尔特·特里普莱特暂代职务。此后，县议会选定特里普莱特担任临时行政长官，直至11月选举。

en.s: The 2009 San Bernardino mayoral election was held on November 3, 2009, to elect the mayor of San Bernardino, California. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Pat Morris. A candidate won out right pass 50% No runoff was needed.

zh.s: 2009年11月3日举行加利福尼亚州圣贝纳迪诺市长选举。在任市长帕特·莫里斯成功连任。没有候选人直接获得超过50%的选票，因此无需举行决选。

en.s: Pittsburgh held a mayoral election on November 3, 2009. Incumbent mayor Luke Ravenstahl, a Democrat, defeated his two independent challengers by a wide margin. The 2009 election was the first regular-cycle election in which Ravenstahl participated; he was originally appointed as an interim mayor to succeed Bob O'Connor and subsequently won a special election in 2007.

zh.s: 匹兹堡于2009年11月3日举行市长选举。民主党籍时任市长卢克·雷文斯塔尔以明显优势击败两名独立候选人。2009年是雷文斯塔尔首次参加按常规周期举行的市长选举。他最初被任命为临时市长，接替鲍勃·奥康纳，之后于2007年赢得特别选举。

en.s: The 2009 Seattle mayoral election took place November 3, 2009. Incumbent Seattle Mayor Greg Nickels sought re-election to a third term as the position of Seattle mayor has no term limits but finished third in the August 18, 2009 nonpartisan primary election. The general election was instead between Joe Mallahan and Michael McGinn. McGinn beat Mallahan in the election with 51%.

zh.s: 2009年西雅图市长选举于11月3日举行。西雅图没有市长任期限制，时任市长格雷格·尼克尔斯竞选第三个任期，但在8月18日举行的无党派初选中排名第三。最终进入大选的是乔·马拉汉和迈克尔·麦金。麦金以51%的得票率击败马拉汉。

en.s: The 2009 Erie County Executive election was held on November 3, 2009. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Mark A. DiVecchio ran for re-election to a second term. However, he was defeated in the Democratic primary by restaurant owner Barry Grossman. In the general election, Grossman faced Mike Kerner, a manufacturing executive and the Republican nominee. Grossman narrowly defeated Kerner, winning by a 343-vote margin.

zh.t: 2009年宾夕法尼亚州伊利县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2009年伊利县行政长官选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任县行政长官马克·A·迪维奇奥竞选连任第二个任期，但在民主党初选中败给餐馆老板巴里·格罗斯曼。格罗斯曼在大选中对阵共和党提名人、制造业高管迈克·科纳。格罗斯曼以343票的优势险胜。

en.t: Mayoral elections in Syracuse, New York
en.s: Elections are held in Syracuse, New York, to choose the city's mayor. Currently, these elections are regularly scheduled to be held once every four years, with the elections taking place in the off-year immediately after United States presidential election years. The current mayor of Syracuse is Sharon Owens, who assumed office in 2026.

zh.t: 纽约州锡拉丘兹市长选举
zh.s: 纽约州锡拉丘兹举行市长选举，选出该市市长。目前，选举通常每四年举行一次，安排在美国总统选举年的次年，也就是所谓的非选举年。锡拉丘兹现任市长为莎伦·欧文斯，她于2026年就任。

en.s: The 2009 election for Mayor of New York City took place on Tuesday, November 3. Incumbent Michael Bloomberg, an independent who left the Republican Party in 2007, was reelected on the Republican and Independence Party/Jobs & Education lines with 50.7% of the vote, over the retiring City Comptroller, Bill Thompson, a Democrat (also endorsed by the Working Families Party), who won 46.3%.

zh.s: 纽约市市长选举于2009年11月3日星期二举行。独立人士迈克尔·布隆伯格于2007年退出共和党，此次以共和党和独立党／就业与教育党候选人身份参选，以50.7%的得票率击败民主党人、即将卸任的市审计长比尔·汤普森。汤普森还得到工人家庭党的支持，得票率为46.3%。

en.s: El Castillo del Terror (2011) was a major annually occurring professional wrestling event produced by the International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG) that took place on November 3, 2011. The event was the eleventh show held under the El Castillo del Terror banner, with the first taking place in 2000. The main event was the eponymous Castillo del Terror (Spanish for "Castle of Terror") Steel cage match where the last person eliminated would be forced to take off his mask per the match stipulation.

zh.s: 2011年El Castillo del Terror是国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）每年举办的大型职业摔角赛事，于2011年11月3日举行。这是以“El Castillo del Terror”为名的第11场赛事；首场于2000年举行。主赛是同名的“恐怖城堡”铁笼赛；按照比赛规则，最后一名被淘汰的选手必须摘下面具。

en.s: The Rif Dimashq clashes were a series of unrests and armed clashes in and around Damascus, the capital of Syria, from November 2011 until a stalemate in March 2012. The violence was part of the wider early insurgency phase of the Syrian civil war. Large pro-government and anti-government protests took place in the suburbs and center of Damascus, with the situation escalating when members of the Free Syrian Army (FSA) started attacking military targets in November.

en.t: World Series of Fighting 1: Arlovski vs. Cole
en.s: World Series of Fighting 1: Arlovski vs. Cole was the inaugural event of the promotion held on November 3, 2012 (2012-11-03) at the Planet Hollywood Resort and Casino in Las Vegas, United States. The main card began at 10:30 p.m. Eastern Time and the preliminary card was streamed on Sherdog.com.

zh.t: 世界格斗系列赛1：阿尔洛夫斯基对阵科尔
zh.s: 世界格斗系列赛1：阿尔洛夫斯基对阵科尔是该赛事的首场比赛，于2012年11月3日在美国拉斯维加斯的好莱坞星球度假村赌场举行。主赛于美国东部时间晚上10点30分开始，预赛通过Sherdog.com直播。

en.s: Match for Michaela was a Gaelic football match played under floodlights at Casement Park in Belfast on Saturday 3 November 2012. The match was held in memory of Michaela McAreavey.

zh.t: 为米凯拉举行的盖尔式足球赛
zh.s: “为米凯拉举行的比赛”是一场盖尔式足球赛，于2012年11月3日星期六在贝尔法斯特的卡瑟门特公园灯光球场举行，以纪念米凯拉·麦卡雷维。

en.s: The 2012 AFC Cup final was a football match which was played on 3 November 2012, to determine the champion of the 2012 AFC Cup. It was the final of the 8th edition of the AFC Cup, a competition organized by the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) for clubs from "developing countries" in Asia. The final was played between Erbil from Iraq and Al-Kuwait from Kuwait.

zh.s: 2012年亚足联杯决赛于2012年11月3日举行，决出该届赛事冠军。这是亚足联杯第8届决赛。该赛事由亚洲足球联合会主办，参赛俱乐部来自亚洲的“发展中国家”。决赛由伊拉克的埃尔比勒对阵科威特的科威特体育俱乐部。

en.s: The 2012 Congolese–Rwandan border clash was a minor skirmish that occurred along the two countries' border that resulted in the deaths of three soldiers.

zh.s: 2012年刚果（金）—卢旺达边境冲突是两国边境发生的一次小规模交火，造成3名士兵死亡。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in the city of Montreal, Quebec, Canada on 3 November 2013 as part of the 2013 Quebec municipal elections. Voters elected 65 positions on the Montreal City Council, including the mayor, borough mayors, and city councillors, as well as 38 borough councillors. Dennis Coderre replaced interim mayor Laurent Blanchard, who was elected to replace the previous interim mayor, Michael Applebaum, who resigned due to 14 charges laid against him including fraud, conspiracy, breach of trust, and corruption in municipal affairs. Previous elected mayor Gérald Tremblay left office on 5 November 2012 after his party Union Montréal was suspected of corruption and mafia involvement.

zh.s: 加拿大魁北克省蒙特利尔市于2013年11月3日举行市政选举，是2013年魁北克市政选举的一部分。选民选出65名蒙特利尔市议会成员，包括市长、各区区长和市议员，以及38名区议员。丹尼斯·科德尔接替临时市长洛朗·布朗沙尔；布朗沙尔此前接替因涉及欺诈、共谋、背信和市政事务腐败等14项指控而辞职的前临时市长迈克尔·阿普尔鲍姆。此前当选的市长热拉尔·特朗布莱于2012年11月5日离任；其政党蒙特利尔联盟被怀疑涉及腐败和黑手党活动。

en.s: El Castillo del Terror (2013) was a professional wrestling event, the tenth annual El Castillo del Terror event produced by the International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG). IWRG has held an Castillo del Terror branded show since 2005, usually late in the year, making this year's event the ninth overall event in the series. The event took place on November 3, 2013, at Arena Naucalpan in Naucalpan, State of Mexico, IWRG's main arena. The main event was the eponymous Castillo del Terror (Spanish for "Castle of Terror") Steel cage match where the last person eliminated was forced to unmasked per the match stipulation.

zh.t: 2013年El Castillo del Terror职业摔角赛
zh.s: 2013年El Castillo del Terror是国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）举办的第十届同名职业摔角赛事。IWRG自2005年以来持续举办“El Castillo del Terror”品牌赛事，通常在年底举行，因此2013年的赛事是该系列整体的第九场。赛事于2013年11月3日在IWRG的主场馆——墨西哥州纳乌卡尔潘的纳乌卡尔潘竞技场举行。主赛是同名的“恐怖城堡”铁笼赛；按照比赛规则，最后一名被淘汰的选手必须摘下面具。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in the city of Westmount, Quebec, Canada on November 3, 2013 as part of the 2013 Quebec municipal elections. Voters elected 8 positions on the Westmount City Council, as well as one mayor. On October 4th, Mayor Peter Trent, as well as councillors Nicole Forbes and Victor Drury were acclaimed. Councillors Tim Price of District 2 and Gary Ikeman of District 5 will not be seeking another term on council.

zh.s: 2013年11月3日，加拿大魁北克省韦斯特蒙特市举行市政选举，属于2013年魁北克市政选举的一部分。选民选出8名市议员和一名市长。10月4日，市长彼得·特伦特以及市议员妮科尔·福布斯和维克托·德鲁里因无人竞争而直接当选。第二选区议员蒂姆·普赖斯和第五选区议员加里·艾克曼不会竞选连任。

en.s: The 2013 Longueuil municipal election took place on November 3, 2013, to elect a mayor and city councillors in Longueuil, Quebec, Canada. This is in conjunction with 2013 Quebec municipal elections that was held across the province on the same date. Longueuil City Council voted to reduce the number of councillors from 26 to 15 in time for the 2013 municipal election.

en.s: The 2013 Quebec City municipal election took place on November 3, 2013, to elect a mayor and city councillors in Quebec City, Quebec, Canada. Quebec City Council voted to reduce the number of councillors from 27 to 21 in time for the 2013 municipal election.

en.s: The 2013 FAI Women's Cup final was the final match of the 2013 FAI Women's Cup, the national association football Cup of the Republic of Ireland. The match took place on 3 November 2013 at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin. Raheny United and Castlebar Celtic contested the match. The match was shown live on RTÉ2 and RTÉ2 HD in Ireland and was refereed by Marie Ward, assisted by Deirdre Nolan and Olivia Syned with Natasha Valenti as Fourth Official.

zh.s: 2013年爱尔兰足协女子杯决赛是该项爱尔兰共和国全国足球杯赛的决赛。比赛于2013年11月3日在都柏林的英杰华体育场举行，由拉赫尼联队对阵卡斯尔巴凯尔特人队。爱尔兰RTÉ2和RTÉ2高清频道对比赛进行直播。裁判为玛丽·沃德，助理裁判为迪尔德丽·诺兰和奥利维娅·西内德，第四官员为娜塔莎·瓦伦蒂。

en.s: The 2013 FAI Cup final was the final match of the 2013 FAI Cup, the national association football cup of the Republic of Ireland. The match took place on 3 November 2013 at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin. Drogheda United and Sligo Rovers contested the match. The match was shown live on RTÉ Two and RTÉ Two HD in Ireland and was refereed by Paul Tuite, assisted by Damien MacGraith and Michelle O’Neill with Derek Tomney as Fourth Official.

zh.s: 2013年爱尔兰足协杯决赛是爱尔兰共和国全国足球杯赛的决赛。比赛于2013年11月3日在都柏林的英杰华体育场举行，由德罗赫达联队对阵斯莱戈流浪者队。爱尔兰RTÉ Two和RTÉ Two高清频道对比赛进行直播。裁判为保罗·图伊特，助理裁判为达米恩·麦格莱思和米歇尔·奥尼尔，第四官员为德里克·汤尼。

zh.s: 2013年马来西亚杯决赛于2013年11月3日举行，决出该届赛事冠军。这是马来西亚杯第87届决赛，由马来西亚足球协会主办。决赛双方是吉兰丹和彭亨。

en.s: The 2013 Boucherville municipal election was an election that was held on the 3rd of November 2013 to elect Boucherville's mayor and eight councillors. Jean Martel and his party's eight candidates were elected. The voter turnout was 53.4%. The election results were made available on the website of Québec's Ministry of Municipal Affairs and Housing.

en.t: One World Trade Center officially opens in New York City, replacing the Twin Towers after they were destroyed during the September 11 attacks
en.s: One World Trade Center, also known as One WTC and the Freedom Tower, is the main building of the rebuilt World Trade Center complex in Lower Manhattan, New York City. Designed by David Childs of Skidmore, Owings & Merrill, One World Trade Center is the tallest building in the United States, the tallest building in the Western Hemisphere, and the seventh-tallest in the world.

zh.t: 纽约世贸中心一号楼正式开放，取代在9·11袭击中被毁的双子塔
zh.s: 世贸中心一号楼也称One WTC和自由塔，是纽约市曼哈顿下城重建后的世界贸易中心建筑群主楼。大楼由斯基德莫尔、奥因斯与梅里尔建筑事务所的戴维·柴尔兹设计，是美国和西半球最高的建筑，也是世界第七高的建筑。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 2015 took place on November 3, 2015. Voters elected the Mayor of Indianapolis, members of the Indianapolis City-County Council, as well as several other local officials. Incumbent Republican Greg Ballard did not run for re-election to a third term in office. Primary elections were held on May 5, 2015 with the Democrats nominating former Secretary of State of Indiana and United States Attorney Joe Hogsett. Republicans nominated former Marine, Chuck Brewer to face Hogsett. The 2015 Indianapolis City-County elections took place alongside the mayoral election.

zh.t: 2015年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 2015年印第安纳波利斯市长选举于11月3日举行。选民选出市长、市—县议会议员及其他地方官员。共和党籍时任市长格雷格·巴拉德没有竞选第三个任期。初选于2015年5月5日举行；民主党提名了前印第安纳州州务卿、美国联邦检察官乔·霍格塞特。共和党提名了前海军陆战队员查克·布鲁尔与霍格塞特对决。2015年印第安纳波利斯市—县选举与市长选举同时举行。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of New Jersey on November 3, 2015. Primary elections were held on June 2. The only state positions up in this election cycle were all 80 seats in the New Jersey General Assembly and one Senate special election in the 5th Legislative District. In addition to the State Legislative elections, numerous county offices and Freeholders in addition to municipal offices were up for election. There were no statewide ballot questions this year though some counties and municipalities may have had a local question asked.

zh.s: 美国新泽西州于2015年11月3日举行普选，初选于6月2日举行。本轮选举唯一涉及的州级职位，是新泽西州议会下院全部80个席位，以及第五立法选区的一个州参议员特别选举席位。除了州议会选举外，多项县级职位、县自由持有人职位和市政职位也进行改选。今年没有全州范围的公投问题，但部分县和市可能提出了地方公投问题。

en.s: The United States gubernatorial elections of 2015 were held on November 3, 2015, in the states of Kentucky and Mississippi and on November 21, 2015 in the state of Louisiana. The gubernatorial elections are to elect the state governor; the official at the head of the executive branch of a state. In addition, special elections may take place (if respective constitutions require) if other gubernatorial seats are vacated. These elections form part of the 2015 United States elections. The last regular gubernatorial elections for all three states were in 2011.

zh.s: 2015年美国州长选举于11月3日在肯塔基州和密西西比州举行，路易斯安那州则于11月21日举行。州长选举用于选出州行政部门首长。此外，如果各州宪法有此规定，在州长职位空缺时也可能举行特别选举。这些选举是2015年美国选举的一部分。三个州上一次举行常规州长选举都是在2011年。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Orlando mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2015, to elect the mayor of Orlando, Florida. Incumbent mayor Buddy Dyer is running for a fourth term. Municipal elections in Orlando and Orange County are non-partisan. If no candidate receives a majority of the votes in the general election, runoffs are held between the two candidates that received the greatest number of votes. On November 3, 2015, incumbent mayor Buddy Dyer won with 62.5% of the vote, eliminating the need for a run-off.

zh.s: 2015年奥兰多市长选举于11月3日星期二举行，选出佛罗里达州奥兰多市市长。时任市长巴迪·戴尔竞选第四个任期。奥兰多和奥兰治县的市政选举不分党派。如果没有候选人在普选中获得过半选票，得票最高的两名候选人将参加决选。2015年11月3日，戴尔获得62.5%的选票，成功连任，无需举行决选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Philadelphia mayoral election was held on November 3, 2015, to elect the Mayor of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, concurrently with various other state and local elections. Heavily favored Democratic party candidate Jim Kenney won. Incumbent Democratic party Mayor Michael Nutter could not run for re-election to a third consecutive term due to term limits in the city's home rule charter. Registered Democrats hold a formidable 7-to-1 ratio over registered Republicans in Philadelphia, giving Democratic candidates a distinct advantage in citywide elections. The mayoral primary elections were held on May 19, 2015. Democrats nominated Jim Kenney, a member of the Philadelphia City Council, as their party's nominee.

zh.s: 2015年费城市长选举于11月3日举行，与其他州和地方选举同时进行。大幅领先的民主党候选人吉姆·肯尼获胜。民主党籍时任市长迈克尔·纳特受该市地方自治宪章的任期限制，不能连续竞选第三个任期。费城登记选民中，民主党人数约为共和党的7倍，使民主党候选人在全市选举中明显占优。市长初选于2015年5月19日举行；民主党提名了费城市议会议员吉姆·肯尼。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Kentucky gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 2015, to elect the Governor of Kentucky. Incumbent Democratic Governor Steve Beshear was not eligible to run for re-election to a third term due to term limits established by the Kentucky Constitution. Primary elections were held on May 19, 2015. Despite being behind in most pre-election polls, Republican Matt Bevin won the election by approximately a nine-point margin.

zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行肯塔基州州长选举。在任民主党州长史蒂夫·贝希尔受州宪法规定的任期限制，不能竞选第三届。初选于2015年5月19日举行。尽管共和党人马特·贝文在多数选前民调中落后，他最终仍以约9个百分点的优势获胜。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 2015, to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Republican Governor Phil Bryant ran for re-election to a second and final term in office. Primary elections were held on August 4.

zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行密西西比州州长选举。在任共和党州长菲尔·布莱恩特竞选第二届、也是最后一届任期。初选于8月4日举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Mississippi on November 3, 2015. All of Mississippi's executive officers were up for election. Primary elections were held on August 4, 2015, with primary runoffs, necessary if no candidate wins a majority of the vote, to be held on August 25, 2015. The filing deadline for primary ballot access was February 27.

zh.s: 2015年11月3日，密西西比州举行大选，该州所有行政部门职位均参与改选。初选于8月4日举行；如果没有候选人获得过半数选票，则于2015年8月25日举行初选决选。初选登记截止日期为2月27日。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Pennsylvania Supreme Court elections were held on November 3, 2015.

zh.t: 2015年宾夕法尼亚州最高法院选举
zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行宾夕法尼亚州最高法院选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Kentucky on November 3, 2015. All of Kentucky's executive officers were up for election. Primary elections were held on May 19, 2015.

zh.s: 2015年11月3日，肯塔基州举行大选，该州所有行政部门职位均参与改选。初选于同年5月19日举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Virginia Senate election was held on November 3, 2015, to elect all 40 members of the Virginia Senate. From January 28 to June 12, 2014, Democrats had held a majority as they won the Lieutenant Governorship in the 2013 elections, but then later lost a seat in a special election, thereby giving Republicans a 21-19 majority. Republicans retained their 21–19 majority in the chamber in the 2015 elections.

zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行弗吉尼亚州参议院全部40个席位的选举。2013年选举中，民主党赢得副州长职位后，从2014年1月28日至6月12日曾占多数；随后他们在特别选举中失去一个席位，共和党因此以21席对19席占多数。共和党在2015年选举中保住了这个席位优势。

en.s: The 2015 Mississippi Attorney General election was held on November 3, 2015. Incumbent Democrat Jim Hood, who had been the only statewide elected Democrat in Mississippi since 2008, sought and won reelection to a fourth term. As of 2026, this is the last time Democrats won a statewide election in Mississippi.

zh.t: 2015年密西西比州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行密西西比州总检察长选举。在任民主党总检察长吉姆·胡德是自2008年以来密西西比州唯一通过全州选举产生的民主党官员。他竞选连任第四届并成功当选。截至2026年，这是民主党人最后一次赢得密西西比州全州选举。

en.s: The 2015 United States state legislative elections were held on November 3, 2015. Seven legislative chambers in four states held regularly scheduled elections. These off-year elections coincided with other state and local elections, including gubernatorial elections in three states. Republicans maintained control of both chambers of the Louisiana, Mississippi, and Virginia legislatures, while Democrats maintained control of the New Jersey General Assembly.

zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行美国州议会选举。4个州的7个议会院举行了定期选举。选举与其他州和地方选举同时进行，包括3个州的州长选举。共和党继续控制路易斯安那州、密西西比州和弗吉尼亚州的两个议院；民主党继续控制新泽西州众议院。

en.s: Portland, Maine, held an election for mayor on November 3, 2015. It was the second election since Portland voters approved a citywide referendum changing the city charter to recreate an elected mayor position in 2010. The new citizen-elected mayor serves full-time in the position for a four-year term, exercises the powers and duties enumerated in Article II Section 5 of the Portland City Charter, be elected using instant-runoff voting, and, like the rest of municipal government in Portland, be officially non-partisan.

zh.s: 2015年11月3日，缅因州波特兰市举行市长选举。自2010年选民通过全市公投修改城市章程、恢复民选市长职位以来，这是第二次市长选举。新设的民选市长职位为全职，任期四年，权责列于《波特兰城市章程》第二章第五节。选举采用即时决选制，与波特兰其他市政职位一样，正式设为无党派职位。

en.s: The 2015 Akron mayoral election was held on November 3, 2015. On May 8, 2015, Mayor Don Plusquellic announced that he would not seek an eighth term and that he would resign from office on May 31, which elevated City Council President Garry Moneypenny to serve as interim Mayor.

zh.s: 2015年阿克伦市长选举于2015年11月3日举行。市长唐·普拉斯奎利克于2015年5月8日宣布不再竞选第八个任期，并将于5月31日辞职。此后，市议会主席加里·莫尼潘尼接任代理市长。

en.s: The 2015 Indianapolis City–County Council elections took place on November 3, 2015. With all 25 seats up for election, this was the first for the council with newly redrawn districts and without the four at-large seats, which were eliminated by the Republican-controlled Indiana General Assembly in 2013. Before the elections Democrats held a 15–14-seat majority. Primaries for the council were held on May 5, 2015, with a handful of races being very close.

zh.t: 2015年印第安纳波利斯市县议会选举
zh.s: 2015年印第安纳波利斯市县议会选举于2015年11月3日举行，议会全部25个席位都进行改选。这是议会按新选区选举的首次选举，四个不分区席位已于2013年被共和党控制的印第安纳州议会取消。选举前，民主党以15比14席占多数。议会初选于2015年5月5日举行，其中少数选区的竞争十分激烈。

en.s: The 2015 Tucson mayoral election was held on November 3, 2015. It saw the reelection of incumbent Jonathan Rothschild.

zh.s: 2015年图森市长选举于2015年11月3日举行，现任市长乔纳森·罗斯柴尔德再次当选。

en.s: The 2015 Philadelphia City Council election took place on November 3, 2015, along with the 2015 Philadelphia mayoral election. The composition of the Philadelphia City Council remained unchanged from before the election, with Democrats maintaining their 14-3 majority on the council.

zh.s: 2015年费城市议会选举于2015年11月3日举行，与费城市长选举同时举行。费城市议会的席位分布与选举前相同，民主党继续以14比3占多数。

en.s: The 2015 Kentucky Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 2015, to elect the Secretary of State of Kentucky. Primary elections were held on May 19, 2015. Incumbent Democratic Secretary Alison Lundergan Grimes narrowly won re-election to a second term against Republican nominee Steve Knipper.

zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行肯塔基州州务卿选举，初选于同年5月19日举行。现任民主党州务卿艾莉森·伦德根·格莱姆斯以微弱优势击败共和党候选人史蒂夫·克尼珀，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2015 Columbus mayoral election took place on November 3, 2015, to elect the Mayor of Columbus, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the May 5 primary advancing to the general election, regardless of party. Incumbent Democratic Mayor Michael B. Coleman was not running for re-election to a fifth term in office.

zh.t: 2015年俄亥俄州哥伦布市长选举
zh.s: 2015年哥伦布市长选举于11月3日举行，选出俄亥俄州哥伦布市的市长。选举正式采用无党派形式，5月5日初选中得票前两名的候选人进入大选，不受党派限制。民主党籍时任市长迈克尔·B·科尔曼没有竞选第五个任期。

en.s: The 2015 Snohomish County Executive election took place on November 3, 2015, to elect the county executive of Snohomish County, Washington. Incumbent Democratic County Executive John Lovick, who was first appointed in 2013 and elected in a 2014 special election to serve out the term of Aaron Reardon, ran for re-election to a full term.

zh.t: 2015年斯诺霍米什县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2015年斯诺霍米什县行政长官选举于11月3日举行，选出华盛顿州斯诺霍米什县的行政长官。民主党籍时任县行政长官约翰·洛维克于2013年首次获任命，并在2014年特别选举中当选，以完成亚伦·里尔登的任期；此次他竞选完整任期。

en.s: The 2015 Salt Lake City mayoral election took place on November 3, 2015, to elect the Mayor of Salt Lake City, Utah. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and was officially nonpartisan. Incumbent Mayor Ralph Becker, a Democrat in office since 2008, sought a third term in office, but was narrowly defeated by Jackie Biskupski.

zh.s: 2015年盐湖城市长选举于11月3日举行，与其他地方选举同时进行，正式采用无党派形式。民主党籍时任市长拉尔夫·贝克自2008年起任职，竞选第三个任期，但以微弱差距败给杰基·比斯库普斯基。

en.s: Bridgeport, Connecticut, held an election for mayor on November 3, 2015. It saw former mayor Joseph Ganim return to the office. Ganim defeated incumbent mayor Bill Finch in the Democratic primary.

zh.t: 2015年康涅狄格州布里奇波特市长选举
zh.s: 康涅狄格州布里奇波特市于2015年11月3日举行市长选举，前市长约瑟夫·加尼姆重新当选。加尼姆在民主党初选中击败现任市长比尔·芬奇。

en.s: The 2015 Greensboro mayoral election was held on November 3, 2015, to elect the mayor of Greensboro, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of Nancy Vaughan.

zh.s: 2015年格林斯伯勒市长选举于11月3日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州格林斯伯勒市的市长。南希·沃恩成功连任。

en.s: The 2015 Allegheny County Executive election took place on November 3, 2015. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Rich Fitzgerald, first elected in 2011, ran for re-election to a second term. He faced no opposition in the Democratic primary and won the nomination unopposed. In the general election, his only opponent was independent Todd Elliott Koger, a perennial candidate who was also simultaneously running for several other positions in the county.

zh.t: 2015年阿勒格尼县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2015年阿勒格尼县行政长官选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任县行政长官里奇·菲茨杰拉德于2011年首次当选，此次竞选连任第二个任期。他在民主党初选中没有对手，自动获得提名。大选中，他唯一的对手是独立候选人托德·埃利奥特·科格尔。科格尔长期参选，同时还竞选县内其他几个职位。

en.s: The 2015 Henrico County Commonwealth's Attorney election was held on November 3, 2015, to elect the Commonwealth's Attorney of Henrico County, Virginia, concurrently with elections to the Senate of Virginia and Virginia House of Delegates. Incumbent Democratic Commonwealth's Attorney Shannon Taylor won reelection to a second term against Republican nominee Tony Pham by a wide margin.

zh.t: 2015年弗吉尼亚州亨里科县检察官选举
zh.s: 2015年亨里科县检察官选举于11月3日举行，与弗吉尼亚州参议院和州众议院选举同时进行。民主党籍时任检察官香农·泰勒以明显优势击败共和党提名人托尼·范，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2015 Miami Beach mayoral election took place on November 3, 2015, to elect the mayor of Miami Beach, Florida. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and was officially nonpartisan. Mayor Philip Levine secured reelection with over 50% of the vote, avoiding a runoff.

zh.s: 2015年迈阿密海滩市长选举于11月3日举行，与其他地方选举同时进行，正式采用无党派形式。市长菲利普·莱文以超过50%的得票率成功连任，无需进入第二轮投票。

en.s: The 2015 Des Moines mayoral election was held on November 3, 2015, to elect the mayor of Des Moines, Iowa. It saw Frank Cownie win reelection.

zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行艾奥瓦州得梅因市长选举。弗兰克·考尼成功连任。

en.s: The 2015 Fayetteville mayoral election took place on November 3, 2015, to elect the mayor of Fayetteville, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Nat Robertson.

zh.t: 2015年北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔市长选举
zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行费耶特维尔市长选举。在任市长纳特·罗伯逊成功连任。

en.s: The 2015 San Francisco mayoral election took place on November 3, 2015, to elect the Mayor of San Francisco, California. Incumbent Mayor Ed Lee won re-election to a second term in office. All local elections in California are nonpartisan.

zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行加利福尼亚州旧金山市长选举。在任市长李孟贤成功连任第二届。加利福尼亚州所有地方选举均正式设为无党派选举。

en.s: The 2015 Charlotte mayoral election took place on November 3, 2015, to elect the Mayor of Charlotte, North Carolina. Mayoral elections in Charlotte are biennial, with the winner being sworn in in December. Primary elections were held on September 15, 2015, with primary runoffs held on October 6 since no candidate took more than 40% of the vote. Incumbent Democratic Party Mayor Dan Clodfelter has been in office since April 2014.

zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行北卡罗来纳州夏洛特市长选举。夏洛特每两年举行一次市长选举，胜选者于12月宣誓就职。初选于2015年9月15日举行；由于无人获得超过40%的选票，10月6日又举行初选决选。在任民主党市长丹·克洛德费尔特自2014年4月起任职。

en.s: The 2015 South Bend, Indiana mayoral election was held on November 3, 2015. The election was won by the incumbent mayor, Pete Buttigieg, who was reelected with more than 80 percent of the votes, defeating Republican Kelly Jones. The election coincided with races for the Common Council and for South Bend City Clerk.

zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行印第安纳州南本德市长选举。在任市长皮特·布蒂吉格以超过80%的选票击败共和党人凯莉·琼斯，成功连任。选举与市议会和南本德市书记官职位选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2015 Durham mayoral election was held on November 3, 2015, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Bill Bell.

zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市长选举。在任市长比尔·贝尔成功连任。

en.s: The 2015 Toledo mayoral special election was held on November 3, 2015, to determine the mayor of Toledo, Ohio and to finish the term of former mayor D. Michael Collins who died in office. Incumbent acting mayor Paula Hicks-Hudson was elected mayor with 35.63% of the vote.

zh.t: 2015年俄亥俄州托莱多市长特别选举
zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行俄亥俄州托莱多市长特别选举，选出托莱多市长并完成前任市长D·迈克尔·柯林斯去世后剩余的任期。在任代理市长葆拉·希克斯-哈德森当选，得票率为35.63%。

en.s: The 2015 Boise mayoral election was held on November 3, 2015, to determine the mayor of Boise, Idaho. The election was officially nonpartisan.

zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行爱达荷州博伊西市长选举。该选举正式设为无党派选举。

en.s: The 2015 Saint Paul City Council elections was held on November 3, 2015, to elect the 7 members of the Saint Paul City Council for four-year terms. Members were elected from single-member districts via instant-runoff voting, popularly known as ranked choice voting. Municipal elections in Minnesota are nonpartisan, although candidates were able to identify with a political party on the ballot.

zh.s: 2015年11月3日举行圣保罗市议会选举，选出7名任期四年的市议员。市议员由单席位选区选出，采用即时决选投票，也称排序选择投票。明尼苏达州市政选举正式设为无党派选举，不过候选人可在选票上注明所属政党。

en.s: All 80 seats in the General Assembly were up for election this year. In each Legislative district, there are two people elected; the top two winners in the general election are the ones sent to the Assembly. Typically, the two members of each party run as a team in each election. After the previous election, Democrats captured 48 seats while the Republicans won 32 seats.

zh.t: 2015年美国新泽西州众议院选举
zh.s: 2015年11月3日，新泽西州举行州众议院选举，改选全部80个席位。每个选区选出两名议员，得票最高的两名候选人当选。选前民主党持有48席，共和党持有32席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Virginia House of Delegates election of 2015 was held on Tuesday, November 3. All 100 seats of the Virginia House of Delegates were on the ballot. While Republicans maintained an enormous edge against Democrats in the chamber, their net loss of one seat cost them their previously held veto-proof majority against Governor Terry McAuliffe.

zh.s: 2015年弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于11月3日星期二举行，众议院全部100个席位均改选。共和党继续大幅领先民主党，但净失去一个席位，因而失去此前能够否决州长特里·麦考利夫决定的绝对多数。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2015 Houston mayoral election was decided by a runoff that took place on December 12, 2015, to elect the Mayor of Houston, Texas. As no candidate won a majority of the vote during the general election on November 3, 2015, the run off was held between the top two finishers, Sylvester Turner, who received 31.31% of the vote, and Bill King, who received 25.27%.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2015年休斯敦市长选举通过12月12日举行的决选产生胜者。11月3日的大选中无人获得过半选票，因此得票最高的两名候选人西尔维斯特·特纳（31.31%）和比尔·金（25.27%）进入决选。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的首轮选举日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: Savannah holds the first round of its 2015 mayoral election
en.s: Savannah, Georgia, held the first round of its mayoral election on November 3, 2015. Incumbent Edna Jackson received 9,802 votes (44.00%), ahead of Eddie DeLoach with 9,332 (41.89%). Neither candidate received a majority, so they advanced to a runoff on December 1; DeLoach won that later vote.
en.n: This records the November 3 first round, not the December 1 runoff.

en.s: The Wenchang Space Launch Site (Chinese: 文昌航天发射场) is a rocket launch site located in Wenchang on the island of Hainan, in China. Formally a suborbital test center, it currently serves as China's southernmost spaceport. The site was selected for its low latitude, 19° north of the equator, allowing for larger payloads to be launched. Unlike launch facilities on the mainland, Wenchang uses its seaport for deliveries.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the United States on November 3, 2020. The Democratic ticket of former vice president Joe Biden and California junior senator Kamala Harris defeated the incumbent Republican president Donald Trump and vice president Mike Pence. The election saw the highest voter turnout by percentage since 1900. Biden received more than 81 million votes, the most votes ever cast for a presidential candidate in U.S. history. In a competitive primary that featured the most candidates for any political party in the modern era of American politics, Biden secured the Democratic presidential nomination.

zh.s: 美国于2020年11月3日举行总统选举。民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登和来自加利福尼亚州的初级参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯，击败了共和党籍时任总统唐纳德·特朗普和副总统迈克·彭斯。这次选举的投票率为1900年以来最高。拜登获得超过8,100万票，是美国历史上总统候选人获得的最高票数。在竞争激烈的民主党初选中，候选人人数创下现代美国政治史上单一政党初选的最高纪录，拜登最终赢得民主党总统候选人提名。

en.s: The 2020 Wisconsin Fall general election was held in the U.S. state of Wisconsin on November 3, 2020. All of Wisconsin's eight seats in the United States House of Representatives were up for election, as well as sixteen seats in the Wisconsin State Senate and all 99 seats in the Wisconsin State Assembly. Voters also chose ten electors to represent them in the Electoral College, which then participated in selecting the president of the United States.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，威斯康星州举行秋季大选。该州全部8个联邦众议院席位、州参议院16个席位和州众议院全部99个席位均参与改选。选民还选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出美国总统。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Nebraska was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Nebraska voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.s: 2020年内布拉斯加州总统选举于11月3日星期二举行，是2020年美国总统选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。内布拉斯加州选民通过普选选出选举人，由他们组成选举人团。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普及其竞选搭档、时任副总统迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in New Mexico
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. New Mexico voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.s: 2020年新墨西哥州总统选举于11月3日星期二举行，是2020年美国总统选举的一部分；美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。新墨西哥州选民通过普选选出选举人，由他们组成选举人团。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普及其竞选搭档、时任副总统迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.s: The 2020 Volusia County Chair election was held on November 3, 2020, following a primary election on August 18, 2020, to elect the Volusia County Chair. Incumbent County Chair Ed Kelley, who was first elected in 2016, initially announced that he would seek re-election, but ultimately declined to seek re-election to a second term. Three candidates ran to succeed Kelley: County Councilwoman Deb Denys, farmer Jeff Brower, and retiree Gerard Witman.

zh.s: 2020年沃卢西亚县县长选举于11月3日举行，选出沃卢西亚县县长；此前初选于8月18日举行。时任县长埃德·凯利于2016年首次当选，起初宣布竞选连任，但最终决定不竞选第二个任期。三名候选人参选接替凯利：县议员黛布·丹尼斯、农民杰夫·布劳尔和退休人士杰拉德·惠特曼。

en.s: The 2020 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was a general election occurring on November 3, 2020, in which the incumbent Republican, Mike Kehoe, defeated his challenger, Democrat Alissia Canady. Kehoe was originally appointed to the position in 2018, making the election his first time elected as Missouri's lieutenant governor, despite the fact that he was already in office at the time of the election.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行密苏里州副州长大选。共和党籍现任副州长迈克·基奥击败民主党候选人阿莉西亚·卡纳迪。基奥于2018年获任命接任副州长，因此这次是他首次通过选举当选，尽管他在投票时已经在任。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Delaware was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Delaware, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年特拉华州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行特拉华州联邦参议员选举，选出代表特拉华州的联邦参议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Florida was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election, in which all 50 states and the District of Columbia participated. Florida voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent president Donald Trump, and his running mate, Vice President Mike Pence, against Democratic Party nominee, former vice president Joe Biden, and his running mate, United States senator Kamala Harris, of California.

zh.t: 2020年佛罗里达州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，佛罗里达州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。佛罗里达州选民通过普选选出选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与副总统迈克·彭斯搭档，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、来自加利福尼亚州的联邦参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.s: Elections to the Montana House of Representatives were held on November 3, 2020.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行蒙大拿州众议院选举。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Idaho
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Idaho was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Idaho, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年爱达荷州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行爱达荷州联邦参议员选举，选出代表爱达荷州的联邦参议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.s: General elections were held in Palau on 3 November 2020 to elect a President and the National Congress.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，帕劳举行大选，选出总统和国民议会议员。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Mississippi
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Mississippi were held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the U.S. state of Mississippi; one from each of the state's four congressional districts. Primaries were scheduled for March 10, 2020.

zh.t: 2020年密西西比州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二举行密西西比州联邦众议院选举，选出该州4个国会选区的联邦众议员。初选原定于2020年3月10日举行。

en.s: The 2020 elections for the Illinois House of Representatives were held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, to elect representatives from all 118 districts. The primary election occurred on March 17, 2020. The winners of this election are currently serving in the 102nd General Assembly, with seats apportioned among the states based on the 2010 United States census. The Democratic Party had held a House majority since 1997.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二举行伊利诺伊州众议院选举，选出全部118个选区的州众议员。初选于2020年3月17日举行。当选者目前在第102届伊利诺伊州议会任职。席位根据2010年美国人口普查结果在各州之间分配。民主党自1997年以来一直控制州众议院。

en.s: The 2020 California State Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, with the primary election scheduled for March 3, 2020. Voters in the 20 odd-numbered districts of the California State Senate elected their representatives. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including for U.S. president and the state assembly.

zh.t: 2020年加利福尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二举行加利福尼亚州参议院选举，初选安排在同年3月3日举行。加利福尼亚州选民选出全部20个奇数编号选区的州参议员。选举与总统和州众议院等其他职位选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2020 Ohio general elections were held on November 3, 2020 throughout the US state of Ohio. The office of the Ohio Secretary of State oversees the election process, including voting and vote counting. To vote by mail, registered Ohio voters must have requested a ballot by October 31, 2020. As of early October some 2,112,685 voters have requested mail ballots.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，俄亥俄州举行大选。俄亥俄州州务卿办公室负责管理选举，包括投票和计票。俄亥俄州登记选民如要邮寄投票，必须在2020年10月31日前申请选票。截至10月初，已有约2,112,685名选民申请邮寄选票。

en.t: 2020 San Juan, Puerto Rico, mayoral election
en.s: San Juan, Puerto Rico, held an election for mayor on November 3, 2020. Among other elections, it was held concurrently with the 2020 Puerto Rico general election. It saw the election of New Progressive Party nominee Miguel Romero. Incumbent mayor Carmen Yulín Cruz, a member of the Popular Democratic Party did not seek reelection to a third term, and instead ran an unsuccessful campaign for her party's nomination in the gubernatorial election.

zh.s: 波多黎各圣胡安市于2020年11月3日举行市长选举。此次选举与2020年波多黎各大选同时举行。进步新党候选人米格尔·罗梅罗当选。人民民主党籍现任市长卡门·尤林·克鲁兹没有竞选第三个任期，而是竞选本党州长提名，但未能胜出。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the 14 U.S. representatives from the state of Michigan, one from each of the state's 14 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年密歇根州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年密歇根州联邦众议院选举于2020年11月3日举行，选出该州14名联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。此次选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: An election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect all 110 members of Michigan's House of Representatives. The election was held alongside numerous other state and federal elections, and saw the Republican Party retain control of the chamber.

zh.s: 2020年密歇根州众议院选举于11月3日举行，选出该州众议院全部110名议员。选举与多场州级和联邦选举同时举行，共和党继续控制众议院。

en.s: By-elections for twenty eight state assembly constituencies were held in Madhya Pradesh on 3 November 2020. The ruling BJP won 19 out of the 28 seats, gaining 18 seats and retaining its majority in the Madhya Pradesh Legislative Assembly. The opposition Congress won nine seats, losing 18 seats following the election.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，印度中央邦28个邦议会选区举行补选。执政党印度人民党赢得其中19席，增加18席并保住其在中央邦立法议会的多数地位。反对党国大党赢得9席，选后减少18席。

en.s: The 2020 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the Attorney General of Missouri. It was held concurrently with the presidential election, along with elections to the United States Senate and United States House of Representatives, as well as various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Attorney General Eric Schmitt was elected to a full term after he was appointed by Governor Mike Parson when Josh Hawley was elected to the U.S.

zh.s: 2020年密苏里州总检察长选举于2020年11月3日举行，选出该州总检察长。此次选举与美国总统选举、联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。共和党籍现任总检察长埃里克·施密特获选完整任期；他此前在乔希·霍利当选联邦参议员后获州长迈克·帕森任命接任。

en.s: South Dakota state elections in 2020 were held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020. Its primary elections were held on June 2, 2020 (with runoffs on August 11, 2020). In addition to the U.S. presidential race, South Dakota voters elected the Class II U.S.

zh.s: 2020年南达科他州选举于11月3日（星期二）举行。初选于6月2日举行，决选于8月11日举行。除了总统选举外，南达科他州选民还参加了州内选举。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Kansas was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Kansas voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump of Florida, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence of Indiana against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden of Delaware, and his running mate Senator Kamala Harris of California.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，堪萨斯州举行美国总统选举，全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次选举。堪萨斯州选民通过普选选出总统选举人。共和党提名人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、副总统迈克·彭斯角逐民主党提名人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Pennsylvania voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.t: 2020年宾夕法尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，宾夕法尼亚州举行美国总统选举，全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次选举。宾夕法尼亚州选民通过普选选出总统选举人。共和党提名人、总统唐纳德·特朗普与副总统迈克·彭斯角逐民主党提名人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Tennessee was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Tennessee voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，田纳西州举行美国总统选举，全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次选举。田纳西州选民通过普选选出总统选举人。共和党提名人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、副总统迈克·彭斯角逐民主党提名人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the 12 U.S. representatives from the state of New Jersey, one from each of the state's 12 congressional districts. The primary election in which candidates were chosen took place on July 7, 2020.

zh.t: 2020年新泽西州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，新泽西州举行联邦众议院选举，选出来自该州12个国会选区的12名联邦众议员。初选于2020年7月7日举行。

en.s: The 2020 Maine State Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, with the primary election using instant-runoff voting being held on July 14, 2020, to elect the 130th Maine Senate. Voters in all 35 districts of the Maine State Senate elected their senators. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including for U.S. president, U.S. Senate, U.S. House and the Maine House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行缅因州参议院选举，选出第130届州参议院议员。采用即时决选投票的初选于2020年7月14日举行。缅因州参议院全部35个选区均选出参议员。选举与总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和缅因州众议院等其他职位选举同时举行。

en.t: 2020 San Diego County Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2020 San Diego County Board of Supervisors election was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, with the primary election held on March 3, 2020. While the San Diego County Board of Supervisors is officially a nonpartisan institution, Republicans controlled four out of the five supervisory seats, while a Democrat held one.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行圣迭戈县监事会选举，初选于2020年3月3日举行。圣迭戈县监事会正式设为无党派机构，但共和党掌握5个监事席位中的4席，民主党人占1席。

en.s: Elections to the South Dakota Senate were held on November 3, 2020 as a part of the biennial elections in the U.S. state of South Dakota. Voters in 35 single-member constituencies elected members to the 93rd Senate. Elections were also held in the state for U.S. president, the U.S. Senate, the U.S. House, and the South Dakota House of Representatives. Primary elections were held on June 2, 2020.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行南达科他州参议院选举，属于该州每两年一次的选举。选民在35个单席位选区中选出第93届州参议院议员。该州同期还举行总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州众议院选举。初选于2020年6月2日举行。

en.s: The 2020 Connecticut State Senate election took place on November 3, 2020. Part of the biennial 2020 United States elections. Connecticut voters elected senators in all of the 36 State Senate districts. State senators serve two-year terms in the Connecticut State Senate, with all 36 of the seats up for election each cycle. The primary elections on August 11, 2020, determined which candidates appeared on the ballot for the general election.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行康涅狄格州参议院选举，属于2020年美国两年一度选举的一部分。选民选出该州36个州参议院选区的议员。州参议员任期两年，因此每轮选举36个席位都参与改选。初选于2020年8月11日举行，以确定大选候选人。

en.s: General elections were held in American Samoa on 3 November 2020. Voters elected a governor and lieutenant governor, members of the House of Representatives and the American Samoan delegate to the United States Congress. Incumbent Governor of American Samoa Lolo Matalasi Moliga was not eligible for reelection due to term limits.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，美属萨摩亚举行大选。选民选出州长、副州长、众议院议员和该地区驻美国国会代表。由于任期限制，时任州长洛洛·马塔拉西·莫利加不能竞选连任。

en.s: The 2020 Alaska House of Representatives election was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, with the primary election on August 18, 2020. Voters in the 40 districts of the Alaska House of Representatives elected their representatives, in conjunction with state senate elections and the biennial United States elections for federal offices.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行阿拉斯加州众议院选举，初选于2020年8月18日举行。阿拉斯加州众议院40个选区的选民选出各自的代表。选举与州参议院选举以及美国联邦职位的两年一度选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2020 Minnesota House of Representatives election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 3, 2020, to elect members to the House of Representatives of the 92nd Minnesota Legislature. A primary election was held in several districts on August 11, 2020. The election coincided with the election of the other house of the Legislature, the Senate, and other elections.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，明尼苏达州举行众议院选举，选出第92届州议会众议员。多个选区于2020年8月11日举行初选。选举与州参议院及其他选举同时举行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Idaho
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Idaho were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of Idaho, one from both of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年爱达荷州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，爱达荷州举行联邦众议院选举，选出来自该州两个国会选区的两名联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和联邦众议院其他选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Rhode Island was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Rhode Island, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年罗得岛州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行罗得岛州联邦参议院选举，与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2020 Tennessee House of Representatives election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect 99 seats for the Tennessee House of Representatives. The elections coincided with the Presidential, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate elections. The Democratic Party regained control of the 90th district. Incumbent Rep.

zh.s: 2020年田纳西州众议院选举于11月3日举行，改选州众议院99个席位。选举与总统、联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州参议员选举同期举行。民主党重新赢得第90选区。

en.s: The 2020 Puerto Rican municipal election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the mayors of the 78 municipalities of Puerto Rico, concurrently with the election of the Governor, the Resident Commissioner, the Senate, and the House of Representatives. As candidates in the 2020 general elections, the winners were elected to serve a four-year term from January 3, 2020, to January 3, 2025.

zh.s: 波多黎各于2020年11月3日举行市政选举，选出78个市镇的市长；选举与州长、驻美专员、参议院和众议院选举同时举行。胜选者作为2020年大选当选官员，任期为2020年1月3日至2025年1月3日。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the 36 U.S. representatives from the state of Texas, one from each of the state's 36 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the U.S. Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举，选出该州36个国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Maine
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Maine were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of Maine, one from each of the state's two congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行缅因州联邦众议院选举，选出缅因州两个国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.s: The 2020 Utah House of Representatives election was held in the U.S. state of Utah on November 3, 2020 to elect members to the House of Representatives. Elections were held in 75 electoral districts to elect two-year term members to the 64th Utah State Legislature. Elections were also held throughout the state for U.S. president, the U.S. House, and for the Utah Senate.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，犹他州举行众议院选举，选出75个选区的州众议员，组成第64届犹他州议会，任期两年。选举还与总统、联邦众议院和犹他州参议院选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2020 Wyoming State Senate elections was held as part of the biennial elections in the United States. Wyoming voters elected state senators in 15 of the 30 state Senate districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Wyoming State Senate. Elections for the office of Wyoming State Senate took place in 2020. The general election was held on November 3, 2020.

zh.s: 2020年怀俄明州参议院选举是美国两年一度选举的一部分。怀俄明州选民在30个州参议院选区中的15个选区选出州参议员。州参议员任期四年。大选于2020年11月3日举行。

en.s: Elections were held in Oklahoma on Tuesday, November 3, 2020. Its primaries were held on June 30, 2020, with runoffs taking place on August 25. Its presidential primaries were an exception to this, occurring on March 3, 2020.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，俄克拉何马州举行选举。初选于同年6月30日举行，初选决选于8月25日举行。总统选举初选是例外，于3月3日举行。

en.s: The 2020 Los Angeles County elections were held on November 3, 2020, in Los Angeles County, California, with nonpartisan blanket primary elections for certain offices being held on March 3. Three of the five seats of the Board of Supervisors were up for election, as well as one of the countywide elected officials, the District Attorney.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，洛杉矶县举行选举，部分职位的无党派初选于3月3日举行。县监事会5个席位中有3个席位进行选举，全县选出的职位中还有地区检察官职位进行选举。

en.s: Elections were held in Texas on Tuesday, November 3, 2020. Its primaries were held on March 3, 2020, with runoffs taking place on July 14.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，得克萨斯州举行选举。初选于同年3月3日举行，初选决选于7月14日举行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the five U.S. representatives from the state of Connecticut, one from each of the state's five congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年康涅狄格州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行康涅狄格州联邦众议院选举，选出该州5个国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期举行。

en.s: The Indiana state elections in 2020 were held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020. The primary elections were held on June 2, 2020. Primary candidates for the 2020 Attorney General election were not selected in the primary, but in a primary convention on June 20, 2020.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，印第安纳州举行州级选举。初选于2020年6月2日举行。总检察长选举的初选候选人没有通过初选选出，而是在6月20日举行的党内提名大会上产生。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives election in Northern Mariana Islands
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives election in the Northern Mariana Islands was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, to elect the territory's delegate to the United States House of Representatives in the 117th United States Congress. The delegate, who is elected to a two-year term, represents the Northern Mariana Islands' at-large congressional district in the U.S. House of Representatives.

zh.t: 2020年北马里亚纳群岛联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，北马里亚纳群岛举行联邦众议院选举，选出第117届国会的北马里亚纳群岛代表。该代表任期两年，代表北马里亚纳群岛的全州国会选区进入联邦众议院。

en.s: An election was held November 3, 2020, to elect 25 members to Montana's Senate. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including the presidency, U.S Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, governorship, and state house. The primary election was held on June 2, 2020.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行蒙大拿州参议院选举，选出25名州参议员。选举与总统、联邦参议员、联邦众议员、州长和州众议院等职位选举同期进行。初选于同年6月2日举行。

en.s: The 2020 Utah Attorney General election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the Attorney General of Utah. The election was held alongside various federal and state elections, including for governor. Incumbent Attorney General Sean Reyes won re-election to a second full term, defeating Democratic nominee Greg Skordas and Libertarian nominee Rudy Bautista. The conventions for the Republican, Democratic and Libertarian parties were held on April 25.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行犹他州总检察长选举，与各类联邦和州级选举同期进行，包括州长选举。现任总检察长肖恩·雷耶斯击败民主党候选人格雷格·斯科达斯和自由党候选人鲁迪·包蒂斯塔，成功连任第二个完整任期。共和党、民主党和自由党的党代会均于4月25日举行。

en.s: The 2020 Vermont gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Vermont. As Vermont does not impose term limits upon its governors, incumbent Republican governor Phil Scott was eligible to run for re-election to a third two-year term in office. On November 18, 2019, he confirmed that he was running for reelection, but did not yet publicly announce his campaign.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行佛蒙特州州长选举。佛蒙特州没有州长任期限制，现任共和党州长菲尔·斯科特可以竞选第三个两年任期。2019年11月18日，他确认会竞选连任，但当时尚未公开宣布竞选活动。

en.s: The 2020 Montana Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the secretary of state of the U.S. state of Montana. Incumbent Republican Montana Secretary of State Corey Stapleton was elected in 2016 with 55.5% of the vote. Stapleton announced he would not seek re-election, instead running unsuccessfully in the Republican primary for the open U.S. House seat in Montana.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行蒙大拿州州务卿选举。现任共和党州务卿科里·斯台普顿于2016年当选，得票率为55.5%。他宣布不竞选连任，转而竞选蒙大拿州联邦众议院共和党提名，但未能胜出。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Vermont on November 3, 2020. All of Vermont's executive officers were up for election, as well as Vermont's at-large seat in the United States House of Representatives. Primary elections were held on August 11, 2020.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，佛蒙特州举行大选。州内所有行政职位和联邦众议院的全州单一席位都进行选举。初选于2020年8月11日举行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Washington was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 U.S. states plus the District of Columbia participated. Washington voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，华盛顿州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。华盛顿州选民通过普选选出选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与副总统迈克·彭斯搭档，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、来自加利福尼亚州的参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.s: The 2020 New York State Senate elections were held on November 3, 2020, to elect representatives from all 63 State Senate districts across the U.S. state of New York. Primary elections were held on June 23, 2020. Prior to the 2020 elections, Democrats held 40 seats in the State Senate, while Republicans held 20 seats and three other seats were vacant.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行纽约州参议院选举，选出纽约州参议院全部63个选区的议员。初选于2020年6月23日举行。选举前，民主党在州参议院占40席，共和党占20席，另有3席空缺。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the state of Minnesota, one from each of its congressional districts. Primary elections were held in six districts on August 11. The elections coincided with the 2020 United States presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and other state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年明尼苏达州联邦众议院选举
