zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行明尼苏达州联邦众议院选举，选出该州8个国会选区的联邦众议员。6个选区的初选于8月11日举行。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期举行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Alaska
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Alaska took place on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states and the District of Columbia participated. Alaska voters chose three electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Republican President Donald Trump and his running mate, incumbent Vice President Mike Pence, against Democratic challenger and former Vice President Joe Biden and his running mate, United States Senator Kamala Harris of California.

zh.t: 2020年阿拉斯加州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，阿拉斯加州举行美国总统选举，作为当年美国总统选举的一部分。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。阿拉斯加州选民通过普选选出3名选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。共和党籍时任总统唐纳德·特朗普及其竞选搭档、时任副总统迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、来自加利福尼亚州的联邦参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the five U.S. representatives from the state of Oklahoma, one from each of the state's five congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年俄克拉何马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，俄克拉何马州举行联邦众议院选举，选出来自该州5个国会选区的5名联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、联邦众议院其他选举、联邦参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2020 elections for the Illinois Senate took place on November 3, 2020, to elect senators from 22 of the state's 59 Senate districts to serve in the 102nd General Assembly, with seats apportioned among the states based on the 2010 United States census. Under the Illinois Constitution of 1970, senators are divided into three groups, each group having a two-year term at a different part of the decade between censuses, with the rest of the decade being taken up by two four-year terms.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，伊利诺伊州举行参议院选举，选出州参议院59个选区中的22个席位，进入第102届州议会。席位划分依据2010年美国人口普查结果。根据1970年《伊利诺伊州宪法》，州参议员分为三组，在每个十年人口普查周期的不同阶段任职两年；其余时间则分两轮、每轮四年。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Montana
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Montana was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Montana voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump and running mate Vice President Mike Pence, against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，蒙大拿州举行美国总统选举，全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次选举。蒙大拿州选民通过普选选出总统选举人。共和党提名人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、副总统迈克·彭斯角逐民主党提名人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.s: The 2020 Utah Senate election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect state senators in 15 of the 29 Utah State Senate districts. These coincided with other elections in Utah, including for governor and the House of Representatives. State senators serve four-year terms in the Utah State Senate.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行犹他州参议院选举，选出29个州参议院选区中的15个席位。选举与犹他州州长和众议院等职位选举同时进行。州参议员任期四年。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the state of Maryland, one from each of the state's eight congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年马里兰州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2020年马里兰州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，选出该州8名联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。选举与2020年美国总统选举同时举行，也与其他联邦众议院、联邦参议院以及州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of New Mexico on November 3, 2020. To vote by mail, registered New Mexico voters must have requested a ballot by October 30, 2020.

zh.s: 美国新墨西哥州于2020年11月3日举行大选。登记选民如要邮寄投票，必须在10月30日前申请选票。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Virginia
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Virginia was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the 11 U.S. representatives from the state of Virginia, one from each of the state's 11 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年弗吉尼亚州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2020年弗吉尼亚州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，选出该州11名联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。选举与2020年美国总统选举同时举行，也与其他联邦众议院、联邦参议院以及州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Mississippi was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Mississippi voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.t: 2020年美国总统选举密西西比州选情
zh.s: 2020年美国总统选举密西西比州选情于11月3日星期二举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分，50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参与投票。密西西比州选民通过普选选出总统选举人。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、时任副总统迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Iowa was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Iowa, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年美国爱荷华州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2020年美国爱荷华州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行，选出一名代表爱荷华州的联邦参议员。选举与总统选举、其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议员选举以及各级州和地方选举同期举行。

en.s: The Pennsylvania Treasurer election of 2020 took place on November 3, 2020. Primary elections were originally due to take place on April 28, 2020. However, following concerns regarding the coronavirus pandemic the primaries were delayed until June 2, 2020. Incumbent Democratic State Treasurer Joe Torsella lost re-election to a second term to Republican Stacy Garrity.

zh.t: 2020年宾夕法尼亚州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2020年宾夕法尼亚州财政部长选举于11月3日举行。初选原定于2020年4月28日举行，但因新冠疫情引发的担忧，推迟至6月2日。民主党籍时任州财政部长乔·托塞拉竞选连任第二个任期失败，败给共和党人斯泰西·加里蒂。

en.s: Kansas state elections in 2020 were held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020. The deadline to register to vote was October 13, 2020. Early voting began October 14, 2020. Voters in Kansas are eligible to vote absentee, and there are no special eligibility criteria for doing so. Absentee ballots must be returned and received (in person or via mail) before November 2, 2020.

zh.s: 2020年堪萨斯州选举于11月3日星期二举行。选民登记截止日期为10月13日，提前投票于10月14日开始。堪萨斯州选民可以申请缺席投票，没有特别资格限制。缺席选票必须在11月2日前送达或寄达。

en.s: The 2020 Massachusetts general election was held on November 3, 2020, throughout Massachusetts. Primary elections were held on September 1, 2020. At the federal level, all nine seats in the United States House of Representatives were up for election. Also contested was the United States Senate seat held by Ed Markey. At the state level, all seats in the Massachusetts General Court (state legislature) were up for election.

zh.s: 2020年马萨诸塞州大选于2020年11月3日在全州举行，初选于2020年9月1日举行。联邦层面，众议院的全部9个席位都将改选，爱德·马基所持的联邦参议院席位也在此次选举中改选。州层面，马萨诸塞州议会（州立法机构）的全部席位也都进行改选。

en.s: The 2020 West Virginia State Treasurer election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the state treasurer of West Virginia. Incumbent Democrat John Perdue lost re-election to a seventh term to Republican nominee Riley Moore, who won 48 out of 55 counties. Primary elections were held on June 9. Perdue and Moore both won their primaries unopposed. This was the first time since W.

zh.t: 2020年美国西弗吉尼亚州州财长选举
zh.s: 2020年西弗吉尼亚州州财长选举于11月3日举行，以选出州财长。民主党籍时任财长约翰·珀杜竞选第七个任期连任失败，输给共和党候选人赖利·摩尔。摩尔赢得该州55个县中的48个。初选于6月9日举行，珀杜和摩尔均在无人竞争的情况下赢得各自党派提名。

en.s: Elections to the Iowa House of Representatives were held on November 3, 2020. In October 2020, The Washington Post identified this state election as one of eight whose outcomes could affect partisan balance during post-census redistricting.

zh.s: 爱荷华州众议院选举于2020年11月3日举行。2020年10月，《华盛顿邮报》将这场州级选举列为八场可能影响人口普查后选区重划政党格局的选举之一。

en.s: The 2020 Indiana gubernatorial election was won by incumbent Republican Eric Holcomb on November 3, 2020. The election was held concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Holcomb was eligible to run for re-election to a second term in office, and announced his intention to do so on July 13, 2019, alongside his lieutenant governor, Suzanne Crouch.

zh.s: 共和党籍时任州长埃里克·霍尔科姆于2020年11月3日赢得印第安纳州州长选举。选举与2020年美国总统选举同时举行，也与联邦众议院及多场州和地方选举同时进行。霍尔科姆符合竞选连任第二个任期的资格，并于2019年7月13日与副州长苏珊娜·克劳奇一同宣布参选。

en.s: The 2020 Washington State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 2020 United States elections. Washington voters elected state senators in 26 of the 49 state legislative districts. Elections to the Washington State Senate were held on November 3, 2020. Following the previous election in 2018, Democrats held a 28-seat majority in the Senate, compared to Republicans' 21 seats.

zh.s: 2020年华盛顿州参议院选举是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。该州选民在49个州议会选区中的26个选区选出州参议员。选举于2020年11月3日举行。2018年上一次选举后，民主党在参议院占28席，共和党占21席。

en.t: 2020 North Carolina Council of State elections
en.s: Elections were held in North Carolina on November 3, 2020, to select the ten officers of the North Carolina Council of State. These elections coincided with the presidential election, elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the Senate and elections to the North Carolina General Assembly and top state courts. Primary elections were held on March 3, 2020, for offices for which more than one candidate filed per party.

zh.t: 2020年北卡罗来纳州州务委员会选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，北卡罗来纳州举行州务委员会10个职位的选举。选举与总统、联邦众议院、联邦参议院、州议会和州最高法院等职位选举同时举行。对于有多个候选人参选的职位，各党于2020年3月3日举行初选。

en.s: The 2020 elections for the Indiana House of Representatives were held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, to elect representatives from all 100 districts. The primary election occurred on June 2, 2020. The Republican Party has held a House majority since 2010. Indiana legislators assume office on the second Tuesday after the general election. The elections for the United States President, Indiana's 9 congressional districts, Indiana's Governor race, and the Indiana Senate were held on this date.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，印第安纳州举行众议院全部100个选区的选举。初选于2020年6月2日举行。自2010年以来，共和党一直在州众议院占多数。州议员在大选后的第二个星期二就职。该州同期还举行美国总统、联邦众议院、州长和州参议院选举。

en.s: The 2020 West Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the governor of West Virginia, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Governor Jim Justice announced his 2020 re-election campaign on January 7, 2019.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行西弗吉尼亚州州长选举，与2020年美国总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院以及各州和地方选举同时进行。在任州长吉姆·贾斯蒂斯于2019年1月7日宣布竞选连任。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Ohio voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden and his running mate, California Senator Kamala Harris against the Republican Party's nominee—incumbent President Donald Trump and his running mate, Vice President Mike Pence.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，俄亥俄州举行美国总统选举。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。俄亥俄州选民通过普选选出选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登与其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯，对阵共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普及其竞选搭档、时任副总统迈克·彭斯。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Kentucky was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Kentucky voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，肯塔基州举行美国总统选举。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。肯塔基州选民通过普选选出选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与副总统迈克·彭斯搭档，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、来自加利福尼亚州的参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Missouri
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Missouri were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the state of Missouri, one from each of the state's eight congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 United States presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年密苏里州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行密苏里州联邦众议院选举，选出该州8个国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.s: The 2020 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the governor of New Hampshire. Incumbent Republican Governor Chris Sununu was elected to a third two-year term in office with more than 65% of the vote and winning every county, defeating his opponent Dan Feltes, the Majority Leader of the Senate. Nine governors ran for re-election in this cycle and all nine were re-elected.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。共和党籍现任州长克里斯·苏努努以超过65%的得票率赢得第三个两年任期，并赢得该州所有县，击败参议院多数党领袖、民主党候选人丹·费尔特斯。本轮选举中有9位州长竞选连任，9人全部当选。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Arkansas
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Arkansas were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the state of Arkansas, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年阿肯色州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行阿肯色州联邦众议院选举，选出该州4个国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.s: Elections were held in Nevada on November 3, 2020. On that date, the state held elections for U.S. President, U.S. House of Representatives, Nevada Assembly, 10 of the 21 seats in the Nevada Senate, and various others. In addition, several measures were on the ballot. To vote by mail, registered Nevada voters had to ensure each ballot was postmarked by November 3 and received by November 10, 2020.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，内华达州举行选举。选民投票选举美国总统、联邦众议员、内华达州众议员、州参议院21个席位中的10个席位以及其他职位。此外，还有多项议案列入选票。内华达州登记选民如要邮寄投票，必须确保选票于11月3日前寄出，并于2020年11月10日前送达。

en.s: The 2020 Idaho House of Representatives elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections on November 3, 2020. Idaho voters elected state representatives in all 70 seats of the House, electing 2 state representatives in each of the 35 Idaho state legislative districts. State representatives serve two-year terms in the Idaho House of Representatives. Following the previous election, Republicans held a 56-to-14-seat majority over Democrats.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，爱达荷州举行州众议院选举，作为美国两年一度选举的一部分。选民选出州众议院全部70名议员，35个州议会选区各选出2人。州众议员任期两年。上次选举后，共和党以56席对14席领先民主党。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Washington
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Washington were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the 10 U.S. representatives from the state of Washington, one from each of the state's 10 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年华盛顿州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行华盛顿州联邦众议院选举，选出该州10个国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in South Dakota was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. South Dakota voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.t: 2020年南达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，南达科他州举行美国总统选举。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。南达科他州选民通过普选选出选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与副总统迈克·彭斯搭档，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、来自加利福尼亚州的参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in South Carolina
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in South Carolina was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of South Carolina. Republican incumbent Lindsey Graham won re-election to a fourth term, defeating Democratic nominee Jaime Harrison. Primary elections were held on June 9, 2020.

zh.t: 2020年南卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行南卡罗来纳州联邦参议员选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。共和党籍现任参议员林赛·格雷厄姆击败民主党候选人杰米·哈里森，成功连任第四个任期。初选于2020年6月9日举行。

en.s: Alaska state elections in 2020 were held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020. Aside from its party-run Democratic presidential primary held on April 10 (not including the Republican Party presidential primary which was cancelled by the state party), its primary elections were held on August 18, 2020. In addition to the U.S. presidential race, Alaska voters elected the Class II U.S.

zh.s: 2020年阿拉斯加州选举于11月3日（星期二）举行。民主党在4月10日举行了自行组织的总统初选；共和党州党部取消了该党总统初选。州内其他初选于8月18日举行。除总统选举外，阿拉斯加州选民还参加了州内选举。

en.s: The 2020 Northern Mariana Islands general election were held on Tuesday, 3 November 2020, corresponding with the 2020 United States general elections. Voters in the Northern Mariana Islands voted for the non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives, 3 seats in the Northern Mariana Islands Senate, all twenty seats in the Northern Mariana Islands House of Representatives, seats for the municipal council, seats for the board of education, 1 justice, and 2 judges.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，北马里亚纳群岛举行大选，与2020年美国大选同期进行。选民投票选出一名没有投票权的联邦众议院代表、北马里亚纳群岛参议院3个席位、州众议院全部20个席位，以及市议会席位、教育委员会席位、一名司法官和两名法官。

en.t: 2020 West Virginia Secretary of State election
en.s: The 2020 West Virginia Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the secretary of state of West Virginia. It was held concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, along with elections to the United States Senate and United States House of Representatives, as well as various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年西弗吉尼亚州州务卿选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行西弗吉尼亚州州务卿选举，与2020年美国总统选举、联邦参议员和联邦众议员选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the seven U.S. representatives from the state of Alabama, one from each of the state's seven congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举，选出该州7个国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the seven U.S. representatives from the state of South Carolina, one from each of the state's seven congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举，选出该州7个国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the five U.S. representatives from the state of Oregon, one from each of the state's five congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年俄勒冈州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行俄勒冈州联邦众议院选举，选出该州5个国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.s: The 2020 Montana Attorney General election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the Attorney General of the U.S. state of Montana. Incumbent Republican Montana Attorney General Tim Fox was re-elected in 2016 with 67.7% of the vote. Fox was term-limited and was ineligible to run for re-election. Fox decided to run for the Governor of Montana election, losing the nomination to Greg Gianforte.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行蒙大拿州总检察长选举。现任共和党总检察长蒂姆·福克斯于2016年当选，得票率为67.7%。他因任期限制不能竞选连任，决定竞选蒙大拿州州长提名，但在共和党初选中败给格雷格·吉安福特。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Hawaii
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Hawaii were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of Hawaii, one from each of the state's two congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年夏威夷州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行夏威夷州联邦众议院选举，选出该州两个国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.s: The 2020 Missouri Secretary of State General election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the Secretary of State of Missouri. It was held concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, along with elections to the United States Senate and United States House of Representatives, as well as various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Secretary of State Jay Ashcroft won re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行密苏里州州务卿大选，与2020年美国总统选举、联邦参议员和联邦众议员选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。现任共和党州务卿杰伊·阿什克罗夫特成功连任第二个任期。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Texas was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Texas has historically voted Republican, but recent demographic shifts have made the voter turnout more competitive.

zh.t: 2020年得克萨斯州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，得克萨斯州举行美国总统选举。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。得克萨斯州历来支持共和党，但近年人口结构变化使选民投票竞争更加激烈。

en.s: The 2020 Oregon State Treasurer election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the Oregon State Treasurer. Incumbent Democratic State Treasurer Tobias Read, first elected in 2016, was reelected to a second term in office.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行俄勒冈州州财长选举。在任民主党州财长托比亚斯·里德于2016年首次当选，这次成功连任第二届。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Kentucky
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Kentucky was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the six U.S. representatives from the state of Kentucky, one from each of the state's six congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年肯塔基州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，肯塔基州举行联邦众议院选举，选出来自该州6个国会选区的6名联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of New Hampshire, one from each of the state's two congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年新罕布什尔州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，新罕布什尔州举行联邦众议院选举，选出来自该州两个国会选区的两名联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Rhode Island was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Rhode Island voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，罗得岛州举行美国总统选举，全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次选举。罗得岛州选民通过普选选出总统选举人。共和党提名人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、副总统迈克·彭斯角逐民主党提名人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.s: The 2020 Fort Lauderdale mayoral election took place on November 3, 2020. A 2019 amendment to the city charter eliminated municipal primary elections, lengthened the Mayor's term of office from three to four years, and aligned mayoral elections with presidential elections, beginning with the 2020 election. Incumbent Mayor Dean Trantalis ran for re-election to a second term, and was challenged by attorney Kenneth Cooper.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行劳德代尔堡市长选举。2019年城市章程修正案取消了市政初选，将市长任期从3年延长到4年，并规定从2020年起与总统选举同时举行市长选举。在任市长迪恩·特兰塔利斯竞选连任第二届，对手是律师肯尼思·库珀。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Nevada
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Nevada was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the state of Nevada, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the Nevada Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年内华达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，内华达州举行联邦众议院选举，选出来自该州4个国会选区的4名联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和州参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Wisconsin was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Wisconsin voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.t: 2020年威斯康星州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，威斯康星州举行美国总统选举，全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次选举。威斯康星州选民通过普选选出总统选举人。共和党提名人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、副总统迈克·彭斯角逐民主党提名人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.s: The 2020 elections for the Pennsylvania State Senate were held on November 3, 2020, with 25 of 50 districts being contested. Primary elections were held on June 2, 2020. The term of office for those elected in 2020 began when the Senate convened in January 2021. Pennsylvania State Senators are elected for four-year terms, with half of the seats up for election every two years.

zh.t: 2020年宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举，50个选区中有25个席位参与改选。初选于2020年6月2日举行。2020年当选的州参议员于2021年1月州参议院召开会议时开始任职。州参议员任期四年，因此每两年改选一半席位。

en.t: 2020 United States secretary of state elections
en.s: The 2020 United States secretary of state elections were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the secretaries of state in seven states. These elections took place concurrently with several other federal, state, and local elections. The previous elections for this group of states took place in 2016. The secretary of state of Vermont serves two-year terms and was last elected in 2018.

zh.s: 2020年美国州务卿选举于11月3日举行，改选7个州的州务卿。选举与多项联邦、州及地方选举同期举行。这组州上一次选举州务卿是在2016年。佛蒙特州州务卿任期为两年，上一次选举在2018年举行。

en.s: South Carolina state elections in 2020 were held in the U.S. state of South Carolina on November 3, 2020.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，南卡罗来纳州举行州级选举。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the 27 U.S. representatives from Florida, one from each of the state's 27 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the U.S. Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，佛罗里达州举行联邦众议院选举，选出来自该州27个国会选区的27名联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和联邦众议院其他选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Wyoming was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Wyoming, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年怀俄明州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行怀俄明州联邦参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 3, 2020, the District of Columbia held an election for its non-voting House delegate representing the District of Columbia's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the elections of other federal, state, and local offices. The non-voting delegate is elected for a two-year term. Democrat Eleanor Holmes Norton, who had represented the district since 1991, was re-elected to a sixteenth term in office.

zh.t: 2020年哥伦比亚特区联邦众议院代表选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，哥伦比亚特区举行不具表决权的联邦众议院代表选举，选出该区不分区选区的代表。选举与其他联邦、州和地方职位选举同时举行。该代表任期两年。自1991年起代表该区的民主党人埃莉诺·霍姆斯·诺顿成功连任第16届。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Ohio
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Ohio were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the 16 U.S. representatives from the state of Ohio, one from each of the state's 16 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年俄亥俄州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，俄亥俄州举行联邦众议院选举，选出来自该州16个国会选区的16名联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2020 Montana gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the next governor of Montana, concurrently with the U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the U.S. Senate and the House of Representatives and various state and local elections. It resulted in voters selecting Greg Gianforte over Mike Cooney.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行蒙大拿州州长选举，与总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院以及各州和地方选举同时进行。选民选出格雷格·吉安福特，击败迈克·库尼。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Massachusetts was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate in other states, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行马萨诸塞州联邦参议院选举，选出代表马萨诸塞州的联邦参议员，与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Indiana
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Indiana were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the nine U.S. representatives from the state of Indiana, one from each of the state's nine congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年印第安纳州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2020年印第安纳州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，选出该州9名联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。选举与2020年美国总统选举同时举行，也与其他联邦众议院、联邦参议院以及州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: An election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect all 50 members to North Carolina's Senate. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including the Presidency, U.S. Senate, Governor, U.S. House of Representatives, and state house. The primary election was held on March 3, 2020, with a run-off on June 23, 2020.

zh.t: 2020年北卡罗来纳州参议院选举
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于2020年11月3日举行选举，选出州参议院全部50名议员。选举与总统、联邦参议员、州长、联邦众议员和州众议院等职位的选举同时举行。初选于2020年3月3日举行，第二轮于6月23日举行。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in Guam on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, along with the election for the Guam delegate to the U.S. House of Representatives. Before the election, the Democratic Party held ten of the fifteen seats in the Legislature while the Republican Party held five seats. The election resulted in a gain of two seats for the Republican and a loss of two seats for Democrats to retain.

zh.s: 关岛立法议会选举于2020年11月3日星期二举行，同时选出关岛驻美国众议院代表。选举前，民主党在议会15个席位中占10席，共和党占5席。选举后，共和党增加2席，民主党减少2席，但仍保住多数。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in North Dakota was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. North Dakota voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump from Florida, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence from Indiana against Democratic nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden from Delaware, and his running mate Senator Kamala Harris of California.

zh.t: 2020年北达科他州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，北达科他州举行美国总统选举。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。北达科他州选民通过普选选出选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。共和党候选人、来自佛罗里达州的时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与来自印第安纳州的副总统迈克·彭斯搭档，对阵民主党候选人、来自特拉华州的前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、来自加利福尼亚州的参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 3, 2020, to elect representatives from all 435 congressional districts across each of the 50 U.S. states to the 117th United States Congress, as well as six non-voting delegates from the District of Columbia and the inhabited U.S. territories. Special House elections were also held on various dates throughout 2020.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行美国联邦众议院选举，选出美国50个州全部435个国会选区的议员，组成第117届国会；此外还选出来自哥伦比亚特区和有人居住的美国领地的6名无投票权代表。2020年全年还有多场联邦众议院特别选举。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Oklahoma was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Oklahoma voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.t: 2020年俄克拉何马州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，俄克拉何马州举行美国总统选举。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。俄克拉何马州选民通过普选选出选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与副总统迈克·彭斯搭档，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、来自加利福尼亚州的参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in South Dakota was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of South Dakota, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年南达科他州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行南达科他州联邦参议员选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议员和联邦众议员选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in New Jersey
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in New Jersey was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. New Jersey voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，新泽西州举行美国总统选举。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。新泽西州选民通过普选选出选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与副总统迈克·彭斯搭档，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、来自加利福尼亚州的参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.s: The 2020 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the governor of North Carolina, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to one-third of the United States Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Democratic incumbent Roy Cooper was elected to a second term, defeating Republican lieutenant governor Dan Forest.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行北卡罗来纳州州长选举，与2020年美国总统选举、三分之一联邦参议员改选、联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。民主党籍现任州长罗伊·库珀击败共和党候选人、副州长丹·福里斯特，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2020 election for Missouri House of Representatives was held on November 3, 2020. All 163 seats in the state House were up for election in 2020. The primary election was held on August 31, 2020.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行密苏里州众议院选举，州众议院全部163个席位都进行选举。初选于2020年8月31日举行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the three U.S. representatives from the state of Nebraska, one from each of the state's three congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年内布拉斯加州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行内布拉斯加州联邦众议院选举，选出该州3个国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in South Carolina was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. South Carolina voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.t: 2020年南卡罗来纳州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，南卡罗来纳州举行美国总统选举。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。南卡罗来纳州选民通过普选选出选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与副总统迈克·彭斯搭档，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、来自加利福尼亚州的参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.s: Three justices of the seven-member North Carolina Supreme Court and five judges of the 15-member North Carolina Court of Appeals were elected by North Carolina voters on November 3, 2020, concurrently with other state elections. Terms for seats on each court are eight years. These elections were conducted on a partisan basis.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，北卡罗来纳州选民选出北卡罗来纳州最高法院7名大法官中的3名，以及北卡罗来纳州上诉法院15名法官中的5名，选举与其他州级选举同期进行。每个法院的法官任期均为8年。选举按党派举行。

en.s: A general election in the state of Montana was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020. One seat in the United States House of Representatives, one seat in the United States Senate, and all five state constitutional offices were up for election. Additionally half of the seats in the Montana Senate, all of the Montana House of Representatives, various local offices and ballot measures were up for election.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，蒙大拿州举行大选。联邦众议院、联邦参议院和州内全部5个宪法规定的职位都进行选举。此外，蒙大拿州参议院一半席位、州众议院全部席位、各类地方职位和公投议题也都进行选举。

en.s: The 2020 Pennsylvania attorney general election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the attorney general of Pennsylvania. Democratic incumbent Josh Shapiro won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican nominee Heather Heidelbaugh. Primary elections were originally due to take place on April 28, 2020. Following concerns regarding the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States including Pennsylvania, the primaries were delayed until June 2, 2020.

zh.t: 2020年宾夕法尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行宾夕法尼亚州总检察长选举。民主党籍现任总检察长乔什·夏皮罗击败共和党候选人希瑟·海德尔鲍，成功连任第二个任期。初选原定于2020年4月28日举行，但由于新冠疫情在美国及宾夕法尼亚州传播引发担忧，初选推迟至6月2日。

en.s: The 2020 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the State Treasurer of the U.S. state of Missouri. Elections were also held for U.S. president, U.S. House, and governor of Missouri, as well as various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Scott Fitzpatrick was appointed by Governor Mike Parson to finish the term of previous Treasurer Eric Schmitt, who had been subsequently appointed as Attorney General.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行密苏里州财政部长选举，与总统、联邦众议院和密苏里州州长等职位选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。现任共和党财政部长斯科特·菲茨帕特里克由州长迈克·帕森任命，接替后来获任命为总检察长的前财政部长埃里克·施密特，完成其剩余任期。

en.s: The 2020 Wisconsin Senate elections were held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, at the Fall general election in Wisconsin. 16 of the 33 seats in the Wisconsin Senate were up for election—the even-numbered districts. Before the election, Republicans held 18 seats, Democrats held 13, and two were vacant. Of the seats up for election, seven were held by Republicans, seven were held by Democrats, one was vacated by a Democratic resignation, and one was vacated by a Republican resignation.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，威斯康星州举行秋季大选，州参议院33个席位中的16个进行选举，即所有偶数编号选区。选举前，共和党占18席，民主党占13席，另有2席空缺。在此次改选的席位中，共和党和民主党各占7席，另有1席因民主党参议员辞职而空缺，1席因共和党参议员辞职而空缺。

en.t: 2020 West Virginia House of Delegates election
en.s: Elections to the West Virginia House of Delegates took place on November 3, 2020. All the seats in the West Virginia House of Delegates were up for election.

zh.t: 2020年西弗吉尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行西弗吉尼亚州众议院选举，众议院全部席位都进行选举。

en.s: Elections were held in California on November 3, 2020. Unlike previous election cycles, the primary elections were held on Super Tuesday, March 3, 2020. In addition to the U.S. presidential race, California voters elected all of California's seats to the House of Representatives, all of the seats of the State Assembly, and all odd-numbered seats of the State Senate. Neither of the state's two U.S.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州选举于2020年11月3日举行。与以往选举周期不同，当年的初选在3月3日超级星期二举行。除了总统选举外，加州选民还改选了所有联邦众议院席位、州众议院席位及州参议院的所有奇数席位。

en.t: 2020 North Dakota House of Representatives election
en.s: Elections to the North Dakota House of Representatives were held on November 3, 2020. A total of 46 seats out of 94 were up for re-election. The primary election was held on June 9, 2020.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行北达科他州众议院选举，94个席位中有46个席位进行改选。初选于2020年6月9日举行。

en.s: The 2020 Hawaii House of Representatives elections took place on November 3, 2020, as part of the biennial 2020 United States elections. The process elected all 51 seats in the Hawaii House of Representatives. Primary elections took place on August 8.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行夏威夷州众议院选举，作为美国两年一度选举的一部分，选出夏威夷州众议院全部51个席位。初选于8月8日举行。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Louisiana
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Louisiana was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Louisiana, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年路易斯安那州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行路易斯安那州联邦参议员选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议员和联邦众议员选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.s: The Wisconsin State Assembly elections of 2020 were held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020. All 99 seats in the Wisconsin State Assembly were up for election. 13 incumbent Assembly members filed papers declaring that they would not run for re-election, including two who announced early vacancies. Right before this election, 63 Assembly seats were held by Republicans, 34 seats were held by Democrats, and two seats were vacant (both seats were vacated by Democrats).

zh.t: 2020年威斯康星州州众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二举行威斯康星州众议院选举，州众议院全部99个席位都进行选举。13名现任州众议员提交文件宣布不竞选连任，其中两人提前宣布将腾出席位。选举前，共和党占63席，民主党占34席，另有2席空缺（均因民主党议员离任而空缺）。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Utah was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Utah voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.t: 2020年美国总统选举犹他州选情
zh.s: 2020年美国总统选举犹他州选情于11月3日星期二举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分，50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参与投票。犹他州选民通过普选选出总统选举人。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、时任副总统迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.s: The 2020 Arizona Senate elections was held on November 3, 2020, as part of the biennial 2020 United States elections. Arizona voters elected state senators in all of the state's 30 senate districts. State senators serve two-year terms in the Arizona Senate, with all of the seats up for election each cycle. The primary elections on August 4, 2020, determined which candidates appeared on the general election ballot.

zh.s: 2020年亚利桑那州参议院选举于11月3日举行，是当年两年一度的美国选举的一部分。选民在该州全部30个参议院选区选出州参议员，任期两年，每届选举所有席位均改选。2020年8月4日举行的初选决定了哪些候选人进入大选。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the U.S. representative from Delaware's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections. The Democratic and Republican primaries was held on September 15, 2020.

zh.t: 2020年特拉华州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2020年特拉华州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，选出该州单一国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举同时举行，也与其他联邦众议院、联邦参议院以及州和地方选举同时进行。民主党和共和党的初选于2020年9月15日举行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Connecticut was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Connecticut voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.t: 2020年美国总统选举康涅狄格州选情
zh.s: 2020年美国总统选举康涅狄格州选情于11月3日星期二举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分，50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参与投票。康涅狄格州选民通过普选选出总统选举人。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、时任副总统迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Illinois was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Illinois, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, various state and local elections, and the Illinois Fair Tax.

zh.t: 2020年伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2020年伊利诺伊州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行，选出一名代表伊利诺伊州的联邦参议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举同时举行，也与其他州的联邦参议员、联邦众议员以及州和地方选举同时进行，并与伊利诺伊州累进税议案的表决同时举行。

en.s: The 2020 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 3, 2020, to elect the Lieutenant Governor of North Carolina, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Primary elections were held on March 3, 2020.

zh.t: 2020年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 2020年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举于11月3日举行，选出该州副州长，同时举行的还有美国总统、联邦参议员、联邦众议员以及州和地方选举。初选于2020年3月3日举行。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Alaska
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Alaska was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Alaska, concurrently with the nationwide presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年阿拉斯加州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2020年阿拉斯加州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行，选出一名代表阿拉斯加州的联邦参议员。选举与全国总统选举同时举行，也与其他州的联邦参议员、联邦众议员以及州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Iowa
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Iowa was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the state of Iowa, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年爱荷华州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2020年爱荷华州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，选出该州4名联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。选举与2020年美国总统选举同时举行，也与其他联邦众议院、联邦参议院以及州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in West Virginia
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in West Virginia were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the three U.S. representatives from the state of West Virginia, one from each of the state's three congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年西弗吉尼亚州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2020年西弗吉尼亚州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，选出该州3名联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。选举与2020年美国总统选举同时举行，也与其他联邦众议院、联邦参议院以及州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2020 elections for the Florida Senate took place on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, to elect state senators from 20 of 40 districts. The Republican Party has held a Senate majority since 1995. The result was a one-seat gain for the Republicans, thus maintaining their majority. The elections for U.S. President, U.S. House of Representatives, and the Florida House of Representatives were also held on this date.

zh.s: 2020年佛罗里达州参议院选举于11月3日星期二举行，选出40个选区中的20个州参议员席位。共和党自1995年以来一直在参议院占多数。这次选举后共和党增加一个席位，继续保持多数。联邦总统、联邦众议院和佛罗里达州众议院选举也在当天举行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states and the District of Columbia participated. Alabama voters chose nine electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Republican President Donald Trump and his running mate, incumbent Vice President Mike Pence, against Democratic challenger and former Vice President Joe Biden and his running mate, United States Senator Kamala Harris of California.

zh.t: 2020年美国总统选举阿拉巴马州选情
zh.s: 2020年美国总统选举阿拉巴马州选情于11月3日星期二举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分，50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参与投票。阿拉巴马州选民通过普选选出9名总统选举人。共和党籍时任总统唐纳德·特朗普及其竞选搭档、时任副总统迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州联邦参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.s: The 2020 Delaware Senate election was held on November 3, 2020, concurrently with the elections for the Delaware House of Representatives, to elect members to the Delaware General Assembly. 11 of the 21 seats in the Delaware Senate were up for election. Primary elections were held on September 16, 2020. Democrats increased their majority in the Senate by gaining two seats, winning 14 seats, compared to seven seats for the Republicans.

zh.s: 2020年特拉华州参议院选举于11月3日举行，与特拉华州众议院选举同时进行，选出特拉华州议会成员。州参议院21个席位中有11个改选。初选于2020年9月16日举行。民主党增加两个席位，进一步扩大多数优势，最终获得14席，共和党获得7席。

en.s: The 2020 Oregon Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the Oregon Secretary of State, the highest office in the state after the governor. Incumbent Republican Bev Clarno had agreed not to run for a full term. Clarno was appointed by Governor Kate Brown to replace Dennis Richardson, who died of cancer during his term.

zh.s: 2020年俄勒冈州州务卿选举于2020年11月3日举行，选出该州州务卿，这是州长之后的最高职务。共和党籍现任州务卿贝芙·克拉诺已同意不竞选完整任期。州长凯特·布朗任命她接替因癌症去世的丹尼斯·理查森。

en.s: The 2020 elections for the Florida House of Representatives took place on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, to elect representatives from all 120 districts. The Republican Party had held a House majority since 1997. The elections for U.S. president, U.S. House of Representatives, and the state Florida senate were also held on this date. The Republicans gained seven seats, while the Democrats lost four in the state house.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行佛罗里达州众议院全部120个选区的选举。自1997年以来，共和党一直在州众议院占多数。该州同期还举行美国总统、联邦众议院和州参议院选举。共和党增加7席，民主党减少4席。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of New Jersey. It was held concurrently with the 2020 United States presidential election, as well as various other elections. The primary elections were moved from June 2, 2020, to July 7, 2020, due to COVID-19 pandemic concerns.

zh.t: 2020年新泽西州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行新泽西州联邦参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举及其他选举同时举行。由于新冠疫情，初选从2020年6月2日改到7月7日举行。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in New Mexico
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in New Mexico was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of New Mexico, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年新墨西哥州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行新墨西哥州联邦参议院选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员，与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2020 Massachusetts Senate election was held on November 3, 2020 to elect all 40 members of the Massachusetts Senate. Primary elections were held on September 1, 2020. Voters in Massachusetts elected all 40 members of the State Senate to serve two-year terms in the Massachusetts General Court. The election coincided with United States national elections and Massachusetts state elections, including U.S. Senate, U.S.

zh.t: 2020年美国马萨诸塞州参议院选举
zh.s: 2020年美国马萨诸塞州参议院选举于11月3日举行，改选州参议院全部40个席位。初选于9月1日举行。马萨诸塞州选民选出州参议院全部40名议员，任期两年。选举与美国全国选举及马萨诸塞州其他选举同期举行，包括联邦参议员选举和联邦……

en.s: Utah state elections in 2020 were held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020. Aside from its presidential primaries held on March 3, its primary elections were held on June 30, 2020. In addition to the U.S. presidential race, Utah voters elected the Governor of Utah, 9 seats of its Board of Education, four of Utah's other executive officers, all of its seats to the House of Representatives, all of the seats of the Utah House of Representatives, and 15 of 29 seats in the Utah State Senate.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，犹他州举行州级选举。除3月3日举行的总统初选外，其他初选于2020年6月30日举行。选举职位包括州长、州教育委员会9个席位、另外4个州行政职位、联邦众议院全部席位、犹他州众议院全部席位，以及州参议院29个席位中的15个。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent Michigan. It was held concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. This was one of two Democratic-held U.S.
