zh.s: 2020年美国密歇根州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行，选出一名代表密歇根州的联邦参议员。选举与总统选举、其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议员选举以及各级州和地方选举同期举行。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Arkansas
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Arkansas was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Arkansas, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年美国阿肯色州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2020年美国阿肯色州联邦参议员选举于11月3日举行，选出一名代表阿肯色州的联邦参议员。选举与总统选举、其他州的联邦参议员选举、联邦众议员选举以及各级州和地方选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2020 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the governor of Utah. Incumbent Republican Governor Gary Herbert declined to run for election to a third full term.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行犹他州州长选举，以选出州长。现任共和党州长加里·赫伯特没有竞选第三个完整任期。

en.s: General elections were held in the U.S. state of Washington on November 3, 2020. A primary was held on August 4.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，华盛顿州举行大选。初选于同年8月4日举行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Nevada was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Nevada voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，内华达州举行美国总统选举。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。内华达州选民通过普选选出选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与副总统迈克·彭斯搭档，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、来自加利福尼亚州的参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Maine was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Maine voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，缅因州举行美国总统选举。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。缅因州选民通过普选选出选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与副总统迈克·彭斯搭档，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、来自加利福尼亚州的参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Wisconsin
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Wisconsin were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the state of Wisconsin, one from each of the state's eight congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年威斯康星州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行威斯康星州联邦众议院选举，选出该州8个国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.s: The 2020 California State Assembly election was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, with the primary election being held on March 3, 2020. Voters in the 80 districts of the California State Assembly elected their representatives. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including for U.S. president and the state senate.

zh.t: 2020年加利福尼亚州州众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二举行加利福尼亚州州众议院选举，初选于同年3月3日举行。选民选出加利福尼亚州州众议院全部80个选区的代表。选举还与总统和州参议院等其他职位选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2020 New Hampshire Executive Council elections took place on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, to elect all five members of the Executive Council of New Hampshire. The party primaries were held on September 8.

zh.t: 2020年新罕布什尔州行政委员会选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二举行新罕布什尔州行政委员会选举，选出该委员会全部5名成员。党内初选于9月8日举行。

en.s: The 2020 Maine House of Representatives elections took place on November 3, 2020, alongside the biennial United States elections. Maine voters elected members of the Maine House of Representatives via plurality voting in all 151 of the state house's districts, as well as a non-voting member from the Passamaquoddy Tribe. The election was also held alongside elections for the Maine Senate.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行缅因州众议院选举，作为美国两年一度选举的一部分。缅因州选民通过相对多数票制选出全部151个州众议院选区的议员，以及一名来自帕萨马夸迪部族、没有投票权的成员。选举还与缅因州参议院选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2020 elections for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives was held on November 3, 2020, with all districts being decided. The term of office for those that were elected in 2020 began when the House of Representatives convened in January 2021. Pennsylvania State Representatives were elected for two-year terms, with all 203 seats up for election every two years.

zh.t: 2020年宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举，所有选区都进行选举。2020年当选的议员于2021年1月众议院开会时开始任职。宾夕法尼亚州众议员任期两年，全部203个席位每两年改选一次。

en.s: The 2020 Will County Executive election was held on November 3, 2020. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Larry Walsh declined to run for re-election to a fifth term, citing health issues. Walsh died on June 3, 2020, and County Board Speaker Denise Winfrey was appointed to serve out the remainder of his term. State Senator Jennifer Bertino-Tarrant ran to succeed Walsh, and faced Nick Palmer, Walsh's chief of staff, in the Democratic primary.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行威尔县县行政长官选举。民主党籍现任县行政长官拉里·沃尔什因健康问题，没有竞选第五个任期。沃尔什于2020年6月3日去世后，县委员会主席丹妮丝·温弗瑞获任命，接替他完成剩余任期。州参议员詹妮弗·贝尔蒂诺-塔兰特竞选接替沃尔什，并在民主党初选中对阵沃尔什的办公厅主任尼克·帕尔默。

en.s: The 2020 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the governor and lieutenant governor of North Dakota, concurrently with other statewide elections and federal elections, including the U.S. presidential election. Incumbent Republican Governor Doug Burgum and Lieutenant Governor Brent Sanford were both re-elected to a second term.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行北达科他州州长和副州长选举，与其他全州和联邦选举同期进行，包括总统选举。共和党籍现任州长道格·伯古姆和副州长布伦特·桑福德均成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2020 Indiana Attorney General election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the attorney general of the U.S. state of Indiana. The Democratic primary convention was scheduled for June 13, 2020. The Republican primary convention was scheduled with a live stream on June 18, 2020, followed by mail-in voting between June 22 and July 9.

zh.t: 2020年印第安纳州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行印第安纳州总检察长选举。民主党党代会原定于2020年6月13日举行。共和党党代会原定于6月18日举行，并进行网络直播；邮寄投票时间为6月22日至7月9日。

en.s: The 2020 United States state treasurer elections were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the state treasurer in seven states. These elections took place concurrently with several other federal, state, and local elections. The previous elections for this group of states took place in 2016. The state treasurer of Vermont serves a two-year term and was last elected in 2018.

zh.s: 2020年美国各州州财长选举于11月3日举行，改选7个州的州财长，并与多项联邦、州及地方选举同期举行。这组州上一次选举州财长是在2016年。佛蒙特州州财长任期为两年，上一次选举在2018年举行。

en.s: The 2020 Indiana Senate election was held on November 3, 2020, as a part of the biennial elections in the U.S. state of Indiana, coinciding with other elections in the state, including for U.S. president, U.S. House, Indiana governor, and Indiana House, as well as various other state and local elections. Voters elected members to 25 of the 50 seats in the Indiana Senate to serve four-year terms in single-member constituencies.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行印第安纳州参议院选举，作为该州两年一度选举的一部分，与总统、联邦众议院、印第安纳州州长和州众议院等职位选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。选民选出印第安纳州参议院50个席位中的25个，议员由单一议员选区选出，任期四年。

en.t: 2020 North Carolina House of Representatives election
en.s: An election was held on November 3, 2020 to elect all 120 members to North Carolina's House of Representatives. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including the Presidency, U.S Senate, Governor, U.S. House of Representatives, and state senate. The primary election was held on March 3, 2020 with a run-off on June 23, 2020.

zh.t: 2020年北卡罗来纳州众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行北卡罗来纳州众议院选举，选出该州众议院全部120名议员。选举还与总统、联邦参议员、州长、联邦众议院和州参议院等其他职位选举同期举行。初选于2020年3月3日举行，决选于6月23日举行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Michigan was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Michigan voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump of Florida, and his running mate, Vice President Mike Pence of Indiana against the Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden of Delaware, and his running mate, Senator Kamala Harris of California.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，密歇根州举行美国总统选举。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。密歇根州选民通过普选选出选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。共和党候选人、来自佛罗里达州的时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与来自印第安纳州的副总统迈克·彭斯搭档，对阵民主党候选人、来自特拉华州的前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、来自加利福尼亚州的参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Hawaii
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Hawaii was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Hawaii voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，夏威夷州举行美国总统选举。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。夏威夷州选民通过普选选出选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与副总统迈克·彭斯搭档，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、来自加利福尼亚州的参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Maryland was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Maryland voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，马里兰州举行美国总统选举。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了选举。马里兰州选民通过普选选出选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。共和党候选人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与副总统迈克·彭斯搭档，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、来自加利福尼亚州的参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Oregon on November 3, 2020. Primary elections were held on May 19, 2020.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，俄勒冈州举行大选。初选于2020年5月19日举行。

en.s: A general election were held in the U.S. state of Idaho on November 3, 2020; with primaries being held in March and May. To vote by mail, registered Idaho voters must have requested a ballot by October 23, 2020.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，爱达荷州举行大选，初选于3月和5月举行。登记选民如要邮寄投票，必须在2020年10月23日前申请选票。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives election in Guam
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives election in Guam was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, to elect the non-voting Delegate to the United States House of Representatives from Guam's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including the larger 2020 United States House of Representatives elections and the 2020 Guamanian legislative election.

zh.t: 2020年关岛联邦众议院代表选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，关岛举行联邦众议院代表选举，选出该岛不分区选区的无表决权代表。选举与其他联邦和州级职位选举同时进行，包括规模更大的2020年联邦众议院选举和2020年关岛议会选举。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Wyoming was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states and the District of Columbia participated. Wyoming voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump and running mate Vice President Mike Pence, against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，怀俄明州举行美国总统选举，全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次选举。怀俄明州选民通过普选选出总统选举人。共和党提名人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、副总统迈克·彭斯角逐民主党提名人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives election in Montana
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives election in Montana was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the U.S. representative from Montana's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年蒙大拿州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行蒙大拿州联邦众议院选举，选出该州不分区国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和联邦众议院其他选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Oregon was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Oregon voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，俄勒冈州举行美国总统选举，全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次选举。俄勒冈州选民通过普选选出总统选举人。共和党提名人、总统唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、副总统迈克·彭斯角逐民主党提名人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Virginia
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Virginia was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Virginia voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.t: 2020年弗吉尼亚州美国总统选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，弗吉尼亚州举行美国总统选举，全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参加了这次选举。弗吉尼亚州选民通过普选选出总统选举人。共和党提名人、时任总统唐纳德·特朗普与竞选搭档、副总统迈克·彭斯角逐民主党提名人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.s: General elections were held in Puerto Rico on November 3, 2020, to elect the officials of the Puerto Rican government who served from January 2021 to January 2025, most notably the position of Governor and Resident Commissioner. In addition, there was a non-binding status referendum to ask voters if Puerto Rico should become the 51st state of the Union.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，波多黎各举行大选，选出2021年1月至2025年1月任职的政府官员，主要职位包括州长和驻美国国会专员。选民还参加了一项不具约束力的地位公投，决定是否支持波多黎各成为美国第51个州。

en.s: The 2020 United States state legislative elections were held on November 3, 2020, for 86 state legislative chambers in 44 states. Across the fifty states, approximately 65 percent of all upper house seats and 85 percent of all lower house seats were up for election. Nine legislative chambers in the five permanently inhabited U.S. territories and the federal district of Washington, D.C. also held elections.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，美国44个州的86个州议会院举行选举。在50个州中，约65%的上议院席位和85%的下议院席位参与改选。美属领地和哥伦比亚特区也举行了选举：5个常住人口众多的美国领地共有9个议会院参与选举。

en.s: The 2020 Arizona House of Representatives election was held on November 3, 2020. Voters in each of Arizona's 30 legislative districts elected two state representatives to the Arizona House of Representatives. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including the presidency, U.S Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and state senate. The primary election took place on August 4, 2020.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行亚利桑那州众议院选举。该州30个立法选区的选民各选出两名州众议员。选举与总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州参议院等职位选举同时进行。初选于2020年8月4日举行。

en.s: West Virginia held elections on November 3, 2020. The Democratic and Republican party primary elections were held on June 9, 2020. The 2020 elections solidified West Virginia's rightward shift as Republican party candidates won all U.S. House seats, statewide executive offices and the U.S. Senate seat up for election (all with more than 56% of the vote) while also expanding their majorities in both state legislative chambers.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，西弗吉尼亚州举行选举。民主党和共和党初选于2020年6月9日举行。此次选举巩固了该州向右转的趋势：共和党候选人赢得所有待选联邦众议院席位、全州行政职位和联邦参议院席位，得票率均超过56%，并扩大了在州议会两院的多数优势。

en.s: The 2020 West Virginia Senate elections were held on November 3, 2020, as part of the biennial United States elections. Seventeen of the 34 West Virginia state senators stood for election. West Virginia Senate districts each have two elected representatives.

zh.t: 2020年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，西弗吉尼亚州举行参议院选举，属于美国两年一度选举的一部分。34名州参议员中有17人参与竞选。每个西弗吉尼亚州参议院选区选出两名代表。

en.s: Elections to the Kentucky House of Representatives were held on November 3, 2020.

zh.s: 肯塔基州众议院选举于2020年11月3日举行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Arkansas voters chose six electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Republican President Donald Trump and his running mate, incumbent Vice President Mike Pence, against Democratic challenger and former Vice President Joe Biden and his running mate, United States Senator Kamala Harris of California.

zh.t: 2020年美国总统选举阿肯色州选情
zh.s: 2020年美国总统选举阿肯色州选情于11月3日星期二举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分，50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参与投票。阿肯色州选民通过普选选出6名总统选举人。共和党籍时任总统唐纳德·特朗普及其竞选搭档、时任副总统迈克·彭斯，对阵民主党候选人、前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加利福尼亚州联邦参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Utah
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Utah were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the state of Utah, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2020年犹他州联邦众议员选举于11月3日举行，选出该州4名联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。选举与2020年美国总统选举同时举行，也与其他联邦众议院、联邦参议院以及州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2020 San Francisco Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2020 San Francisco Board of Supervisors elections were held on November 3, 2020, though many voted early by mail due to the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States. Six of the eleven seats on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors were contested. One incumbent was termed out of office, another incumbent chose to retire, and four ran for reelection. The election was conducted with ranked-choice voting.

zh.s: 旧金山监事会选举于2020年11月3日举行。受新冠疫情影响，许多选民提前通过邮寄方式投票。监事会11个席位中有6个改选：一名时任监事因任期限制不能参选，另一名选择退休，其余4人竞选连任。选举采用排序复选投票制。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Montana
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Montana was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Montana. It was held concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2020年蒙大拿州联邦参议院选举于2020年11月3日举行，选出一名代表蒙大拿州的联邦参议员。此次选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2020 Colorado House of Representatives elections took place on November 3, 2020, with the primary elections held on June 30, 2020. Voters in all 65 districts of the state House elected their representative for a two-year term. It coincided with the state Senate elections and the biennial United States elections. The Democratic Party retained control of the House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2020年科罗拉多州众议院选举于11月3日举行，初选于2020年6月30日举行。该州众议院全部65个选区的选民各选出一名代表，任期两年。此次选举与州参议院选举和美国两年一度的选举同时举行。民主党继续控制众议院。

en.s: The 2020 Colorado Senate elections took place on November 3, 2020, with the primary elections held on June 30, 2020. Voters in 18 out of 35 districts of the state senate elected their representative for a four-year term. It coincided with the state House elections and the biennial United States elections. The Democratic Party retained control of the Senate, winning 20 seats, and increased their majority by one, gaining the 27th district from the Republican Party.

zh.s: 2020年科罗拉多州参议院选举于11月3日举行，初选于2020年6月30日举行。州参议院35个选区中有18个选区的选民选出本区参议员，任期四年。此次选举与州众议院选举和美国两年一度的选举同时举行。民主党继续控制参议院，赢得20个席位，优势增加一个席位，并从共和党手中赢下第27选区。

en.t: 2020 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 3, 2020, the District of Columbia held a U.S. House of Representatives election for its shadow representative. Unlike its non-voting delegate, the shadow representative is only recognized by the district and is not officially sworn or seated. ANC Commissioner Oye Owolewa won the election to replace retiring three-term incumbent shadow representative Franklin Garcia.

zh.t: 2020年哥伦比亚特区影子联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，哥伦比亚特区举行影子联邦众议员选举。影子众议员与没有投票权的代表不同，只由哥伦比亚特区承认，不会正式宣誓就职，也不会正式进入国会任职。社区咨询委员会委员奥耶·奥沃莱瓦当选，接替退休、已任职三届的影子众议员富兰克林·加西亚。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Maine
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Maine was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Maine. Republican incumbent Susan Collins won re-election to a fifth term, defeating Democratic speaker Sara Gideon. The race became the most expensive in Maine's history, with Collins spending $23 million and Gideon $48 million.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行缅因州联邦参议员选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。共和党籍现任参议员苏珊·柯林斯击败民主党候选人、州众议院议长萨拉·吉迪恩，成功连任第五个任期。该选举是缅因州历史上花费最高的一次，柯林斯花费2,300万美元，吉迪恩花费4,800万美元。

en.s: The 2020 Massachusetts House of Representatives election took place on November 3, 2020. It elected members of the Massachusetts House of Representatives. Democrats achieved a net gain of 2 seats. One independent, Susannah Whipps, was also elected. Incumbent Speaker Robert DeLeo won re-election but resigned before the new session to take a position at Northeastern University; Ronald Mariano replaced him as Speaker.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行马萨诸塞州众议院选举，民主党净增2席。独立候选人苏珊娜·惠普斯也当选。现任众议院议长罗伯特·德莱奥成功连任，但在新一届议会开会前辞职，转而在东北大学任职；罗纳德·马里亚诺接替他担任议长。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Alabama
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Alabama was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Alabama, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行阿拉巴马州联邦参议员选举，选出代表阿拉巴马州的联邦参议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议员和联邦众议员选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.s: Members of the Wyoming House of Representatives were elected on November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 Wyoming elections. Primary elections were held on August 18, 2020. This election featured the first Libertarian state legislator elected anywhere in the United States since 2000, District 39 Representative Marshall Burt.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，加利福尼亚州举行联邦众议院选举，选出来自该州53个国会选区的53名联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、联邦众议院和联邦参议院其他选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: Richmond, Virginia, held a general election on November 3, 2020. Voters elected the mayor of Richmond, Virginia, members of the Richmond City Council, and several other local officials. The incumbent, Levar Stoney, who was elected in 2016, ran for reelection, facing five challengers. While local races in Virginia are officially nonpartisan elections, four candidates (Stoney, Gray, Rodgers, and McLean) identified with the Democratic party while Griffin ran as an independent.

zh.t: 2020年弗吉尼亚州里士满市长选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，弗吉尼亚州里士满市举行大选，选出市长、市议员和其他地方官员。在任市长莱瓦尔·斯托尼于2016年当选，这次竞选连任，对手有5人。弗吉尼亚州地方选举正式设为无党派选举，但斯托尼、格雷、罗杰斯和麦克莱恩4名候选人认同民主党，格里芬则以独立人士身份参选。

en.s: The 2020 Baltimore mayoral election was held on November 3, 2020, concurrent with the general election. Baltimore City Council President Brandon Scott, the Democratic Party nominee, won a sizable victory over independent candidate Bob Wallace, Republican Party nominee Shannon Wright, and Working Class Party nominee David Harding. Incumbent acting mayor Jack Young, who unsuccessfully ran for the Democratic Party nomination, had become mayor following the resignation of Catherine Pugh.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行巴尔的摩市长选举，与大选同期进行。民主党候选人、巴尔的摩市议会议长布兰登·斯科特大幅领先独立候选人鲍勃·华莱士、共和党候选人香农·赖特和工人阶级党候选人大卫·哈丁，当选市长。曾竞选民主党提名但未能胜出的代理市长杰克·杨，在凯瑟琳·皮尤辞职后接任市长。

en.s: Mayoral elections in Guam were held on November 3, 2020, to elect mayors of nineteen villages in Guam and vice mayors in seven.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行关岛各村镇市长选举，选出19个村镇的市长和7个村镇的副市长。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the U.S. representative from Vermont's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年佛蒙特州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行佛蒙特州联邦众议院选举，选出代表佛蒙特州全州单一国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.s: Elections to the New York State Assembly were held on November 3, 2020 in the U.S. state of New York. The elections were part of the biennial elections in the United States, with elections for the State Senate, the U.S. House, and U.S. president being held on the same day. Primary elections were held on June 23.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，纽约州举行众议院选举，作为美国两年一度选举的一部分。选举还与州参议院、联邦众议院和总统选举同期举行。初选于6月23日举行。

en.t: 2020 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 2020 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia took place on November 3, 2020, to elect a shadow member to the United States Senate to represent the District of Columbia. The member was only recognized by the District of Columbia and not officially sworn or seated by the United States Senate. Paul Strauss won election to a fifth term with the largest percentage and number of votes in his career.

zh.t: 2020年哥伦比亚特区影子参议员选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，哥伦比亚特区举行影子参议员选举，选出一名代表哥伦比亚特区的美国参议院影子议员。该议员只由哥伦比亚特区承认，不会正式宣誓就职，也不会正式进入美国参议院任职。保罗·施特劳斯成功当选第五个任期，得票率和票数均创下个人竞选纪录。

en.s: The 2020 Connecticut House of Representatives election was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, to elect members to the Connecticut House of Representatives, one from each of the state's 151 General Assembly districts. The date of this the election corresponded with other elections in the state, including presidential, U.S. House, and the Connecticut State Senate.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二举行康涅狄格州众议院选举，选出该州151个州议会选区的议员。选举与总统、联邦众议院和康涅狄格州参议院等其他州内选举同期举行。

en.t: 2020 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: The 2020 United States Virgin Islands general election was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, to elect the non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives and all fifteen seats in the Legislature of the Virgin Islands.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日星期二，美属维尔京群岛举行大选，选出一名没有投票权的联邦众议院代表和维尔京群岛立法机构全部15个席位。

en.s: The 2020 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate and United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Lieutenant Governor Bethany Hall-Long won re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行特拉华州副州长选举，与2020年美国总统选举、联邦参议员和联邦众议员选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。民主党籍现任副州长贝瑟尼·霍尔-朗成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2020 North Carolina election for Attorney General was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the Attorney General of North Carolina, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Party primary elections were held on March 3, 2020.

zh.t: 2020年北卡罗来纳州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行北卡罗来纳州总检察长选举，与2020年美国总统选举、联邦参议员和联邦众议员选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。党内初选于2020年3月3日举行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Massachusetts
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Massachusetts were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the nine U.S. representatives from the state of Massachusetts, one from each of the state's nine congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年马萨诸塞州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行马萨诸塞州联邦众议院选举，选出该州9个国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in New Hampshire was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of New Hampshire, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年新罕布什尔州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行新罕布什尔州联邦参议员选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议员和联邦众议员选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the 18 U.S. representatives from the state of Illinois, one from each of the state's 18 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, various state and local elections, and the Illinois Fair Tax.

zh.t: 2020年伊利诺伊州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行伊利诺伊州联邦众议院选举，选出该州18个国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举、各类州和地方选举以及伊利诺伊州公平税议案同期进行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives election in Alaska
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives election in Alaska was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the U.S. representative from Alaska's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections. This was Don Young's last re-election as he died in office on March 18, 2022.

zh.t: 2020年阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行阿拉斯加州联邦众议院选举，选出代表阿拉斯加州全州单一国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。这是唐·扬最后一次竞选连任；他于2022年3月18日在任内去世。

en.s: The Pennsylvania Auditor General election of 2020 took place on November 3, 2020. Primary elections were originally due to take place on April 28, 2020. However, following concerns regarding the coronavirus pandemic the primaries were delayed until June 2, 2020. Under the Pennsylvania Constitution incumbent Democratic Auditor General Eugene DePasquale was ineligible to seek a third consecutive term.

zh.t: 2020年宾夕法尼亚州州审计长选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行宾夕法尼亚州州审计长选举。初选原定于2020年4月28日举行，但由于新冠疫情引发担忧，初选推迟至6月2日。根据宾夕法尼亚州宪法，民主党籍现任州审计长尤金·德帕斯夸莱没有资格竞选连续第三个任期。

en.s: The 2020 Kentucky Senate election was held on November 3, 2020. The Republican and Democratic primary elections were held on June 23. Half of the senate seats (all odd-numbered seats) were up for election. Republicans increased their majority in the chamber, gaining two seats. A numbered map of the senate districts at the time can be viewed here.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行肯塔基州参议院选举。共和党和民主党的初选于6月23日举行。参议院一半席位进行选举，即所有奇数编号席位。共和党在参议院增加2席。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Minnesota was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Minnesota, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the U.S. Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and other state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行明尼苏达州联邦参议员选举，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他联邦参议员和联邦众议员选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.s: The 2020 Tennessee State Senate election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect 16 of the 33 seats for the Tennessee's State Senate. The elections coincided with the Presidential, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State House elections. The primary elections were held on August 6, 2020, with the exception of presidential primaries held on March 3 of that year.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行田纳西州参议院选举，选出州参议院33个席位中的16个。选举与总统、联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州众议院选举同期举行。初选于2020年8月6日举行，总统选举初选除外；后者于当年3月3日举行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the three U.S. representatives from the state of New Mexico, one from each of the state's three congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举，选出该州3个国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期举行。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Tennessee was held on November 3, 2020, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate. The 2020 U.S. presidential election and elections to the U.S. House of Representatives were also held, as well as the State Senate and State House elections. Incumbent Republican Senator Lamar Alexander announced that he would not run for re-election on December 17, 2018.

zh.t: 2020年田纳西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行田纳西州联邦参议员选举，与其他州的联邦参议员选举、总统和联邦众议院选举以及田纳西州参议院和众议院选举同期举行。现任共和党参议员拉马尔·亚历山大于2018年12月17日宣布不竞选连任。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives election in North Dakota
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives election in North Dakota was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the U.S. representative from North Dakota's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年北达科他州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行北达科他州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州全州单一国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同期进行。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the nine U.S. representatives from the state of Arizona, one from each of the state's nine congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年亚利桑那州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，亚利桑那州举行联邦众议院选举，选出来自该州9个国会选区的9名联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、联邦众议院和联邦参议院其他选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 3, 2020, in 11 states and two territories. The previous gubernatorial elections for this group of states took place in 2016, except in New Hampshire and Vermont where governors only serve two-year terms. These two states elected their current governors in 2018.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，美国11个州和两个领地举行州长选举。这些州和领地上次举行同类选举是在2016年，只有新罕布什尔州和佛蒙特州例外；两州州长任期为两年，因此在2018年选出时任州长。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Pennsylvania
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Pennsylvania were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the 18 U.S. representatives from the state of Pennsylvania, one from each of the state's 18 congressional districts. The state's primary election occurred on June 2, 2020. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年宾夕法尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，宾夕法尼亚州举行联邦众议院选举，选出来自该州18个国会选区的18名联邦众议员。初选于2020年6月2日举行。选举与2020年美国总统选举、联邦众议院和联邦参议院其他选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: Ultimate Party 2020 was a professional wrestling event produced by CyberFight's DDT Pro-Wrestling (DDT). The event took place on November 3, 2020, in Tokyo at the Ota City General Gymnasium. It was the second event under the Ultimate Party chronology. The event aired live on AbemaTV and on DDT's streaming service Wrestle Universe. Ten matches were contested at the event, including two on the pre-show.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，CyberFight旗下DDT职业摔角制作了Ultimate Party 2020赛事。赛事在东京大田区综合体育馆举行，是Ultimate Party系列的第二场赛事。节目在AbemaTV和DDT流媒体服务Wrestle Universe上直播，共有10场比赛，其中两场为预热赛。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the 13 U.S. representatives from the state of North Carolina, one from each of the state's 13 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年北卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，北卡罗来纳州举行联邦众议院选举，选出来自该州13个国会选区的13名联邦众议员。选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院选举、联邦参议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2020 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the governor of Delaware, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic governor John Carney was re-elected to a second term, defeating Republican Julianne Murray in a landslide.

zh.s: 2020年特拉华州州长选举于2020年11月3日举行，选出特拉华州州长。此次选举与2020年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。民主党籍现任州长约翰·卡尼再次当选，开启第二个任期，并以明显优势击败共和党候选人朱莉安·默里。

en.s: The 2020 Nevada Assembly election was held on November 3, 2020. Elections were also held in the state for U.S. president, U.S. House of Representatives, and for the Nevada Senate. Primary elections were held on August 8.

zh.s: 2020年内华达州众议院选举于11月3日举行。该州还同时举行了美国总统、联邦众议院和内华达州参议院选举。初选于8月8日举行。

en.s: The 2020 Oregon Attorney General election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the Attorney General of Oregon. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Ellen Rosenblum was originally appointed to the role by former Governor John Kitzhaber on June 29, 2012, to finish the term of her predecessor John Kroger, who resigned from office. She was elected to a full term in 2012 and re-elected in 2016.

zh.s: 2020年俄勒冈州总检察长选举于2020年11月3日举行，选出该州总检察长。民主党籍现任总检察长艾伦·罗森布卢姆最初于2012年6月29日获前州长约翰·基茨哈伯任命，填补辞职的前任约翰·克罗格的剩余任期。她在2012年当选完整任期，并于2016年连任。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Virginia
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the Commonwealth of Virginia, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2020年弗吉尼亚州联邦参议院选举于11月3日举行，选出一名代表弗吉尼亚州的联邦参议员。此次选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2020 United States Senate election in Mississippi
en.s: The 2020 United States Senate election in Mississippi was held on November 3, 2020, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Mississippi, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年密西西比州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2020年密西西比州联邦参议院选举于11月3日举行，选出一名代表密西西比州的联邦参议员。此次选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他州的联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2020 South Dakota House of Representatives election
en.s: Elections to the South Dakota House of Representatives were held on November 3, 2020, as a part of the biennial elections in the U.S. state of South Dakota. All 70 seats were up for re-election. Each of the 70 seats are subdivided in two single-member districts. Primary elections were held on June 2, 2020.

zh.s: 南达科他州众议院选举于2020年11月3日举行，是该州每两年举行一次的选举的一部分。众议院全部70个席位都进行改选，每个席位对应两个单一议员选区。初选于2020年6月2日举行。

en.s: The 2020 Oregon State Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, with the primary election being held on May 19, 2020. Voters in 16 of the 30 Oregon State Senate districts elected their state senators. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including for U.S. President. The Democratic Party kept their majority. The Oregon State Senate does not have term limits.

zh.s: 2020年俄勒冈州参议院选举于2020年11月3日（星期二）举行，初选于2020年5月19日举行。俄勒冈州参议院30个选区中有16个选区的选民选出本区参议员。此次选举与总统等其他公职选举同时举行。民主党继续占据参议院多数。俄勒冈州参议员没有任期限制。

en.s: The 2020 Arkansas House of Representatives elections were held on November 3, 2020. Elections were held to elect representatives from all 100 House of Representatives districts across the U.S. state of Arkansas. It was held alongside numerous other federal, state, and local elections, including the 2020 Arkansas Senate elections. Prior to the election, the National Conference of State Legislatures labeled this as one of many state and local races throughout the country that could affect partisan balance during post-census redistricting.

zh.s: 2020年阿肯色州众议院选举于11月3日举行，选出美国阿肯色州众议院全部100个选区的代表。此次选举与许多其他联邦、州和地方选举同时举行，包括2020年阿肯色州参议院选举。选举前，全国州议会会议将这场选举列为全美众多可能影响人口普查后选区重划时党派力量平衡的州和地方选举之一。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in West Virginia was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. West Virginia voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden, and his running mate California Senator Kamala Harris.

zh.s: 2020年西弗吉尼亚州总统选举于2020年11月3日（星期二）举行，是2020年美国总统选举的一部分，美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参与此次选举。西弗吉尼亚州选民通过普选选出选举人，进入选举人团投票；候选人包括共和党提名的现任总统唐纳德·特朗普及其竞选搭档、副总统迈克·彭斯，以及民主党提名的前副总统乔·拜登及其竞选搭档、加州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Kansas
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Kansas were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the state of Kansas, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年堪萨斯州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年堪萨斯州联邦众议院选举于11月3日举行，选出该州4名联邦众议员，每个国会选区各选出一人。此次选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2020 Missouri gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the governor of Missouri, concurrently with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican governor Mike Parson ran for and was elected to a full term in office.

zh.s: 2020年密苏里州州长选举于11月3日举行，选出密苏里州州长。此次选举与2020年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。共和党籍现任州长迈克·帕森参选并当选完整任期。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the U.S. representative from South Dakota's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年南达科他州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年南达科他州联邦众议院选举于2020年11月3日举行，选出代表南达科他州单一国会选区的联邦众议员。此次选举与2020年美国总统选举、其他联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Colorado was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Colorado voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump from Florida, and his running mate Vice President Mike Pence from Indiana, against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden from Delaware, and his running mate, Senator Kamala Harris from California.

zh.s: 2020年科罗拉多州总统选举于2020年11月3日（星期二）举行，是2020年美国总统选举的一部分，美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参与此次选举。科罗拉多州选民通过普选选出选举人，进入选举人团投票。候选人包括来自佛罗里达州的共和党提名人、现任总统唐纳德·特朗普及其来自印第安纳州的竞选搭档、副总统迈克·彭斯，以及来自特拉华州的民主党提名人、前副总统乔·拜登及其来自加利福尼亚州的竞选搭档、参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.t: 2020–21 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 2020–21 United States Senate election in Georgia was held on November 3, 2020, and on January 5, 2021 (as a runoff), to elect the Class II member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Georgia. Democrat Jon Ossoff narrowly defeated incumbent Republican Senator David Perdue in the runoff election, despite Perdue receiving more votes in the first round.

zh.t: 2020—2021年佐治亚州美国参议员选举
zh.s: 2020—2021年佐治亚州美国参议员选举分别于2020年11月3日及2021年1月5日（第二轮决选）举行，选出代表该州的第二组美国参议员。共和党籍现任参议员戴维·珀杜虽然在首轮得票更多，但在决选中被民主党人乔恩·奥索夫以微弱优势击败。

en.s: The 2020 Miami-Dade County mayoral election was held on November 3, 2020, to determine the mayor of Miami-Dade County, Florida. County Commissioner Daniella Levine Cava defeated fellow commissioner Esteban Bovo. Incumbent Mayor Carlos A. Giménez, first elected in 2011, was term-limited; instead running for the U.S. House of Representatives to represent Florida's 26th congressional district. The election was officially non-partisan.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行佛罗里达州迈阿密-戴德县县长选举。县委员丹妮拉·莱文·卡瓦击败同为县委员的埃斯特班·博沃。在任县长卡洛斯·A·希门尼斯于2011年首次当选，受任期限制不能竞选连任，转而竞选佛罗里达州第26国会选区的联邦众议员。该选举正式设为无党派选举。

en.s: The 2020 United States Senate elections were held on November 3, 2020, with the 33 class 2 seats of the Senate contested in regular elections. Of these, 21 were held by Republicans, and 12 by Democrats. The winners were elected to 6-year terms from January 3, 2021, to January 3, 2027.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行美国联邦参议院选举，参议院33个第二类席位参与常规选举。其中共和党人占据21席，民主党人占据12席。当选者任期六年，从2021年1月3日至2027年1月3日。

en.s: The 2020 Wilmington mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, to elect the mayor of Wilmington, Delaware. Incumbent mayor Mike Purzycki won re-election to a second term. Mike Purzycki first won election in 2016 with 82.2% of the vote. Purzycki faced a competitive primary, winning the Democratic nomination by a 7.26% margin, a difference of 1,019 votes.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行特拉华州威尔明顿市长选举。在任市长迈克·珀齐基成功连任第二届。他于2016年首次当选，得票率为82.2%。珀齐基在竞争激烈的民主党初选中获胜，以1,019票、7.26个百分点的优势赢得党内提名。

en.s: The 2020 Georgia State Senate election was held on November 3, 2020. Georgia voters elected state senators in all 56 of the state senate's districts to the 156th Georgia General Assembly for two-year terms in the Georgia State Senate. The elections coincided with the 2020 United States presidential election, 2020 United States House of Representatives elections, 2020 Georgia House of Representatives election, and more.

zh.t: 2020年美国佐治亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，佐治亚州举行州参议院选举，选出56个选区的议员，任期两年。这场选举与总统选举及其他国会、州议会选举同日进行。

en.s: Several elections took place in the U.S state of Georgia in 2020. The general election was held on November 3, 2020, and the runoff on January 5, 2021. A combined partisan primary for president and all other offices on the ballot was held on June 9, 2020, with a primary runoff held on August 11. To vote by mail, registered Georgia voters must have requested a ballot by October 30, 2020.

zh.s: 美国佐治亚州于2020年举行多项选举。普选在2020年11月3日举行，第二轮决选于2021年1月5日举行。总统及选票上其他职位的党派初选合并于2020年6月9日举行，初选决选则在8月11日举行。登记选民若要邮寄投票，须在2020年10月30日前申请选票。

en.t: 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: The 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia were held on November 3, 2020, to elect the 14 U.S. representatives from the state of Georgia, one from each of the state's 14 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2020 U.S. presidential election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年美国佐治亚州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，佐治亚州在14个国会选区分别选出一名联邦众议员。投票与总统选举及其他联邦、州和地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2020 Baton Rouge mayoral election was held on November 3, 2020, and December 5, 2020, to elect the mayor-president of Baton Rouge, Louisiana. As no candidate won a majority in the first round, a runoff was held between the top two candidates, incumbent Mayor-President Sharon Weston Broome of the Democratic Party and fmr. State Representative Steve Carter of the Republican Party.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日和12月5日举行路易斯安那州巴吞鲁日市长兼县行政长官选举。首轮没有候选人获得过半数选票，因此在民主党籍在任市长兼县行政长官莎伦·韦斯顿·布鲁姆和前州众议员、共和党人史蒂夫·卡特之间举行决选。

en.s: The 2020 elections for members of the Virginia Beach City Council were held on November 3, 2020. Five seats on the council, including the Mayor of Virginia Beach in the 2020 Virginia Beach mayoral election, were up for election in this cycle. While officially nonpartisan, most of the candidates were affiliated with and endorsed by various political parties.

zh.t: 2020年弗吉尼亚海滩市议会选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行弗吉尼亚海滩市议会选举。该届共有5个市议会席位参与改选，其中包括市长职位。选举正式设为无党派选举，但多数候选人获得不同政党的支持和背书。

en.s: The 2020 New Castle County Executive election was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, to elect the County Executive of New Castle County, Delaware. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Matt Meyer won re-election to a second term. Matt Meyer first won election in 2016 with 66.6% of the vote. Incumbent County Executive Matt Meyer and New Castle County Vo-Tech district staff member Maggie Jones ran for the Democratic nomination.

zh.t: 2020年纽卡斯尔县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行特拉华州纽卡斯尔县行政长官选举。在任民主党行政长官马特·迈耶成功连任第二届。他于2016年首次当选，得票率为66.6%。在民主党初选中，迈耶和纽卡斯尔县职业技术学区工作人员玛吉·琼斯角逐党内提名。

en.s: The 2020 Bay County Executive election was held on November 3, 2020. Incumbent County Executive James Barcia ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by businessman Charles Juers, the Republican nominee. Despite Bay County's support for Donald Trump in the 2016 and 2020 presidential elections, Barcia defeated Juers in a landslide, winning re-election with 59 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日举行贝县行政长官选举。在任行政长官詹姆斯·巴西亚竞选连任第二届，对手是共和党提名人、商人查尔斯·朱尔斯。尽管贝县在2016年和2020年总统选举中都支持唐纳德·特朗普，巴西亚仍以59%的得票率大胜，成功连任。

en.s: The 2020 Oakland County Executive election was held on November 3, 2020. Long-time County Executive L. Brooks Patterson died on August 3, 2019, and Ferndale Mayor David Coulter, a Democrat, was appointed to serve out the remainder of Patterson's term. Two elections were held on the same day: one for the remaining two months of Patterson's term, and one for a full four-year term.

zh.s: 2020年奥克兰县行政长官选举于11月3日举行。长期担任县行政长官的L·布鲁克斯·帕特森于2019年8月3日去世。民主党人、芬代尔市长戴维·考尔特获任命，接替帕特森完成剩余任期。当天举行了两场选举：一场选出人选完成帕特森剩余两个月的任期，另一场选出人选担任完整的四年任期。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 3, 2020. Elections were held for Clerk of the Circuit Court, State's Attorney, Cook County Board of Review district 1, three seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County. Primary elections, held using the open primary system, took place on March 17, 2020.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州库克县大选于2020年11月3日举行，选举巡回法院书记官、州检察官、库克县评估委员会第一选区委员、水务管理区委员会3名委员，以及库克县巡回法院法官。采用开放式初选，初选于2020年3月17日举行。

en.s: The 2020 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 2020. It followed a top-two primary held on August 4. Incumbent Governor Jay Inslee, the Democratic candidate, defeated Loren Culp, the Republican candidate by a wide margin. Inslee, who was eligible to run for a third term due to the lack of gubernatorial term limits, initially launched a campaign for president of the United States in the 2020 election.

zh.s: 2020年华盛顿州州长选举于11月3日举行。此前，州内于8月4日举行前两名晋级初选。民主党候选人、时任州长杰伊·英斯利以明显优势击败共和党候选人洛伦·卡尔普。由于该州没有州长任期限制，英斯利符合竞选第三个任期的资格；他最初曾在2020年竞选美国总统。

en.t: 2020 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential election in Georgia was held on Tuesday, November 3, 2020, as part of the 2020 United States presidential election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Georgia voters chose electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote, pitting the Republican Party's nominee, incumbent President Donald Trump of Florida, and running mate Vice President Mike Pence of Indiana against Democratic Party nominee, former Vice President Joe Biden of Delaware, and his running mate Senator Kamala Harris of California.

zh.t: 2020年美国总统选举：佐治亚州投票
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，佐治亚州参与美国总统选举，选民投票决定该州的总统选举人。主要候选人是共和党现任总统唐纳德·特朗普和民主党前副总统乔·拜登，各自的副总统搭档分别是迈克·彭斯和卡玛拉·哈里斯。

en.s: The 2020 Georgia House of Representatives elections took place on November 3, 2020 as part of the biennial United States elections. Georgia voters elected state representatives in all 180 of the state house's districts to the 156th Georgia General Assembly. State representatives serve two-year terms in the Georgia House of Representatives. Primaries were held on June 9, 2020, coinciding with primaries for U.S. President, U.S.

zh.t: 2020年美国佐治亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，佐治亚州举行州众议院选举，180个选区各选出一名议员，任期两年。投票是当年美国全国选举的一部分。

en.s: The 2020 Georgia Public Service Commission election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect two members to the Georgia Public Service Commission, concurrently with the presidential election, as well as both a regular and special election to the U.S. Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2020年美国佐治亚州公共服务委员会选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，佐治亚州举行公共服务委员会选举，改选两名委员。投票与美国总统、国会及地方选举同日进行。

en.t: 2020–21 United States Senate special election in Georgia
en.s: The 2020–21 United States Senate special election in Georgia was held on November 3, 2020, and on January 5, 2021 (as a runoff), to elect the Class III member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Georgia. Democrat Raphael Warnock defeated appointed incumbent Republican Kelly Loeffler.

zh.t: 2020—2021年佐治亚州美国参议员特别选举
zh.s: 2020—2021年佐治亚州美国参议员特别选举分别于2020年11月3日及2021年1月5日（第二轮决选）举行，选出代表该州的第三组美国参议员。民主党人拉斐尔·沃诺克击败了此前获任命就职的共和党籍现任参议员凯利·洛夫勒。

en.s: The 2020 Phoenix mayoral election took place on November 3, 2020, to elect the Mayor of Phoenix, Arizona. The election was held concurrently with elections to City Council Districts 1, 3, 5, and 7. The election was officially nonpartisan. Incumbent mayor Kate Gallego was re-elected with an absolute majority of the vote. Therefore, a runoff election was not held on March 9, 2021.

zh.s: 2020年菲尼克斯市长选举于11月3日举行，同时选举第1、3、5和7选区的市议会议员。该选举正式采用无党派形式。时任市长凯特·加列戈以过半数得票成功连任，因此没有在2021年3月9日举行第二轮投票。

en.t: 2020 St. Louis County Executive special election
en.s: The 2020 St. Louis County Executive special election took place on November 3, 2020. On April 29, 2019, County Executive Steve Stenger resigned following a federal indictment for bribery and fraud. The County Council elected Council Chairman Sam Page to serve as County Executive until the 2020 special election. Page ran to serve out the remainder of Stenger's term.

zh.t: 2020年圣路易斯县行政长官特别选举
zh.s: 2020年圣路易斯县行政长官特别选举于2020年11月3日举行。2019年4月29日，县行政长官史蒂夫·斯滕格因被联邦检方指控贿赂和欺诈而辞职。县议会选出议会主席山姆·佩奇担任行政长官，直至2020年特别选举。佩奇参选以完成斯滕格任期剩余的部分。

en.s: On November 3, 2020 El Paso County elected the mayor of El Paso, Texas, four members of city council (districts 2, 3, 4, and 7), two county commissioners, county sheriff, state senator, and five state representatives. El Pasoans voted for members of the House of Representatives of the United States from the 16th and 23rd districts of Texas, district attorney (which also represents Hudspeth and Culberson counties), United States senator, and president of the United States.

zh.s: 2020年11月3日，埃尔帕索县选出埃尔帕索市市长、4名市议员（第2、3、4和7选区）、2名县委员、县警长、州参议员和5名州众议员。埃尔帕索选民还投票选出得克萨斯州第16和第23国会选区的联邦众议员、地方检察官（其管辖范围还包括哈德斯佩斯县和卡尔伯森县）、联邦参议员和总统。

en.t: 2020 DeKalb County, Georgia Chief Executive Officer election
en.s: The 2020 DeKalb County, Georgia Chief Executive Officer election took place on November 3, 2020. Incumbent CEO Mike Thurmond ran for re-election to a second term. Though Republicans in the Georgia General Assembly contemplated abolishing the position during Thurmond's first term, they ultimately did not do so. No candidate filed to run against Thurmond in the primary or general elections, and he won his second term unopposed.

zh.t: 2020年美国佐治亚州迪卡尔布县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，迪卡尔布县举行行政长官选举。现任行政长官迈克·瑟蒙德没有遇到初选或正式选举对手，无竞争地赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The 2020 Corpus Christi mayoral election was held on November 3, 2020 to elect the mayor of Corpus Christi, Texas. Because the general election did not produce a winner (elections for the mayoralty of Corpus Christi require a majority), a runoff was held on December 15, 2020. Incumbent one-term mayor Joe McComb was defeated by city councilwoman Paulette Guajardo.

zh.t: 2020年科珀斯克里斯蒂市长选举
zh.s: 2020年科珀斯克里斯蒂市长选举于11月3日举行。由于大选没有选出胜者（该市要求市长候选人获得过半数选票），12月15日举行了第二轮投票。只担任过一个任期的时任市长乔·麦康布败给市议员保莱特·瓜哈尔多。

en.s: The 2020 Summit County, Ohio Executive election took place on November 3, 2020. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Ilene Shapiro ran for a second full term. She won the Democratic primary unopposed and faced attorney John Chapman, the Republican nominee, in the general election.

zh.s: 2020年萨米特县行政长官选举于11月3日举行。民主党籍时任县行政长官伊莱恩·夏皮罗竞选第二个完整任期。她在民主党初选中没有对手，并将在大选中对阵共和党提名人、律师约翰·查普曼。

en.s: The 2020 Winston-Salem mayoral election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the mayor of Winston-Salem, North Carolina.

zh.s: 2020年温斯顿-塞勒姆市长选举于11月3日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州温斯顿-塞勒姆市的市长。

en.s: The 2020 Washington lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the lieutenant governor of Washington concurrently with the 2020 Washington elections. The top-two primary was held on August 4, and Democrats Denny Heck and Marko Liias advanced to the general election, which Heck won. Incumbent Cyrus Habib surprised the state by announcing he was foregoing a run for re-election in order to join the Society of Jesus.

zh.s: 2020年华盛顿州副州长选举于11月3日举行，是当年华盛顿州选举的一部分。前两名晋级初选于8月4日举行，民主党人丹尼·赫克和马尔科·利亚斯进入大选，赫克最终获胜。时任副州长赛勒斯·哈比卜宣布不竞选连任，转而加入耶稣会，这让全州感到意外。

en.s: The 2020 Salt Lake County mayoral election was held to elect the next mayor of Salt Lake County, Utah on November 3, 2020, alongside the presidential, House of Representatives and gubernatorial elections. This marked the sixth election to the office since the post was created in 2000.

zh.s: 2020年盐湖县市长选举于11月3日举行，与总统、联邦众议员和州长选举同时进行，选出该县下一任市长。这是自2000年设立这一职位以来的第六次选举。

en.s: The 2020 San Diego mayoral election was held on November 3, 2020, to elect the mayor of San Diego. Incumbent Kevin Faulconer was ineligible to run for a third term due to term limits. The officially non-partisan primary election was held on March 3, 2020. The top two finishers, California State Assembly member and former acting mayor Todd Gloria and San Diego City Council president pro tem Barbara Bry advanced to the general election.

zh.s: 2020年圣迭戈市长选举于11月3日举行，选出该市市长。时任市长凯文·福尔科纳受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。无党派初选于2020年3月3日举行，得票前两名进入大选：加利福尼亚州众议员、前代理市长托德·格洛里亚，以及圣迭戈市议会临时议长芭芭拉·布赖。

en.s: The 2020 Washington Secretary of State election was held on November 3, 2020. Incumbent Republican Kim Wyman won reelection over Democratic nominee Gael Tarleton, the two having received the most votes in an August 2020 primary election. Wyman became the only Republican to hold statewide office in Washington and the entire West Coast. As of 2026, this was the last time a Republican won a statewide election in Washington.

zh.s: 2020年波多黎各参议院选举于2020年11月3日举行，选出波多黎各第27届参议院议员。选举与州长、驻美专员、众议院以及78个市镇的市长选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2020 Honolulu mayoral election determined the mayor of the City and County of Honolulu for the term commencing in January 2021. Incumbent mayor Kirk Caldwell was ineligible to run for a third term due to term limits. The position of mayor of Honolulu is non-partisan. A nonpartisan blanket primary was held on Saturday, August 8, 2020.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2020年檀香山市长选举选出了檀香山市与县下一任市长，任期于2021年1月开始。时任市长柯克·考德威尔因任期限制，不能竞选第三任。檀香山市长职位不设党派。无党派综合初选于2020年8月8日星期六举行。
zh.n: 此条记录的是决选日期，日期依据原文资料框。

en.s: On May 19, 2020, and November 3, 2020, elections were held in Portland, Oregon, to elect the mayor. In Portland local elections, all voters are eligible to participate. All candidates are listed on the ballot without any political party affiliation. All candidates meeting the qualifications competed in a blanket primary election on Tuesday, May 19, 2020.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 美国俄勒冈州波特兰于2020年5月19日和11月3日举行市长选举。波特兰地方选举不设党派，所有选民均可参加，候选人以无党派身份列在选票上。符合资格的候选人于2020年5月19日（星期二）参加无差别初选。
zh.n: 此条记录的是决选日期，日期依据原文资料框。

en.s: The 2020 Ohio Senate election was held on November 3, 2020, with the primary election held on April 28, 2020.

en.t: 2020 United States presidential straw poll in Guam
en.s: The 2020 United States presidential straw poll in Guam was held on November 3, 2020. Guam is a territory and not a state. Thus, it is ineligible to elect members of the Electoral College, who would then in turn cast direct electoral votes for president and for vice president. To draw attention to this fact, the territory conducts a non-binding presidential straw poll during the general election as if they did elect members to the Electoral College.

zh.s: 2020年关岛美国总统模拟投票于2020年11月3日举行。关岛是领地，不是州，因此无权选出总统选举人，由选举人团直接投票选举总统和副总统。为提醒公众注意这一点，关岛在大选期间举行不具约束力的总统模拟投票，投票方式仿照选出总统选举人的正式选举。

en.s: The 2020 Los Angeles elections were held on March 3, 2020. Voters elected candidates in a nonpartisan primary, with runoff elections scheduled for November 3, 2020. Seven of the 15 seats in the City Council were up for election. This was the first election held in the city that correlated with recent changes in election laws, which moved elections from being held on off-years to even-numbered years to correlate with federal and state elections.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2020年洛杉矶市选举首轮于2020年3月3日举行，候选人以无党派身份参选，未直接胜出者进入11月3日举行的决选。市议会15个席位中有7席改选。这是该市选举法调整后首次举行的选举，选举从总统选举年之前的年份改到偶数年，与联邦和州选举同步。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的选举日期。

en.t: 2020 Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2020 Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors elections took place on March 3, 2020, with runoff elections held on November 3, 2020, to elect members of the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors. Three of the five seats on the board were up for election. With the election of Holly Mitchell in the second district, the board of supervisors consisted entirely of women for the first time in history.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2020年洛杉矶县督察委员会选举
zh.s: 2020年洛杉矶县督察委员会选举首轮于3月3日举行，决选于11月3日举行，选出县督察委员会成员。委员会5个席位中有3席改选。霍莉·米切尔当选第二选区代表后，委员会历史上首次全部由女性组成。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的选举日期。

en.s: Stockton, California, held an election for mayor on March 3, 2020, with a runoff election held on November 3, 2020. Despite a strong performance in the primary, incumbent Democrat Michael Tubbs was defeated by Republican Kevin Lincoln in the general election. Municipal elections in California are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州斯托克顿市长选举首轮于2020年3月3日举行，决选于11月3日举行。民主党籍现任市长迈克尔·塔布斯在初选中表现强劲，但在大选中败给共和党人凯文·林肯。加利福尼亚州的市政选举名义上不分党派，候选人的党派不会显示在选票上。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的决选日期。

en.t: 2020 Orange County Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2020 Orange County Board of Supervisors elections were held on March 3, 2020 and November 3, 2020. Two of the five seats of the Orange County, California Board of Supervisors were up for election. County elections in California are officially nonpartisan. A two-round system was used for the election, starting with the first round in March; followed by a runoff in November between the top-two candidates in each district.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2020年美国加州橙县监事会选举决选
zh.s: 2020年11月3日，加利福尼亚州橙县监事会选举举行第二轮投票，改选监事会五个席位中的两个。首轮投票已于3月3日举行，每个选区由得票最高的两名候选人进入决选；这项县级选举没有党派标识。
zh.n: 此条记录11月的第二轮投票。

en.s: Stardom Super Wars (スターダムスーパーウォーズ, Sutādamusūpāu~ōzu) was a trilogy of professional wrestling events promoted by the Japanese professional wrestling promotion World Wonder Ring Stardom. They took place beginning with November 3, 2021 and culminated on December 18, 2021, with a limited attendance for each event due in part to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic at the time.

zh.s: 《Stardom Super Wars》（スターダムスーパーウォーズ，Sutādamusūpāu~ōzu）是日本女子职业摔角联盟World Wonder Ring Stardom主办的三场赛事。赛事于2021年11月3日开始，12月18日结束。受当时持续的新冠疫情影响，每场赛事都限制了观众人数。

en.s: The 2023 Ms. Olympia was an International Federation of Bodybuilding and Fitness Professional League (IFBB Pro League) professional female bodybuilding contest and part of Joe Weider's Olympia Fitness & Performance Weekend 2023. This was the 39th Ms. Olympia contest to be held.

zh.s: 2023年奥林匹亚女士大赛是国际健美与健身联合会职业联盟（IFBB Pro League）举办的女子职业健美赛事，也是2023年乔·韦德尔奥林匹亚健身与表演周的一部分。这是第39届奥林匹亚女士大赛。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Moldova on 20 October 2024, with a runoff held on 3 November. Incumbent president Maia Sandu, who won the first round, and former Prosecutor General Alexandr Stoianoglo, who was the runner-up, contested the runoff, with Sandu winning a majority of votes and being re-elected for a second and final term.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2024年摩尔多瓦总统选举首轮于10月20日举行，决选于11月3日举行。现任总统玛雅·桑杜在首轮获胜，随后与得票第二的前总检察长亚历山德鲁·斯托亚诺格洛参加决选。桑杜在决选中获得多数选票，再次当选，开始第二个也是最后一个任期。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是来源资料中所列的第二轮日期。

en.s: Ultimate Party 2025 was a professional wrestling event produced by CyberFight's DDT Pro-Wrestling (DDT). The event took place on November 3, 2025, in Tokyo at the Ryōgoku Kokugikan. It was the fifth event under the Ultimate Party chronology. The event aired live on DDT's streaming service Wrestle Universe.

zh.s: 2025 Ultimate Party 是由 CyberFight 旗下 DDT Pro-Wrestling（DDT）举办的职业摔角赛事。赛事于2025年11月3日在东京两国国技馆举行，是 Ultimate Party 系列的第五场赛事，并通过 DDT 的流媒体服务 Wrestle Universe 进行现场直播。

en.s: The 2025 Yukon general election was held on November 3, 2025, to elect members to the 36th Legislature of Yukon. A plebiscite on electoral reform was also held in conjunction with the general election.

zh.s: 2025年育空地区大选于11月3日举行，选出育空地区第36届立法议会议员。选举期间还举行了选举制度改革公投。
